Flight in Distress#020.src: Greetings, young adventurer. You haven't seen my glasses, have you?
Flight in Distress#020.dst: Selamlar, genç maceracı. Gözlüklerimi görmedin, değil mi?
Flight in Distress#020.speaker: Baron Axol

Flight in Distress#021.src: The interior of this ship is beautiful!
Flight in Distress#021.speaker: Passenger John

Flight in Distress#022.src: Good day to you, soldier! This will be your quarters for the flight. I wish you a pleasant trip with us!
Flight in Distress#022.dst: İyi günler, asker! Uçuş boyunca kalacağın yer burası. Bizimle keyifli bir yolculuk dilerim!
Flight in Distress#022.speaker: Attendant

Flight in Distress#023.src: You can sleep through your journey here if you have nothing else to do!
Flight in Distress#023.dst: Yapacak başka işin yoksa yolculuk boyunca burada uyuyabilirsin!
Flight in Distress#023.speaker: Attendant

Flight in Distress#024.src: The food they serve here is dreadful! As if it were meant for beasts they transport below deck.
Flight in Distress#024.dst: Burada verdikleri yemek berbat! Sanki alt güvertede taşıdıkları hayvanlar için yapılmış.
Flight in Distress#024.speaker: Passenger Casula

Flight in Distress#025.src: *Sniff*... Have you seen my child? We were in our cabin, and then he just disappeared!
Flight in Distress#025.dst: *Hıçkırık*... Çocuğumu gördün mü? Kamaramızdaydık, sonra birden ortadan kayboldu!
Flight in Distress#025.speaker: Passenger Nancy

Flight in Distress#026.src: I heard that a big ship was approaching from north. I saw it from the entrance deck. I wonder what they are doing.
Flight in Distress#026.dst: Kuzeyden büyük bir geminin yaklaştığını duydum. Giriş güvertesinden gördüm. Ne yapıyorlar acaba.
Flight in Distress#026.speaker: Sub-engineer Akot

Flight in Distress#027.src: Are you here to volunteer to search for the missing child?
Flight in Distress#027.dst: Kayıp çocuğu aramak için gönüllü olmaya mı geldin?
Flight in Distress#027.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#028.src: We only just to set off and there is already an incident.
Flight in Distress#028.dst: Daha yeni yola çıktık ve şimdiden bir olay var.
Flight in Distress#028.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#029.src: His mother informed us that her son disappeared soon after boarding.
Flight in Distress#029.dst: Annesi, oğlunun gemiye bindikten kısa süre sonra kaybolduğunu bildirdi.
Flight in Distress#029.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#030.src: Poor parenting, if you ask me. Alas, we must find the lad.
Flight in Distress#030.dst: Bana sorarsan kötü ebeveynlik. Neyse, çocuğu bulmalıyız.
Flight in Distress#030.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#031.src: Since we don't have any leads, it might be best to ask some of the passengers for information.
Flight in Distress#031.dst: Elimizde hiçbir ipucu olmadığından, yolculardan bilgi almak en iyisi olabilir.
Flight in Distress#031.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#032.src: Most of them will be in the dining area or in the lounge.
Flight in Distress#032.dst: Çoğu yemek salonunda ya da dinlenme salonunda olur.
Flight in Distress#032.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#033.src: Thank you so much for your help; I hope you find the lad soon.
Flight in Distress#033.dst: Yardımın için çok teşekkürler; umarım çocuğu çabucak bulursun.
Flight in Distress#033.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#034.src: Try and find out where the missing child is located by speaking to the passengers.
Flight in Distress#034.dst: Yolcularla konuşarak kayıp çocuğun nerede olduğunu bulmaya çalış.

Flight in Distress#035.src: Hey! Look at that ship over in the distance. It has been following the ship almost since we left off.
Flight in Distress#035.dst: Hey! Şu uzaktaki gemiye bak. Neredeyse yola çıktığımızdan beri gemimizi takip ediyor.
Flight in Distress#035.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#036.src: I know I shouldn't be down here but...
Flight in Distress#036.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#037.src: I love airships, and I have never seen one like that.
Flight in Distress#037.dst: Hava gemilerine bayılırım, ve öylesini hiç görmedim.
Flight in Distress#037.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#039.src: Okay then, I will head back right now!
Flight in Distress#039.dst: Tamam o zaman, hemen geri dönüyorum!
Flight in Distress#039.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#041.src: Thank you so much for finding my child! He will not be leaving my side for the rest of the trip.
Flight in Distress#041.dst: Çocuğumu bulduğun için çok teşekkür ederim! Yolculuğun geri kalanında yanımdan hiç ayrılmayacak.
Flight in Distress#041.speaker: Passenger Nancy

Flight in Distress#042.src: I'm sorry I caused such a worry earlier...
Flight in Distress#042.dst: Az önce sizi öyle endişelendirdiğim için özür dilerim...
Flight in Distress#042.speaker: Found Child

Flight in Distress#043.src: Hello again, did you find him?
Flight in Distress#043.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#044.src: How did he get down there?! There is supposed to be someone on duty!
Flight in Distress#044.dst: Oraya nasıl inmiş?! Orada nöbetçi olması gerekiyordu!
Flight in Distress#044.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#045.src: Thank you so much for finding him. You were the only volunteer.
Flight in Distress#045.dst: Onu bulduğun için çok teşekkürler. Tek gönüllü sendin.
Flight in Distress#045.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#046.src: Hopefully that is the only hiccup in the journey.
Flight in Distress#046.dst: Umarım yolculuktaki tek aksilik bu olur.
Flight in Distress#046.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#047.src: What in good heavens was that? Crew, report!
Flight in Distress#047.dst: Tanrı aşkına o da neydi? Mürettebat, rapor verin!
Flight in Distress#047.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#048.src: Sir! One of our engines blew out! We've lost all thrust on that side.
Flight in Distress#048.dst: Efendim! Motorlarımızdan biri patladı! O taraftaki bütün itiş gücünü kaybettik.
Flight in Distress#048.speaker: Airship Crewmember

Flight in Distress#049.src: Blast it all! We are sitting dead in the water without both engines.
Flight in Distress#049.dst: Kahretsin! İki motor olmadan olduğumuz yerde çakılı kaldık.
Flight in Distress#049.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#050.src: Go check on the condition of the passengers.
Flight in Distress#050.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#051.src: Soldier, go report to the Engineer in the engine room and see if there is anything you can do to help us get moving once again.
Flight in Distress#051.dst: Asker, makine dairesindeki Mühendis'e git ve yeniden yola çıkmamız için yapabileceğin bir şey var mı bak.
Flight in Distress#051.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#052.src: Look if the engineer has something for you to do in order to help.
Flight in Distress#052.dst: Mühendisin yardım etmen için sana verecek bir işi var mı bak.

Flight in Distress#053.src: You must be the 'uman the captain done told me.
Flight in Distress#053.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#054.src: We sure are havin' quite the situation down 'ere.
Flight in Distress#054.dst: Aşağıda epey bi' durum var valla.
Flight in Distress#054.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#055.src: I hafta stay here and man the 'ngines, else she might damage 'erself.
Flight in Distress#055.dst: Burda kalıp m'torlara bakmam lazım, yoksa kız kendine zarar verebilir.
Flight in Distress#055.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#056.src: If ye wanna help 'uman, go on up the riggin' and take a gander at the props.
Flight in Distress#056.dst: Yardım etmek istiyosan 'nsan, halatlardan yukarı çık da pervanelere bi' göz at.
Flight in Distress#056.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#057.src: Ye can get to 'em through the access 'atches in the bridge.
Flight in Distress#057.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#058.src: If'n they're stopped, just hit the breakers that are off.
Flight in Distress#058.dst: Durmuşlarsa kapalı olan şalterlere bas yeter.
Flight in Distress#058.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#059.src: Come back here when ye done. I need ta stay here and keep her cool.
Flight in Distress#059.dst: İşin bitince buraya gel. Burda kalıp kızı serin tutmam lazım.
Flight in Distress#059.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#060.src: Go find and fix the issue with the airship's engines. They are located on top of the balloon through the bridge.
Flight in Distress#060.dst: Hava gemisinin motorlarındaki sorunu bul ve düzelt. Motorlar köprüden çıkılan balonun tepesinde.

Flight in Distress#061.src: In event of shut-down, maitenence must be performed.
Flight in Distress#061.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#062.src: Worker must restart all wooden switches before engine overheats.
Flight in Distress#062.dst: Çalışan, motor aşırı ısınmadan önce tüm ahşap şalterleri yeniden çalıştırmalıdır.
Flight in Distress#062.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#063.src: DO NOT PRESS THE STONE SWITCHES
Flight in Distress#063.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#064.src: Report to Engineer Eric that you fixed the engines.
Flight in Distress#064.dst: Mühendis Eric'e motorları tamir ettiğini bildir.

Flight in Distress#065.src: Thank ye! The 'ngines are back up and running!
Flight in Distress#065.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#066.src: I couldn't have dun this without ye.
Flight in Distress#066.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#067.src: You go back to yer quarters and get some rest. A passen'er like yerself shouldn' have to help the crew.
Flight in Distress#067.dst: Sen kamarana dön de biraz dinlen. Senin gibi bi' yolcunun mürettebata yardım etmesi gerekmez.
Flight in Distress#067.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#068.src: I hope the rest of yer journey is good. I'll let the cap'n know so he can turn her up ta max and get us movin' again.
Flight in Distress#068.dst: Umarım yolculuğunun kalanı iyi geçer. Kap'tana haber vereyim de kızı sonuna kadar açıp bizi yeniden yola çıkarsın.
Flight in Distress#068.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#072.src: All staff report to stations! This is not a drill! All staff report to stations!
Flight in Distress#072.dst: Tüm personel görev yerlerine! Bu bir tatbikat değil! Tüm personel görev yerlerine!
Flight in Distress#072.speaker: Broadcast

Flight in Distress#073.src: Explore the lower deck and find out what caused the explosion.
Flight in Distress#073.dst: Alt güverteyi keşfet ve patlamaya neyin sebep olduğunu bul.

Flight in Distress#074.src: Hol' togetha old girl, ye got this!
Flight in Distress#074.dst: Dayan be koca kız, yaparsın sen bunu!
Flight in Distress#074.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#075.src: Men, hold her steady. We can still survive this! We just need to stop them following us.
Flight in Distress#075.dst: Beyler, gemiyi sabit tutun. Bunu hâlâ atlatabiliriz! Sadece bizi takip etmelerini durdurmamız gerek.
Flight in Distress#075.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#077.src: Look here girls, the meat has come to us!
Flight in Distress#077.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#078.src: Send more in! They can't get all of us!
Flight in Distress#078.dst: Daha fazlasını gönderin! Hepimizi alt edemezler!
Flight in Distress#078.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#079.src: The rest of you all, get in here!
Flight in Distress#079.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#081.src: I heard fighting? Is someone there? I am in the jail cell!
Flight in Distress#081.dst: Kavga sesi mi duydum? Orada biri var mı? Hücredeyim!
Flight in Distress#081.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#083.src: I heard fighting above, well done! Any chance to see those raiders get what's coming warms my old heart.
Flight in Distress#083.dst: Yukarıda kavga sesleri duydum, aferin! O yağmacıların hak ettiklerini bulduğunu görmek yaşlı kalbimi ısıtır.
Flight in Distress#083.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#084.src: I used to be the greatest locksmith in all of Gavel! I was known all over, unfortunately.
Flight in Distress#084.dst: Eskiden bütün Gavel'in en büyük çilingiriydim! Ne yazık ki her yerde tanınırdım.
Flight in Distress#084.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#085.src: These fiends captured me, years ago, and made me create hundreds of keys for their raids.
Flight in Distress#085.dst: Bu alçaklar yıllar önce beni yakaladı ve baskınları için yüzlerce anahtar yaptırdı.
Flight in Distress#085.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#086.src: I am much too old now, but I would love to see them taken down before I leave this world.
Flight in Distress#086.dst: Artık çok yaşlıyım, ama bu dünyadan göçmeden önce onların yenildiğini görmeyi çok isterim.
Flight in Distress#086.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#087.src: My key making gear is stored down the hall, behind the staircase. You can use them to craft a way inside the Queen's quarters.
Flight in Distress#087.dst: Anahtar yapma aletlerim koridorun sonunda, merdivenin arkasında duruyor. Onlarla Kraliçe'nin odasına girmenin bir yolunu yapabilirsin.
Flight in Distress#087.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#088.src: Just look into the keyhole to see how to make them. Good luck!
Flight in Distress#088.dst: Nasıl yapılacağını görmek için anahtar deliğine bak yeter. Bol şans!
Flight in Distress#088.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#089.src: Make the key to reach the Skyraider Queen.
Flight in Distress#089.dst: Skyraider Kraliçesi'ne ulaşmak için anahtarı yap.

Flight in Distress#090.src: So you think you can just come on my ship, huh?
Flight in Distress#090.dst: Demek gemime öylece gelebileceğini sanıyorsun, ha?
Flight in Distress#090.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#091.src: Kill my crew? Interrupt my plunder?
Flight in Distress#091.dst: Tayfamı öldürmek mi? Yağmamı bölmek mi?
Flight in Distress#091.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#092.src: I know how to deal with 'problems' like you!
Flight in Distress#092.dst: Senin gibi 'sorunlar'la nasıl başa çıkılacağını bilirim!
Flight in Distress#092.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#093.src: Fight the Skyraider Queen and take one of her personal treasures with you.
Flight in Distress#093.dst: Skyraider Kraliçesi ile savaş ve onun kişisel hazinelerinden birini yanına al.

Flight in Distress#094.src: Escape the ship and speak to Captain Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#094.dst: Gemiden kaç ve Kaptan Ackbar ile konuş.

Flight in Distress#095.src: Wow, You single handedly took out a skyraider invasion.
Flight in Distress#095.dst: Vay, bir skyraider istilasını tek başına püskürttün.
Flight in Distress#095.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#096.src: And you're a passenger! It's a good job you did...
Flight in Distress#096.dst: Üstelik bir yolcusun! İyi ki yaptın...
Flight in Distress#096.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#097.src: We have no defense on this ship. We are a civilian carrier.
Flight in Distress#097.dst: Bu gemide hiçbir savunmamız yok. Biz sivil bir taşıyıcıyız.
Flight in Distress#097.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#098.src: What is this? A ring from the queen? It looks valuable. You should keep it.
Flight in Distress#098.dst: Bu ne? Kraliçeden bir yüzük mü? Değerli görünüyor. Sende kalsın.
Flight in Distress#098.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#099.src: I still do not know how to thank you... We owe you so much.
Flight in Distress#099.dst: Sana nasıl teşekkür edeceğimi hâlâ bilmiyorum... Sana çok şey borçluyuz.
Flight in Distress#099.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#100.src: Wait! I know! You can have free travel from {p} to {p}!
Flight in Distress#100.dst: Dur! Buldum! {p} ile {p} arasında ücretsiz yolculuk yapabilirsin!
Flight in Distress#100.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#101.src: A private airship owner called Calo owes me big.
Flight in Distress#101.dst: Calo adında özel bir hava gemisi sahibi bana büyük bir borçlu.
Flight in Distress#101.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#102.src: I will tell him the deal. All you have to do is enter his ship and he'll take you back and forth!
Flight in Distress#102.dst: Ona anlaşmayı anlatırım. Tek yapman gereken gemisine binmek, o da seni gidip getirir!
Flight in Distress#102.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#103.src: Oh, and you will also be rewarded kindly monetarily. I will also personally send him the ring, so that it doesn't get damaged on the way, and you will receive it there.
Flight in Distress#103.dst: Ha, bir de güzel bir para ödülü alacaksın. Yüzüğü de yolda zarar görmesin diye ona bizzat göndereceğim, orada teslim alırsın.
Flight in Distress#103.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#104.src: Just head down to the entrance deck, and we are about to arrive at {p} Airbase now.
Flight in Distress#104.dst: Giriş güvertesine in yeter, {p} Hava Üssü'ne varmak üzereyiz.
Flight in Distress#104.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#105.dst: Bize yardım ettiğin için gerçekten teşekkürler!
Flight in Distress#105.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#106.src: Head down to the entrance deck, and get off.
Flight in Distress#106.dst: Giriş güvertesine in ve gemiden ayrıl.

Flight in Distress#107.src: Speak to Calo next to the little ship at the {p} docks.
Flight in Distress#107.dst: {p} limanındaki küçük geminin yanında Calo ile konuş.

Flight in Distress#108.src: Hey there. You must be the Human Ackbar told me about.
Flight in Distress#108.dst: Selam. Ackbar'ın bahsettiği İnsan sen olmalısın.
Flight in Distress#108.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#109.src: I heard what you did on the ship, very admirable. Fortunately for you, I owe Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#109.dst: Gemide yaptıklarını duydum, çok takdire değer. Şansına, Ackbar'a borçluyum.
Flight in Distress#109.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#110.src: I'll take you from {p} to {p} or vice versa whenever you want.
Flight in Distress#110.dst: Ne zaman istersen seni {p} ile {p} arasında götürüp getiririm.
Flight in Distress#110.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#111.src: All you have to do is board my ship. Oh, this was also from Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#111.dst: Tek yapman gereken gemime binmek. Ha, bu da Ackbar'dan.
Flight in Distress#111.speaker: Calo

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.src: Y'see, I got a few things here... look around for a bit, they're all very rare...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.dst: Bak hele, elimde birkaç şey var... Şöyle bir göz at, hepsi çok nadir...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.src: I see that look in yer eyes... Ya interested in something here? It's all 'fa sale...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.dst: Gözlerindeki o bakışı görüyorum... Bir şeyle mi ilgilendin? Hepsi satılık...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.src: ..Say, humie... I ain't mean to alarm ya, but do ya know who that guy sneakin' up behind 'ye is?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.dst: ..Baksana, insancık... Seni korkutmak istemem ama arkandan sinsice yaklaşan o adam kim, biliyor musun?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#005.src: OI! Wake up, you damned miscreant!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#005.dst: HEY! Uyan, seni lanet olası serseri!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.src: Took ya long enough.. Alright, listen up, maggot!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.dst: Amma uzun sürdü.. Pekâlâ, dinle beni, kurtçuk!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.src: We found ya outside of {p}, passed out near some dead body, and... Well, we had to arrest someone for that merchant's death!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.dst: Seni {p} dışında, bir cesedin yanında baygın bulduk ve... Eh, o tüccarın ölümü için birini tutuklamamız gerekiyordu!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.src: And don't think you get to just lounge around all day in your cell. You gotta do work here, or you're getting thrown in the hole.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.dst: Bütün gün hücrende yan gelip yatacağını da sanma. Burada çalışmak zorundasın, yoksa seni deliğe atarlar.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.src: But for now, you’re stayin’ in your cell, understood? Now, stay here, and take a look around your cell. You'll know when it's time to work..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.dst: Ama şimdilik hücrende kalıyorsun, anlaşıldı mı? Şimdi burada dur ve hücrene bir göz at. Çalışma vakti gelince anlarsın..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#012.src: GWAH! Who the hell are you?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#012.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.src: Oh, thank grook, you're just another prisoner... So young, too...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.dst: Ah, grook'a şükür, sadece başka bir mahkûmsun... Hem de ne kadar gençsin...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.src: You just got here, right? Well... I can tell you're innocent... Just like almost everyone else in this forsaken prison...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.dst: Daha yeni geldin, değil mi? Eh... Masum olduğunu anlayabiliyorum... Bu lanet hapishanedeki hemen herkes gibi...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.src: Listen, human... This prison... You couldn't have come to a more horrific prison in the entire world! This place is hellish!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.dst: Dinle, insan... Bu hapishane... Dünyada bundan daha korkunç bir hapishaneye düşemezdin! Burası tam bir cehennem!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.src: The guards here, they're sadistic! They'll pluck random prisoners out of their cells, and nobody ever sees them again! They're trying to kill us all in here!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.dst: Buradaki gardiyanlar sadist! Hücrelerden rastgele mahkûmları çekip alıyorlar ve o kişileri bir daha kimse görmüyor! Hepimizi burada öldürmeye çalışıyorlar!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.src: I'm being serious, human! If you stay here, they'll kill you, too! You HAVE to escape this place, whatever it t-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.dst: Ciddiyim, insan! Burada kalırsan seni de öldürürler! Buradan kaçmak ZORUNDASIN, neye mal olursa o-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.src: Oi, filth! You're comin' with us. Get out of your cell, NOW!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.dst: Hey, pislik! Bizimle geliyorsun. Çık hücrenden, HEMEN!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.src: Are you sure, uh, sir? I don't think I'm supposed to be anywhere today...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.dst: Emin misiniz, şey, efendim? Bugün bir yere gitmem gerekmiyordu diye biliyorum...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.src: Oh, ya think you're smart, trying to resist?? Oi, Jon, block the entrance!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.dst: Ooo, karşı koyarak akıllılık ettiğini mi sanıyorsun?? Hey, Jon, girişi kapat!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.src: H-HEY! WHAT ARE YOU- GET OFF- AAAAAHH!! SOMEONE!! HELP ME!!! PLEASE!!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.dst: H-HEY! NE YAPIYORSUN- BIRAK BENİ- AAAAAHH!! BİRİ!! YARDIM EDİN!!! LÜTFEN!!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.src: OI! Quit starin’ off into space, maggot! Come over to your cell's bars.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.dst: HEY! Boşluğa bakmayı kes, kurtçuk! Hücrenin parmaklıklarına gel.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.src: It’s work time, filth. I'll escort you to the hallways. Once you're there, someone will tell you what to do. Do as they say, and you might come back tonight.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.dst: Çalışma vakti, pislik. Seni koridorlara götüreceğim. Oraya varınca biri sana ne yapacağını söyler. Dediğini yaparsan belki bu gece geri dönersin.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.src: You got that, wretch? Alright, now get out of your cell!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.dst: Anladın mı, sefil? Pekâlâ, şimdi çık hücrenden!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#025.src: Get your instructions from the guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.src: Guess you're the one on cleanin' duty, huh? Alright. Listen up, scum!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.dst: Temizlik görevi sende demek, ha? Pekâlâ. Dinle beni, it!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.src: Take this sponge, and look around the hallways. If you see a mess, use the sponge to clean it up. Someone will escort you back to the cells once you're done.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.dst: Şu süngeri al ve koridorlarda dolaş. Bir pislik görürsen süngerle temizle. İşin bitince biri seni hücrelere geri götürür.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#028.src: Got it? Alright. Now, get to work!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#028.dst: Anladın mı? Pekâlâ. Şimdi işinin başına!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#028.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#029.src: Search the hallways for messes to clean up

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#030.src: Report to the prison guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.src: You're done cleaning? Alright, it's time for rollcall. You're being escorted back to the cell block. Follow me, and don't move.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.dst: Temizlik bitti mi? Pekâlâ, yoklama vakti. Seni hücre bloğuna geri götürüyoruz. Beni takip et ve kımıldama.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.src: Well, well, well... Looks like the dross of society is here on time!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.dst: Vay, vay, vay... Toplumun döküntüleri tam vaktinde gelmiş!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.src: Alright. Stay in line, and don't move, maggots! It's time for roll call...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.dst: Pekâlâ. Sıraya girin ve kımıldamayın, kurtçuklar! Yoklama vakti...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.src: You’re all here… Ha! That’s a surprise, you outcasts can actually follow orders!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.dst: Hepiniz buradasınız… Ha! Şaşırtıcı, siz dışlanmışlar emre uymayı da biliyormuşsunuz!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.src: ...Hm… Looks like we’ve got a new arrival too.. Don’t worry, peon... your soul will be well secure here for the rest of eternity.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.dst: ...Hm… Yeni biri de gelmiş galiba.. Merak etme, zavallı... ruhun sonsuza dek burada güvende kalacak.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.src: Alright. That’s it for now, you worthless menaces. It’s meal time. Head to the cafeteria, and pray that we’re not giving you your last meal.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.dst: Pekâlâ. Şimdilik bu kadar, sizi işe yaramaz baş belaları. Yemek vakti. Yemekhaneye gidin ve son yemeğinizi yemiyor olmak için dua edin.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#038.src: Find a place to sit in the cafeteria

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.src: Hi... Say, could you... do something for me...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.dst: Merhaba... Baksana, benim için... bir şey yapabilir misin...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.src: I'm... starving to death here... those blasted guards won't... let me get any food...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.dst: Burada... açlıktan ölüyorum... o lanet gardiyanlar... yemek almama izin vermiyor...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.src: Please... to my right... There's some food sitting there, if you could get it for me, I'd be... eternally grateful...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.dst: Lütfen... sağımda... Orada biraz yemek duruyor, onu bana getirebilirsen... sonsuza dek... minnettar kalırım...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.src: I... I can't thank you enough, human... I should be able to keep going with this...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.dst: Sana... sana ne kadar teşekkür etsem az, insan... Bununla dayanabilirim artık...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.src: Say... if you ever get out of this slaughterhouse... could you go to {p}... and try and talk with my family, there? Let them know that I'm still alive...? I'd appreciate that....
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.dst: Baksana... bir gün bu mezbahadan çıkarsan... {p} bölgesine gidip... oradaki ailemle konuşabilir misin? Hâlâ hayatta olduğumu söyle...? Çok sevinirim....
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.src: Hey.. It's alright, you can sit here, don't worry.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.dst: Hey.. Sorun yok, buraya oturabilirsin, merak etme.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.src: So... you're new here, right? Hah… Guessing you're innocent, just like the rest of us… and I mean that...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.dst: Demek... yenisin, değil mi? Hah… Tahminim, sen de bizim gibi masumsun… ve ciddiyim...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.src: He's tellin' the truth, new guy. Most of us here are just average civilians. I worked at a transportation company in {p}, and was delivering some crates to {p} when they snatched me just out of town.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.dst: Doğru söylüyor, çaylak. Buradakilerin çoğu sıradan vatandaş. Ben {p} bölgesinde bir nakliye şirketinde çalışıyordum, {p} tarafına sandık götürürken kasabanın hemen dışında beni yakaladılar.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.src: Me too! I don't even know why I was put here at all! I wasn't even given a trial in court, or anything! They just plucked me off the streets and threw me in here!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.dst: Ben de! Neden buraya atıldığımı bile bilmiyorum! Mahkemeye bile çıkarılmadım! Beni sokaktan kapıp buraya tıktılar!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.src: They wanna kill you, that's why. Did ya hear about Revan? He got taken away a couple of days ago, after he accidentally stumbled during roll call. Nobody's heard or seen 'em since.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.dst: Seni öldürmek istiyorlar, sebebi bu. Revan'ı duydun mu? Yoklamada yanlışlıkla tökezledi diye birkaç gün önce alıp götürdüler. O günden beri ne sesini duyan var ne kendisini gören.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.src: I… you're probably right... I just dont understand any of this anymore... I just want to escape this damn place for good...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.dst: Ben… herhalde haklısın... Artık hiçbir şeyi anlamıyorum... Sadece bu lanet yerden temelli kaçmak istiyorum...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.src: ...Good luck with that.. Only way out is through that exit door, and even then you gotta get into the Control Room, as well. It's...just impossible, y'know?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.dst: ...Kolay gelsin.. Tek çıkış şu çıkış kapısı, ona rağmen Kontrol Odası'na da girmen gerek. Yani... düpedüz imkânsız, anlarsın ya?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.src: Alright, meal time's over! Get to your cells, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.dst: Pekâlâ, yemek vakti bitti! Hücrelerinize, pislikler!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.src: ...Well… That's this place in a nutshell for you, human. Just try not to get in anyone's way or step out of line, and you should be alright until they end up taking you.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.dst: ...Eh… Burası kısaca böyle bir yer, insan. Kimsenin yoluna çıkma, sıranı bozma, seni alıp götürene kadar idare edersin.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.src: Oi, who’s this guy right ‘ere? We don’t know ya. Move it!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.dst: Hey, bu herif de kim? Seni tanımıyoruz. Yürü!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.src: ‘Ey, ‘ey, let it rest, Don. They're not hurtin’ nobody.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.dst: Hey, hey, bırak, Don. Kimseye zararları yok.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.src: Don’t worry about it. So... You know who we are, novello?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.dst: Dert etme. Eee... Kim olduğumuzu biliyor musun, novello?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.src: We’re part of the Placido Crime Family. We do business across the entire world; all parts of it, you know what I’m saying?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.dst: Biz Placido Suç Ailesi'ndeniz. Dünyanın dört bir yanında iş çeviririz; her köşesinde, anlıyor musun beni?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.src: Almost all of us at this table got caught for running with the family-... Ah, bet you’re surprised to hear that there are some guilty people up in this slaughterhouse, yeah?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.dst: Bu masadakilerin neredeyse hepsi aileyle iş çevirirken yakalandı-... Ah, bu mezbahada gerçekten suçlu insanlar da olduğunu duyunca şaşırdın, değil mi?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.src: It’s alright, you don’t have to worry about us getting plucked and killed like those other piacevole here. Guards keep on sayin’ something about “our souls are too tainted”, whatever they mean.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.dst: Merak etme, buradaki öbür piacevole gibi kapılıp öldürülmemizden korkmana gerek yok. Gardiyanlar hep “ruhlarımız fazla kirli” diye bir şey deyip duruyor, ne demekse.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.src: Hah! Maybe you’ll get the same treatment too, novello. I saw it the minute I laid eyes on ya. You’re a killer too, ain't ya? Hey, gotta be one to know you're dealin' with one..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.dst: Hah! Belki sana da aynısını yaparlar, novello. Seni gördüğüm an anladım. Sen de katilsin, değil mi? Hey, bir katili ancak bir katil tanır..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.src: ..Anyways... You thinkin’ about staying in this prison, fratello? Word of advice: Don’t. If you can, you gotta escape. You might think it’s impossible for someone to escape here, or whatnot...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.dst: ..Neyse... Bu hapishanede kalmayı mı düşünüyorsun, fratello? Bir tavsiye: Kalma. Elinden gelirse kaç. Buradan kaçmanın imkânsız olduğunu falan düşünebilirsin...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.src: Alright, meal time’s over! Get to your cells, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.dst: Pekâlâ, yemek vakti bitti! Hücrelerinize, pislikler!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.src: But no, you're different. I can see it in those eyes. You just gotta find a way into that Control Room, somehow. And hey, if you do get outta here, go and raise some hell in the Levtus Black Market for us, yeah?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.dst: Ama yok, sen farklısın. O gözlerde görüyorum. Bir şekilde o Kontrol Odası'na girmenin yolunu bulman lazım. Hem, buradan çıkarsan, bizim için Levtus Black Market'i bir güzel karıştır, olur mu?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.src: Alright, look straight, scum! Morning rollcall is about to start.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.dst: Pekâlâ, dik durun, itler! Sabah yoklaması başlamak üzere.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.src: ...you’re all here...? Hm... Disappointing, honestly. Rollcall is over. All of you, head to wherever your job is, and get to work!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.dst: ...hepiniz burada mısınız...? Hm... Açıkçası hayal kırıklığı. Yoklama bitti. Hepiniz işinizin başına gidin ve çalışın!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#070.src: Search the hallways for possible escape routes, and find a guard outfit
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#070.dst: Koridorlarda olası kaçış yollarını ara ve bir gardiyan kıyafeti bul

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#071.src: Report to the Prison Guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.src: You're done? Alright, now follow me. Rollcall is about to start.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.dst: Bitti mi? Pekâlâ, şimdi beni takip et. Yoklama başlamak üzere.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.src: What with you all, showing up late like this?? It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.dst: Bu ne böyle, hepiniz geç kalıyorsunuz?? Yoklama vakti!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.src: You're all here, huh? Alright then, head on to dinn-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.dst: Hepiniz buradasınız, ha? Pekâlâ, o zaman akşam yemeğine-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.src: Oi! Quit steppin' on my shoes, cretino!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.src: Hey! What the hell are you talkin' about, making up something like that! I didn't do anythin'!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.dst: Hey! Ne saçmalıyorsun be, böyle bir şey uydurup! Ben bir şey yapmadım!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.src: Shut it, fat-nose! You know what you were doin'! Now stay out of my way!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.dst: Kapa çeneni, kalın burun! Ne yaptığını biliyorsun! Şimdi çekil yolumdan!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.src: OI! Are you blind, or something?!? Get those lowlifes under control, guards!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.dst: HEY! Kör müsünüz siz?!? Şu ayak takımını zapt edin, gardiyanlar!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.src: You two got some damn nerve, fightin' during rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.dst: Siz ikiniz amma yüzsüzsünüz, yoklama sırasında kavga ediyorsunuz!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.src: W-Woah, HEY! This maggot has a shank! Back up!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.dst: V-Vay, HEY! Bu kurtçukta bıçak var! Geri çekilin!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.src: LOCKDOWN! LOCKDOWN! ALL OF YOU, IN YOUR CELLS, NOW!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.src: You two really are stupid, huh? Fighting in the midst of all of these guards? And you got a shank, too...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.dst: Siz ikiniz gerçekten aptalsınız, ha? Bu kadar gardiyanın ortasında kavga, hem de yanınızda bıçakla...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.src: Well, looks like it's game over for you two outcasts. You're heading straight to the hole!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.dst: Eh, sizin için oyun bitti, dışlanmışlar. Doğruca deliğe gidiyorsunuz!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.src: You, take these two cretins to the hole, and you, go to my office and get one of the spare control room keys. Now, LIGHTS OUT!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.dst: Sen, bu iki aptalı deliğe götür, sen de ofisime git ve yedek kontrol odası anahtarlarından birini al. Şimdi, IŞIKLAR SÖNSÜN!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.src: Alright, everyone get in line, and stand straight! Don't move, or it's game over for you!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.dst: Pekâlâ, herkes sıraya girsin ve dik dursun! Kımıldayan olursa oyun biter!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#090.src: H-hey! Stop pushing me, mate! Seriou-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#090.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.src: Well, well, well... Another peon thought it was wise to step off course..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.dst: Vay, vay, vay... Bir zavallı daha sıradan çıkmanın akıllıca olduğunu sanmış..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.src: W-wait a minute, miss! Someone pushed me out of line! I swear!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.dst: D-durun bir dakika, hanımefendi! Biri beni sıradan itti! Yemin ederim!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.src: BE QUIET! I didn't say you could speak, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.src: Get back in line! Once this is over, you're out, slime!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.dst: Sıraya geri dön! Bu iş bitince sen gidiyorsun, sümüklü!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.src: Steal the key from the warden's office, and head to the control room
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.dst: Müdürün ofisinden anahtarı çal ve kontrol odasına git

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#097.src: Find a way to open the exit door
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#097.dst: Çıkış kapısını açmanın bir yolunu bul

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#098.src: Head through the exit door at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#099.src: Sneak past the guards and find a way to the Records Room
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#099.dst: Gardiyanlara görünmeden geç ve Kayıt Odası'na giden yolu bul

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.src: Oh, thank the bovine! There's a friendly face around here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.dst: Ah, bovine'a şükür! Burada dost bir yüz var..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.src: Listen, human, you gotta get me out of here! They've been killin' people in here all day! If you don't help me out, I'll be next!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.dst: Dinle, insan, beni buradan çıkarmalısın! Bütün gün burada insan öldürüyorlar! Bana yardım etmezsen sıradaki ben olacağım!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.src: Look, next to my cell, on that desk! There's a key! Grab it and hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.dst: Bak, hücremin yanında, o masada! Bir anahtar var! Al onu, bana ver!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.src: Yes, perfect, PERFECT! That's the key, hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.dst: Evet, harika, HARİKA! İşte o anahtar, ver bana!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.src: I can't explain the debt I owe you, human... You have no idea how grateful I am..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.dst: Sana olan borcumu anlatamam, insan... Ne kadar minnettar olduğumu bilemezsin..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.src: Say, what's your name, human? {u}? Alright, my name's Kaetan. Go on ahead and get out of here, I'll catch up. If you do get out of this chop-shop, meet me in {p}, I want to give you something there.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.dst: Söylesene, adın ne, insan? {u} mu? Peki, benim adım Kaetan. Sen önden git, çık buradan, ben arkandan gelirim. Bu kasaphaneden çıkarsan benimle {p} bölgesinde buluş, sana orada bir şey vermek istiyorum.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.src: Huh...? Oh- HEY! The table caught on fire, someone get over 'ere and help me put it out!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.dst: Hıh...? Ah- HEY! Masa alev aldı, biri buraya gelip söndürmeme yardım etsin!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#109.src: Find and destroy your criminal records
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#109.dst: Sabıka kayıtlarını bul ve yok et

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.src: Who are you? Can I help you, human?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.dst: Sen kimsin? Yardımcı olabilir miyim, insan?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.src: WHAT?? Taron, he-he's alive?? And you... made sure he didn't starve in that prison...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.dst: NE?? Taron, o-o yaşıyor mu?? Ve sen... o hapishanede açlıktan ölmemesini mi sağladın...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.src: I... human, I can't thank you enough. Even if he doesn't get out of there, just knowing he's alive is... please, I know it's not a lot, but take this.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.dst: Ben... insan, sana ne kadar teşekkür etsem az. Oradan çıkamasa bile yaşadığını bilmek bile... lütfen, çok bir şey değil biliyorum ama bunu al.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#114.src: Good evening. Can I help you with anything?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#114.dst: İyi akşamlar. Bir şeye yardımcı olabilir miyim?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#114.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.src: M-my son? He's alive?!? Oh, sweet baby bovine, that's...! Where is he??
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.dst: O-oğlum mu? Yaşıyor mu?!? Ah, tatlı bovine'ım, bu...! Nerede o??
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.src: ...the prison, huh? Well... It's good to know that he'll be able to hold on a little longer... Thank you so much, human. Here, take this!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.dst: ...hapishane, ha? Eh... Biraz daha dayanabileceğini bilmek iyi... Çok teşekkür ederim, insan. Al, bu senin!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#117.src: The only way to escape is by heading through the exit door. You'll need to access the control room in order to open it...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#117.dst: Kaçmanın tek yolu çıkış kapısından geçmek. Kapıyı açmak için kontrol odasına girmen gerekecek...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#118.src: The Prison appears to be lying about almost everything they do to the government, and they appear to buy into it, despite all the rumors about this place.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#118.dst: Hapishane yaptığı hemen her şey hakkında hükümete yalan söylüyor gibi görünüyor, hükümet de burayla ilgili onca söylentiye rağmen bunlara inanıyor.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#119.src: It looks like the only way to get out of here is through the exit door..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#119.dst: Buradan çıkmanın tek yolu çıkış kapısı gibi görünüyor..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#120.src: Hey, hey, humie! Yeah, I'm talkin to ya here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#120.dst: Hey, hey, insancık! Evet, seninle konuşuyorum..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#120.speaker:
Merchant
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#121.src: So, welcome to the {p}. You're in here for the rest of your life, short-nose, so no use complaining about it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#121.dst: Pekâlâ, işte {p}, hoş geldin. Ömrünün sonuna kadar buradasın, kısa burun, sızlanmanın faydası yok.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#121.speaker:
Prison Guard
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#124.src: There's a dusty key inside, labeled "SUPPLY CLOSETS"
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#124.dst: İçinde üstünde "MALZEME DOLAPLARI" yazan tozlu bir anahtar var

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#126.src: Some water came out of the shower head.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#126.speaker:
Grook 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿞 󐀂
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#128.src: Looks like there's an inmate being interrogated...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#130.src: It's blocked off, though the holes in the fence are wide enough for you to get something through...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#130.dst: Önü kapatılmış, ama çitteki delikler bir şeyi içeri geçirecek kadar geniş...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#131.src: This must be the exit door..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#132.src: It appears to be completely locked.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#133.src: There's some stuff on the table. It looks like... flesh??
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#133.dst: Masada bir şeyler var. Bunlar... et mi??

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#134.src: You bite back the urge to vomit... was this once a person???
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#134.dst: Kusma isteğini zor bastırıyorsun... bu bir zamanlar insan mıydı???

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#135.src: The book is titled 'A GUIDE TO SOUL EXTRACTION'.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#136.src: It'd probably be best not to touch it..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#137.src: There's some broken bits and pieces of a torture device here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#137.dst: Burada bir işkence aletinin kırık parçaları var..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#138.src: The blade is rusted and completely stained with dried blood..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#138.dst: Bıçak paslanmış ve baştan sona kurumuş kanla lekelenmiş..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#140.src: There's some cheese inside of the crate.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#141.src: This must be the warden's office...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#142.src: The warden seems very engrossed in her writing..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#142.dst: Müdür kendini yazısına iyice kaptırmış görünüyor..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#143.src: You place the cheese on the floor, where the rat had run by...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#143.dst: Peyniri, sıçanın koşarak geçtiği yere, yere bırakıyorsun...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#144.src: Looks like the rat dropped something when it ran away...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#144.dst: Sıçan kaçarken bir şey düşürmüş gibi...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#145.src: You managed to fill your bucket with some water.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#146.src: You throw the water bucket onto the generator...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#147.src: Looks like something popped out of the generator...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#147.dst: Jeneratörün içinden bir şey fırlamış gibi...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#148.src: Looks like you've cleaned up all the messes! You should return to the Guard at the entrance of the hallways to tell him that you're done.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#148.dst: Görünüşe göre bütün pislikleri temizledin! İşinin bittiğini söylemek için koridor girişindeki gardiyana dönmelisin.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#149.src: You're escorted back to the cell block by the guard...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#149.dst: Gardiyan seni hücre bloğuna geri götürüyor...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#150.src: The two of you arrive just as rollcall is about to begin. Some guards shove you into place with the other prisoners...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#150.dst: İkiniz tam yoklama başlarken varıyorsunuz. Birkaç gardiyan seni itip öteki mahkûmların yanına diziyor...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#151.src: You're escorted to the cafeteria by the guards...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#152.src: You're escorted out of the cafeteria and back to your cell...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#152.speaker:
Grook 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿞 󐀂
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#153.src: Looks like that's the end of today... Your top priority tomorrow should be to devise a plan to escape the prison. Finding a guard outfit could be helpful, as well..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#153.dst: Bugün de böyle bitti galiba... Yarın ilk işin hapishaneden kaçmak için bir plan kurmak olmalı. Bir gardiyan kıyafeti bulmak da işine yarayabilir..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#153.speaker:
Grook 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿞 󐀂
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#154.src: [{~}/{~}] ??? Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#154.dst: [{~}/{~}] ??? Pekâlâ! Herkes kalksın! Hücrelerinizden çıkın, HEMEN! Yoklama vakti!

similar.text: Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#155.src: There's a lockpicking kit inside of this crate!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#155.dst: Bu sandığın içinde bir maymuncuk seti var!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#156.src: There's a few stacks of coins inside of this crate.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#156.dst: Bu sandığın içinde birkaç deste bozuk para var.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#157.src: There are some vegetables inside of this crate.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#157.dst: Bu sandığın içinde biraz sebze var.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#158.src: This must be the exit door.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#159.src: This should be the most direct way out of the prison... You'll need to get into the control room to open it, though.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#159.dst: Hapishaneden çıkmanın en kestirme yolu bu olmalı... Yine de açmak için kontrol odasına girmen gerekecek.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#160.src: It's the map of the prison's hallways.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#162.src: Looks like the Warden isn't here during your regular work time... That could be useful later on...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#162.dst: Görünüşe göre Müdür, senin normal çalışma saatinde burada olmuyor... Bu ileride işine yarayabilir...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#163.src: This must be the control room those inmates were talking about yesterday...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#163.dst: Dün o mahkûmların bahsettiği kontrol odası bu olmalı...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#164.src: This room has to be your ticket out of this place. You just need to find a way inside of it...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#164.dst: Buradan çıkış biletin bu oda olmalı. Sadece içeri girmenin bir yolunu bulman gerek...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#165.src: You vaguely remember the rat that had ran by here yesterday...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#165.dst: Dün buradan koşarak geçen sıçanı belli belirsiz hatırlıyorsun...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#166.src: You put the guard uniform underneath your regular outfit. This should help you avoid some suspicion when you make your escape...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#166.dst: Gardiyan üniformasını normal kıyafetinin altına giyiyorsun. Kaçarken şüphe çekmemene yardımcı olur...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#167.src: Looks like this is all you'll be able to find for now. You should head back to the Guard at the entrance of the hallways to tell him that you're finished working.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#167.dst: Şimdilik bulabileceğin bu kadar gibi. Çalışmanın bittiğini söylemek için koridor girişindeki gardiyana geri dönmelisin.

similar.text: "Don't touch me."

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#169.src: Time to take stock of the situation. You need to get out of here, and you might just have found enough out to do it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#169.dst: Durumu bir gözden geçirme vakti. Buradan çıkman gerek ve bunu yapacak kadar şey öğrenmiş olabilirsin.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#170.src: The Warden mentioned during rollcall that there's spare control room keys in her office. You'll have to find a way into her office during work time in order to access the control room.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#170.dst: Müdür, yoklamada ofisinde yedek kontrol odası anahtarları olduğunu söyledi. Kontrol odasına girmek için çalışma saatinde ofisine girmenin bir yolunu bulmalısın.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#171.src: Alright, now, the rest of you, get to work! Rollcall is over fo-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#171.dst: Pekâlâ, şimdi geri kalanınız, işinizin başına! Yoklama bitti, şimdil-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#171.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#172.src: -The hell? Ow, hey! Get off me, you worthless pests!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#172.dst: -Bu da ne? Ay, hey! Çekilin üstümden, sizi işe yaramaz haşereler!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#173.src: ...All of you... Get out... Of my sight... NOW.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#173.speaker:
The Warden
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#174.src: Now that the guard isn't standing here, you can more closely inspect this vent...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#174.dst: Gardiyan burada durmadığına göre bu havalandırmayı daha yakından inceleyebilirsin...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#175.src: It looks quite old, and the vent grates appear to be splitting at their seams... it shouldn't take too much effort to just...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#175.dst: Epey eski görünüyor, havalandırma ızgarası da dikişlerinden ayrılıyor... çok uğraştırmadan şöyle bir...?

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#176.src: Perfect! With the grate off, it's relatively easy to squeeze through the vent opening.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#176.dst: Harika! Izgara çıkınca havalandırma ağzından sıyrılıp geçmek oldukça kolay.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#177.src: These papers on the desk appear to be directed to the Warden.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#177.dst: Masadaki bu kâğıtlar Müdüre gönderilmiş gibi görünüyor.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#178.src: The papers appear to be asking the Warden for...? A quota of souls...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#178.dst: Kâğıtlarda Müdürden...? Bir ruh kotası isteniyor gibi...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#179.src: The signature at the end simply reads the letter D.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#179.dst: Sondaki imzada yalnızca D harfi yazıyor.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#180.src: There are some books stacked up in piles right here.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#181.src: The subject of the books range from the history of the Decay, to spirit magic and... Soul extraction.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#181.dst: Kitapların konusu Çürüme'nin tarihinden ruh büyüsüne ve... Ruh çıkarmaya kadar uzanıyor.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#182.src: It'd probably be best to stop looking through these.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#182.dst: Bunları karıştırmayı bıraksan iyi olur herhalde.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#183.src: The key fits perfectly into the door's keyhole...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#184.src: There are some papers here about the prison's history..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#184.dst: Burada hapishanenin tarihiyle ilgili kâğıtlar var..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#185.src: The papers say that the prison was constructed in {~} AP, and was reserved for Gavel's worst criminals...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#185.dst: Kâğıtlara göre hapishane {~} AP yılında inşa edilmiş ve Gavel'ın en kötü suçlularına ayrılmış...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#186.src: It's also the largest prison in all of Gavel, and receives an enormous amount of funding in order to maintain captivity of their inmates...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#186.dst: Aynı zamanda tüm Gavel'ın en büyük hapishanesiymiş ve mahkûmlarını tutsak tutabilmek için muazzam miktarda fon alıyormuş...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#188.src: It's just instructions on how to operate electromagic appliances.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#189.src: There are a few rusted axe heads in here. The sharp edges are stained with dried blood...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#189.dst: Burada birkaç paslı balta başı var. Keskin kenarları kurumuş kanla lekelenmiş...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#190.src: The screen appears to show a map of the entire prison! It looks like after you head through the exit door, you'll have to sneak through a large portion of the prison to escape.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#190.dst: Ekranda bütün hapishanenin haritası var gibi! Çıkış kapısından geçtikten sonra kaçmak için hapishanenin büyük bir kısmından gizlice geçmen gerekecek gibi.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#191.src: Near the back of the prison, there's a room that holds almost all of the records in the prison... You might be able to destroy your criminal record if you reach it!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#191.dst: Hapishanenin arka tarafında, hapishanedeki neredeyse bütün kayıtların tutulduğu bir oda var... Oraya ulaşırsan sabıka kaydını yok edebilirsin!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#192.src: There's a lever on this control panel that is labeled with the words "UNLOCK EXIT DOOR".
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#192.dst: Bu kontrol panelinde üstünde "ÇIKIŞ KAPISI KİLİDİNİ AÇ" yazan bir şalter var.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#193.src: You can hear the sound of a door opening in the distance... the exit door must have just opened!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#193.dst: Uzaktan bir kapının açılma sesini duyuyorsun... çıkış kapısı az önce açılmış olmalı!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#194.src: This screen appears to show some information about guard patrols and placements in the second half of the prison...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#194.dst: Bu ekranda hapishanenin ikinci yarısındaki gardiyan devriyeleri ve yerleri hakkında bilgiler var gibi...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#195.src: ...The entire area is going to be crawling with guards. You're going to have to sneak through them all in order to escape the prison for good.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#195.dst: ...Bütün bölge gardiyan kaynayacak. Hapishaneden temelli kaçmak için hepsinin arasından gizlice geçmen gerekecek.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#196.src: There's some extremely dark looking metal inside of this closet. You can't tell what it's used for...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#196.dst: Bu dolabın içinde son derece karanlık görünümlü bir metal var. Ne işe yaradığını çıkaramıyorsun...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#197.src: This cabinet has a number of letters between Gavel's government and the Prison.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#197.dst: Bu dolapta Gavel hükümeti ile Hapishane arasındaki birçok mektup var.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#198.src: The government must not care about the lives of anyone who lives in Gavel's northern forests enough to condemn the prison for all of this slaughter.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#198.dst: Hükümet, Gavel'ın kuzey ormanlarında yaşayanların hayatını bu katliam yüzünden hapishaneyi kapatacak kadar umursamıyor olmalı.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#199.src: These cabinets have some criminal records on a lot of the prisoners here...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#199.dst: Bu dolaplarda buradaki mahkûmların çoğuna ait sabıka kayıtları var...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#200.src: Most of these files are virtually empty, save for a select few that had committed petty thefts some time ago.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#200.dst: Bu dosyaların çoğu neredeyse boş, bir zamanlar küçük hırsızlıklar yapmış birkaç kişininki hariç.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#201.src: This box has a few criminal records in here. The first one has your name on it... At least you didn't need to search very long to find it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#201.dst: Bu kutuda birkaç sabıka kaydı var. İlkinde senin adın yazıyor... En azından bulmak için uzun süre aramana gerek kalmadı.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#202.src: There should be something nearby you can use to destroy it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#202.dst: Yakınlarda onu yok etmek için kullanabileceğin bir şey olmalı.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#203.src: You toss your criminal records into the fire. Good riddance.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#204.src: Your record has been destroyed, for now. You can finally leave the prison for good.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#204.dst: Kaydın şimdilik yok edildi. Sonunda hapishaneden temelli çıkabilirsin.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#205.src: This cabinet has a few records on the Warden...but they all seem incomplete.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#205.dst: Bu dolapta Müdür hakkında birkaç kayıt var...ama hepsi eksik gibi.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#206.src: Hardly any of the information is actually filled out, No age, career history, family, or any other information. She appears to be a complete un-person.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#206.dst: Bilgilerin neredeyse hiçbiri doldurulmamış. Yaş yok, iş geçmişi yok, aile yok, başka hiçbir bilgi yok. Sanki hiç var olmamış biri.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#207.src: It's as if she just popped into existence for the sole purpose of being this prison's warden.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#207.dst: Sanki yalnızca bu hapishanenin müdürü olmak için birden ortaya çıkmış.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#208.src: Have you seen the ruins of the mansion out to the southwest of town? It's really something, huh?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#208.dst: Kasabanın güneybatısındaki konağın kalıntılarını gördün mü? Görülmeye değer, değil mi?

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#209.src: Folks around here say it's cursed, and I'm one to agree. That place... it just feels wrong, you know?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#209.dst: Buralılar lanetli olduğunu söylüyor, ben de katılıyorum. O yer... bir tuhaf, anlarsın ya?

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#210.src: One of the weirdest things about it, though... sometimes, when you go near the graves... there's this odd ticking sound.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#210.dst: Yine de en tuhaf yanı şu... bazen mezarların yanına gidince... garip bir tık tık sesi duyuluyor.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#211.src: I'd suggest you stay away from there. Wouldn't want to get cursed by proximity...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#211.dst: Bence oradan uzak dur. Yakınında bulundun diye lanetlenmek istemezsin...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#211.speaker:
Burtur
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#212.src: There you are! Good to see you managed to escape that horrid place!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#212.dst: İşte buradasın! O berbat yerden kaçmayı başarmana sevindim!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#213.src: But seriously, thank you, {u}. I thought I was going to get killed in there! This isn't much, but hopefully it can help you get back on your feet after all of that.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#213.dst: Ama cidden, teşekkürler, {u}. Orada öldürüleceğimi sanmıştım! Çok bir şey değil ama umarım bütün o olanlardan sonra toparlanmana yardımcı olur.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#214.src: Anyways, I have to go now. But if I can ever help you with anything at all, just let me know! I'm forever in your debt, human.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#214.dst: Neyse, şimdi gitmem lazım. Ama bir gün sana herhangi bir konuda yardım edebilirsem söylemen yeter! Sana ömür boyu borçluyum, insan.

From the Bottom#000.src: An'! The best part! The idiot came back with a crumpled wrist and this HORRIFIED look- Musta gotten on the Hive witch's bad side!
From the Bottom#000.dst: Ve! En güzel yeri! Salak, bileği buruşmuş ve yüzünde DEHŞETE düşmüş bir ifadeyle geri döndü- Kovan cadısını kızdırmış olmalı!

From the Bottom#002.src: Ah, hey there, human! I'm certain you've noticed the bazaar down here. It's a point of pride for the Dwarves- biggest marketplace of all the Dwarf cities!
From the Bottom#002.dst: Ah, selam, insan! Aşağıdaki çarşıyı fark etmişsindir eminim. Cücelerin gurur kaynağıdır- bütün Cüce şehirlerinin en büyük pazarı!
From the Bottom#002.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#003.src: Specialty items you can't find anywhere else- All sorts of strange, wonderful, unique things. I've been looking for a few sundry items myself here.
From the Bottom#003.dst: Başka hiçbir yerde bulamayacağın özel eşyalar- Her türlü tuhaf, harika, eşsiz şey. Ben de burada birkaç ufak tefek şey arıyorum.
From the Bottom#003.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#004.src: It's almost all barter, unlike the merchants above that deal in that shiny stuff. Which is...a little unfortunate for me, in a way.
From the Bottom#004.dst: Neredeyse her şey takasla dönüyor, yukarıdaki o parlak şeylerle iş yapan tüccarların aksine. Bu da...bir bakıma benim için biraz talihsizlik.
From the Bottom#004.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#005.src: You see, I'm a historian by trade, but what I'm really after now is some Troll Hair. See, I really like the sme- er. It's good and sturdy for binding books- wait a second!
From the Bottom#005.dst: Bak, mesleğim tarihçilik ama şu an asıl peşinde olduğum şey biraz Troll Hair. Yani, kokusuna bayılı- şey. Kitap ciltlemek için sağlam ve iyidir- bir saniye!
From the Bottom#005.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#006.src: YOU have some? Phenomenal! I can never get it myself- was never much of a fighter. Um, here! Let me trade you that, for...this!
From the Bottom#006.dst: SENDE mi var? Muhteşem! Ben bir türlü elde edemiyorum- hiç iyi bir savaşçı olmadım. Şey, al! Onu sana şununla takas edeyim...bununla!
From the Bottom#006.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#007.src: A Decorative Bottlecap Set! These were hard to come by, but I've got two sets of them anyways. Check them out! You'll learn a lot. Thank you very much, by the way!
From the Bottom#007.dst: Bir Decorative Bottlecap Set! Bunları bulmak zordu ama zaten iki takımım var. Bir bak! Çok şey öğrenirsin. Bu arada çok teşekkür ederim!
From the Bottom#007.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#008.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Decorative Bottlecap Collection]. Dobile is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#008.dst: {p} içinde [Decorative Bottlecap Collection] almak isteyen birini bul. Dobile {~}, {~}, -{~} konumunda

From the Bottom#009.src: Minerals for sale! Minerals for sale! Come get your rare metals! We've got Kanderstone, Wynnic Copper, genuine {p} Sandstone, real Voidstone from the {p}!
From the Bottom#009.dst: Satılık mineraller! Satılık mineraller! Gelin nadir metallerinizi alın! Kanderstone, Wynnic Copper, hakiki {p} Sandstone, {p} bölgesinden gerçek Voidstone var!
From the Bottom#009.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#010.src: Human, you there! If you're interested in smithing, you've found the right place! ...so long as you like drinking Dwarven drinks. I'm looking for bottlecap sets in exchange for these.
From the Bottom#010.dst: İnsan, sen! Demircilikle ilgileniyorsan doğru yere geldin! ...yeter ki Cüce içkilerini seviyor ol. Bunların karşılığında şişe kapağı takımları arıyorum.
From the Bottom#010.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#011.src: What's that look for? Are you new here or something? Never seen a bottlecap collector before? Or is that just your face?
From the Bottom#011.dst: Bu bakış ne? Yeni misin buralarda? Hiç şişe kapağı koleksiyoncusu görmedin mi? Yoksa suratın hep böyle mi?
From the Bottom#011.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#012.src: Wh- That! That's! I! How did you! It...It's in pristine condition! There's not a single cap missing! There's not even any dents from the bottle openers!!!
From the Bottom#012.dst: N- Bu! Bu! Ben! Nasıl! Bu...Bu kusursuz durumda! Tek bir kapak bile eksik değil! Açacak izi bile yok!!!
From the Bottom#012.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#013.src: There's no way you got those in person! You can't possibly understand the significance of what you're holding!! I! NEED! THEM!
From the Bottom#013.dst: Bunları kendin almış olamazsın! Elinde tuttuğun şeyin önemini anlaman imkânsız!! BUNLAR! BANA! LAZIM!
From the Bottom#013.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#014.src: Here! My rarest metal! Take them! Take them and give me those bottlecaps! I've got to complete my collection!! Give it! Give it! Give it give it give it give it NOW!
From the Bottom#014.dst: Al! En nadir metalim! Al onları! Al ve o şişe kapaklarını bana ver! Koleksiyonumu tamamlamalıyım!! Ver! Ver! Ver ver ver ver HEMEN!
From the Bottom#014.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#015.src: ...er. Ahem. I got carried away there. But...those bottlecaps are from the very first Dogun Festival. It wasn't even held in Courag at the time these were made!
From the Bottom#015.dst: ...şey. Öhöm. Biraz kendimi kaptırdım. Ama...o şişe kapakları ilk Dogun Festivali'nden. Bunlar yapıldığında festival Courag'da bile yapılmıyordu!
From the Bottom#015.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#016.src: I'd love to talk about them more, but I can't spend too long on the sale, or other customers might go away. But you got a good deal with that Jasplite I gave you!
From the Bottom#016.dst: Onlar hakkında daha çok konuşmak isterdim ama satışa fazla vakit ayıramam, yoksa öbür müşteriler gider. Ama sana verdiğim o Jasplite ile iyi bir pazarlık yaptın!
From the Bottom#016.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#017.src: Come to think of it, some guy wanted that stuff, but he didn't even have a plain ol' sodapop cap on him! I think he's right close by. Maybe you'd have some interest in what you're selling instead.
From the Bottom#017.dst: Aklıma geldi de, bir adam o şeyi istiyordu ama üstünde sıradan bir gazoz kapağı bile yoktu! Hemen yakınlarda olmalı. Belki senin elindekiyle ilgilenir.
From the Bottom#017.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#018.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy some [Molten Jasplite Ingots]. Dorroc is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#018.dst: {p} içinde [Molten Jasplite Ingots] almak isteyen birini bul. Dorroc {~}, {~}, -{~} konumunda

From the Bottom#019.src: Hm...a human trader? Well, I've heard of you, but I hope it isn't just the standard fare from you.
From the Bottom#019.dst: Hm...bir insan tüccar mı? Senin türünü duymuştum ama umarım bildik mallardan getirmemişsindir.
From the Bottom#019.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#020.src: Yes, I've seen quite a few of your type to this bazaar- Using the community forges and smithing tables in all. You seem to have metals in bulk...
From the Bottom#020.dst: Evet, bu çarşıda senin türünden epey kişi gördüm- Ortak ocakları, demirci masalarını falan kullanıyorlar. Toptan metalin var gibi...
From the Bottom#020.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#021.src: ...but probably ninety-eight out of a hundred of the metal ingots I've seen humans use have been trash quality! Worthless only for practice! I seek only the finest metals, you see.
From the Bottom#021.dst: ...ama insanların kullandığını gördüğüm metal külçelerinin muhtemelen yüzde doksan sekizi çöp kalitesindeydi! Alıştırmadan başka işe yaramaz! Ben yalnızca en iyi metalleri ararım, anlıyor musun.
From the Bottom#021.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#022.src: ...so, of course, you have to prove me wrong by having MOLTEN JASPLITE?! Oh, you must have gotten that from Dobile. Wouldn't have taken you as a bottlecap collector!
From the Bottom#022.dst: ...ve tabii ki sen de elinde MOLTEN JASPLITE ile beni yanıltmak zorundasın?! Ah, onu Dobile'dan almış olmalısın. Seni şişe kapağı koleksiyoncusu sanmazdım!
From the Bottom#022.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#023.src: I've been pestering him for a while about his stock. The metal of the Unseen Blade is very valuable, you see. It's fragile, yes...
From the Bottom#023.dst: Bir süredir malı için başının etini yiyordum. Unseen Blade'in metali çok değerlidir, bilirsin. Kırılgandır, evet...
From the Bottom#023.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#024.src: ...but to wield it is to channel the power of Ockar the Unseen Blade himself! The wartime taskmaster who cowed a hundred demons with a mere dagger!
From the Bottom#024.dst: ...ama onu kullanmak, Unseen Blade Ockar'ın gücünü bizzat taşımak demektir! Yüz iblisi sadece bir hançerle sindiren savaş zamanının o sert komutanı!
From the Bottom#024.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#025.src: Sneaking behind the lines of the enemy, braving blistering heat! Remaining as a shadow, and cutting through sheer earth and magma without flinching!!
From the Bottom#025.dst: Düşman hatlarının ardına sızan, kavurucu sıcağa göğüs geren! Bir gölge gibi kalan, toprağı ve magmayı gözünü kırpmadan yaran!!
From the Bottom#025.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#026.src: ...erm, yes. Anyways! For that, I can give you nothing less than my rarest stock. A Golemlus Power Core. If Qira found out I had this, I'd be worse off than a dead man.
From the Bottom#026.dst: ...şey, evet. Neyse! Bunun karşılığında sana en nadir malımdan azını veremem. Bir Golemlus Power Core. Qira bunun bende olduğunu öğrenirse ölüden beter olurum.
From the Bottom#026.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#027.src: She keeps the secrets of those creatures under lock and key- and it must be the ticket to unlocking that particular mystery. Treasure this, human! It is no mere Corkian battery.
From the Bottom#027.dst: O yaratıkların sırlarını kilit altında tutuyor- ve bu, o gizemi çözmenin anahtarı olmalı. Buna iyi bak, insan! Sıradan bir Corkus pili değil bu.
From the Bottom#027.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#028.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Golemlus Power Cell]. Lodog is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#028.dst: {p} içinde [Golemlus Power Cell] almak isteyen birini bul. Lodog {~}, {~}, -{~} konumunda

From the Bottom#029.src: Right chief, what can I do ya for? I got all kinds'a machines here. One of 'em's gotta catch your eye, y'hear?
From the Bottom#029.dst: Buyur şefim, ne yapalım senin için? Burada her türlü makinem var. Biri mutlaka gözüne çarpar, duydun mu?
From the Bottom#029.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#030.src: I jury-rigged this juicer! Put a lemon inside, give it some, heheh, juice, and you'll get yourself lemon juice in a jiff!
From the Bottom#030.dst: Bu meyve sıkacağını kendim derme çatma yaptım! İçine bir limon koy, biraz, hehe, çevir, bir çırpıda limon suyun hazır!
From the Bottom#030.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#031.src: Or how 'bout this coin-shooter? Turn the crank and this'll spit out any coin-sized object like nobody's business. Just, uh, don't aim it at any windows, unless you really hate that window.
From the Bottom#031.dst: Ya da şu para fırlatıcıya ne dersin? Kolu çevir, para boyundaki her şeyi deli gibi tükürür. Yalnız, şey, pencerelere doğrultma, o pencereden gerçekten nefret etmiyorsan.
From the Bottom#031.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#032.src: ...what? Oh, I see. You think you got somethin' that'll interest ME instead of the other way round. I gotcha. Well, lemme see it a sec.
From the Bottom#032.dst: ...ne? Ha, anladım. Tersine, BENİ ilgilendirecek bir şeyin olduğunu düşünüyorsun. Anladım seni. Eh, bir saniye göreyim şunu.
From the Bottom#032.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#033.src: ...okay. I can't make heads or tails a' this thing. What'd you say it was again? Don't tell me this is some Corkus gadget from that not-so-{p}!
From the Bottom#033.dst: ...tamam. Bu şeyin neresi baş neresi kıç anlayamıyorum. Ne demiştin neydi bu? Sakın bana şu pek de {p} olmayan yerden gelme bir Corkus aleti olduğunu söyleme!
From the Bottom#033.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#034.src: ...a... A Golemlus Power Core...? This... hot DOG! Yahaaah, I'd heard about these wacko golem thingies ages ago, I always wanted to take 'em apart! Aw hell, but this is an opportunity!
From the Bottom#034.dst: ...bir... Bir Golemlus Power Core mu...? Bu... vay ANASINI! Yahuuu, bu kaçık golem zımbırtılarını yıllar önce duymuştum, hep sökmek istemiştim! Hay aksi, ama bu bir fırsat!
From the Bottom#034.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#035.src: Gotta say, for something that came from that Hive it's a lot less purple and black and spidery-all-over than I expected. The complexity...this has gotta be the real deal, but...
From the Bottom#035.dst: Şunu söylemeliyim, o Kovan'dan gelen bir şey için beklediğimden çok daha az mor, siyah ve her tarafı örümceksi. Bu karmaşıklık...kesin hakiki bu, ama...
From the Bottom#035.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#036.src: Feels like someone else made this. That Qira lady doesn't seem like the handsy type, and this is something like {~} mechanics, {~} magic. Just seems out of character.
From the Bottom#036.dst: Sanki bunu başka biri yapmış. O Qira hanım elleriyle iş yapacak birine benzemiyor, bu da {~} mekanik, {~} büyü gibi bir şey. Pek ona göre değil.
From the Bottom#036.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#037.src: Ah, but I'm gettin' away from myself. Tell ya what- prob'ly went through a lotta trouble ta get this, and that means you got guts. You got bravery. You got STONES, human!
From the Bottom#037.dst: Ah, ama dağıttım. Bak ne diyeceğim- bunu almak için muhtemelen epey dert çektin, demek ki cesaretin var. Yüreğin var. Sende ÇELİK var, insan!
From the Bottom#037.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#038.src: So, how 'bout these Ice Drake Scales then? It fits a brave soul like you, it does! Take 'em with pride, there!
From the Bottom#038.dst: O zaman şu Ice Drake Scales'e ne dersin? Senin gibi yürekli birine yakışır, hem de nasıl! Gururla al, hadi!
From the Bottom#038.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#039.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy the Ice Drake Scales. Mastro is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#039.dst: {p} içinde Ice Drake Scales almak isteyen birini bul. Mastro {~}, {~}, -{~} konumunda
