Off the Rails#736.dst: Fruma'nın dertli halkı yöneticilerinin yanılmaz tanrılar olmadığını anlayacak; kendi kaderlerinin dizginlerinin yalnızca kendi ellerinde olduğunu sonunda kavrayacaklar...!
Off the Rails#736.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#738.src: And executed so poetically, too! Think- a titan of House Takshah, slain by merely the poison of House Efelu- even a small Murex Mollusc takes down the mighty rhinoce-
Off the Rails#738.dst: Üstelik ne şiirsel bir şekilde! Düşünsenize, House Takshah'ın bir devi, House Efelu'nun basit zehriyle yere serildi. Küçücük bir Murex Mollusc bile kudretli gergedanı devir-
Off the Rails#738.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#739.src: Well, actually, Murex Molluscs are noted for being quite large for a sn-
Off the Rails#739.dst: Şey, aslında Murex Mollusc'lar bir salyangoz için oldukça büyük olmalarıyla bilin-
Off the Rails#739.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#741.src: Before you take me away, you must admit... my exploits are impressive, no?
Off the Rails#741.dst: Beni götürmeden önce kabul etmelisiniz... yaptıklarım etkileyici, değil mi?
Off the Rails#741.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#742.src: Er... No. I ain't paid enough to care about whatever revolution thing ya were just talkin' about.
Off the Rails#742.dst: Iı... Hayır. Az önce bahsettiğin devrim mevrim umurumda olsun diye bana para vermiyorlar.
Off the Rails#742.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#743.src: Yeah, do you really think any of this is gonna make a difference? Nobody cares about some general. None of this matters.
Off the Rails#743.dst: Evet, gerçekten bunların bir şey değiştireceğini mi sanıyorsun? Kimse bir generali umursamıyor. Hiçbirinin önemi yok.
Off the Rails#743.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#745.src: What does matter, though, is that you just made our job REAL easy fer us.
Off the Rails#745.dst: Ama önemli olan şu, az önce işimizi BAYAĞI kolaylaştırdın.
Off the Rails#745.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#746.src: C'mon, punk, the train's arrivin' now. We're takin' you to the slammer.
Off the Rails#746.dst: Hadi, serseri, tren geliyor. Seni kodese götürüyoruz.
Off the Rails#746.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#748.src: I guess a guy like him could grow jaded against the system. He's a Roughworker, after all.
Off the Rails#748.dst: Galiba onun gibi biri sisteme karşı kin besleyebilir. Sonuçta Roughworks'lü.
Off the Rails#748.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#749.src: Yeah, and he's the only guy who could possibly have unlocked the door to the private cabin, so it makes sense, really.
Off the Rails#749.dst: Evet, özel kompartımanın kapısını açabilecek tek kişi de o, yani aslında mantıklı.
Off the Rails#749.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#750.src: But... I would never kill one of the Queen's servants... Or anyone for that matter! Please! Have mercy!
Off the Rails#750.dst: Ama... Ben asla Kraliçe'nin hizmetkârlarından birini öldürmem... Hatta hiç kimseyi! Lütfen! Merhamet edin!
Off the Rails#750.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#751.src: Heh. I don't think ya did it. But I don't care. We never were specifically lookin' to arrest the actual perpetrator.
Off the Rails#751.dst: Heh. Senin yaptığını sanmıyorum. Ama umurumda değil. Zaten hiçbir zaman asıl faili tutuklamaya çalışmıyorduk.
Off the Rails#751.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#752.src: Yeah, you're believable enough. We'll go with you.
Off the Rails#752.dst: Evet, yeterince inandırıcısın. Seninle devam edelim.
Off the Rails#752.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#753.src: Good timin', too! We're about to arrive in {p}.
Off the Rails#753.dst: Zamanlama da iyi! {p} şehrine varmak üzereyiz.
Off the Rails#753.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#756.src: Yeah, I uh, don' see the angle on this one, pal..
Off the Rails#756.dst: Evet, ıı, bu işte mantık göremiyorum, dostum..
Off the Rails#756.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#757.src: Eh, Roughworkers are pretty disobedient. I think it makes enough sense.
Off the Rails#757.dst: Eh, Roughworks'lüler epey söz dinlemez. Bence yeterince mantıklı.
Off the Rails#757.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#758.src: True... We never were arrestin' based on real guilt anyway, were we? We'll just go with this.
Off the Rails#758.dst: Doğru... Zaten hiçbir zaman gerçek suça göre tutuklamıyorduk, değil mi? Bununla devam edelim.
Off the Rails#758.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#760.src: Heh. Tell it to Oru, bub.
Off the Rails#760.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#761.src: ...Is that something Oru does? Take questio-
Off the Rails#761.dst: ...Oru öyle bir şey yapıyor mu? Soru dinli-
Off the Rails#761.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#762.src: I DON'T KNOW, Harvin. It just sounded cool to say. And now you've ruined the moment.
Off the Rails#762.dst: BİLMİYORUM, Harvin. Söylemesi havalı geldi sadece. Şimdi de anı mahvettin.
Off the Rails#762.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#763.src: ...Ech. Whatever. Train's about to arrive in {p}, let's get this guy to the slammer.
Off the Rails#763.dst: ...Iyy. Neyse. Tren {p} şehrine varmak üzere, bu adamı kodese götürelim.
Off the Rails#763.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#765.src: What? No! It couldn't have been her!
Off the Rails#765.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#766.src: Uh... Yeah, I don' see how it could've been her, bud.
Off the Rails#766.dst: Iı... Evet, onun nasıl yapmış olabileceğini göremiyorum, dostum.
Off the Rails#766.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#767.src: Do we care? We were going to arrest our detective here without evidence, anyway, Maury.
Off the Rails#767.dst: Umurumuzda mı? Zaten buradaki dedektifimizi kanıt olmadan tutuklayacaktık, Maury.
Off the Rails#767.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#768.src: I guess yer right, though it might be hard to spin an Aelumian as guilty... They're pretty well-behaved.
Off the Rails#768.dst: Haklısın galiba, gerçi bir Aelumia'lıyı suçlu göstermek zor olabilir... Epey uslu insanlardır.
Off the Rails#768.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#769.src: ...This is ridiculous! You can't do this!
Off the Rails#769.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#770.src: Must I repeat myself? Do ya want to be put down as an accomplice? Quiet, you.
Off the Rails#770.dst: Tekrar mı etmem gerek? Suç ortağı olarak mı yazılmak istiyorsun? Sus, sen.
Off the Rails#770.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#771.src: Hey, Maury... What if we arrested HIM instead. It'd be easier to explain, no?
Off the Rails#771.dst: Hey, Maury... Onun yerine ONU tutuklasak? Açıklaması daha kolay olur, değil mi?
Off the Rails#771.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#773.src: ...you know what? Yes. Take me instead.
Off the Rails#773.dst: ...biliyor musunuz? Evet. Onun yerine beni alın.
Off the Rails#773.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#775.src: Hands behind yer back, bub, the train's about to arrive in {p}.
Off the Rails#775.dst: Eller arkaya, ahbap, tren {p} şehrine varmak üzere.
Off the Rails#775.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#776.src: Come on, idiot. We're not going to let you accuse US, obviously.
Off the Rails#776.dst: Hadi, salak. BİZİ suçlamana izin vermeyeceğimiz belli.
Off the Rails#776.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#777.src: Even if it WAS me, there'd be nothing ya could do about it. We're the ones with power here. Now go and select one of the passengers, come on.
Off the Rails#777.dst: BEN yapmış olsam bile elinden bir şey gelmezdi. Burada güç bizde. Şimdi git yolculardan birini seç, hadi.
Off the Rails#777.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#778.src: ...You mean to suggest she... No, that's just not possible.
Off the Rails#778.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#779.src: Yeah, why would she? She had important business to do...
Off the Rails#779.dst: Evet, neden yapsın? Halletmesi gereken önemli bir işi vardı...
Off the Rails#779.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#780.src: Well, Harvin, maybe she got tired of her job? That Majin bossin' her around all the time's gotta get tirin'...
Off the Rails#780.dst: Eh Harvin, belki işinden bıkmıştır? O Majin'in sürekli ona patronluk taslaması insanı yorar...
Off the Rails#780.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#782.src: You know what? Even if she did do it, I don't care; we need someone to blame. Now COME ON! Accuse someone already, preferably alive this time!
Off the Rails#782.dst: Biliyor musun? Onun yaptığı doğru olsa bile umurumda değil, suçlayacak birine ihtiyacımız var. Şimdi HADİ! Artık birini suçla, tercihen bu sefer yaşayan birini!
Off the Rails#782.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#784.src: That guy we just arrested? He was STACKED! LOADED! We're gonna be vacationing in the {p} with this kind of money, haha!
Off the Rails#784.dst: Az önce tutukladığımız adam var ya? Adam ZENGİNMİŞ! PARA BABASIYMIŞ! Bu parayla {p} bölgesinde tatil yapacağız, haha!
Off the Rails#784.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#785.src: Don't tell Maury, but I felt like you deserved a small cut of the profits, Y'know, for figuring it out, and all.
Off the Rails#785.dst: Maury'ye söyleme ama kârdan küçük bir payı hak ettiğini düşündüm. Hani, işi çözdüğün için falan.
Off the Rails#785.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#786.src: HEY! HARVIN! Didn't I tell ya not to go and give 'em anything? Idiot!
Off the Rails#786.dst: HEY! HARVIN! Ona hiçbir şey verme demedim mi? Salak!
Off the Rails#786.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#787.src: ...Shoot. Guess that's my cue to leave.
Off the Rails#787.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#788.src: Got a ticket or train pass?
Off the Rails#788.dst: Biletin ya da tren kartın var mı?
Off the Rails#788.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#789.src: A General's trian pass??? But... But you're not
Off the Rails#789.dst: Bir General'in tren kartı mı??? Ama... Ama sen general değil
Off the Rails#789.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#790.src: Okay, okay... Sorry for questioning you, General. Where would you like to go today?
Off the Rails#790.dst: Tamam, tamam... Sorguladığım için kusura bakmayın, General. Bugün nereye gitmek istersiniz?
Off the Rails#790.speaker: Ticket Collector

One Thousand Meters Under#000.src: Read the Help Wanted sign in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

One Thousand Meters Under#004.src: Oh, you're here about the job vacancy? Well, you're a little late.
One Thousand Meters Under#004.dst: Ah, iş ilanı için mi geldin? Eh, biraz geç kaldın.
One Thousand Meters Under#004.speaker: The Secretary

One Thousand Meters Under#005.src: There might still be time, just sneak in to the conference room behind me.
One Thousand Meters Under#005.dst: Belki hâlâ vakit vardır, arkamdaki toplantı odasına gizlice gir.
One Thousand Meters Under#005.speaker: The Secretary

One Thousand Meters Under#006.src: Enter the conference room and listen to the scientist.
One Thousand Meters Under#006.dst: Toplantı odasına gir ve bilim insanını dinle.

One Thousand Meters Under#008.src: I am Ynnos, one of the leading scientists in Gavel. You're here because... Well you read the help wanted sign.
One Thousand Meters Under#008.dst: Ben Ynnos, Gavel'ın önde gelen bilim insanlarından biriyim. Buradasınız çünkü... Şey, işçi aranıyor tabelasını okudunuz.
One Thousand Meters Under#008.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#009.src: Allow me to explain the situation we're in. It's a series of unfortunate events. I study the amazing properties of crystals and other geodes.
One Thousand Meters Under#009.dst: İçinde bulunduğumuz durumu açıklayayım. Talihsiz olaylar zinciri. Kristallerin ve diğer jeotlerin muhteşem özelliklerini inceliyorum.
One Thousand Meters Under#009.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#010.src: I am funded by a private organization, however that seems to have stopped. So... We had to make cuts in the budget.
One Thousand Meters Under#010.dst: Özel bir kuruluş tarafından finanse ediliyorum, ama o destek kesilmiş gibi görünüyor. Yani... Bütçede kesintiye gitmek zorunda kaldık.
One Thousand Meters Under#010.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#011.src: One of these, was using cheaper rope. While moving the crystal across {p}, well, it snapped. The crystal fell.
One Thousand Meters Under#011.dst: Bunlardan biri daha ucuz halat kullanmaktı. Kristali {p} üzerinden taşırken, şey, halat koptu. Kristal düştü.
One Thousand Meters Under#011.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#012.src: I can not stress the value of that crystal. It had many unique properties that are allowing me to understand why the {p} float the way they do.
One Thousand Meters Under#012.dst: O kristalin değerini ne kadar vurgulasam az. {p} adalarının neden böyle süzüldüğünü anlamamı sağlayan pek çok eşsiz özelliği vardı.
One Thousand Meters Under#012.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#013.src: They hold the very key to restoring this land to being whole once more... But it's gone.
One Thousand Meters Under#013.dst: Bu toprakları yeniden bütün hâle getirmenin anahtarı onlarda... Ama kristal gitti.
One Thousand Meters Under#013.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#014.src: Fortunately, I detected an impact. It's hit something down in the void. We're not sure what, however or how deep.
One Thousand Meters Under#014.dst: Neyse ki bir çarpma tespit ettim. Aşağıda, boşlukta bir şeye çarpmış. Neye ya da ne kadar derinde olduğunu bilmiyoruz ama.
One Thousand Meters Under#014.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#015.src: Your mission will be to retrieve the crystal in a specially designed ship to withstand the void. We barely scraped it out of the budget, so try to bring it back in one piece.
One Thousand Meters Under#015.dst: Göreviniz boşluğa dayanmak için özel tasarlanmış bir gemiyle kristali geri getirmek. Gemiyi bütçeden zar zor çıkardık, o yüzden onu sağlam getirmeye çalışın.
One Thousand Meters Under#015.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#016.src: If you think you are not up for the challenge, leave now...
One Thousand Meters Under#016.dst: Bu işe hazır olmadığınızı düşünüyorsanız hemen gidin...
One Thousand Meters Under#016.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#017.src: When you think you are ready, exit the room behind me and meet me at the dock as soon as possible.
One Thousand Meters Under#017.dst: Hazır olduğunuzda arkamdaki odadan çıkın ve en kısa sürede beni rıhtımda bulun.
One Thousand Meters Under#017.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#019.src: Wait for the submarine to arrive at the void islands.

One Thousand Meters Under#021.src: This is the ship's mechanic. There appears to be a fault on the lower deck. I request urgent assistance.
One Thousand Meters Under#021.dst: Ben geminin teknisyeniyim. Alt güvertede bir arıza var gibi görünüyor. Acil yardım istiyorum.
One Thousand Meters Under#021.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#022.src: I wonder what the mechanic is doing?
One Thousand Meters Under#022.speaker: Arlene

One Thousand Meters Under#023.src: He has been screaming and crying for a while now. I hope everything is alright down there.
One Thousand Meters Under#023.dst: Bir süredir bağırıp ağlıyor. Umarım aşağıda her şey yolundadır.
One Thousand Meters Under#023.speaker: Arlene

One Thousand Meters Under#024.src: Ah finally! One of the air pipes has shattered, we need to patch it up ASAP!
One Thousand Meters Under#024.dst: Ah, nihayet! Hava borularından biri parçalandı, hemen yamamamız lazım!
One Thousand Meters Under#024.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#025.src: Quick, head into the room behind me and line up the white glass with the blue blocks. I'll control things from here!
One Thousand Meters Under#025.dst: Çabuk, arkamdaki odaya gir ve beyaz camı mavi bloklarla hizala. Ben buradan kontrol ederim!
One Thousand Meters Under#025.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#026.src: Take a nap in the resting room.

One Thousand Meters Under#027.src: Oh wow, thanks for the help! You should head up to the resting room and take a nap before we arrive at the first island.
One Thousand Meters Under#027.dst: Vay be, yardımın için sağ ol! İlk adaya varmadan önce dinlenme odasına çıkıp biraz kestirmelisin.
One Thousand Meters Under#027.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#028.src: Talk to the captain outside of the submarine.

One Thousand Meters Under#029.src: We have encountered out first island, {~}m down. Crew members, climb up the ladder and search the island for the crystal.
One Thousand Meters Under#029.dst: İlk adamıza ulaştık, {~} m derinlikte. Mürettebat, merdivenden çıkın ve adada kristali arayın.
One Thousand Meters Under#029.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#030.src: We've arrived at the next void island.
One Thousand Meters Under#030.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#031.src: The void islands are really different from Gavel... Or are we still even in Gavel?
One Thousand Meters Under#031.dst: Boşluk adaları Gavel'dan çok farklı... Yoksa hâlâ Gavel'da mıyız ki?
One Thousand Meters Under#031.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#032.src: Anyway, let's explore the island, look for the void crystal, and return to {p}!
One Thousand Meters Under#032.dst: Neyse, adayı keşfedelim, boşluk kristalini arayalım ve {p} bölgesine dönelim!
One Thousand Meters Under#032.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#033.src: Explore the island and look for the crystal.

One Thousand Meters Under#034.src: Return to the submarine and continue your journey.
One Thousand Meters Under#034.dst: Denizaltına dön ve yolculuğuna devam et.

One Thousand Meters Under#036.src: Oh my, what are these creatures!?
One Thousand Meters Under#036.dst: Aman tanrım, bu yaratıklar da ne!?
One Thousand Meters Under#036.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#037.src: They are attacking the windshield in the front room, it looks like it's about to break at any moment!
One Thousand Meters Under#037.dst: Ön odadaki ön cama saldırıyorlar, her an kırılacak gibi!
One Thousand Meters Under#037.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#038.src: Quick, you! Come into the cockpit and press on the window to scare them off!
One Thousand Meters Under#038.dst: Çabuk, sen! Kokpite gel ve onları korkutmak için cama bastır!
One Thousand Meters Under#038.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#039.src: This is not good, the creatures destroyed part of the windshield.
One Thousand Meters Under#039.dst: Durum hiç iyi değil, yaratıklar ön camın bir kısmını parçaladı.
One Thousand Meters Under#039.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#040.src: We can't continue much longer with a broken windshield, we'll have to repair it at another island.
One Thousand Meters Under#040.dst: Kırık bir ön camla daha fazla devam edemeyiz, başka bir adada tamir etmemiz gerekecek.
One Thousand Meters Under#040.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#041.src: Ynnos said the void has pockets of toxic gas... Go take a nap, I'll wake you up when we're there.
One Thousand Meters Under#041.dst: Ynnos boşlukta zehirli gaz cepleri olduğunu söylemişti... Git biraz kestir, varınca seni uyandırırım.
One Thousand Meters Under#041.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#043.src: Meet up with the captain outside the submarine.

One Thousand Meters Under#044.src: Attention crew. We have arrived at the second island, {~}m down. We cannot progress without making some emergency repairs.
One Thousand Meters Under#044.dst: Mürettebatın dikkatine. İkinci adaya vardık, {~} m derinlikte. Acil tamirat yapmadan ilerleyemeyiz.
One Thousand Meters Under#044.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#045.src: Crew, please disembark and search resources to help repair the ship. We need glass and some kind of glue.
One Thousand Meters Under#045.dst: Mürettebat, lütfen gemiden inin ve gemiyi tamir etmek için malzeme arayın. Cam ve bir çeşit yapıştırıcı lazım.
One Thousand Meters Under#045.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#046.src: The void creatures did heavy damage to our craft, we need to repair the submarine.
One Thousand Meters Under#046.dst: Boşluk yaratıkları aracımıza ağır hasar verdi, denizaltıyı tamir etmemiz gerek.
One Thousand Meters Under#046.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#047.src: I'm not sure what we'll find here, but we'll need some glue and glass...
One Thousand Meters Under#047.dst: Burada ne bulacağımızdan emin değilim ama biraz yapıştırıcı ve cam lazım...
One Thousand Meters Under#047.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#048.src: I doubt we'll find those exact things, so get resourceful!
One Thousand Meters Under#048.dst: Tam olarak bunları bulacağımızdan şüpheliyim, o yüzden yaratıcı olun!
One Thousand Meters Under#048.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#049.src: Bring me [{~} Sand Substitutes] and [{~} Glue Substitutes], that should be enough.
One Thousand Meters Under#049.dst: Bana [{~} Sand Substitutes] ve [{~} Glue Substitutes] getir, bu kadarı yeter.
One Thousand Meters Under#049.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#050.src: Find [{~} Sand] and [{~} Glue] on the void island.
One Thousand Meters Under#050.dst: Boşluk adasında [{~} Sand] ve [{~} Glue] bul.

One Thousand Meters Under#051.src: Ech! What is this stuff? Well, this should do the trick.
One Thousand Meters Under#051.dst: Iyy! Bu da ne böyle? Neyse, iş görür.
One Thousand Meters Under#051.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#052.src: Me and the mechanic will start repairing. It'll take a while, so enter the submarine and rest up.
One Thousand Meters Under#052.dst: Teknisyenle ben tamire başlayacağız. Biraz sürer, o yüzden denizaltına gir ve dinlen.
One Thousand Meters Under#052.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#053.src: We'll continue the trip when we've repaired the ship.
One Thousand Meters Under#053.dst: Gemiyi tamir edince yolculuğa devam ederiz.
One Thousand Meters Under#053.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#055.src: This is the mechanic, requesting urgent assistence in the basement!
One Thousand Meters Under#055.dst: Ben teknisyen, bodrumda acil yardım istiyorum!
One Thousand Meters Under#055.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#056.src: Toxic gas has leaked in through the submarine's vents, someone will have to manually close them.
One Thousand Meters Under#056.dst: Zehirli gaz denizaltının havalandırmalarından içeri sızdı, birinin onları elle kapatması lazım!
One Thousand Meters Under#056.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#057.src: I'll control things from here, someone get down to the lowest level and close those vents!
One Thousand Meters Under#057.dst: Ben buradan kontrol ederim, biri en alt kata insin ve o havalandırmaları kapatsın!
One Thousand Meters Under#057.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#058.src: Attention crew. We have arrived at the next island {~}m down.
One Thousand Meters Under#058.dst: Mürettebatın dikkatine. Sıradaki adaya vardık, {~} m derinlikte.
One Thousand Meters Under#058.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#059.src: Disembark and start the search for the crystal.
One Thousand Meters Under#059.dst: Gemiden inin ve kristali aramaya başlayın.
One Thousand Meters Under#059.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#060.src: Let's hope it's here... I don't know how much more void my body can handle.
One Thousand Meters Under#060.dst: Umarım buradadır... Vücudum daha ne kadar boşluğa dayanır bilmiyorum.
One Thousand Meters Under#060.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#061.src: Look out! {u}, we'll build a bridge to the other island whilst you defend us from the mobs!
One Thousand Meters Under#061.dst: Dikkat! {u}, sen bizi yaratıklardan korurken biz diğer adaya bir köprü kuracağız!
One Thousand Meters Under#061.speaker: Rex

One Thousand Meters Under#063.src: Keep fighting! We're almost halfway to the other side!
One Thousand Meters Under#063.dst: Savaşmaya devam! Karşıya yarı yola geldik sayılır!
One Thousand Meters Under#063.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#066.src: Return to the submarine and continue the journey.
One Thousand Meters Under#066.dst: Denizaltına dön ve yolculuğa devam et.

One Thousand Meters Under#067.src: We didn't find the crystal here either. Maybe it just fell in the void?
One Thousand Meters Under#067.dst: Kristali burada da bulamadık. Belki de boşluğa düşüp gitmiştir?
One Thousand Meters Under#067.speaker: Rex

One Thousand Meters Under#068.src: No, it must have hit an island. The scientist said he detected a collision.
One Thousand Meters Under#068.dst: Hayır, bir adaya çarpmış olmalı. Bilim insanı bir çarpışma tespit ettiğini söyledi.
One Thousand Meters Under#068.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#070.src: The ropes are snapping! Quick! Abandon ship!
One Thousand Meters Under#070.dst: Halatlar kopuyor! Çabuk! Gemiyi terk edin!
One Thousand Meters Under#070.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#074.src: Someone dropped a boooook about you people! Warriors! Workers!
One Thousand Meters Under#074.dst: Biri sizin hakkınızda bir kitaaaap düşürdü! Savaşçılar! İşçiler!
One Thousand Meters Under#074.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#075.src: Ah. Yoooou want to know about this place?
One Thousand Meters Under#075.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#076.src: Well... We were once Villagers. I think we still are, a bit.
One Thousand Meters Under#076.dst: Şey... Bir zamanlar Köylüydük. Sanırım hâlâ biraz öyleyiz.
One Thousand Meters Under#076.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#077.src: For some reason, {~} years agoooo. The sky islands ruptured.
One Thousand Meters Under#077.dst: Bir sebepten, {~} yıl öncee. Gökyüzü adaları parçalandı.
One Thousand Meters Under#077.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#078.src: Some stayed. Others fell. We somehow survived the fall into the vooooid.
One Thousand Meters Under#078.dst: Bazıları kaldı. Bazıları düştü. Biz bir şekilde boşluğa düşüşten sağ çıktııık.
One Thousand Meters Under#078.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#079.src: How we have lived for so long, I doooo not know. But one thing we know for sure. The void provides.
One Thousand Meters Under#079.dst: Bunca zamandır nasıl yaşadık, bilmiyoruuum. Ama kesin bildiğimiz bir şey var. Boşluk verir.
One Thousand Meters Under#079.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#080.src: We are stuck here now. The void has forever changed our physiology.
One Thousand Meters Under#080.dst: Artık burada mahsur kaldık. Boşluk bedenimizi sonsuza dek değiştirdi.
One Thousand Meters Under#080.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#081.src: The crystal yoooou are looking for fell on this island. But...
One Thousand Meters Under#081.dst: Aradığın kristal bu adaya düştü. Aaama...
One Thousand Meters Under#081.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#082.src: We need it. It will aid us for years.
One Thousand Meters Under#082.dst: Ona ihtiyacımız var. Yıllarca işimize yarayacak.
One Thousand Meters Under#082.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#083.src: We have very limited resources here. That's why a power source like this is soooo valuable.
One Thousand Meters Under#083.dst: Burada kaynaklarımız çok kısıtlı. O yüzden böyle bir güç kaynağı çooook değerli.
One Thousand Meters Under#083.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#084.src: If you go to the east, you will find Rontaid, our chief scientist. He'll know what to doooo.
One Thousand Meters Under#084.dst: Doğuya gidersen baş bilim insanımız Rontaid'i bulursun. O ne yapılacağını bilir.
One Thousand Meters Under#084.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#085.src: Talk to Rontaid outside the town at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

One Thousand Meters Under#087.src: Well, looks like the book we found wasn't fiction after all!
One Thousand Meters Under#087.dst: Bak sen, bulduğumuz kitap uydurma değilmiş meğer!
One Thousand Meters Under#087.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#088.src: This crystal is going toooo be our saviour. I was trying to create one of my own, you know.
One Thousand Meters Under#088.dst: Bu kristal bizim kurtarıcımız olacaaak. Biliyor musun, kendi kristalimi yapmaya çalışıyordum.
One Thousand Meters Under#088.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#089.src: I think I have the formula, but we don't have what we need to make it.
One Thousand Meters Under#089.dst: Sanırım formül bende ama yapmak için gerekenler elimizde yok.
One Thousand Meters Under#089.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#090.src: Instead of taking this crystal back, why don't I exchange it for the recipe?
One Thousand Meters Under#090.dst: Bu kristali geri almak yerine onu tarifle takas etsek nasıl olur?
One Thousand Meters Under#090.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#091.src: That way, you can make however many crystals youuuu want, and we can keep this one.
One Thousand Meters Under#091.dst: Böylece istediğin kadar kristal yapabilirsiiin, biz de bunu saklarız.
One Thousand Meters Under#091.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#092.src: Here's the recipe, give it to a scientist or someone a bit...smarter than yourself. No offense.
One Thousand Meters Under#092.dst: Al tarif, bunu bir bilim insanına ya da senden biraz... daha akıllı birine ver. Alınma.
One Thousand Meters Under#092.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#093.src: A platform was lowered from the surface a while ago at your crash site, as well. If youuuu wish to return, follow this path, I made a shortcut.
One Thousand Meters Under#093.dst: Bir süre önce yüzeyden kaza yerine bir platform indirildi. Dönmek istersen bu yolu takip et, bir kestirme yaptım.
One Thousand Meters Under#093.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#094.src: Return to the crash site by following the road.
One Thousand Meters Under#094.dst: Yolu takip ederek kaza yerine dön.

One Thousand Meters Under#095.src: Return to the scientist and tell him the news.
One Thousand Meters Under#095.dst: Bilim insanına dön ve olanları anlat.

One Thousand Meters Under#096.src: You survived! Where is everyone else?
One Thousand Meters Under#096.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#098.src: I knew some must have died... But all of them?
One Thousand Meters Under#098.dst: Bazılarının öldüğünü tahmin ediyordum... Ama hepsi mi?
One Thousand Meters Under#098.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#099.src: Well... At least I don't have to pay them! Hah!
One Thousand Meters Under#099.dst: Eh... En azından onlara para ödemem gerekmiyor! Hah!
One Thousand Meters Under#099.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#100.src: ...That was heartless of me, I'm sorry. The rope we used was too weak to hold you down there.
One Thousand Meters Under#100.dst: ...Bu çok kalpsizceydi, özür dilerim. Kullandığımız halat sizi orada tutamayacak kadar zayıfmış.
One Thousand Meters Under#100.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#101.src: My calculations didn't account for the void's physics, it seems.
One Thousand Meters Under#101.dst: Görünüşe göre hesaplarım boşluğun fiziğini hesaba katmamış.
One Thousand Meters Under#101.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#102.src: At least we got you back in one piece. You can tell us what happened.
One Thousand Meters Under#102.dst: En azından seni sağ salim geri aldık. Bize ne olduğunu anlatabilirsin.
One Thousand Meters Under#102.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#104.src: Well I'll be damned. I'll start sending post down there! We can work together.
One Thousand Meters Under#104.dst: Vay canına. Oraya posta göndermeye başlayacağım! Birlikte çalışabiliriz.
One Thousand Meters Under#104.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#105.src: Better to keep everything that happened here a secret. I don't want to lose what little funding I have. This recipe is genius! Here, take this as well as your money.
One Thousand Meters Under#105.dst: Burada olan her şeyi gizli tutmak en iyisi. Elimdeki üç kuruş fonu da kaybetmek istemem. Bu tarif dâhiyane! Al, bunu da paranla birlikte al.
One Thousand Meters Under#105.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

Out of my Mind#000.src: Wait Viola, this is our chance! This stranger sure seems like they could tackle anything, even evil hermit crabs! We could just ask them to see if these rumours are true!
Out of my Mind#000.dst: Dur Viola, bu bizim fırsatımız! Bu yabancı her şeyin üstesinden gelebilecek gibi duruyor, kötü keşiş yengeçlerinin bile! Şu söylentiler doğru mu diye bir ona sorabiliriz!

Out of my Mind#001.src: I don't know, you guys, all these rumours seem a little far-fetched. What next? Will he suddenly turn out to be some mad scientist?
Out of my Mind#001.dst: Bilmem ki çocuklar, bu söylentiler biraz abartı gibi. Sırada ne var? Adam birden çılgın bir bilim insanı mı çıkacak?
Out of my Mind#001.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#002.src: Let's go, I'll take you to the exit so that I don't waste your time any longer!
Out of my Mind#002.dst: Hadi, seni çıkışa götüreyim de vaktini daha fazla almayayım!

Out of my Mind#003.src: So you must be thinking, how have you never met a fine fellow such as myself until now? To be quite honest, you must have just been terribly unlucky, I used to travel the world, you know!
Out of my Mind#003.dst: Şimdi düşünüyorsundur, benim gibi efendi birine bugüne kadar nasıl hiç rastlamadın? Açıkçası çok şanssızmışsın, ben eskiden dünyayı dolaşırdım, biliyor musun!
Out of my Mind#003.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#004.src: Oh the places I've been were wonderful! From the depths of the jungle to the lesser depths of the jungle to even my back garden, I've done my fair share of exploring, if I do say so myself!
Out of my Mind#004.dst: Ah, gittiğim yerler harikaydı! Ormanın derinliklerinden ormanın daha az derin yerlerine, hatta arka bahçeme kadar, kendi ağzımla söylemek gibi olmasın, epey keşif yaptım!

Out of my Mind#005.src: You are the first normal person I've seen recently, {u}. I went out recently and was met with some very rude remarks by some very rude townsfolk!
Out of my Mind#005.dst: Son zamanlarda gördüğüm ilk normal insansın, {u}. Geçenlerde dışarı çıktım, çok kaba kasabalılardan çok kaba laflar işittim!

Out of my Mind#006.src: The last time I visited the town it was all empty too, but I could feel people were hiding in their homes, even on such a lovely day as then. There was no one even there to hide from! Strange people.
Out of my Mind#006.dst: Kasabaya son gittiğimde de her yer bomboştu, ama insanların evlerinde saklandığını hissedebiliyordum, hem de öyle güzel bir günde. Saklanacak kimse de yoktu ortada! Tuhaf insanlar.
Out of my Mind#006.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#007.src: Here we are, the library! I could spend years in here, but who has time for that? I could talk about books for hours too! Here's one right now.
Out of my Mind#007.dst: İşte geldik, kütüphane! Burada yıllarımı geçirebilirim ama kimin buna vakti var? Saatlerce kitaplardan da konuşabilirim! İşte bir tanesi.
Out of my Mind#007.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#008.src: The ground is shaking... I thought that was supposed to happen later! Come back friend, I can't do this alone!
Out of my Mind#008.dst: Yer sallanıyor... Bunun sonra olması gerekiyordu sanıyordum! Geri gel dostum, bunu tek başıma yapamam!

Out of my Mind#009.src: If you remember, we were talking about keeping the door shut when suddenly something heavy fell off a shelf hitting you square in the head!
Out of my Mind#009.dst: Hatırlarsan kapıyı kapalı tutmaktan bahsediyorduk ki birden raftan ağır bir şey düştü ve tam kafana geldi!
Out of my Mind#009.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#010.src: During the shaking, some of my machines broke apart, but we could use these to build something capable of dropping something heavier on your head for the second time.
Out of my Mind#010.dst: Sarsıntı sırasında bazı makinelerim parçalandı ama bunları kullanarak kafana ikinci kez daha ağır bir şey düşürebilecek bir şey yapabiliriz.
Out of my Mind#010.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#011.src: Surely by that logic everything has to go well, you know. Now let me explain how we can do this. First, choose what part you want to use to make our machine, then choose were you want it to go and face.
Out of my Mind#011.dst: Bu mantıkla her şeyin yolunda gitmesi lazım, biliyorsun. Şimdi bunu nasıl yapacağımızı anlatayım. Önce makinemiz için kullanmak istediğin parçayı seç, sonra nereye koyulacağını ve hangi yöne bakacağını seç.
Out of my Mind#011.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#012.src: Quick, head through the large door and stop the cause of all that shaking!
Out of my Mind#012.dst: Çabuk, büyük kapıdan geç ve bütün bu sarsıntının kaynağını durdur!
Out of my Mind#012.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#013.src: I don't know about you, Todd, but I feel we should make them our new honorary club member for finding such amazing things!
Out of my Mind#013.dst: Seni bilmem Todd, ama bence böyle harika şeyler bulduğu için onu kulübümüzün yeni onursal üyesi yapmalıyız!
Out of my Mind#013.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#014.src: Ignore Viola, she's acting up today, probably because you've got the spotlight this time. However, I agree with Prentiss.
Out of my Mind#014.dst: Viola'ya aldırma, bugün huysuzluğu üstünde, herhalde bu sefer ilgi odağı sen olduğun için. Ama Prentiss'e katılıyorum.
Out of my Mind#014.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#015.src: Welcome you to the club, new member! Here is your shiny new badge that you can parade around town to show off how cool you are to others with style.
Out of my Mind#015.dst: Kulübe hoş geldin, yeni üye! Al, bu pırıl pırıl yeni rozetinle kasabada gezip ne kadar havalı olduğunu herkese şıkça gösterebilirsin.
Out of my Mind#015.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#016.src: You tell the group of kids your experiences of strange creatures, even stranger men as well as a hazy memory about... a coconut?
Out of my Mind#016.dst: Çocuklara tuhaf yaratıklarla, ondan da tuhaf adamlarla ilgili yaşadıklarını ve... bir hindistancevizi hakkındaki bulanık bir anıyı anlatıyorsun?

Out of my Mind#017.src: Speak with the {p} children in the treehouse.

Out of my Mind#018.src: Did ye two hear about some guy wandering around town? I've heard strange rumours about him...
Out of my Mind#018.dst: Siz ikiniz kasabada dolaşan bir adamı duydunuz mu? Onunla ilgili tuhaf söylentiler duydum...
Out of my Mind#018.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#019.src: Of course I have, he's the talk of the town! I heard he only brushes his teeth once a day and that he enjoys books about gardening!
Out of my Mind#019.dst: Tabii duydum, herkes ondan bahsediyor! Dişlerini günde sadece bir kere fırçalıyormuş, bahçecilik kitaplarına da bayılıyormuş!
Out of my Mind#019.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#020.src: Oh shush you, we're not living inside some storybook! Besides, if he *was* a mad scientist, wouldn't he be trying to take over the city like all mad scientists in stories do?
Out of my Mind#020.dst: Sus be sen, masal kitabının içinde yaşamıyoruz! Hem adam *gerçekten* çılgın bir bilim insanı olsaydı, hikâyelerdeki bütün çılgın bilim insanları gibi şehri ele geçirmeye çalışmaz mıydı?
Out of my Mind#020.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#021.src: To me that doesn't sound all that strange compared to these other things I've been hearing, anyway... Something about labs and a "hermit".
Out of my Mind#021.dst: Bana kalırsa duyduğum öbür şeylerin yanında bu o kadar da tuhaf değil zaten... Laboratuvarlar ve bir "keşiş" hakkında bir şeyler.
Out of my Mind#021.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#022.src: I think that's a type of crab or something. Adults are right old weirdos sometimes.
Out of my Mind#022.dst: Bence o bir çeşit yengeç falan. Yetişkinler bazen tam bir tuhaf oluyor.
Out of my Mind#022.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#023.src: Hey, a stranger! How long have you been listening to us? Didn't your mom teach you any manners?
Out of my Mind#023.dst: Hey, bir yabancı! Ne zamandır bizi dinliyorsun? Annen sana hiç terbiye öğretmedi mi?
Out of my Mind#023.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#024.src: Ignore my friends over there, they're always like that, but what Prentiss said was true. This might be our only chance to really know who this mystery man really is!
Out of my Mind#024.dst: Şuradaki arkadaşlarıma aldırma, hep böyleler, ama Prentiss'in dediği doğru. Bu gizemli adamın aslında kim olduğunu öğrenmek için tek şansımız bu olabilir!
Out of my Mind#024.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#025.src: It might be a good idea to look at that weird house next to those spooky ruins south-east of the city. We found this key you could try out, but if you lose it there are some spares in our base.
Out of my Mind#025.dst: Şehrin güneydoğusundaki o ürkütücü harabelerin yanındaki tuhaf eve bakmak iyi bir fikir olabilir. Bu anahtarı bulduk, bir dene, kaybedersen üssümüzde yedekleri var.
Out of my Mind#025.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#026.src: Find the hidden door next to the gate near the Undergrowth Ruins outside {p}
Out of my Mind#026.dst: {p} dışındaki Undergrowth Ruins yakınında, kapının yanındaki gizli geçidi bul

Out of my Mind#027.src: Find a way inside the house at [-{~},-{~}]
Out of my Mind#027.dst: [-{~},-{~}] konumundaki eve girmenin bir yolunu bul

Out of my Mind#028.src: Explore the hidden lab in search of information
Out of my Mind#028.dst: Bilgi bulmak için gizli laboratuvarı keşfet

Out of my Mind#029.src: Hello stranger! Welcome to my humble wooden abode. Comfy, isn't it? I bet you'd like a cup of this coff-
Out of my Mind#029.dst: Merhaba yabancı! Mütevazı ahşap yuvama hoş geldin. Rahat, değil mi? Eminim şu kahveden bir fincan iste-
Out of my Mind#029.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#030.src: Oh yes, I am the affable Ariodo, friendly neighbourhood neighbour. What do you need me for?
Out of my Mind#030.dst: Ah evet, ben güler yüzlü Ariodo, mahallenin cana yakın komşusu. Benden ne istiyordun?
Out of my Mind#030.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#031.src: Kidnappings? Poaching? Not brushing my teeth?! Who is this lowly person you're talking about... they don't seem like a nice fellow such as myself.
Out of my Mind#031.dst: Adam kaçırma mı? Kaçak avcılık mı? Dişlerimi fırçalamamak mı?! Bahsettiğin bu aşağılık kişi kim... benim gibi iyi biri hiç değil gibi.
Out of my Mind#031.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#032.src: This is the room you came from. I call it the "Vivarium", creative name I came up with, right? It keeps my pets that aren't quite ready.
Out of my Mind#032.dst: Geldiğin oda burası. Ona "Vivaryum" diyorum, yaratıcı isim, değil mi? Henüz tam hazır olmayan evcil hayvanlarımı burada tutuyorum.
Out of my Mind#032.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#033.src: Ready for what? Well that would ruin the surprise, wouldn't it? Can't have anyone finding out before the big event!
Out of my Mind#033.dst: Ne için hazır mı? Söylersem sürpriz bozulur, değil mi? Büyük olaydan önce kimse öğrenmemeli!
Out of my Mind#033.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#034.src: Let us go now, time is precious.
Out of my Mind#034.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#035.src: I'm just a normal guy, so why can't anyone appreciate me for once? I'm sure you do, right?
Out of my Mind#035.dst: Ben sadece normal biriyim, neden kimse beni bir kere olsun takdir etmiyor? Sen ediyorsun, değil mi?
Out of my Mind#035.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#036.src: This is 'The Long-Winded and Painful Death of Sweeney S. Greenville' and I must say it is a hidden gem among books! One day it just suddenly appeared in here so I couldn't resist reading it. So it starts off with Sweeney S. Greenville...
Out of my Mind#036.dst: Bu 'The Long-Winded and Painful Death of Sweeney S. Greenville' ve şunu söylemeliyim, kitaplar arasında gizli bir hazine! Bir gün birden burada beliriverdi, okumadan duramadım. Şöyle başlıyor, Sweeney S. Greenville...
Out of my Mind#036.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#037.src: We're here now! Take the exit right in front of you, don't mind the corridor to the right, it's only decoration!
Out of my Mind#037.dst: Geldik! Tam önündeki çıkıştan çık, sağdaki koridora aldırma, sadece süs!
Out of my Mind#037.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#038.src: Maybe you can come back some day for a tea or coffee and a long talk about books, since I noticed you were very interested in my long-winded review! Have fun out there and don't forget, I'm always here for you!
Out of my Mind#038.dst: Belki bir gün çay ya da kahve içip kitaplar hakkında uzun uzun konuşmak için yine gelirsin, uzun soluklu incelememle çok ilgilendiğini fark ettim! Dışarıda iyi eğlenceler, unutma, ben hep buradayım!
Out of my Mind#038.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#039.src: Build a machine to hit your head and get back to normal
Out of my Mind#039.dst: Kafana vuracak bir makine yap ve eski hâline dön

Out of my Mind#040.src: Help me keep this door shut, or else my surprise will be ruined!
Out of my Mind#040.dst: Bu kapıyı kapalı tutmama yardım et, yoksa sürprizim bozulacak!
Out of my Mind#040.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#041.src: Just keep to the sides, it's safer that way.
Out of my Mind#041.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#042.src: Just stay here for one more momen...
Out of my Mind#042.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#043.src: Oh my, a ghost? Wait, is this just you, my trusty friend, playing a prank on me? No? Well that certainly is a problem!
Out of my Mind#043.dst: Aman, bir hayalet mi? Dur, bu sen misin, güvenilir dostum, bana şaka mı yapıyorsun? Değil mi? Eh, bu kesinlikle bir sorun!
Out of my Mind#043.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#044.src: I think I heard something about fighting fire with fire, so I think I have a way to get you back! You are a bit too heavy for me, so we need to think of a workaround.
Out of my Mind#044.dst: Ateşe ateşle karşılık vermek diye bir şey duymuştum, sanırım seni geri getirmenin bir yolunu biliyorum! Sen benim için biraz ağırsın, o yüzden başka bir çözüm bulmamız lazım.
Out of my Mind#044.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#045.src: The [Cart] can carry the coconut from one end of the platform to another for a few tiles, while the [Fan] can push the coconut even further.
Out of my Mind#045.dst: [Cart] hindistancevizini platformun bir ucundan diğerine birkaç kare taşıyabilir, [Fan] ise hindistancevizini daha da ileri itebilir.
Out of my Mind#045.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#046.src: The [Hammer] is able to knock the coconut over a one space gap while the [Cannon] can shoot the coconut one grid up diagonally in the direction it is facing.
Out of my Mind#046.dst: [Hammer] hindistancevizini bir karelik boşluğun üzerinden aşırabilir, [Cannon] ise baktığı yönde hindistancevizini çapraz olarak bir kare yukarı fırlatabilir.
Out of my Mind#046.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#047.src: I think I hit my head too, so I'll need your help deciding where to place each part. You want to get the coconut across to the green tile, remember?
Out of my Mind#047.dst: Sanırım ben de kafamı çarptım, o yüzden her parçayı nereye koyacağımıza karar vermek için yardımın lazım. Hindistancevizini yeşil kareye ulaştırmak istiyorsun, hatırladın mı?
Out of my Mind#047.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#048.src: You're back! To be quite honest, I didn't think that would work, but I'm glad it did!
Out of my Mind#048.dst: Geri döndün! Açıkçası işe yarayacağını sanmıyordum ama yaradığına sevindim!
Out of my Mind#048.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#049.src: Find a way to destroy the plant monster, then return to the group in {p} at [-{~},-{~}] to report your findings
Out of my Mind#049.dst: Bitki canavarını yok etmenin bir yolunu bul, sonra bulduklarını anlatmak için {p} içindeki gruba dön: [-{~},-{~}]

Out of my Mind#050.src: Oh no no, this is not good! If I had known that my little pet has grown so much I would have rushed you out sooner. Now it is wilted...
Out of my Mind#050.dst: Ah hayır hayır, bu hiç iyi değil! Küçük evcil hayvanımın bu kadar büyüdüğünü bilseydim seni daha erken çıkarırdım. Şimdi soldu gitti...
Out of my Mind#050.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#051.src: You did what you had to, though. I am sorry to say this friend, but I think I'll stay inside a little longer. Sorry, my only friend.
Out of my Mind#051.dst: Ama yapman gerekeni yaptın. Bunu söylediğim için üzgünüm dostum, ama sanırım bir süre daha içeride kalacağım. Kusura bakma, tek dostum.
Out of my Mind#051.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#052.src: We'll surely meet again in the future, so don't be sad. I'll still be the one and only friendly neighbourhood neighbour when that moment comes, I promise. Goodbye now!
Out of my Mind#052.dst: Gelecekte elbet yine karşılaşırız, o yüzden üzülme. O an geldiğinde de mahallenin biricik cana yakın komşusu olacağım, söz. Hoşça kal!
Out of my Mind#052.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#053.src: You're back! You were gone for ages too, and what happened to your head? Who did the mystery man turn out to be?
Out of my Mind#053.dst: Döndün! Çok uzun zaman yoktun, kafana ne oldu? Gizemli adam kim çıktı?
Out of my Mind#053.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#054.src: That sounds ridiculous! Who could ever belie-
Out of my Mind#054.dst: Kulağa saçma geliyor! Kim buna inana-
Out of my Mind#054.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#055.src: Wow that sounded just like in the stories, but it came from you, so it must be true!
Out of my Mind#055.dst: Vay, tıpkı hikâyelerdeki gibiydi, ama senden duyduk, o yüzden doğru olmalı!
Out of my Mind#055.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#056.src: Why do I even try... You two would believe anything.
Out of my Mind#056.dst: Neden uğraşıyorum ki... Siz ikiniz her şeye inanırsınız.
Out of my Mind#056.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#057.src: I'm pretty sure they mentioned something about being hit by coconut crabs, and just look at their head. One... two... two huge bumps!
Out of my Mind#057.dst: Eminim hindistancevizi yengeçleri tarafından vurulduğundan falan bahsetti, kafasına bir baksanıza. Bir... iki... iki kocaman şişlik!
Out of my Mind#057.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#058.src: Oh fine... whatever you say, Prentiss. I'm sure they'll bring you on some wacky adventures next time around!
Out of my Mind#058.dst: Ah peki... sen ne dersen o, Prentiss. Eminim bir dahaki sefere seni de çılgın maceralara götürür!
Out of my Mind#058.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#059.src: Thanks to you, we solved the case of the mystery man as well as the mystery house! For this I'd like to...
Out of my Mind#059.dst: Senin sayende gizemli adam ve gizemli ev vakasını çözdük! Bunun için sana...
Out of my Mind#059.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#060.src: Also since all the adults do it, we'll give you some emeralds that you rightly deserve for such an achievement. We all pitched in!
Out of my Mind#060.dst: Bir de bütün yetişkinler böyle yaptığı için böyle bir başarıyı fazlasıyla hak ettiğin biraz Zümrüt vereceğiz. Hepimiz katkıda bulunduk!
Out of my Mind#060.speaker: Prentiss

Overture to Despair#000.src: - No weaponry or blessed equipment in common areas.
Overture to Despair#000.dst: - Ortak alanlarda silah ya da kutsanmış teçhizat yasaktır.

Overture to Despair#002.src: No matter, it can be sorted ou-

Overture to Despair#005.src: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change.
Overture to Despair#005.dst: Uzun zamandır gömülü gerçeği gün yüzüne çıkaralım ve değişimi getirelim.
Overture to Despair#005.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

similar.text: May we unearth the truth long buried and bring forth change. Never forget that.

Overture to Despair#006.src: Different plants require different soils, temperatures and water requirements.
Overture to Despair#006.dst: Farklı bitkiler farklı toprak, sıcaklık ve su ister.

Overture to Despair#007.src: At first, I was afraid of being labeled as cursed. But power does not come without risk. I am willing to risk everything for power.
Overture to Despair#007.dst: İlk başta lanetli damgası yemekten korkuyordum. Ama güç risksiz gelmez. Güç için her şeyi riske atmaya hazırım.

Overture to Despair#009.dst: Mini Görev Başladı: Beyaz Zambak Topla

similar.text: Mini-Quest Started: Collect Liff Leaves

Overture to Despair#010.src: I only serve customers with something to show me.
Overture to Despair#010.dst: Yalnızca bana gösterecek bir şeyi olan müşterilere hizmet ederim.

Overture to Despair#012.src: Do you want to play a song?

Overture to Despair#013.src: - Late checkout will come with a {~}  fine.

Overture to Despair#014.src: You open a page at random...

Overture to Despair#015.src: Unsurprisingly, it's talking about Majin's love life. You look inside.
Overture to Despair#015.dst: Şaşırtıcı değil, Majin'in aşk hayatından bahsediyor. İçine göz atıyorsun.

Overture to Despair#017.src: The painting most likely symbolises the destruction of the Auburn of old and the hope of a better time to come.
Overture to Despair#017.dst: Tablo büyük ihtimalle eski Auburn'ün yıkılışını ve daha iyi günlerin geleceğine dair umudu simgeliyor.

Overture to Despair#018.src: Painted in {~}NA by Piju Rae. This oil masterpiece embraces revolutionary color techniques using pigments sourced from the highland dye production.
Overture to Despair#018.dst: {~}NA yılında Piju Rae tarafından yapıldı. Bu yağlı boya şaheser, yayla boya üretiminden gelen pigmentlerle devrim niteliğinde renk teknikleri kullanıyor.

Overture to Despair#019.src: Yes, hello, you staring at me from across the desk, give me a moment I've ran out of ink.
Overture to Despair#019.dst: Evet, merhaba, masanın öbür ucundan bana bakan sen, bir saniye bekle, mürekkebim bitti.

Overture to Despair#020.src: To a lesser extent we also monitor trade between the other districts in Fruma, including anything transported via rail.
Overture to Despair#020.dst: Daha az ölçüde, demiryoluyla taşınanlar dahil Fruma'nın diğer bölgeleri arasındaki ticareti de denetliyoruz.

Overture to Despair#023.src: Heather is a simple starting plant to grow in the {p}. Any acidic soil from the {p} can be used in the gardening bed or flower pot.
Overture to Despair#023.dst: Funda, {p} içinde yetiştirmeye başlamak için basit bir bitkidir. {p} bölgesinden herhangi bir asidik toprak bahçe yatağında ya da saksıda kullanılabilir.

Overture to Despair#024.src: Excuse me. It has been a long day. Again, any questions?
Overture to Despair#024.dst: Kusura bakma. Uzun bir gündü. Tekrar soruyorum, sorusu olan?

Overture to Despair#025.src: To keep it working as intended, the power to issue death sentences should be limited. Giving one trusted official, besides Her Majesty, the right to pass
Overture to Despair#025.dst: Sistemin amaçlandığı gibi işlemesi için ölüm cezası verme yetkisi sınırlı olmalı. Majesteleri dışında güvenilir tek bir yetkiliye bu hakkı vermek

Overture to Despair#027.src: Would you like to keep reading?

Overture to Despair#028.src: Right. that is the thirty first time I have had to write that sentence today, the third pot of ink I've been through, and my hands are starting to shake.
Overture to Despair#028.dst: Tamam. Bu cümleyi bugün otuz birinci kez yazıyorum, üçüncü mürekkep şişesini bitirdim ve ellerim titremeye başladı.

Overture to Despair#029.src: Do you want to get some ice?

Overture to Despair#030.src: Paper published and written by Majin in {~}IA.
Overture to Despair#030.dst: Majin tarafından {~}IA yılında yazılıp yayımlanan gazete.

Overture to Despair#033.src: You are gripped by terror. You can't bear to read more.
Overture to Despair#033.dst: Dehşete kapılıyorsun. Daha fazlasını okumaya dayanamıyorsun.

Overture to Despair#034.src: "SO YEAH, OF COURSE WE'RE GOING TO REPEAT A FEW QUESTIONS. ALRIGHT? GET OVER YOURSELVES."
Overture to Despair#034.dst: "EVET, TABİİ Kİ BİRKAÇ SORUYU TEKRARLAYACAĞIZ. TAMAM MI? KENDİNİZE GELİN."

Overture to Despair#035.src: There's a picture of a funny looking fish. The headline reads as follows:
Overture to Despair#035.dst: Komik görünümlü bir balık resmi var. Manşet şöyle diyor:

Overture to Despair#036.src: New Chapter Started: Blossom of Blades
Overture to Despair#036.dst: Yeni Bölüm Başladı: Blossom of Blades

Overture to Despair#037.src: "Fish Experts Warn Dangerous New Invasive Fish Headed For {p}. Its Diet? Your-"
Overture to Despair#037.dst: "Balık Uzmanları Uyarıyor: Tehlikeli Yeni İstilacı Balık {p} Yolunda. Peki Ne Yiyor? Sizin-"

Overture to Despair#038.src: Meet up with Sui outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Overture to Despair#039.src: ...{p}. Ha, the... the tourists really weren't lying when they kept saying it was a work of art.
Overture to Despair#039.dst: ...{p}. Ha, şey... turistler bir sanat eseri deyip dururken gerçekten yalan söylemiyorlarmış.
Overture to Despair#039.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#040.src: It must be nice, living here... being able to ignore everything going on everywhere else...
Overture to Despair#040.dst: Burada yaşamak güzel olmalı... başka her yerde olup biten her şeyi görmezden gelebilmek...
Overture to Despair#040.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#041.src: {u}, we need to find that... that so-called "number one" Sovereign! If we can do that, then... ha, then we can save Rex and Zeph.
Overture to Despair#041.dst: {u}, o... o sözde "bir numaralı" Hükümdar'ı bulmalıyız! Bunu yapabilirsek... ha, Rex ile Zeph'i kurtarabiliriz.
Overture to Despair#041.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#042.src: Why not?! You're the one who wanted to- to rush into Deraj and free everyone without even stopping to think about it!
Overture to Despair#042.dst: Neden olmasın?! Hiç düşünmeden Deraj'a dalıp herkesi kurtarmak- kurtarmak isteyen sendin!
Overture to Despair#042.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#043.src: So why can't I?! The longer we wait, the more chances there are for s-something to happen!! We need to go already!
Overture to Despair#043.dst: O zaman ben neden yapamıyorum?! Ne kadar beklersek bir ş-şey olma ihtimali o kadar artıyor!! Hemen gitmeliyiz!
Overture to Despair#043.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#044.src: Yeah, I have one. Find the Sovereign. Free Rex and Zeph. And get out of there!
Overture to Despair#044.dst: Evet, var. Hükümdar'ı bul. Rex ile Zeph'i kurtar. Ve oradan çık!
Overture to Despair#044.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#045.src: I'll... f-fill in the details as we go. I will! We just need to go already!
Overture to Despair#045.dst: Ayrıntıları... yolda h-hallederim. Hallederim! Sadece hemen gitmemiz lazım!
Overture to Despair#045.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#048.src: I guess... the Canopy? We can bring them to the Canopy! That... that works...
Overture to Despair#048.dst: Sanırım... Canopy'ye? Onları Canopy'ye götürebiliriz! Bu... bu olur...
Overture to Despair#048.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#049.src: Um... n-no, I guess not. But- but we can find someone who does, and- and force the information out of them!
Overture to Despair#049.dst: Şey... h-hayır, sanırım bilmiyorum. Ama- ama bilen birini bulup- bulup bilgiyi zorla alabiliriz!
Overture to Despair#049.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#050.src: We can do that. Captain Fuhue, she... told me about some of her methods! I just... need to find someone who... knows...
Overture to Despair#050.dst: Bunu yapabiliriz. Kaptan Fuhue bana... yöntemlerinden bazılarını anlattı! Sadece... bilen... birini bulmam lazım...
Overture to Despair#050.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#051.src: If- if that's what it takes!! We were able to k-kill Gikyo, weren't we?
Overture to Despair#051.dst: Ge-gerekirse öyle olsun!! Gikyo'yu ö-öldürmeyi başardık, değil mi?
Overture to Despair#051.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#052.src: Even if it was hard... and Majin is... probably stronger...
Overture to Despair#052.dst: Zor olsa bile... ve Majin... muhtemelen daha güçlü...
Overture to Despair#052.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#053.src: Good. Okay! To start with, we...
Overture to Despair#053.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#056.src: Okay, fine, maybe you're right! Just... ugh!! We have to do something!
Overture to Despair#056.dst: Tamam, peki, belki haklısın! Sadece... ah!! Bir şey yapmalıyız!
Overture to Despair#056.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#057.src: ...right. That's... smart. Word's probably spread from, um, {p}, hasn't it...? We'll need to blend in better.
Overture to Despair#057.dst: ...doğru. Bu... akıllıca. Haber muhtemelen, şey, {p} tarafından yayılmıştır, değil mi...? Daha iyi kaynaşmamız gerek.
Overture to Despair#057.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#058.src: And... we don't know how long it'll be until we... find the information we need. So... a place to say, too?
Overture to Despair#058.dst: Ve... ihtiyacımız olan bilgiyi bulmamızın... ne kadar süreceğini bilmiyoruz. Yani... kalacak bir yer de mi?
Overture to Despair#058.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#059.src: Okay. Find new clothes, and find a place to stay. That's a plan. We can do that.
Overture to Despair#059.dst: Tamam. Yeni kıyafet bul, kalacak yer bul. Plan bu. Bunu yapabiliriz.
Overture to Despair#059.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#063.src: Indeed, I am. I was raised here in {p}.
Overture to Despair#063.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#064.src: Though, in truth... I've never really left. I'm planning on enlisting in the military once I've completed my provincial tour.
Overture to Despair#064.dst: Gerçi, doğrusunu söylemek gerekirse... buradan hiç ayrılmadım. Eyalet turumu bitirince orduya yazılmayı planlıyorum.
Overture to Despair#064.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#065.src: I've been saving up for years for a round-trip ticket throughout the province... I'd like to see all of the less-fortunate regions firsthand.
Overture to Despair#065.dst: Eyaleti baştan sona dolaşacak gidiş-dönüş bileti için yıllardır para biriktiriyorum... Daha talihsiz bölgeleri kendi gözlerimle görmek istiyorum.
Overture to Despair#065.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#066.src: I'm leaving just after the festival. Exciting, isn't it?
Overture to Despair#066.dst: Festivalden hemen sonra yola çıkıyorum. Heyecan verici, değil mi?
Overture to Despair#066.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#067.src: Hotels... hm. I know of several, though most have probably filled entirely for the upcoming festival.
Overture to Despair#067.dst: Oteller... hmm. Birkaçını biliyorum ama çoğu yaklaşan festival yüzünden muhtemelen tamamen dolmuştur.
Overture to Despair#067.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#068.src: There is a fancy hotel north of the bank... The Crown Jewel, I believe? It's probably far too expensive for you, however.
Overture to Despair#068.dst: Bankanın kuzeyinde lüks bir otel var... Crown Jewel'dı galiba? Ama sizin için muhtemelen fazla pahalıdır.
Overture to Despair#068.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#069.src: A fine question. I'm not too certain, honestly... growing up here has made me overlook things.
Overture to Despair#069.dst: Güzel soru. Açıkçası pek emin değilim... burada büyümek bazı şeyleri gözden kaçırmama neden oldu.
Overture to Despair#069.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#070.src: I know tourists typically travel here to look at all our mansions and castles, though. Perhaps you'd be interested?
Overture to Despair#070.dst: Ama turistlerin genelde konaklarımızı ve şatolarımızı görmeye geldiğini biliyorum. Belki ilginizi çeker?
Overture to Despair#070.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#073.src: How might I help you this fine day?
Overture to Despair#073.dst: Bu güzel günde size nasıl yardımcı olabilirim?
Overture to Despair#073.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#074.src: As fine as one may be! Thank you for your inquiry.
Overture to Despair#074.dst: Olabileceği kadar iyi! Sorduğunuz için teşekkürler.
Overture to Despair#074.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#075.src: I have been graciously afforded an hour off from my work, so I have chosen to take the time and... smell the roses. To admire the beauty of our city.
Overture to Despair#075.dst: İşimden bir saatlik izin lütfedildi, ben de bu zamanı... güllerin kokusunu almaya ayırdım. Şehrimizin güzelliğini seyretmeye.
Overture to Despair#075.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#076.src: Ah... tourists from the lower districts, I take it? A fine use of your travel allotments.
Overture to Despair#076.dst: Ah... alt bölgelerden gelen turistler, değil mi? Seyahat haklarınızı güzel kullanmışsınız.
Overture to Despair#076.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#077.src: You will want to visit the bustling market on the west side, it would be a shame to miss it!
Overture to Despair#077.dst: Batı yakasındaki kalabalık pazarı mutlaka gezin, kaçırırsanız yazık olur!
Overture to Despair#077.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#078.src: And if you wish to leave the bounds of the city, I have heard one may find tour guides which will bring you to see the mountains!
Overture to Despair#078.dst: Şehrin sınırları dışına çıkmak isterseniz, sizi dağları görmeye götüren rehberler bulunabileceğini duydum!
Overture to Despair#078.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#079.src: Yes, {p} is known for its high fashion, isn't it? I'm certain you've heard about it... wherever you come from.
Overture to Despair#079.dst: Evet, {p} yüksek modasıyla bilinir, değil mi? Eminim duymuşsunuzdur... nereden geliyorsanız artık.
Overture to Despair#079.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#080.src: The famous House Til has placed a pop-up clothes shop to the north, if you're interested.
Overture to Despair#080.dst: İlgileniyorsanız ünlü House Til kuzeyde geçici bir kıyafet dükkânı açtı.
Overture to Despair#080.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#081.src: I wish you the best on your stay! Praise be to her Majesty!
Overture to Despair#081.dst: Konaklamanızın en güzel şekilde geçmesini dilerim! Majestelerine şükürler olsun!
Overture to Despair#081.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Overture to Despair#083.src: I should have thought about where I'd be staying... I've never taken a train before, so all my thinking went towards making sure that went well!
Overture to Despair#083.dst: Nerede kalacağımı düşünmeliydim... Daha önce hiç trene binmemiştim, bütün kafamı onun iyi geçmesine verdim!
Overture to Despair#083.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#084.src: And now all the hotels except the Crown Jewel are fully booked! Will I... will I have to sleep on the street?
Overture to Despair#084.dst: Ve şimdi Crown Jewel dışındaki bütün oteller dolu! Ben... sokakta mı yatacağım?
Overture to Despair#084.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#085.src: Oh, what am I going to do...?
Overture to Despair#085.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#086.src: Oh, thank you, thank you! The Queen herself must have sent you my way!
Overture to Despair#086.dst: Ah, teşekkürler, çok teşekkürler! Seni bana Kraliçe'nin kendisi göndermiş olmalı!
Overture to Despair#086.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#087.src: ...short on emeralds too, are you? Maybe we can share a comfy bush together! Ha...
Overture to Despair#087.dst: ...senin de mi zümrüdün kıt? Belki rahat bir çalının altını paylaşırız! Ha...
Overture to Despair#087.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#088.src: Oh, I'll remember you forever! You've truly made this festival the best one yet!
Overture to Despair#088.dst: Ah, seni hep hatırlayacağım! Bu festivali gerçekten şimdiye kadarkilerin en iyisi yaptın!
Overture to Despair#088.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#089.src: I can't wait to tell my old folk all about it! How the Queen had blessed me with this miracle...
Overture to Despair#089.dst: Ailemdeki yaşlılara anlatmak için sabırsızlanıyorum! Kraliçe'nin beni bu mucizeyle nasıl kutsadığını...
Overture to Despair#089.speaker: Espren Tourist

Overture to Despair#090.src: But, it wasn't the Queen that... oh, nevermind.
Overture to Despair#090.dst: Ama, onu yapan Kraliçe değildi ki... ah, boş ver.
Overture to Despair#090.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#091.src: Hello, hello! Care to buy any of our fine papers? Perhaps a magazine is up your alley today- quite the juicy bits of gossip I've heard.
Overture to Despair#091.dst: Merhaba, merhaba! Güzel gazetelerimizden almak ister misiniz? Belki bugün bir dergi tam size göredir, epey sulu dedikodular duydum.
Overture to Despair#091.speaker: Newspaper Merchant

Overture to Despair#092.src: Hm... Do I want the Crown of Seraphim collection, or the Peacock Couture...
Overture to Despair#092.dst: Hmm... Crown of Seraphim koleksiyonunu mu alsam, yoksa Peacock Couture'ü mü...
Overture to Despair#092.speaker: Roughworks Tourist

Overture to Despair#093.src: Oh, this is important... a whole year's paycheck is going towards this!
Overture to Despair#093.dst: Ah, bu önemli... bütün bir yılın maaşı buna gidiyor!
Overture to Despair#093.speaker: Roughworks Tourist

Overture to Despair#096.src: Well, it seems you're in luck! Considering this is a pop-up clothes stall, and all.
Overture to Despair#096.dst: O zaman şanslısınız! Ne de olsa burası geçici bir kıyafet tezgâhı.
Overture to Despair#096.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#097.src: I'm here representing House Til today. The new fashionable spring line has almost sold out, so shop now if you're interested!
Overture to Despair#097.dst: Bugün burada House Til'i temsil ediyorum. Modaya uygun yeni bahar serisi neredeyse tükendi, ilgileniyorsanız hemen alın!
Overture to Despair#097.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#098.src: Um... is this the fashion around here?
Overture to Despair#098.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#099.src: Oh, yes. People from all across the province come to shop at these pop-up events.
Overture to Despair#099.dst: Ah, evet. Eyaletin her yerinden insanlar bu geçici etkinliklerde alışverişe gelir.
Overture to Despair#099.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#100.src: House Til is known for incorporating the designs from peacock feathers into their most extravagant garments!
Overture to Despair#100.dst: House Til en gösterişli kıyafetlerinde tavus kuşu tüyü desenleri kullanmasıyla bilinir!
Overture to Despair#100.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#101.src: They come in a wide variety of available colours- all from the district's local dye production!
Overture to Despair#101.dst: Çok çeşitli renkleri var, hepsi bölgenin yerel boya üretiminden!
Overture to Despair#101.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#102.src: We don't need anything fancy. Just... show us the cheapest stuff you have, okay?
Overture to Despair#102.dst: Süslü bir şeye ihtiyacımız yok. Sadece... elindeki en ucuz şeyleri göster, tamam mı?
Overture to Despair#102.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#103.src: My goodness! You must know fashion does not come cheap, miss! Please, allow me to recommend-
Overture to Despair#103.dst: Aman tanrım! Modanın ucuz olmadığını bilmelisiniz, hanımefendi! Lütfen, size önermeme izin verin-
Overture to Despair#103.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#104.src: No. Just let us buy the cheapest stuff you have.
Overture to Despair#104.dst: Hayır. En ucuz şeyleri almamıza izin ver, o kadar.
Overture to Despair#104.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#105.src: Uh huh... well, alright. If you insist...
Overture to Despair#105.dst: Hı hı... peki, tamam. Madem ısrar ediyorsunuz...
Overture to Despair#105.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#106.src: Here, the cheapest I have available. In total, that will cost you... {~} .
Overture to Despair#106.dst: Buyurun, elimdeki en ucuzu bu. Toplamda tutarı... {~} .
Overture to Despair#106.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#107.src: Where regions meet through lines of burrowed steel.
Overture to Despair#107.dst: Bölgelerin oyulmuş çelik hatlarla buluştuğu yerde.

Overture to Despair#108.src: Here, the cheapest I have available. In total, that will cost you... {~} EB.
Overture to Despair#108.dst: Buyurun, elimdeki en ucuzu bu. Toplamda tutarı... {~} EB.
Overture to Despair#108.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#109.src: Very well. Here you are. Now, please leave, your attitude is not good for business!
Overture to Despair#109.dst: Pekâlâ. Buyurun. Şimdi lütfen gidin, tavrınız işime zarar veriyor!
Overture to Despair#109.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#110.src: Okay... that's the clothes. Now we just... need a place to, um, stay. A hotel, maybe...
Overture to Despair#110.dst: Tamam... kıyafetler halloldu. Şimdi sadece... kalacak bir, şey, yer lazım. Belki bir otel...
Overture to Despair#110.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#111.src: Well! As I said, fashion is not cheap!
Overture to Despair#111.dst: Eh! Dediğim gibi, moda ucuz değildir!
Overture to Despair#111.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#112.src: Ah, you're back. As I said, the clothes will cost you {~} EB.
Overture to Despair#112.dst: Ah, geri döndünüz. Dediğim gibi, kıyafetler {~} EB tutuyor.
Overture to Despair#112.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#114.src: Ah... Listen, I still need to sell all of my stock, or I won't receive my bonus!
Overture to Despair#114.dst: Ah... Bakın, bütün stoğumu satmam lazım, yoksa primimi alamam!
Overture to Despair#114.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#115.src: So, unless you're interested in buying more clothes... please, leave.
Overture to Despair#115.dst: Yani daha fazla kıyafet almayacaksanız... lütfen gidin.
Overture to Despair#115.speaker: Clothes Merchant

Overture to Despair#117.src: Why, hello and welcome to the Crown Jewel! How may I assist you?
Overture to Despair#117.dst: Merhaba, Crown Jewel'a hoş geldiniz! Size nasıl yardımcı olabilirim?
Overture to Despair#117.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#119.src: Well, do you have a booking?
Overture to Despair#119.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#121.src: Hm I see. In that case, allow me to quickly check out listings...
Overture to Despair#121.dst: Hmm, anlıyorum. O halde hemen kayıtlara bir bakayım...
Overture to Despair#121.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#122.src: Aha! You're in luck! It seems we have a spare double room available! But that may not last long- let me tell you, they are selling fast!
Overture to Despair#122.dst: Aha! Şanslısınız! Görünüşe göre boş bir çift kişilik odamız var! Ama uzun sürmeyebilir, söyleyeyim, çok hızlı gidiyorlar!
Overture to Despair#122.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#123.src: A... bigger room? You're certain? From where I stand, I only see the two of you, and-
Overture to Despair#123.dst: Daha... büyük bir oda mı? Emin misiniz? Benim gördüğüm kadarıyla yalnızca ikiniz varsınız ve-
Overture to Despair#123.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#124.src: We're... going to have friends with us. They just... haven't, um, arrived yet.
Overture to Despair#124.dst: Yanımızda... arkadaşlarımız olacak. Sadece... henüz, şey, gelmediler.
Overture to Despair#124.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#125.src: I see. I see. That certainly complicates things...
Overture to Despair#125.dst: Anlıyorum. Anlıyorum. Bu işleri epey karıştırıyor...
Overture to Despair#125.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#126.src: "Day after day, the voices greet the seekers. Identify the truth, and read the secrets printed."
Overture to Despair#126.dst: "Her gün sesler arayanları karşılar. Gerçeği tanı ve basılı sırları oku."

Overture to Despair#127.src: I see. I see That certainly complicates things...
Overture to Despair#127.dst: Anlıyorum. Anlıyorum Bu işleri epey karıştırıyor...
Overture to Despair#127.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#128.src: Company? Well, whatever sort? If you're just looking to socialize, the double room should serve your purposes well en-
Overture to Despair#128.dst: Misafir mi? Ne tür misafir? Sadece sohbet etmek istiyorsanız çift kişilik oda işinizi gayet gö-
Overture to Despair#128.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#129.src: No, they'll... be staying with us.
Overture to Despair#129.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#130.src: Mmn. Yes, that would certainly put a damper on things. Hm...
Overture to Despair#130.dst: Hmm. Evet, bu işin tadını kaçırır. Hmm...
Overture to Despair#130.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#131.src: Well. I suppose we do also have the luxury suite available. Though, it's quite the hefty price...
Overture to Despair#131.dst: Peki. Sanırım lüks süitimiz de boş. Gerçi fiyatı epey yüklü...
Overture to Despair#131.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#132.src: We- we'll take it. I'll pay.
Overture to Despair#132.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#133.src: You're certain? Apologies if I am making assumptions here, but you do not seem the sort who would have-
Overture to Despair#133.dst: Emin misiniz? Varsayımda bulunuyorsam kusura bakmayın ama pek de öyle birine benzemiyorsunuz-
Overture to Despair#133.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#135.src: ...huh. Well, everything seems in order then. Here are your keys, madame.
Overture to Despair#135.dst: ...hıh. Peki, o halde her şey yolunda görünüyor. Anahtarlarınız, madam.
Overture to Despair#135.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#137.src: {u}, I'm... going up to the room.
Overture to Despair#137.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#138.src: No. We're... not here for pleasure, {u}. We're here to... to... to save our friends.
Overture to Despair#138.dst: Hayır. Biz... buraya eğlenmeye gelmedik, {u}. Buraya... buraya... arkadaşlarımızı kurtarmaya geldik.
Overture to Despair#138.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#139.src: I'm, um... not hungry. And I'm, ha, definitely not in the mood for a drink.
Overture to Despair#139.dst: Ben, şey... aç değilim. Ve, ha, kesinlikle içecek havasında değilim.
Overture to Despair#139.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#140.src: ...you can, um, take a look around though. If- if you want. Just... don't take too long.
Overture to Despair#140.dst: ...ama sen, şey, etrafa bakabilirsin. İs- istersen. Sadece... çok uzun sürmesin.
Overture to Despair#140.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#141.src: We're in... room {~}, apparently. I'll... leave the door open for you.
Overture to Despair#141.dst: Görünüşe göre... {~} numaralı odadayız. Kapıyı... sana açık bırakırım.
Overture to Despair#141.speaker: Sui

Overture to Despair#142.src: Head to your room and discuss what to do next.
Overture to Despair#142.dst: Odana git ve sırada ne yapılacağını konuş.

Overture to Despair#143.src: Ah! What can I do for you today?
Overture to Despair#143.dst: Ah! Bugün sizin için ne yapabilirim?
Overture to Despair#143.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#144.src: The {p} are known for thier very scenic walks and hikes! I would recommend walking around the lakes or hiking up to the mountains.
Overture to Despair#144.dst: {p} çok manzaralı yürüyüş ve doğa yollarıyla bilinir! Göllerin etrafında yürümenizi ya da dağlara tırmanmanızı öneririm.
Overture to Despair#144.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#145.src: {p} is also known for their very rich alcohol culture. We brew a lot of different beverages that can be enjoyed at our local taverns.
Overture to Despair#145.dst: {p} çok zengin içki kültürüyle de bilinir. Yerel meyhanelerimizde tadabileceğiniz pek çok farklı içecek yaparız.
Overture to Despair#145.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#146.src: We are not hosting any particular events at this moment because of the upcoming festival.
Overture to Despair#146.dst: Yaklaşan festival yüzünden şu an özel bir etkinlik düzenlemiyoruz.
Overture to Despair#146.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#147.src: Usually, we host game nights and quizzes in our bar!
Overture to Despair#147.dst: Normalde barımızda oyun geceleri ve bilgi yarışmaları düzenleriz!
Overture to Despair#147.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#148.src: Oh, are things not up to your standard?
Overture to Despair#148.dst: Ah, bir şeyler beklentinizi karşılamadı mı?
Overture to Despair#148.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#149.src: What have you experienced issues with?
Overture to Despair#149.speaker: Receptionist

Overture to Despair#150.src: I apologise for that! We will send in a cleaner later to fluff em up for ya!
Overture to Despair#150.dst: Bunun için özür dilerim! Daha sonra bir temizlikçi gönderip onları kabartırız!
Overture to Despair#150.speaker: Receptionist
