Royal Trials#096.src: It doesn't look like your apple did anything... you should find another item to throw.
Royal Trials#096.dst: Elman bir işe yaramamış gibi... atacak başka bir eşya bulmalısın.

Royal Trials#097.src: It doesn't look like your egg did anything... you should find another item to throw.
Royal Trials#097.dst: Yumurtan bir işe yaramamış gibi... atacak başka bir eşya bulmalısın.

Royal Trials#098.src: The rock broke the window! Now you've just got to find a way up there...
Royal Trials#098.dst: Taş pencereyi kırdı! Şimdi oraya çıkmanın bir yolunu bulman lazım...

Royal Trials#099.src: Looks like you're inside the Mansion... now you've got to your way to the treasure.
Royal Trials#099.dst: Görünüşe göre malikânenin içindesin... şimdi hazineye giden yolu bulmalısın.

Royal Trials#100.src: Aye, we caught the dirty thief. We'll 'ave that treasure back, and ye can rot in this cell!
Royal Trials#100.dst: Aha, pis hırsızı yakaladık. O hazineyi geri alacağız, sen de bu hücrede çürüyeceksin!
Royal Trials#100.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#101.src: Move along, ya' got clearance to board the airship!
Royal Trials#101.dst: Yürü bakalım, hava gemisine binme iznin var!
Royal Trials#101.speaker: Mansion Guard

Shattered Minds#000.src: The Bluecap Mushrooms grow in a cave out the gate northwest of here.
Shattered Minds#000.dst: Bluecap Mantarları buranın kuzeybatısındaki kapının dışında, bir mağarada yetişir.
Shattered Minds#000.speaker: Efilim Elf 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿢 󐀂

Shattered Minds#001.src: You find and take the mushroom Likeru asked for.

Shattered Minds#003.src: You begin to feel an odd sensation...

Shattered Minds#004.src: ...Now that you... have the mushrooms... you should return to... Likeru...
Shattered Minds#004.dst: ...Artık... mantarlar sende olduğuna göre... Likeru'nun... yanına dönmelisin...

Shattered Minds#005.src: Swish and sproont! Or is it the other way around? The moon shoes will help too!
Shattered Minds#005.dst: Savur ve fışkır! Yoksa tam tersi mi? Ay ayakkabıları da işe yarar!

Shattered Minds#006.src: Sorry! The stairs broke! Try again.
Shattered Minds#006.dst: Pardon! Merdivenler kırıldı! Bir daha dene.
Shattered Minds#006.speaker:
[+487 Combat XP]
[ZLGX]

Shattered Minds#008.src: Is a refreshment needed? For I shall provide- the colors, green, blue, red, yellow, floating above the pillars- reveals where you will arrive
Shattered Minds#008.dst: Biraz serinlik gerekir mi? Çünkü ben sağlarım: renkler, yeşil, mavi, kırmızı, sarı, sütunların üstünde süzülür, nereye varacağını gösterir
Shattered Minds#008.speaker:
Professor Eih
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂
.

Shattered Minds#009.src: They send the same way! Such direction waters my crops and tops my hat- fly well!
Shattered Minds#009.dst: Aynı yöne gönderirler! Böyle bir yön ekinlerimi sular, şapkamı tamamlar. İyi uçuşlar!

Shattered Minds#010.src: A fresh-water fellow finds a fresh start for the fish out of water, frying in the fuzzies' fireplace!
Shattered Minds#010.dst: Tatlı sulu bir tip, sudan çıkmış balığa taze bir başlangıç bulur, tüylülerin ocağında kızarırken!
Shattered Minds#010.speaker:
Professor Eih
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂
.

Shattered Minds#011.src: Green means go- and going green means you get going! Glance the green in the air by the gates, greengills!
Shattered Minds#011.dst: Yeşil, git demek; yeşile dönmek de yola koyulmak demek! Kapıların yanında havadaki yeşile bir göz at, yeşil solungaç!
Shattered Minds#011.speaker:
Professor Eih
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂
.

Shattered Minds#012.src: The Bluecaps are fickle things, inasmuch as inanimate objects can be. We cannot control their influence but in passing. We shall need to take care with them...
Shattered Minds#012.dst: Bluecap'ler cansız nesneler ne kadar kaprisli olabilirse o kadar kaprisli şeylerdir. Etkilerini ancak geçerken kontrol edebiliriz. Onlara dikkat etmemiz gerekecek...
Shattered Minds#012.speaker: Strange Coin 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿪 󐀂

Shattered Minds#013.src: Yeah...the more I think on it, the more that the corruption portal messing with the visions makes sense.
Shattered Minds#013.dst: Evet... düşündükçe, yozlaşma geçidinin vizyonları bozması daha mantıklı geliyor.

Shattered Minds#014.src: Well, if you ever want to try again and see if I'm wrong go ahead, but please don't dive into the pond again?
Shattered Minds#014.dst: Neyse, bir gün yanıldığımı görmek için tekrar denemek istersen buyur, ama lütfen bir daha gölete dalma, olur mu?
Shattered Minds#014.speaker:
Grook 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿞 󐀂
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Shattered Minds#016.src: Aha, perfect! You'll be perfect! Lucky a human decided to come here!
Shattered Minds#016.dst: Aha, mükemmel! Sen tam biçilmiş kaftansın! Ne şans ki bir insan buraya gelmeye karar verdi!
Shattered Minds#016.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#017.src: I'll get to the point- I want you to go get something for me, and then bring it back here. Simple, right?
Shattered Minds#017.dst: Sadede geleyim: Gidip bana bir şey getirmeni, sonra da buraya geri getirmeni istiyorum. Basit, değil mi?
Shattered Minds#017.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#018.src: When you do that, I'm going to fix it up and try something out on you. Something magically enlightening!
Shattered Minds#018.dst: Sen getirince onu hazırlayıp üzerinde bir şey deneyeceğim. Büyülü bir şekilde aydınlatıcı bir şey!
Shattered Minds#018.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#019.src: Oh, don't give me that look, it should be perfectly safe! Unless you've been mired in darkness for the past however many years...
Shattered Minds#019.dst: Ah, öyle bakma bana, tamamen güvenli olmalı! Tabii son kaç yıldır karanlığa gömülmediysen...
Shattered Minds#019.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#020.src: Anyway, what I need is a specific kind of mushroom that grows close by, the Bluecap Mushroom.
Shattered Minds#020.dst: Neyse, ihtiyacım olan şey yakınlarda yetişen özel bir mantar türü: Bluecap Mantarı.
Shattered Minds#020.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#021.src: They grow underground- in a cave out the gate northwest of here. I'll even pay you if you bring it back, so what have you got to lose?
Shattered Minds#021.dst: Yer altında yetişirler, buranın kuzeybatısındaki kapının dışında bir mağarada. Getirirsen sana para bile veririm, kaybedecek neyin var?
Shattered Minds#021.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#022.src: Bring Likeru the mushrooms from the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shattered Minds#023.src: Figure out how to get out of the cave, and return to Likeru.
Shattered Minds#023.dst: Mağaradan nasıl çıkacağını bul ve Likeru'nun yanına dön.

Shattered Minds#024.src: Looks like someone rolled about the air fuzz too much, so indeed hello! A light hello to yourself, {u}, and a greetings to Professor Eih, which is me!
Shattered Minds#024.dst: Görünüşe bakılırsa biri hava tüyünde fazla yuvarlanmış, o halde merhaba! Sana hafif bir merhaba, {u}, ve ben olan Profesör Eih'e de selamlar!

Shattered Minds#025.src: I don't rhyme all the instances, I feel the need to say. But what do you say? Very little! But I bet you're wondering where you are.
Shattered Minds#025.dst: Her seferinde kafiye yapmıyorum, bunu söyleme gereği duyuyorum. Peki sen ne diyorsun? Pek bir şey! Ama bahse girerim nerede olduğunu merak ediyorsun.
Shattered Minds#025.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#026.src: I am no gambling man, but the chips are down and it is time to play {~}-Pickup with the puzzle pieces, and I'll eat my bowtie if you aren't ready.
Shattered Minds#026.dst: Kumarbaz biri değilim ama işler sarpa sardı, yapboz parçalarıyla {~} kartlık toplama oyunu oynama vakti. Hazır değilsen papyonumu yerim.
Shattered Minds#026.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#027.src: The betting pool says the way to go is the opposite of in front, so that leaves someplace we can't talk about in front of the kids as your path!
Shattered Minds#027.dst: Bahis havuzu gidilecek yolun önün tersi olduğunu söylüyor, demek ki yolun, çocukların önünde konuşamayacağımız bir yer!
Shattered Minds#027.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#028.src: I will be around! Or asquare, as it were. Technically amultiplesquares, replete with alines! And abevels! And other some such things like-
Shattered Minds#028.dst: Etrafta olacağım! Yani etrafkare, bir bakıma. Teknik olarak etrafçokkare, etrafçizgilerle dolu! Ve etrafeğimlerle! Ve şunun gibi başka şeyler-
Shattered Minds#028.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#029.src: The punks scramble like eggs, and your skillet is sizzling! Certainly the heat in the kitchen is too much- so where is the fire extinguisher?
Shattered Minds#029.dst: Serseriler yumurta gibi çırpılıyor, tavan cızırdıyor! Mutfak kesinlikle çok sıcak, peki yangın söndürücü nerede?
Shattered Minds#029.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#030.src: It won't rocket you! The hole in the shape of a door looms out of your transparent grasp- frogs can't skip leg day, so be froggy! Bounce and jump!
Shattered Minds#030.dst: Seni fırlatmaz! Kapı şeklindeki delik şeffaf kavrayışının ötesinde beliriyor. Kurbağalar bacak gününü atlayamaz, kurbağa ol! Zıpla ve sıçra!
Shattered Minds#030.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#031.src: Swoosh and sprint! Speed and non-slip shoes! With a CLICK upon me I give you all but one, as much as you need!
Shattered Minds#031.dst: Hızlan ve koş! Hız ve kaymaz ayakkabılar! Bana bir TIK ile, birini hariç hepsini, ne kadar gerekirse veririm!
Shattered Minds#031.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#032.src: The colors! Shimmering as a prism- oh, no one likes those things. The writing is on the wall, but the window mugs it for pocket change! The inhumanity!
Shattered Minds#032.dst: Renkler! Prizma gibi parıldıyor... ah, kimse onları sevmez. Yazı duvarda ama pencere bozuk para için onu soyuyor! Ne insanlık dışı!
Shattered Minds#032.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#033.src: Use your eyes as ears and hear what I shall write! The cockpit is missing ground control and the cornfields all look the same in endless rows!
Shattered Minds#033.dst: Gözlerini kulak gibi kullan ve yazacaklarımı duy! Kokpitin yer kontrolü yok, mısır tarlaları da uçsuz bucaksız sıralar halinde hep aynı görünüyor!
Shattered Minds#033.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#034.src: So Eih, esquire professor PhD, will provide the coordinates in helpfully non-literal fashion, and one's joystick shall lead the holder to bliss!
Shattered Minds#034.dst: Bu yüzden Eih, saygıdeğer profesör doktor, koordinatları yardımsever ve mecazi bir şekilde verecek, kumanda kolu da tutanı mutluluğa götürecek!
Shattered Minds#034.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#035.src: At one's boots, the colors paint themselves towards an orientation. Above one's head, the lights match and fling you the same!
Shattered Minds#035.dst: Ayakların dibinde renkler kendilerini bir yöne doğru boyuyor. Başının üstünde ışıklar eşleşiyor ve seni aynı yere fırlatıyor!
Shattered Minds#035.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#036.src: I'm all out of airplane food, but the goal is more than peanuts- it's progress, just opposite our position. Fly well!
Shattered Minds#036.dst: Uçak yemeğim bitti ama hedef çerez parası değil, ilerleme! Tam da bulunduğumuz yerin tersinde. İyi uçuşlar!
Shattered Minds#036.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#037.src: WOW. Just, WOW! Your brain being frazzled doesn't excuse this failure! Time is money and we're swimming in a river called DEBT!
Shattered Minds#037.dst: VAY. Yani, VAY! Beyninin kızarmış olması bu başarısızlığı mazur göstermez! Vakit nakittir ve BORÇ denen bir nehirde yüzüyoruz!
Shattered Minds#037.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#038.src: I'm just going to stand here and you're gonna go into the teleporters I'm NOT in, and you're gonna like it!
Shattered Minds#038.dst: Ben burada dikileceğim, sen de benim İÇİNDE OLMADIĞIM ışınlayıcılara gireceksin ve bundan hoşlanacaksın!
Shattered Minds#038.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#039.src: Explore the strange forest to find Likeru.
Shattered Minds#039.dst: Likeru'yu bulmak için garip ormanı keşfet.

Shattered Minds#040.src: Hey, look to your left for a moment.

Shattered Minds#041.src: I hope you've got a note pad with you, if you want me to teach you the ways of a master you'll need to write a lot down!
Shattered Minds#041.dst: Umarım yanında bir not defteri vardır, sana bir ustanın yolunu öğretmemi istiyorsan çok not alman gerekecek!
Shattered Minds#041.speaker: Steve

Shattered Minds#042.src: It doesn't matter that we're on a {~}-match losing streak, we'll never give up!
Shattered Minds#042.dst: Üst üste {~} maç kaybetmemiz önemli değil, asla pes etmeyeceğiz!
Shattered Minds#042.speaker: Erd

Shattered Minds#043.src: C'mon Beakmeister, we've ventured together for years now! Why won't you listen to me?
Shattered Minds#043.dst: Hadi Beakmeister, yıllardır birlikte geziyoruz! Neden beni dinlemiyorsun?
Shattered Minds#043.speaker: Flamingo Rider

Shattered Minds#044.src: I don't think she's even listening to me anymore. She's a free spirit!
Shattered Minds#044.dst: Artık beni dinlediğini bile sanmıyorum. Özgür bir ruh o!
Shattered Minds#044.speaker: Flamingo Rider

Shattered Minds#045.src: Familiar to the nursing home, with no IV in sight! Phenomenal, and now my gambling metaphors will be apropos!
Shattered Minds#045.dst: Huzurevi gibi tanıdık, ama ortada serum yok! Harika, artık kumar benzetmelerim yerinde olacak!
Shattered Minds#045.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#046.src: A solid, {~} pure, statue-made-out-of-tons-of-things what looks like me! I call it, “Ill Of The Ooze, Young!” And it begets your path amongst the lilypads.
Shattered Minds#046.dst: Sağlam, {~} ayar saf, tonlarca şeyden yapılmış, bana benzeyen bir heykel! Adını “Balçığın Hastası, Genç!” koydum. Ve nilüferlerin arasında yolunu açıyor.
Shattered Minds#046.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#047.src: Likeru? No, no, she can’t find you here- her eyes deceive her. But I won't! Not any more than the film reel degrades, and the theater is ahead!
Shattered Minds#047.dst: Likeru mu? Yok, yok, seni burada bulamaz, gözleri onu kandırıyor. Ama ben kandırmayacağım! Film şeridi eskidiğinden fazla değil, sinema da ileride!
Shattered Minds#047.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#048.src: Now, don't tell the kids about this one either! The way forward is through my masterpiece- but I can't imagine a gullet glorious!
Shattered Minds#048.dst: Bunu da çocuklara anlatma! İleri giden yol başyapıtımdan geçiyor, daha görkemli bir gırtlak hayal edemiyorum!
Shattered Minds#048.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#049.src: Enter the giant frog and escape.
Shattered Minds#049.dst: Dev kurbağanın içine gir ve kaç.

Shattered Minds#050.src: Don't come any closer... I don't want to have to fight...
Shattered Minds#050.dst: Daha fazla yaklaşma... Savaşmak zorunda kalmak istemiyorum...

Shattered Minds#051.src: I-I'm warning you. You'll stand no match against me...
Shattered Minds#051.dst: U-uyarıyorum seni. Bana karşı hiç şansın yok...

Shattered Minds#053.src: There we are! Snapped out of it! Though perhaps writing in the mud was better- Soon it will dry.
Shattered Minds#053.dst: İşte oldu! Kendine geldin! Gerçi belki çamura yazmak daha iyiydi, yakında kuruyacak.
Shattered Minds#053.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#054.src: Without the static of the fungal caps, the radio station will be off-air- and the device unplugged!
Shattered Minds#054.dst: Mantar şapkaların paraziti olmadan radyo istasyonu yayın dışı kalacak, cihazın da fişi çekilecek!
Shattered Minds#054.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#055.src: Scratch it in your eyelids- the lightbulb screwed between the arches, and the feather-duster's sunset shades will reveal my deepest compatriot. Quick now, wake!
Shattered Minds#055.dst: Göz kapaklarına kazı: kemerlerin arasına vidalanmış ampul ve tüy süpürgesinin gün batımı tonları en derin yoldaşımı gösterecek. Çabuk, uyan!
Shattered Minds#055.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#056.src: Ugh. Rats chewing the roots. They've their place, it simply isn't here. Neither is your place in the koi pond, stranger.
Shattered Minds#056.dst: Of. Kökleri kemiren fareler. Onların da bir yeri var, sadece burası değil. Senin yerin de koi göleti değil, yabancı.
Shattered Minds#056.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#057.src: I believe Likeru tossed you into the deep end without meaning, so to speak. I understand your being overwhelmed, but still...
Shattered Minds#057.dst: Sanırım Likeru seni istemeden suyun derin yerine attı, tabiri caizse. Bunalmanı anlıyorum ama yine de...
Shattered Minds#057.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#058.src: Speaking of which, it might behoove you to let her know you've recovered. Though, should you need rest, you may take it here.
Shattered Minds#058.dst: Hazır lafı açılmışken, iyileştiğini ona haber versen iyi olur. Gerçi dinlenmen gerekirse burada dinlenebilirsin.
Shattered Minds#058.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#060.src: Ehm. Okay, that was...a bad idea. Should NOT have done that with a human. Uh, noted for the futu- oh, you're actually alright?!
Shattered Minds#060.dst: Ehm. Tamam, bu... kötü bir fikirdi. Bunu bir insanla KESİNLİKLE yapmamalıydım. Ee, bir dahaki sefere not- ah, gerçekten iyi misin?!
Shattered Minds#060.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#061.src: You came back and just leapt into the koi pond! I thought you'd drowned down there!
Shattered Minds#061.dst: Geri gelip doğrudan koi göletine atladın! Orada boğuldun sandım!
Shattered Minds#061.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#062.src: I guess the spores from the Bluecaps got to you before you could bring them back. I wonder what you saw?
Shattered Minds#062.dst: Sanırım Bluecap'lerin sporları, sen onları getiremeden seni etkiledi. Acaba ne gördün?
Shattered Minds#062.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#063.src: You reacted like you were crazy when I tried to talk with you... You were supposed to get visions of the light! A deep connection!
Shattered Minds#063.dst: Seninle konuşmaya çalıştığımda deli gibi tepki verdin... Işığın vizyonlarını görmen gerekiyordu! Derin bir bağ!
Shattered Minds#063.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#064.src: Wait, maybe it's cause of that portal...the signals got mixed? I'll have to look into this more...but hey, I got the Bluecap, anyways, so...
Shattered Minds#064.dst: Dur, belki o geçit yüzündendir... sinyaller karıştı mı? Buna daha çok bakmam lazım... ama hey, Bluecap'i aldım ya, o yüzden...
Shattered Minds#064.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#065.src: Here, your payment- and a little extra I whipped up too. Um, really sorry about all that!
Shattered Minds#065.dst: Al, ödemen, bir de hazırladığım küçük bir ekstra. Şey, bütün bunlar için gerçekten özür dilerim!
Shattered Minds#065.speaker: Likeru

Shrouded in Mist#004.src: Would you like to challenge Sovereign Zhiraok again?
Shrouded in Mist#004.dst: Hükümdar Zhiraok'a tekrar mücadelek ister misin?

Shrouded in Mist#005.src: New Chapter Started: Amongst the Canopy

Shrouded in Mist#006.src: There's a thin layer of dust on top of the bed.
Shrouded in Mist#006.dst: Yatağın üstünde ince bir toz tabakası var.

Shrouded in Mist#007.src: The monitor is keeping the machine running.

Shrouded in Mist#008.src: Maybe something sharp can break it...
Shrouded in Mist#008.dst: Belki keskin bir şey onu kırabilir...

Shrouded in Mist#009.src: - Entry {~}: Stayed in and slept all day. Was very tired.
Shrouded in Mist#009.dst: - Kayıt {~}: Evde kalıp bütün gün uyudum. Çok yorgundum.

Shrouded in Mist#010.src: - Entry {~}: Slept in. Boss wasn't happy with me, has me working extra shifts next week.
Shrouded in Mist#010.dst: - Kayıt {~}: Uyuyakaldım. Patron benden memnun değildi, gelecek hafta fazladan vardiyaya koydu beni.

Shrouded in Mist#013.src: The entries stop after this point...

Shrouded in Mist#014.src: This must be where Nisen lives...

Shrouded in Mist#015.src: Group up with the remaining members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#020.src: About what? What could you possibly be thinking about right-
Shrouded in Mist#020.dst: Neyi? Şu an neyi düşünüyor olabilirsin ki-
Shrouded in Mist#020.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#021.src: I don't know, Yusanu! Maybe about what to do next? How we can- h-how we-
Shrouded in Mist#021.dst: Bilmiyorum, Yusanu! Belki sırada ne yapacağımızı? Nasıl- n-nasıl biz-
Shrouded in Mist#021.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#022.src: There's nothing we can do! We're stuck in unfamiliar territory, all lone, our family and friends all captured, or- or worse-
Shrouded in Mist#022.dst: Yapabileceğimiz hiçbir şey yok! Bilmediğimiz bir yerde mahsur kaldık, yapayalnızız, ailemiz ve dostlarımız yakalandı, ya da- ya da daha kötüsü-
Shrouded in Mist#022.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#024.src: Urgh! I can't believe I let her convince me stealing this... this thing was worth it! If I hadn't, then... then our agreement wouldn't have fallen through, and none of this would have-
Shrouded in Mist#024.dst: Ah! Bu... bu şeyi çalmanın buna değeceğine beni ikna etmesine izin verdiğime inanamıyorum! Etmeseydim... anlaşmamız bozulmazdı ve bunların hiçbiri-
Shrouded in Mist#024.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#025.src: Don't you dare pin this on Rex. You heard what that Sovereign said, they- th-they knew what we were planning for ages!
Shrouded in Mist#025.dst: Sakın bunu Rex'in üstüne yıkma. O Hükümdar'ın ne dediğini duydun, onlar- o-onlar ne planladığımızı çoktandır biliyordu!
Shrouded in Mist#025.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#026.src: ...then maybe it'd have been best if you left us out of it.
Shrouded in Mist#026.dst: ...o zaman belki bizi hiç bulaştırmasaydın daha iyi olurdu.
Shrouded in Mist#026.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#031.src: Woah woah woah woah woah! Alright, let's all take a step back, shall we?
Shrouded in Mist#031.dst: Dur dur dur dur dur! Pekâlâ, hepimiz bir adım geri çekilelim, olur mu?

Shrouded in Mist#032.src: Owls! Step down! Bit of a leap, jumping straight to violence- we reserve that for the obviously crown-aligned, eheheh.
Shrouded in Mist#032.dst: Baykuşlar! Geri çekilin! Doğrudan şiddete atlamak biraz fazla oldu, onu açıkça tacın yanında olanlara saklıyoruz, ehehe.

Shrouded in Mist#033.src: Allow me to introduce myself! The name's Rurie, member of the Canopy, captain of the Owls division! Apologies for the roughhousing, seems everyone's a little enthusiastic today, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#033.dst: Kendimi tanıtayım! Adım Rurie, Canopy üyesi, Baykuşlar bölüğünün kaptanı! Kabalık için kusura bakmayın, bugün herkes biraz hevesli galiba, ha?
Shrouded in Mist#033.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#035.src: Questions, questions! I'm afraid it's our turn first- I've called the owls off for a time, but don't think you're off the hook just yet, young lady!
Shrouded in Mist#035.dst: Sorular, sorular! Korkarım önce sıra bizde. Baykuşları bir süreliğine geri çektim ama hemen paçayı kurtardığını sanma, genç hanım!
Shrouded in Mist#035.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#036.src: ...captain, are you certain about this? For all we know, they could be spies-
Shrouded in Mist#036.dst: ...kaptan, bundan emin misiniz? Bildiğimiz kadarıyla casus olabilirler-
Shrouded in Mist#036.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#037.src: Ah ah ah! Trust in the process, my friend. Spies or not, information is valuable.
Shrouded in Mist#037.dst: Ah ah ah! Sürece güven, dostum. Casus olsunlar ya da olmasınlar, bilgi değerlidir.
Shrouded in Mist#037.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#038.src: Besides! We know how to... ah, deal with spies, as it were. Risk factor is minimal!
Shrouded in Mist#038.dst: Hem! Casuslarla nasıl... ah, başa çıkılacağını biliyoruz, tabiri caizse. Risk minimum!
Shrouded in Mist#038.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#039.src: So... what, are you also resisting-
Shrouded in Mist#039.dst: Yani... ne, siz de mi direniyor-
Shrouded in Mist#039.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#040.src: Hold it there, mister! Didn't you hear me? We'll be asking the questions here first.
Shrouded in Mist#040.dst: Orada dur, bayım! Beni duymadın mı? Burada önce soruları biz soracağız.
Shrouded in Mist#040.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#041.src: Seems you're the only one who hasn't spoken yet! Well now, don't be shy. Tell me - where are you lot from?
Shrouded in Mist#041.dst: Görünüşe göre bir tek sen konuşmadın! Hadi bakalım, utanma. Söyle bana, siz nerelisiniz?
Shrouded in Mist#041.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#042.src: Really? Quite far afield, aren't you? Finding your way from there to here is quite an endeavor.
Shrouded in Mist#042.dst: Gerçekten mi? Epey uzaktan gelmişsiniz, değil mi? Oradan buraya yol bulmak hiç de kolay iş değil.
Shrouded in Mist#042.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#043.src: Ahhh! Now the pieces are clicking together! I think I get it now.
Shrouded in Mist#043.dst: Ahhh! Şimdi parçalar yerine oturuyor! Sanırım anladım.
Shrouded in Mist#043.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#044.src: Ohoho? Really now? How very, very curious. You're either a verrrry clever spy, or...
Shrouded in Mist#044.dst: Ohoho? Sahi mi? Ne kadar da, ne kadar da ilginç. Ya çoook zeki bir casussun, ya da...
Shrouded in Mist#044.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#045.src: H... hey! Listen! I don't know who, or, or what you guys are, but--
Shrouded in Mist#045.dst: H... hey! Dinle! Kim, ya da, ya da ne olduğunuzu bilmiyorum ama--
Shrouded in Mist#045.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#046.src: How many times must I repeat myself? I said no que-
Shrouded in Mist#046.dst: Kaç kere tekrarlamam gerekiyor? Soru yok dedi-
Shrouded in Mist#046.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#047.src: Shut UP! We just BARELY escaped {p} after we- after we tried to KILL the Queen! The rest of our friends are... captured, or d- dead!
Shrouded in Mist#047.dst: KES SESİNİ! {p} şehrinden zar zor KAÇTIK, Kraliçe'yi- Kraliçe'yi ÖLDÜRMEYE çalıştıktan sonra! Diğer dostlarımız... yakalandı ya da ö- öldü!
Shrouded in Mist#047.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#048.src: So- so either leave us alone, or I'll- I'll make sure you never see your loved ones a- again!
Shrouded in Mist#048.dst: O yüzden- o yüzden ya bizi rahat bırakırsın ya da sevdiklerini bir daha a- asla görmemeni sağlarım!
Shrouded in Mist#048.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#051.src: Ohoho, she's sure got some temper, huh?
Shrouded in Mist#051.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#052.src: Rurie... her story could explain what-
Shrouded in Mist#052.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#053.src: Yes, my friend, I was just thinking the very same thing. Well well, new folk, if what you're saying is true, the Canopy might just be able to assist!
Shrouded in Mist#053.dst: Evet dostum, ben de tam aynı şeyi düşünüyordum. Vay vay, yeni gelenler, söyledikleriniz doğruysa Canopy size yardım edebilir!
Shrouded in Mist#053.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#054.src: I may have information regarding your allies.
Shrouded in Mist#054.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#055.dst: Si- sizde mi var? Gerçekten mi...?
Shrouded in Mist#055.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#056.src: Ah- but! But but but, see- trust is a currency here in the {p}. I can't just spill all my secrets at once, can I?
Shrouded in Mist#056.dst: Ah- ama! Ama ama ama, bakın, {p} bölgesinde güven para gibidir. Bütün sırlarımı bir anda dökemem, değil mi?
Shrouded in Mist#056.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#057.src: And if you'd like to earn our trust... I'll need you to, ah, deal with some things for me.
Shrouded in Mist#057.dst: Güvenimizi kazanmak istiyorsanız... benim için, ah, bazı işleri halletmeniz gerekecek.
Shrouded in Mist#057.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#059.src: Oh, nothing too difficult... I'll tell you on one condition! I'll be taking one of you with me as leverage! Eenie, meenie, money... you, little man!
Shrouded in Mist#059.dst: Ah, çok zor bir şey değil... Bir şartla söylerim! Birinizi rehine olarak yanıma alacağım! Ondan, bundan, şundan... sen, ufaklık!
Shrouded in Mist#059.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#061.src: You, indeed! Worry not, for I'll be sure to keep you safe, but... well, you understand the need, yes?
Shrouded in Mist#061.dst: Evet, sen! Merak etme, seni güvende tutacağım, ama... eh, gerekliliğini anlıyorsun, değil mi?
Shrouded in Mist#061.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#062.src: We can't! We can't lose... we can't lose anyone else. Please, there has to be something-
Shrouded in Mist#062.dst: Olmaz! Kaybedemeyiz... başka kimseyi kaybedemeyiz. Lütfen, başka bir yolu olmalı-
Shrouded in Mist#062.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#063.src: Sui... it's... fine. I don't think we have a choice. Just... do what they ask of you.
Shrouded in Mist#063.dst: Sui... sorun... yok. Başka seçeneğimiz olduğunu sanmıyorum. Sadece... senden istediklerini yap.
Shrouded in Mist#063.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#065.src: Goodness, so melodramatic! Come on, I'm a trustworthy fella! You've got nothing to worry about from me.
Shrouded in Mist#065.dst: Tanrım, ne melodram! Hadi ama, ben güvenilir biriyim! Benden korkacak bir şeyiniz yok.
Shrouded in Mist#065.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#067.src: Ah-mazing! I'm glad you chose to be reasonable. In that case - I'll need the remaining two of you to go and sabotage three military structures.
Shrouded in Mist#067.dst: Muh-teşem! Mantıklı davranmanıza sevindim. O halde, kalan ikinizin gidip üç askeri yapıyı sabote etmesi gerekecek.
Shrouded in Mist#067.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#068.src: Now, go and say your goodbyes, then come grab the list from me!
Shrouded in Mist#068.dst: Şimdi gidin vedalaşın, sonra gelip listeyi benden alın!
Shrouded in Mist#068.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#069.src: Talk to Rurie before heading out at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#069.dst: Yola çıkmadan önce [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki Rurie ile konuş.

Shrouded in Mist#070.src: Hey. You'll be fine. I'll be fine.
Shrouded in Mist#070.dst: Hey. Sen iyi olacaksın. Ben de iyi olacağım.
Shrouded in Mist#070.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#071.src: I think we can trust them for now, at least. Not like we have an alternative...
Shrouded in Mist#071.dst: Bence şimdilik onlara güvenebiliriz, en azından. Başka seçeneğimiz var gibi değil...
Shrouded in Mist#071.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#073.src: We really... don't have a choice, do we? We, we need their support.
Shrouded in Mist#073.dst: Gerçekten... başka seçeneğimiz yok, değil mi? Bizim, bizim onların desteğine ihtiyacımız var.
Shrouded in Mist#073.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#074.src: I just... hope Yusanu will be safe.
Shrouded in Mist#074.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#075.src: Ugh... Captain's being reckless as usual...
Shrouded in Mist#075.dst: Of... Kaptan her zamanki gibi pervasız davranıyor...
Shrouded in Mist#075.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#076.src: Have we finished with the heartfelt goodbyes? Excellent. Truly, I am glad you took me up on this generous offer.
Shrouded in Mist#076.dst: Duygusal vedalaşmalar bitti mi? Harika. Gerçekten, bu cömert teklifimi kabul etmenize sevindim.
Shrouded in Mist#076.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#077.src: Don't worry about your little friend over there! He'll be safe and sound amongst our Canopy.
Shrouded in Mist#077.dst: Şuradaki küçük dostunuzu dert etmeyin! Canopy'mizin arasında sapasağlam kalacak.
Shrouded in Mist#077.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#078.src: ...and how can we trust you? To not... hurt him?
Shrouded in Mist#078.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#079.src: Ah, isn't that the issue at the heart of it all? You can't. But as I said, trust is valuable in these woods. That must go both ways!
Shrouded in Mist#079.dst: Ah, işin özündeki sorun da bu değil mi? Güvenemezsiniz. Ama dediğim gibi, bu ormanlarda güven değerlidir. Bu da iki taraflı olmalı!
Shrouded in Mist#079.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#080.src: Well, newbies! You've a list of the structures I need you to sabotage, so it really should be a simple task.
Shrouded in Mist#080.dst: Eee, acemiler! Sabote etmenizi istediğim yapıların listesi elinizde, gayet basit bir iş olmalı.
Shrouded in Mist#080.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#081.src: Just find a way to... disable them! However you manage it, I can't say I really care - so long as it gets done!
Shrouded in Mist#081.dst: Onları... devre dışı bırakmanın bir yolunu bulun! Nasıl yaptığınız pek umurumda değil, yeter ki iş görülsün!
Shrouded in Mist#081.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#083.src: Why, because it's a golden opportunity! The work needs doing, and you need a way to prove yourselves...
Shrouded in Mist#083.dst: Çünkü bu altın bir fırsat! İşin yapılması lazım, sizin de kendinizi kanıtlamanın bir yoluna ihtiyacınız var...
Shrouded in Mist#083.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#084.src: So why not? It's less work for me to do, so I'm not complaining!
Shrouded in Mist#084.dst: Neden olmasın? Bana daha az iş düşüyor, şikâyetim yok!
Shrouded in Mist#084.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#085.src: Newbies! That's what you are, isn't it? New to the woods, new to the world...
Shrouded in Mist#085.dst: Acemiler! Öylesiniz, değil mi? Ormana yeni, dünyaya yeni...
Shrouded in Mist#085.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#086.src: ...maybe new to Fruma, even? Ah ah, wipe that expression of shock off your face! I won't tell if you don't either.
Shrouded in Mist#086.dst: ...belki Fruma'ya bile yeni? Ah ah, o şaşkın ifadeyi yüzünüzden silin! Siz söylemezseniz ben de söylemem.
Shrouded in Mist#086.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#087.dst: Her zamanki gibi ilham dolu! Güzel!
Shrouded in Mist#087.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#088.src: Once you're done, find me back here! Just don't take too long, eh? Wouldn't want to get bored!
Shrouded in Mist#088.dst: İşiniz bitince beni burada bulun! Ama çok oyalanmayın, olur mu? Sıkılmak istemem!
Shrouded in Mist#088.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#089.src: Ta ta, newbies! Good luck out there! And just a word of advice - stay on your guard. You never know what the mists may be hiding.
Shrouded in Mist#089.dst: Hoşça kalın, acemiler! Bol şans! Bir de küçük bir tavsiye: tetikte olun. Sislerin neler sakladığını asla bilemezsiniz.
Shrouded in Mist#089.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#090.src: Select the structure to sabotage using the checklist.
Shrouded in Mist#090.dst: Kontrol listesini kullanarak sabote edilecek yapıyı seç.

Shrouded in Mist#091.src: Still a bit lost? Just use your taskbook to find the things I need broken!
Shrouded in Mist#091.dst: Hâlâ biraz kayıp mısınız? Kırılmasını istediğim şeyleri bulmak için görev defterinizi kullanın!
Shrouded in Mist#091.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#092.src: Head to the watchtower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it using a spell.
Shrouded in Mist#092.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki gözetleme kulesine git ve bir büyüyle sabote et.

Shrouded in Mist#093.src: So is this... the place? "Military... Watchtower..." I guess so.
Shrouded in Mist#093.dst: Burası mı... o yer? “Askeri... Gözetleme Kulesi...” Sanırım öyle.
Shrouded in Mist#093.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#094.src: Those supports look rather unstable, don't they? I wonder...
Shrouded in Mist#094.dst: Şu destekler epey dengesiz görünüyor, değil mi? Acaba...
Shrouded in Mist#094.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#095.src: C-can you deal with them, please?
Shrouded in Mist#095.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#096.src: Huh?! We're under attack - it must be the Canopy!
Shrouded in Mist#096.speaker: Watchtower Guard

Shrouded in Mist#098.src: Let's just get this over with.
Shrouded in Mist#098.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#100.src: Check the book, where should we go next?
Shrouded in Mist#100.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#102.src: Head to the water pump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it.
Shrouded in Mist#102.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki su pompasına git ve sabote et.

Shrouded in Mist#104.src: I think we can work together for this one. Go, um, blast some weak spots on the structure, and I'll... see if I can reverse the water flow.
Shrouded in Mist#104.dst: Bence bu sefer birlikte çalışabiliriz. Sen, şey, yapının zayıf noktalarını patlat, ben de... su akışını tersine çevirebilir miyim bakayım.
Shrouded in Mist#104.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#105.src: Let's just... get rid of this hunk of junk.
Shrouded in Mist#105.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#106.src: You, um, should try to blast some of the weak points with your magic.
Shrouded in Mist#106.dst: Sen, şey, büyünle zayıf noktalardan bazılarını patlatmayı denemelisin.
Shrouded in Mist#106.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#107.src: Did you manage to apply some pressure on the pipes?
Shrouded in Mist#107.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#108.src: Good, then it's... time for my part, I guess. Um, come talk to me when you're ready.
Shrouded in Mist#108.dst: Güzel, o zaman... sıra bende, galiba. Şey, hazır olunca gel benimle konuş.
Shrouded in Mist#108.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#110.src: Okay... okay. Breathe. I need to... focus.
Shrouded in Mist#110.dst: Tamam... tamam. Nefes al. Odaklanmam... lazım.
Shrouded in Mist#110.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#111.src: After... after, um, everything that- that's happened, I've been... struggling with my cur-... ugh. You get what I mean.
Shrouded in Mist#111.dst: Olanlardan... olanlardan sonra, şey, her- her şeyden sonra... lanetimle başa çık-... of. Ne demek istediğimi anlıyorsun.
Shrouded in Mist#111.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#112.src: It all feels so... so... hopeless! We've lost everyone, and now- now we've lost Yusanu too, and I... I couldn't do anything!
Shrouded in Mist#112.dst: Her şey öyle... öyle... umutsuz geliyor ki! Herkesi kaybettik, şimdi- şimdi Yusanu'yu da kaybettik ve ben... ben hiçbir şey yapamadım!
Shrouded in Mist#112.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#113.src: And the last thing we did before was... argue! And now, he's... he's safe, probably, but... I don't know. I wish we hadn't.
Shrouded in Mist#113.dst: Ve ondan önce yaptığımız son şey... tartışmaktı! Şimdi o... o güvende, muhtemelen, ama... bilmiyorum. Keşke tartışmasaydık.
Shrouded in Mist#113.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#114.src: Every time I think about- about any of it, I get so... angry! And the swirling ocean around me starts raging more and more and more, and... and...
Shrouded in Mist#114.dst: Ne zaman- ne zaman bunlardan birini düşünsem öyle... sinirleniyorum ki! Etrafımdaki girdaplı okyanus da gittikçe daha çok, daha çok kabarıyor ve... ve...
Shrouded in Mist#114.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#115.src: I'm scared, {u}. I'm scared for Mora... Syndra... Rex, Zeph, the whole Steel Feather- for all of them! And I... there's nothing I can do...
Shrouded in Mist#115.dst: Korkuyorum, {u}. Mora... Syndra... Rex, Zeph, bütün Steel Feather için korkuyorum, hepsi için! Ve ben... yapabileceğim hiçbir şey yok...
Shrouded in Mist#115.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#116.src: What if... what if they're all gone? And, and, and it's just us, forever...?
Shrouded in Mist#116.dst: Ya... ya hepsi gittiyse? Ve, ve, ve sonsuza dek sadece biz kaldıysak...?
Shrouded in Mist#116.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#117.src: I... I know, {u}, I know! I'm... I'm trying, okay?!
Shrouded in Mist#117.dst: Ben... Biliyorum, {u}, biliyorum! Ben... deniyorum, tamam mı?!
Shrouded in Mist#117.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#120.src: I don't know if I, ha, have any left. Everything's... moving so fast...
Shrouded in Mist#120.dst: Bende hiç kaldı mı bilmiyorum, ha. Her şey... çok hızlı ilerliyor...
Shrouded in Mist#120.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#121.src: I... I never wanted any of this. I just... I just wanted to live...
Shrouded in Mist#121.dst: Ben... ben bunların hiçbirini istemedim. Ben sadece... sadece yaşamak istedim...
Shrouded in Mist#121.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#122.src: Sigh... okay. Sui, focus. You can do this.
Shrouded in Mist#122.dst: Of... tamam. Sui, odaklan. Bunu yapabilirsin.
Shrouded in Mist#122.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#124.src: That's... I don't... how did I...
Shrouded in Mist#124.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#125.src: It... the ocean, it... stopped. I pulled at it, and it... it stopped moving, and...
Shrouded in Mist#125.dst: O... okyanus... durdu. Ona çektim ve o... hareket etmeyi bıraktı ve...
Shrouded in Mist#125.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#126.src: There's... there's no time to, to think about it. It worked, so... so that's good.
Shrouded in Mist#126.dst: Bunu... bunu düşünmeye, düşünmeye vakit yok. İşe yaradı, yani... yani bu iyi.
Shrouded in Mist#126.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#127.src: Just... check the book, what's our next stop?
Shrouded in Mist#127.dst: Sadece... deftere bak, sıradaki durağımız neresi?
Shrouded in Mist#127.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#128.src: I... I think that was the last one. Let's go tell Rurie that it's, um, done.
Shrouded in Mist#128.dst: Ben... sanırım sonuncusu buydu. Gidip Rurie'ye işin, şey, bittiğini söyleyelim.
Shrouded in Mist#128.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#129.src: Head to the mining drill at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#131.src: It looks... durable. Like, um, it'll be hard to just... break. We need to find another way...
Shrouded in Mist#131.dst: Epey... sağlam görünüyor. Yani, şey, öylece... kırmak zor olacak. Başka bir yol bulmamız lazım...
Shrouded in Mist#131.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#132.src: There- there isn't any water nearby. So, so if any soldiers show up... please, can you deal with them?
Shrouded in Mist#132.dst: Ya- yakında hiç su yok. Yani, yani asker gelirse... lütfen, onları halledebilir misin?
Shrouded in Mist#132.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#133.src: Aha, saboteurs! You won't get away with damaging the crown's property, not on my watch!
Shrouded in Mist#133.dst: Aha, sabotajcılar! Tacın malına zarar verip yanınıza kâr kalmayacak, ben buradayken asla!
Shrouded in Mist#133.speaker: Mistwoods Captain

Shrouded in Mist#134.src: Um... good job, {u}. I didn't think about breaking the controls...
Shrouded in Mist#134.dst: Şey... aferin, {u}. Kontrolleri kırmayı hiç düşünmemiştim...
Shrouded in Mist#134.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#135.src: We should check the book, and find our next stop.
Shrouded in Mist#135.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#136.src: Was that the last one? Let's head back to Rurie and... and tell him it's done.
Shrouded in Mist#136.dst: Sonuncusu bu muydu? Rurie'ye dönüp... işin bittiğini söyleyelim.
Shrouded in Mist#136.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#137.src: Return to Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and discuss the next step.
Shrouded in Mist#137.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki Rurie'ye dön ve sonraki adımı konuş.

Shrouded in Mist#138.src: Well well! So the newbies return! Tell me, how did you find your trial?
Shrouded in Mist#138.dst: Vay vay! Acemiler dönmüş! Söyleyin bakalım, sınavınız nasıldı?
Shrouded in Mist#138.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#139.src: We did what you asked, so... so tell us about our friends, already!
Shrouded in Mist#139.dst: İstediğini yaptık, o yüzden... o yüzden dostlarımızdan bahset artık!
Shrouded in Mist#139.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#140.src: Ah ah ah! Not so fast! I'm afraid you're not done quite yet!
Shrouded in Mist#140.dst: Ah ah ah! O kadar hızlı değil! Korkarım işiniz henüz tam bitmedi!
Shrouded in Mist#140.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#142.src: Deadly serious, I fear! That, dear friends, was but the first part of your task.
Shrouded in Mist#142.dst: Ölümüne ciddiyim, maalesef! O, sevgili dostlarım, görevinizin yalnızca ilk kısmıydı.
Shrouded in Mist#142.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#143.src: Oh, but on the contrary! I received word immediately once you had done the deed.
Shrouded in Mist#143.dst: Ah, tam tersine! İşi bitirdiğiniz anda haberim oldu.
Shrouded in Mist#143.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#144.src: Ugh... we had an agreement! You can't just-
Shrouded in Mist#144.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#145.src: But I can. If you want our support, you'll do what we ask. If it is any consolation, this is the last I will ask of you before our deal is concluded.
Shrouded in Mist#145.dst: Ama yapabilirim. Desteğimizi istiyorsanız istediğimizi yapacaksınız. Biraz teselli olacaksa, anlaşmamız bitmeden sizden isteyeceğim son şey bu.
Shrouded in Mist#145.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#147.src: I would ask of you to kindly... ehm, transport an {p} citizen here. Do make sure you aren't spotted by anyone else! That could cause... issues.
Shrouded in Mist#147.dst: Sizden rica etsem... ehm, bir {p} vatandaşını buraya taşır mısınız? Başka kimseye görünmediğinizden emin olun! Bu... sorun çıkarabilir.
Shrouded in Mist#147.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#149.src: Ah! Allow me to rephrase. You need to kidnap them.
Shrouded in Mist#149.dst: Ah! Şöyle söyleyeyim. Onu kaçırmanız gerekiyor.
Shrouded in Mist#149.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#151.src: Yes, indeed! Kidnap them, bring them here, and we will deal with the rest.
Shrouded in Mist#151.dst: Evet, aynen! Kaçırın, buraya getirin, gerisini biz hallederiz.
Shrouded in Mist#151.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#152.src: You want us to just... just snatch a random citizen from their home? And, and what do you mean "deal with the rest?"
Shrouded in Mist#152.dst: Yani rastgele bir vatandaşı öylece... öylece evinden mi kapalım? Hem, hem “gerisini halletmek” ne demek?
Shrouded in Mist#152.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#153.src: No questions, young lady! Not if you'd like to ensure the safety of your friend, that is.
Shrouded in Mist#153.dst: Soru yok, genç hanım! Tabii dostunun güvende kalmasını istiyorsan.
Shrouded in Mist#153.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#155.src: You didn't even tell us who we're looking for!
Shrouded in Mist#155.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#156.src: Ahaha, apologies, my mistake! You'll be looking for the man named Nisen. Bring him here, but don't take too long!
Shrouded in Mist#156.dst: Ahaha, kusura bakmayın, benim hatam! Nisen adında bir adamı arayacaksınız. Onu buraya getirin ama çok oyalanmayın!
Shrouded in Mist#156.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#157.src: Nisen. Fine. {u}, let's... talk about this outside the cave.
Shrouded in Mist#157.dst: Nisen. Peki. {u}, bunu... mağaranın dışında konuşalım.
Shrouded in Mist#157.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#158.src: Leave the cave and discuss the plan with Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#158.dst: Mağaradan çık ve [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumunda Sui ile planı konuş.

Shrouded in Mist#160.src: This... this is just getting ridiculous.
Shrouded in Mist#160.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#161.src: We, we need to find a way to get Yusanu back, and... and get out of here.
Shrouded in Mist#161.dst: Bizim, bizim Yusanu'yu geri almanın bir yolunu bulmamız ve... ve buradan çıkmamız lazım.
Shrouded in Mist#161.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#162.src: I know, I know, I know! And if we start looking, they'll, they'll notice.
Shrouded in Mist#162.dst: Biliyorum, biliyorum, biliyorum! Aramaya başlarsak da onlar, onlar fark eder.
Shrouded in Mist#162.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#163.src: I'm... sick and tired of following that clown's orders. But you're right...
Shrouded in Mist#163.dst: O palyaçonun emirlerine uymaktan... bıktım usandım. Ama haklısın...
Shrouded in Mist#163.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#164.src: It's just... weird. This last task. I don't get it.
Shrouded in Mist#164.dst: Sadece... tuhaf. Bu son görev. Anlamıyorum.
Shrouded in Mist#164.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#165.src: Even if Rurie's out of his mind... I don't see him just- just killing an innocent person. Especially if they're, um, a resistance group.
Shrouded in Mist#165.dst: Rurie aklını kaçırmış olsa bile... masum birini öylece- öylece öldüreceğini sanmıyorum. Hele ki onlar, şey, bir direniş grubuysa.
Shrouded in Mist#165.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#166.src: Ugh. I don't know. Maybe if we investigate this Nisen person, we'll... figure out Rurie's reasoning.
Shrouded in Mist#166.dst: Of. Bilmiyorum. Belki şu Nisen denen kişiyi araştırırsak... Rurie'nin neden böyle yaptığını anlarız.
Shrouded in Mist#166.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#168.src: Head to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and locate Nisen.
Shrouded in Mist#168.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki {p} bölgesine git ve Nisen'i bul.

Shrouded in Mist#170.src: Phew. Getting up here really wasn't the easiest... the Red Fox back in Auburn really, ha, pales in comparison.
Shrouded in Mist#170.dst: Of. Buraya çıkmak hiç de kolay değildi... Auburn'deki Red Fox bunun yanında, ha, sönük kalıyor.
Shrouded in Mist#170.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#171.src: I've been trying to get information on Nisen, but... people don't seem to like me much.
Shrouded in Mist#171.dst: Nisen hakkında bilgi almaya çalışıyorum ama... insanlar beni pek sevmiyor gibi.
Shrouded in Mist#171.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#172.src: Maybe you'll have some better luck?
Shrouded in Mist#172.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#187.src: ...I don't...see it. You haven't got one- Er. I. I mean. Nothing. No. Definitely, uh...definitely not.
Shrouded in Mist#187.dst: ...göremiyorum...onu. Sende yok- Şey. Ben. Yani. Hiçbir şey. Hayır. Kesinlikle, ee...kesinlikle değil.
Shrouded in Mist#187.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#188.src: I can't look, I'm really not supposed to be talking to you at all, and Wait, that counts as urgh!
Shrouded in Mist#188.dst: Bakamam, seninle hiç konuşmamam gerekiyor aslında, ve dur, bu da sayılır, off!
Shrouded in Mist#188.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#189.src: ...I'm. I. You. ...ugh, I'm no good at this.
Shrouded in Mist#189.dst: ...Ben. Ben. Sen. ...of, bu işlerde hiç iyi değilim.
Shrouded in Mist#189.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#190.src: ...well. ...sorry. Nisen... I. I do know. I shouldn't be telling you, but I do know. Please don't hurt me.
Shrouded in Mist#190.dst: ...peki. ...özür dilerim. Nisen... Ben. Biliyorum. Sana söylememem lazım ama biliyorum. Lütfen bana zarar verme.
Shrouded in Mist#190.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#191.src: You need to take the zipline north-west. Not the one that goes upwards, though.
Shrouded in Mist#191.dst: Kuzeybatıya giden zipline'ı kullanman lazım. Ama yukarı çıkanı değil.
Shrouded in Mist#191.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#195.src: Search Nisen's house for any [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] clues regarding him.
Shrouded in Mist#195.dst: Nisen'in evinde [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] onunla ilgili ipucu ara.

Shrouded in Mist#196.src: Um, let's hope he's not home...
Shrouded in Mist#196.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#197.src: That's odd... the latest entry's dated from weeks ago.
Shrouded in Mist#197.dst: Garip... en son kayıt haftalar öncesine ait.
Shrouded in Mist#197.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#198.src: It's like they stopped writing them abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#198.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#201.src: Eep! That must be Nisen! We need to think of an excuse...
Shrouded in Mist#201.dst: İiik! Nisen bu olmalı! Bir bahane bulmamız lazım...
Shrouded in Mist#201.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#202.src: Excuse me? What are you doing in my abode?
Shrouded in Mist#202.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#203.src: If I am not mistaken, stumbling into other people's abodes is not a custom.
Shrouded in Mist#203.dst: Yanılmıyorsam, başkalarının evine dalmak bir gelenek değildir.
Shrouded in Mist#203.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#204.src: Oh... I- I'm so sorry! I- I- we- we thought this was the... bakery.
Shrouded in Mist#204.dst: Ah... Ç- çok özür dilerim! B- b- biz- biz burayı... fırın sandık.
Shrouded in Mist#204.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#206.src: Oh. Yes, wrong building. The bakery is down at ground level.
Shrouded in Mist#206.dst: Ah. Evet, yanlış bina. Fırın aşağıda, zemin katta.
Shrouded in Mist#206.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#207.src: Oh! Thank you for the directions. We are... so sorry for the misunderstanding.
Shrouded in Mist#207.dst: Ah! Yol tarifi için teşekkürler. Yanlış anlaşılma için... çok özür dileriz.
Shrouded in Mist#207.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#208.src: Regroup with Sui at the main square at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#208.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki ana meydanda Sui ile buluş.

Shrouded in Mist#210.src: That was close... I'm, um, surprised he believed us.
Shrouded in Mist#210.dst: Kıl payı kurtulduk... Şey, bize inanmasına şaşırdım.
Shrouded in Mist#210.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#211.src: I- I panicked, okay! But it worked, didn't it?
Shrouded in Mist#211.dst: P- panikledim, tamam mı! Ama işe yaradı, değil mi?
Shrouded in Mist#211.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#212.src: He was... surprisingly chatty. That's a nice change compared to everyone else.
Shrouded in Mist#212.dst: Şaşırtıcı derecede... konuşkandı. Herkesle kıyaslayınca güzel bir değişiklik.
Shrouded in Mist#212.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#213.src: Though, um, he was a bit... odd. He didn't seem too certain about his answers...
Shrouded in Mist#213.dst: Gerçi, şey, biraz... tuhaftı. Cevaplarından pek emin görünmüyordu...
Shrouded in Mist#213.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#214.src: I don't know. What are you thinking? Any theories?
Shrouded in Mist#214.dst: Bilmiyorum. Sen ne düşünüyorsun? Bir fikrin var mı?
Shrouded in Mist#214.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#215.src: I... was thinking the same thing. It'd explain the diary entries stopping abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#215.dst: Ben de... aynı şeyi düşünüyordum. Günlük kayıtlarının birden kesilmesini açıklar...
Shrouded in Mist#215.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#216.src: Maybe... I guess he could be. I might just be jumping to conclusions.
Shrouded in Mist#216.dst: Belki... olabilir, sanırım. Belki de aceleyle sonuca atlıyorumdur.
Shrouded in Mist#216.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#217.src: Uh... let's workshop that one a little.
Shrouded in Mist#217.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#218.src: Look, I managed to snag a schedule off his bedside table.
Shrouded in Mist#218.dst: Bak, komodinin üstünden bir program kapmayı başardım.
Shrouded in Mist#218.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#219.src: Listen to this. "Deliver hunting tools from weaponsmith through southern exit at noon."
Shrouded in Mist#219.dst: Şunu dinle: “Silah ustasından aldığın av aletlerini öğle vakti güney çıkışından teslim et.”
Shrouded in Mist#219.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#220.src: It's weird, right? Something's definitely off with him... but still, kidnapping him and handing him off to some... some random bird-man! I don't like it.
Shrouded in Mist#220.dst: Tuhaf, değil mi? Onda kesinlikle bir terslik var... ama yine de onu kaçırıp bir... rastgele kuş adama teslim etmek! Hoşuma gitmiyor.
Shrouded in Mist#220.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#221.src: But... we don't have much of a choice. Let's camp outside the southern gate and wait...
Shrouded in Mist#221.dst: Ama... pek seçeneğimiz yok. Güney kapısının dışında pusu kurup bekleyelim...
Shrouded in Mist#221.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#224.src: Guess we'll just have to wait...
Shrouded in Mist#224.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#226.src: I... ha, I've been feeling really out of my depth, here. I've never had to do this much without... um, without their support.
Shrouded in Mist#226.dst: Ben... ha, burada hiç kendimi boyumu aşan bir işte gibi hissediyorum. Hiç bu kadar şeyi... şey, onların desteği olmadan yapmak zorunda kalmamıştım.
Shrouded in Mist#226.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#227.src: But... you're here to help, so. Um. Thanks for- for sticking with me. I... I don't think I'd have made it this far without you.
Shrouded in Mist#227.dst: Ama... sen yardım etmek için buradasın, yani. Şey. Benimle- benimle kaldığın için teşekkürler. Sen olmasan... buraya kadar gelebileceğimi sanmıyorum.
Shrouded in Mist#227.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#231.src: Um... I think it worked, though. Can you help me?
Shrouded in Mist#231.dst: Şey... ama sanırım işe yaradı. Bana yardım edebilir misin?
Shrouded in Mist#231.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#233.src: That was... easier than I expected it to be.
Shrouded in Mist#233.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#234.src: I kind of just, um, landed on top of him? And... and here we are.
Shrouded in Mist#234.dst: Ben sadece, şey, tam üstüne düştüm galiba? Ve... ve işte buradayız.
Shrouded in Mist#234.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#235.src: We should... probably get moving. I don't want anyone to- to see us!
Shrouded in Mist#235.dst: Sanırım... harekete geçsek iyi olur. Kimsenin- kimsenin bizi görmesini istemiyorum!
Shrouded in Mist#235.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#236.src: Um! Control is... maybe not the right word. I... ha, I tried to freeze him. So... still working on it. I guess.
Shrouded in Mist#236.dst: Şey! Kontrol belki... doğru kelime değil. Ben... ha, onu dondurmaya çalıştım. Yani... hâlâ üstünde çalışıyorum. Sanırım.
Shrouded in Mist#236.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#237.src: ......how are we going to move him?
Shrouded in Mist#237.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#238.src: Um! I... didn't think about that.
Shrouded in Mist#238.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#239.src: Well well, newbies! Looks like you could use a hand!
Shrouded in Mist#239.dst: Vay vay, acemiler! Bir yardım eline ihtiyacınız var gibi!
Shrouded in Mist#239.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#240.src: Aah! Wh- where did you come from?!
Shrouded in Mist#240.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#241.src: Why, from the trees, of course! I see you've managed to subdue the good mister Nisen over here, well done, well done.
Shrouded in Mist#241.dst: Ağaçlardan tabii ki! Görüyorum ki sayın Nisen beyi etkisiz hale getirmeyi başarmışsınız, aferin, aferin.
Shrouded in Mist#241.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#242.src: ...we've done everything you've asked for. Now- now tell us what you know!!
Shrouded in Mist#242.dst: ...istediğin her şeyi yaptık. Şimdi- şimdi bildiklerini anlat!!
Shrouded in Mist#242.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#243.src: Oh, dear, you thought you two were done? Ha! Ahahaha!
Shrouded in Mist#243.dst: Aman tanrım, işiniz bitti mi sandınız? Ha! Ahahaha!
Shrouded in Mist#243.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#245.src: Kidding! Kidding, kidding- goodness, the looks on your faces! What's a little practical joke between friends, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#245.dst: Şaka! Şaka, şaka! Tanrım, yüzünüzün haline bakın! Dostlar arasında küçük bir şakanın ne zararı var, ha?
Shrouded in Mist#245.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#246.src: Fine! Fine, fine, I get it! Jeez, lady...
Shrouded in Mist#246.dst: Tamam! Tamam, tamam, anladım! Hadi ama, hanım...
Shrouded in Mist#246.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#247.src: I'll cut it with the jokes... for now. Good news! You've passed the test!
Shrouded in Mist#247.dst: Şakaları keseceğim... şimdilik. Müjde! Sınavı geçtiniz!
Shrouded in Mist#247.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#249.src: Yes, yes, settle down, I will tell you. Give me a moment! Goodness. You're an impatient one, aren't you?
Shrouded in Mist#249.dst: Evet, evet, sakin ol, anlatacağım. Bir saniye ver! Tanrım. Sabırsız birisin, değil mi?
Shrouded in Mist#249.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#250.src: I'll be bringing you two to the Canopy! But, ah, one little precaution- I'll have to blindfold you till we arrive, Just a security measure!
Shrouded in Mist#250.dst: İkinizi Canopy'ye götüreceğim! Ama, ah, ufak bir önlem: varana kadar gözlerinizi bağlamam gerekecek. Sadece güvenlik tedbiri!
Shrouded in Mist#250.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#251.src: Ugh... you know what, I don't even care anymore. Just... bring us to Yusanu.
Shrouded in Mist#251.dst: Of... biliyor musun, artık umurumda bile değil. Sadece... bizi Yusanu'ya götür.
Shrouded in Mist#251.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#252.dst: Perfecto! Hadi yola çıkalım o zaman!
Shrouded in Mist#252.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#253.src: Ugh! Fine fine fine! But hurry up.
Shrouded in Mist#253.dst: Of! Tamam tamam tamam! Ama acele et.
Shrouded in Mist#253.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#254.src: Rurie, care to explain yourself? Why did you bring these outsiders here?
Shrouded in Mist#254.dst: Rurie, kendini açıklamak ister misin? Bu yabancıları neden buraya getirdin?
Shrouded in Mist#254.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#256.src: Ah, you know how it is, Fuhue! I was oh so bored on patrol this morning! You lot aren't exactly the life of the party..
Shrouded in Mist#256.dst: Ah, bilirsin işte, Fuhue! Bu sabah devriyede öyle sıkıldım ki! Siz de pek eğlenceli sayılmazsınız..
Shrouded in Mist#256.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#257.src: You know Azael has clear rules on recruiting. Did you file the necessary paperwork? Because I didn't see anything on my desk regarding this.
Shrouded in Mist#257.dst: Azael'in eleman alma konusunda net kuralları olduğunu biliyorsun. Gerekli evrakları doldurdun mu? Çünkü masamda bununla ilgili hiçbir şey görmedim.
Shrouded in Mist#257.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#258.src: The... ah, the paperwork was real? I always thought it was something you were making up for the fun of it.
Shrouded in Mist#258.dst: Ev... ah, evraklar gerçek miydi? Hep onları eğlence olsun diye uydurduğunu sanıyordum.
Shrouded in Mist#258.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#259.src: No. We have the protocols in place for a reason, Captain Rurie. Will you find the time to review them yourself, or must I have Captain Cileon run you through them?
Shrouded in Mist#259.dst: Hayır. Protokollerin bir nedeni var, Kaptan Rurie. Onları kendin mi gözden geçireceksin, yoksa Kaptan Cileon'un sana anlatmasını mı sağlayayım?
Shrouded in Mist#259.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#260.src: Yes, yes, I understand the importance- though, I believe Cileon shares my views on the protocols. Isn't that right, Cileon?
Shrouded in Mist#260.dst: Evet, evet, önemini anlıyorum. Gerçi Cileon'un da protokoller hakkında benimle aynı fikirde olduğunu düşünüyorum. Değil mi, Cileon?
Shrouded in Mist#260.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#262.src: H- hey! Don't just act like, like we aren't right here!
Shrouded in Mist#262.dst: H- hey! Biz, biz burada değilmişiz gibi davranmayın!
Shrouded in Mist#262.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#263.src: Cileon! That is also against our protocols. We wouldn't want to leave a body for the crown to find, we have far simpler forms of disposal.
Shrouded in Mist#263.dst: Cileon! Bu da protokollerimize aykırı. Tacın bulacağı bir ceset bırakmak istemeyiz, çok daha basit ortadan kaldırma yöntemlerimiz var.
Shrouded in Mist#263.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#264.src: And of course, we need to torture any necessary information out of them first - I have heard this a dozen times over.
Shrouded in Mist#264.dst: Ve tabii ki önce gerekli bilgileri işkenceyle onlardan almamız lazım. Bunu bir düzine kez duydum.
Shrouded in Mist#264.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#265.src: Ah! You were listening! Good, Captain Rurie. We'll knock some sense into you yet.
Shrouded in Mist#265.dst: Ah! Dinliyormuşsun! Aferin, Kaptan Rurie. Seni eninde sonunda akıllandıracağız.
Shrouded in Mist#265.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#266.src: I did have some deerlings bring Nisen into our processing room earlier. Thank you for your service, Captain.
Shrouded in Mist#266.dst: Biraz önce birkaç geyikçiğe Nisen'i sorgu odamıza getirttim. Hizmetin için teşekkürler, Kaptan.
Shrouded in Mist#266.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#267.src: Ah, no problem! Hardly even broke a sweat!
Shrouded in Mist#267.dst: Ah, ne demek! Ter bile dökmedim!
Shrouded in Mist#267.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#268.src: Well, I'll be catching up with you later! I suppose if we're following protocols, I'll need to hand these kids off to Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#268.dst: Neyse, sonra görüşürüz! Protokollere uyacaksak, bu çocukları Azael'e teslim etmem gerekiyor sanırım.
Shrouded in Mist#268.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#269.src: Hey hey, friends! I'm a bit thirsty, so I'll be leaving you now! Think you'll manage to find Azael yourselves?
Shrouded in Mist#269.dst: Hey hey, dostlar! Biraz susadım, o yüzden sizi burada bırakıyorum! Azael'i kendi başınıza bulabilir misiniz?
Shrouded in Mist#269.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#270.src: Find the leader inside the Canopy at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#271.src: Hm. Rurie told you to find Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#271.speaker: Cileon

Shrouded in Mist#280.src: The schedule's always so busy... and now I have even more to deal with.
Shrouded in Mist#280.dst: Program hep çok yoğun... şimdi uğraşacak daha da fazla işim var.
Shrouded in Mist#280.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#281.src: But I suppose I can squeeze you in for questions.
Shrouded in Mist#281.dst: Ama sanırım sorularınız için size biraz vakit ayırabilirim.
Shrouded in Mist#281.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#282.src: I am Fuhue, Team Captain of the Deer clan.
Shrouded in Mist#282.dst: Ben Fuhue, Geyik klanının Takım Kaptanı.
Shrouded in Mist#282.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#283.src: I also function as the overall manager of the Canopy, not just the Deer operations.
Shrouded in Mist#283.dst: Ayrıca sadece Geyik operasyonlarının değil, Canopy'nin genel yöneticisi olarak da görev yapıyorum.
Shrouded in Mist#283.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#284.src: Master Azael can be found in his hut... it's just to the south-west of here.
Shrouded in Mist#284.dst: Usta Azael'i kulübesinde bulabilirsiniz... buranın hemen güneybatısında.
Shrouded in Mist#284.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#285.src: From what I've heard, your friend is over there as well.
Shrouded in Mist#285.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#286.src: I'm afraid so. Insufferable as always...
Shrouded in Mist#286.dst: Korkarım öyle. Her zamanki gibi çekilmez...
Shrouded in Mist#286.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#287.src: But he's incredibly talented at what he does. No one else could run the Owls like he does.
Shrouded in Mist#287.dst: Ama işinde inanılmaz yetenekli. Baykuşları onun gibi kimse yönetemezdi.
Shrouded in Mist#287.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#289.src: Or not! It's Master Azael's decision as to whether you stay or not. Just hope you manage to impress him.
Shrouded in Mist#289.dst: Ya da görüşmeyiz! Kalıp kalmayacağınıza Usta Azael karar verir. Onu etkilemeyi başarmanızı umun.
Shrouded in Mist#289.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#290.src: I have heard about your adventures in the {p} thus far. Very impressive work.
Shrouded in Mist#290.dst: {p} bölgesindeki maceralarınızı duydum. Çok etkileyici bir iş.
Shrouded in Mist#290.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#291.src: Not to interrupt you, but we've been running around all day, and I'm tired. Where's Yusanu?
Shrouded in Mist#291.dst: Sözünüzü kesmek istemem ama bütün gün koşturduk ve yorgunum. Yusanu nerede?
Shrouded in Mist#291.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#294.src: Oh, you're okay... I'm so glad.
Shrouded in Mist#294.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#295.src: Yes, reunited at last. But now that you are here, it is time for business.
Shrouded in Mist#295.dst: Evet, sonunda kavuştunuz. Ama madem buradasınız, artık işe geçme zamanı.
Shrouded in Mist#295.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#296.src: I had Yusanu inform me of your adventures in the {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#296.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#297.src: And it would appear our causes are in alignment... to dismantle the crown. We here in the Canopy have taken a very active approach to this end.
Shrouded in Mist#297.dst: Görünüşe göre amaçlarımız aynı... tacı yıkmak. Biz Canopy olarak bu yolda çok aktif bir yaklaşım benimsedik.
Shrouded in Mist#297.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#298.src: We had established three teams, each with their own responsibility. Each team attacks the crown on different fronts.
Shrouded in Mist#298.dst: Her birinin kendi sorumluluğu olan üç takım kurduk. Her takım tacı farklı cephelerden vuruyor.
Shrouded in Mist#298.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#299.src: The Owls are our eyes and ears. They are also our most efficient assassins. Captain Rurie, who you have already had the pleasure of meeting, is one of our most lethal members.
Shrouded in Mist#299.dst: Baykuşlar gözümüz ve kulağımızdır. Aynı zamanda en verimli suikastçılarımızdır. Tanışma zevkine eriştiğiniz Kaptan Rurie en ölümcül üyelerimizden biridir.
Shrouded in Mist#299.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#300.src: The Foxes are our assault team. They are skilled swordsmen utilizing techniques native to the {p}. They are trained to never lose a duel.
Shrouded in Mist#300.dst: Tilkiler saldırı takımımızdır. {p} bölgesine özgü teknikleri kullanan usta kılıç ustalarıdır. Hiçbir düelloyu kaybetmemek üzere eğitilirler.
Shrouded in Mist#300.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#301.src: The Deers are our command team, the brains behind the operation. They are also responsible for... taking care of spies within {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#301.dst: Geyikler komuta takımımızdır, operasyonun beynidir. Ayrıca {p} içindeki casusların... icabına bakmaktan da onlar sorumludur.
Shrouded in Mist#301.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#303.src: Spies. That man you brought in, Nisen... I fear that is no longer Nisen. Weeks ago, he had been replaced by one of the crown's elite spies. We know them as Changelings.
Shrouded in Mist#303.dst: Casuslar. Getirdiğiniz adam, Nisen... Korkarım artık Nisen değil. Haftalar önce yerine tacın seçkin casuslarından biri geçti. Onlara Changeling diyoruz.
Shrouded in Mist#303.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#304.src: The {p} have been plagued for years by these masterful creatures of disguise. Whenever one is recognized, we capture them and hold them for questioning.
Shrouded in Mist#304.dst: {p} yıllardır bu usta kılık değiştiren yaratıkların belasını çekiyor. Biri fark edildiğinde onu yakalayıp sorgu için tutuyoruz.
Shrouded in Mist#304.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#305.src: The people of our region have developed a form of identification, the medallions. If you do not possess one, many will refuse to speak with you.
Shrouded in Mist#305.dst: Bölgemizin halkı bir kimlik biçimi geliştirdi: madalyonlar. Sizde bir tane yoksa çoğu kişi sizinle konuşmayı reddeder.
Shrouded in Mist#305.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#306.src: Um... Azael, sir, I don't mean to come off as rude, but... Rurie told us there were news on our friends from the Roughworks.
Shrouded in Mist#306.dst: Şey... Azael, efendim, kaba görünmek istemem ama... Rurie, Roughworks'teki dostlarımızla ilgili haber olduğunu söyledi.
Shrouded in Mist#306.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#307.src: In a sense, there are. However, we still are processing the information the Owls have returned with from the festival. I cannot offer anything just yet.
Shrouded in Mist#307.dst: Bir bakıma var. Ancak Baykuşların festivalden getirdiği bilgileri hâlâ işliyoruz. Şimdilik bir şey söyleyemem.
Shrouded in Mist#307.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#308.src: Rest assured, we will not withhold anything once we have gone through everything.
Shrouded in Mist#308.dst: İçiniz rahat olsun, her şeyi inceledikten sonra hiçbir şeyi saklamayacağız.
Shrouded in Mist#308.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#309.src: I give you my word that we will continue searching for any word of your friends.
Shrouded in Mist#309.dst: Size söz veriyorum, dostlarınızdan haber aramaya devam edeceğiz.
Shrouded in Mist#309.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#310.src: It... it finally feels like we have a second to breath.
Shrouded in Mist#310.dst: Sonunda... sonunda bir nefes alacak vaktimiz var gibi.
Shrouded in Mist#310.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#311.src: I'll stay with Yusanu and wait for them to sort through the information.
Shrouded in Mist#311.dst: Yusanu ile kalıp bilgileri ayıklamalarını bekleyeceğim.
Shrouded in Mist#311.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#312.src: I'm going to focus on figuring out what this device is used for.
Shrouded in Mist#312.dst: Ben bu cihazın ne işe yaradığını çözmeye odaklanacağım.
Shrouded in Mist#312.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#313.src: It must have be worth stealing it... somehow.
Shrouded in Mist#313.speaker: Sui

Skittering Spiders#000.src: You should report back to Yahya and tell him the spiders have been cleared out.

Skittering Spiders#001.src: I-is it done? S-s-spiders... No more spiders? Is my m-mushroom patch cl-... cleared?
Skittering Spiders#001.dst: B-bitti mi? Ö-ö-örümcekler... Artık örümcek yok mu? M-mantar tarlam te-... temizlendi mi?

Skittering Spiders#003.src: Well, it looks cleared to me. These are... uh... some fine mushrooms!
Skittering Spiders#003.dst: Eh, bana temiz görünüyor. Bunlar... ee... gayet güzel mantarlar!

Skittering Spiders#004.src: Th-thank you soldiers! That was-... I mean. It was f-fine, I g-... guess.
Skittering Spiders#004.dst: T-teşekkürler askerler! Bu-... Yani. F-fena değildi, s-... sanırım.

Skittering Spiders#006.src: I am everywhere. M-mushroom soup, stew, soup m-makes me fast!
Skittering Spiders#006.dst: Ben her yerdeyim. M-mantar çorbası, yahni, çorba beni h-hızlandırır!

Solidarity of Steel#000.src: I hope the brothers weren't too much of a nuisance. Yuman, especially... he's a good lad, but his enthusiasm gets the best of him sometimes.
Solidarity of Steel#000.dst: Umarım kardeşler başına fazla dert açmamıştır. Özellikle Yuman... iyi çocuktur ama bazen heyecanına yeniliyor.
Solidarity of Steel#000.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#001.src: My water's been out for two days now. Last bloke I tried to get on the job refused.
Solidarity of Steel#001.dst: İki gündür suyum akmıyor. Bu işe çağırdığım son herif de yanaşmadı.

Solidarity of Steel#002.src: These boards can last generations, you're sure of it. And this one is covered in notes of all kinds! Even graffiti carvings mean something. There's a carving in one corner that catches your eye...
Solidarity of Steel#002.dst: Bu panolar nesiller boyu dayanır, eminsin. Bu da her türden notla dolu! Kazınmış duvar yazıları bile bir şey anlatıyor. Köşedeki bir kazıma gözüne çarpıyor...

Solidarity of Steel#003.src: You made it back to Torann.

Solidarity of Steel#004.src: That's what we call the {p} sewers and waterworks. Maze of pipes and brickwork, some of it old old. Vagrants and criminals been settling there for years.
Solidarity of Steel#004.dst: {p} kanalizasyonuna ve su şebekesine biz öyle diyoruz. Borulardan ve tuğladan bir labirent, bazı yerleri eski mi eski. Yıllardır serseriler ve suçlular oraya yerleşiyor.

Solidarity of Steel#006.src: You need to pack something that will help Aihan sleep, something to remind her of home, and something to entertain her at the station.
Solidarity of Steel#006.dst: Aihan'ın uyumasına yardım edecek bir şey, ona evini hatırlatacak bir şey ve istasyonda onu oyalayacak bir şey koymalısın.

Solidarity of Steel#007.src: Wh-what?! H-how did you fit my whole m-mattress in here? Was... was there not anything smaller?
Solidarity of Steel#007.dst: N-ne?! B-bütün y-yatağımı buraya nasıl sığdırdın? Daha... daha küçük bir şey yok muydu?

Solidarity of Steel#008.src: Regroup with your friends outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#009.src: ...that's everyone, then. Good. Good, you're all safe. I wasn't certain, after...
Solidarity of Steel#009.dst: ...demek herkes burada. Güzel. Güzel, hepiniz güvendesiniz. Emin değildim, olanlardan sonra...
Solidarity of Steel#009.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#010.src: Are you just going to ignore what happened back there?
Solidarity of Steel#010.dst: Orada olanları görmezden mi geleceksin yani?
Solidarity of Steel#010.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#012.src: Zhiraok's blessing... it gives him the power to revive himself. It takes some time, though.
Solidarity of Steel#012.dst: Zhiraok'un kutsaması... ona kendini diriltme gücü veriyor. Gerçi biraz zaman alıyor.
Solidarity of Steel#012.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#013.src: If we wanted any chance to get away, I had to- I had to kill him.
Solidarity of Steel#013.dst: Kaçma şansımız olsun istiyorsak onu- onu öldürmem gerekiyordu.
Solidarity of Steel#013.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#014.src: Well, in any case, we're all here! We'll be meeting with my contact soon, after which we'll certainly be safe, but...
Solidarity of Steel#014.dst: Neyse, hepimiz buradayız! Az sonra bağlantımla buluşacağız, ondan sonra kesinlikle güvende oluruz, ama...
Solidarity of Steel#014.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#016.src: We have some time to spare. You've had a few days to acclimate to the Roughworks - any thoughts?
Solidarity of Steel#016.dst: Biraz vaktimiz var. Birkaç gündür Roughworks'e alışmaya çalışıyorsunuz, ne düşünüyorsunuz?
Solidarity of Steel#016.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#017.src: It is, isn't it? It's much busier, less open, and yet... it carries a certain nostalgia for me.
Solidarity of Steel#017.dst: Öyle, değil mi? Çok daha kalabalık, daha kapalı, ama yine de... bana bir şekilde eski günleri hatırlatıyor.
Solidarity of Steel#017.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#018.src: Nostalgic? This place, really? What's so nostalgic about loud factories and urban sprawl?
Solidarity of Steel#018.dst: Eski günler mi? Burası mı, cidden? Gürültülü fabrikalarda ve beton yığınında ne nostalji var ki?
Solidarity of Steel#018.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#020.src: Well, I'm with Rex on th- this- this one! I wouldn't want to s- st- stay here for long, it's s- so... smoggy.
Solidarity of Steel#020.dst: Şey, bu k- ko- konuda Rex'e katılıyorum! Burada uzun s- sü- süre kalmak istemezdim, burası ç- çok... dumanlı.
Solidarity of Steel#020.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#021.src: Certainly, it is not as... clean, I suppose, as the {p}. The smell of the morning dew shall be sorely missed!
Solidarity of Steel#021.dst: Kesinlikle {p} kadar... temiz değil diyelim. Sabah çiyinin kokusunu çok özleyeceğiz!
Solidarity of Steel#021.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#022.src: Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... I'd like to make a good first impression.
Solidarity of Steel#022.dst: Tamam çocuklar, içinizi dökün bitsin. Bağlantımla buluştuğumuzda lütfen Roughworks hakkında kötü konuşmayın... İlk izlenimin iyi olmasını istiyorum.
Solidarity of Steel#022.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#023.src: Oh, you wouldn't think so if you actually had to live here.
Solidarity of Steel#023.dst: Ah, burada gerçekten yaşamak zorunda kalsaydın öyle düşünmezdin.
Solidarity of Steel#023.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#025.src: What?! Most of them would agree with me!
Solidarity of Steel#025.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#026.src: I think I'm with Rex on this- this one! I can't im-imagine- imagine living here, it's s- so... smoggy.
Solidarity of Steel#026.dst: Sanırım bu k- ko- konuda Rex'e katılıyorum! Burada ya- yaşamayı hayal bile e- edemiyorum, burası ç- çok... dumanlı.
Solidarity of Steel#026.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#028.src: Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... no matter how much they may or may not agree.
Solidarity of Steel#028.dst: Tamam çocuklar, içinizi dökün bitsin. Bağlantımla buluştuğumuzda lütfen Roughworks hakkında kötü konuşmayın... size ne kadar hak verirlerse versinler.
Solidarity of Steel#028.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#029.src: In any case, I was told to meet them in the city at noon - {p} is usually empty during the daytime.
Solidarity of Steel#029.dst: Neyse, onlarla öğlen şehirde buluşmam söylendi. {p} gündüzleri genelde boş olur.
Solidarity of Steel#029.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#030.src: What? It's empty during the day? Th- that doesn't make a lot of sense.
Solidarity of Steel#030.dst: Ne? Gündüz mü boş? Bu p- pek mantıklı değil.
Solidarity of Steel#030.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#031.src: I'm afraid the lives of the citizens of the Roughworks revolve entirely around their work. The work day starts at sunrise, and ends with sunset. So, let's just wait...
Solidarity of Steel#031.dst: Korkarım Roughworks halkının hayatı tamamen işleri etrafında dönüyor. İş günü gün doğumunda başlar, gün batımında biter. O yüzden bekleyelim...
Solidarity of Steel#031.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#033.src: Maybe they, um, just read time differently, here...? Or maybe we-
