The Envoy Part I#040.src: Trust me, it is fa' more amazin than Gavel and Wynn. We even 'ave machines!
The Envoy Part I#040.dst: Bana güven, Gavel'den de Wynn'den de çok daha harika. Bizde makine bile var!
The Envoy Part I#040.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#042.src: Trust me, you will enjoy yer stay.
The Envoy Part I#042.dst: Bana güven, buralarda keyfin yerinde olcak.
The Envoy Part I#042.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#045.src: It's such an honour to have a Wynn soldier visit our island.
The Envoy Part I#045.dst: Bir Wynn askerinin adamızı ziyaret etmesi büyük onur.
The Envoy Part I#045.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#046.src: We were hoping for a true envoy, but you will do.
The Envoy Part I#046.dst: Gerçek bir elçi umuyorduk ama sen de iş görürsün.
The Envoy Part I#046.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#047.src: If you follow me, I'll give you a tour of the city.
The Envoy Part I#047.dst: Beni takip edersen sana şehri gezdireyim.
The Envoy Part I#047.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#048.src: We first arrived on Corkus {~} years ago.
The Envoy Part I#048.dst: Corkus'a ilk kez {~} yıl önce geldik.
The Envoy Part I#048.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#049.src: The Corkians, like you, are from Fruma originally...
The Envoy Part I#049.dst: Corkian'lar da senin gibi aslen Fruma'lı...
The Envoy Part I#049.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#051.src: Coming from Fruma, we of course knew no magic at all.
The Envoy Part I#051.dst: Fruma'dan geldiğimiz için elbette hiç büyü bilmiyorduk.
The Envoy Part I#051.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#052.src: We soon developed our own. The rare power of Electromagic.
The Envoy Part I#052.dst: Kısa sürede kendi büyümüzü geliştirdik. Nadir bir güç: Elektrobüyü.
The Envoy Part I#052.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#053.src: It's a difficult modern branch of magic that allows us to create machines.
The Envoy Part I#053.dst: Makine yapmamızı sağlayan, zorlu ve modern bir büyü dalı.
The Envoy Part I#053.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#054.src: Ah, here already. Welcome to {p}, Capital of our island.
The Envoy Part I#054.dst: Aa, geldik bile. Adamızın başkenti {p} şehrine hoş geldin.
The Envoy Part I#054.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#055.src: We've come a long way in a short time.
The Envoy Part I#055.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#056.src: Let me point out where the shops are.
The Envoy Part I#056.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#059.src: To the south is our bank, powder shop, scrolls, and our exclusive powder exchange!
The Envoy Part I#059.dst: Güneyde bankamız, toz dükkânı, parşömenler ve bize özel toz takas yeri var!
The Envoy Part I#059.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#060.src: Oh! And speaking of the powder exchange, I'll start you off with some of these.
The Envoy Part I#060.dst: Aa! Toz takas yeri demişken, başlangıç için sana bunlardan biraz vereyim.
The Envoy Part I#060.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#061.src: Moving on... The south gate leads to {p}. On your way there, you might pass by the-
The Envoy Part I#061.dst: Devam edelim... Güney kapısı {p} bölgesine çıkar. Yolda şunun yanından geçebilirsin-
The Envoy Part I#061.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#062.src: Uhm, nevermind. In fact, we have a gift for you.
The Envoy Part I#062.dst: Şey, boş ver. Aslında sana bir hediyemiz var.
The Envoy Part I#062.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#063.src: The Five Gears Diner is hosting any guests of the island.
The Envoy Part I#063.dst: The Five Gears Diner adanın bütün misafirlerini ağırlıyor.
The Envoy Part I#063.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#064.src: Go through the western gate and head to the diner for your free feast. Enjoy!
The Envoy Part I#064.dst: Batı kapısından geç ve bedava ziyafetin için lokantaya git. Afiyet olsun!
The Envoy Part I#064.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#065.src: Walk towards The Five Gears Diner.
The Envoy Part I#065.dst: The Five Gears Diner'a doğru yürü.

The Envoy Part I#071.src: Before we do anything, I have to explain what's happening here...
The Envoy Part I#071.dst: Bir şey yapmadan önce burada neler olduğunu anlatmam lazım...
The Envoy Part I#071.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#075.src: Our creations have rebelled against us.
The Envoy Part I#075.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#076.src: They now raid towns for parts.
The Envoy Part I#076.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#077.src: Mechs are getting increasingly more desperate.
The Envoy Part I#077.dst: Makineler gittikçe daha çaresiz hâle geliyor.
The Envoy Part I#077.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#078.src: Even in rust, they are still powerful.
The Envoy Part I#078.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#079.src: We have tried to remove them but the factory always makes more.
The Envoy Part I#079.dst: Onları temizlemeye çalıştık ama fabrika hep yenisini yapıyor.
The Envoy Part I#079.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#080.src: It is Corkus' greatest failure. It must be stopped.
The Envoy Part I#080.dst: Corkus'un en büyük başarısızlığı bu. Durdurulması lazım.
The Envoy Part I#080.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#082.src: I can try to open the vent to sneak in.
The Envoy Part I#082.dst: Gizlice girmek için havalandırmayı açmayı deneyebilirim.
The Envoy Part I#082.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#083.src: I know you are a stranger, but talk to me if you want to help.
The Envoy Part I#083.dst: Yabancı olduğunu biliyorum ama yardım etmek istersen benimle konuş.
The Envoy Part I#083.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#088.src: Gah! I can't even do the most basic spell!
The Envoy Part I#088.dst: Ah! En basit büyüyü bile yapamıyorum!
The Envoy Part I#088.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#091.src: I'm sorry for being useless in front of you...
The Envoy Part I#091.dst: Senin önünde böyle işe yaramaz olduğum için özür dilerim...
The Envoy Part I#091.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#092.src: Electromagic is different from your magic.. I'm not very good at it...
The Envoy Part I#092.dst: Elektrobüyü senin büyünden farklı.. Ben pek iyi değilim...
The Envoy Part I#092.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#095.src: Open the door and exit the ducts.
The Envoy Part I#095.dst: Kapıyı aç ve havalandırma kanallarından çık.

The Envoy Part I#101.src: ...What in the world is that mech on top of the pile of scrap over there?!
The Envoy Part I#101.dst: ...Şuradaki hurda yığınının tepesindeki makine de ne öyle?!
The Envoy Part I#101.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#102.src: That is definitely not a regular despermech... It looks brand new!
The Envoy Part I#102.dst: O kesinlikle sıradan bir despermech değil... Yepyeni görünüyor!
The Envoy Part I#102.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#103.src: One of those hasn't been seen since the factory was running...
The Envoy Part I#103.dst: Fabrika çalıştığından beri onlardan biri görülmemişti...
The Envoy Part I#103.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#104.src: We need to do something! I'll clear the path for you. That's the only thing I can do, I... hurt my... leg.
The Envoy Part I#104.dst: Bir şey yapmalıyız! Ben senin için yolu açarım. Yapabileceğim tek şey bu, ben... bacağımı... incittim.
The Envoy Part I#104.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#108.src: Are you okay? Good. Meet me at the entrance where we met. We need to report to {p}!
The Envoy Part I#108.dst: İyi misin? Güzel. Buluştuğumuz girişte görüşelim. {p} yönetimine haber vermeliyiz!
The Envoy Part I#108.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#109.src: Talk to Maxie at the entrance to The Five Gears Diner.
The Envoy Part I#109.dst: The Five Gears Diner'ın girişinde Maxie ile konuş.

The Envoy Part I#111.src: I know a shortcut, we'll be in {p} in no time.
The Envoy Part I#111.dst: Bir kestirme biliyorum, {p} şehrine hemen varırız.
The Envoy Part I#111.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#112.src: Talk to Maxie and Corkus Delegate in {p}.
The Envoy Part I#112.dst: {p} içinde Maxie ve Corkus Delegesi ile konuş.

The Envoy Part I#114.src: Beltrude, we have a problem! The factory is running!
The Envoy Part I#114.dst: Beltrude, bir sorunumuz var! Fabrika çalışıyor!
The Envoy Part I#114.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#116.src: What a load of scrap! You shouldn't talk about that in front of our guest!
The Envoy Part I#116.dst: Ne saçmalık! Misafirimizin önünde bundan bahsetmemelisin!
The Envoy Part I#116.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#118.src: And why would we take the word of someone who can't do basic electromagic?
The Envoy Part I#118.dst: Hem basit bir elektrobüyüyü bile yapamayan birinin sözüne neden güvenelim?
The Envoy Part I#118.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#119.src: Don't listen to Maxie. Enjoy your stay.
The Envoy Part I#119.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#120.src: They won't admit anything with you around. They want to become allies with Wynn.
The Envoy Part I#120.dst: Sen buradayken hiçbir şeyi kabul etmezler. Wynn ile müttefik olmak istiyorlar.
The Envoy Part I#120.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#000.src: Try following the trail outside the castle, it might lead you to the key.
The Envoy Part II#000.dst: Kalenin dışındaki izi takip etmeyi dene, seni anahtara götürebilir.

The Envoy Part II#001.src: Just follow the road to the north to find my friend. Watch out, she doesn't like humans much.
The Envoy Part II#001.dst: Arkadaşımı bulmak için kuzeye giden yolu takip et. Dikkat et, insanları pek sevmez.

The Envoy Part II#002.src: You need the key before you leave!

The Envoy Part II#004.src: The idea was that both species had equal roles in the factory's operations.
The Envoy Part II#004.dst: Fikir, iki türün de fabrikanın işleyişinde eşit rol almasıydı.
The Envoy Part II#004.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#005.src: We need those keys to get in and shut down the factory once more.
The Envoy Part II#005.dst: İçeri girip fabrikayı bir kez daha kapatmak için o anahtarlar lazım.
The Envoy Part II#005.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#006.src: The Corkians won't give up their key very easily, so we should start with the Avos.
The Envoy Part II#006.dst: Corkian'lar anahtarlarından kolay kolay vazgeçmez, o yüzden Avos'larla başlamalıyız.
The Envoy Part II#006.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#007.src: Our best bet is to ask the chief, but... The border's closed due to tensions.
The Envoy Part II#007.dst: En iyisi şefe sormak ama... Gerginlik yüzünden sınır kapalı.

The Envoy Part II#008.src: Fortunately, there's a catapult that can help us in a village north-west of here. Let's meet there!
The Envoy Part II#008.dst: Neyse ki buranın kuzeybatısındaki bir köyde işimize yarayacak bir mancınık var. Orada buluşalım!

The Envoy Part II#009.src: I knew it! There was something here we could use!
The Envoy Part II#009.dst: Biliyordum! Burada işimize yarayacak bir şey vardı!
The Envoy Part II#009.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#010.src: I'll have to use electromagic to make it launch, so you'll have to go alone.
The Envoy Part II#010.dst: Fırlatmak için elektrobüyü kullanmam gerekecek, o yüzden yalnız gitmen lazım.
The Envoy Part II#010.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#013.src: I'm so jealous of the chief, he gets to live in the fanciest house on the hill!
The Envoy Part II#013.dst: Şefi çok kıskanıyorum, tepedeki en şatafatlı evde yaşıyor!

The Envoy Part II#014.src: Hmm, no gears or goggles... You are no Corkian Human.
The Envoy Part II#014.dst: Hmm, ne dişli var ne gözlük... Sen Corkian bir insan değilsin.
The Envoy Part II#014.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#015.src: We saw your battle with "Mech X" at the docks from above. I believe we can trust you.
The Envoy Part II#015.dst: "Mech X" ile iskeledeki savaşını yukarıdan gördük. Sana güvenebileceğimize inanıyorum.
The Envoy Part II#015.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#016.src: Can't you humans see I'm meditating?
The Envoy Part II#016.dst: Siz insanlar meditasyon yaptığımı görmüyor musunuz?

The Envoy Part II#017.src: I don't see why we're helping humans...
The Envoy Part II#017.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#018.src: You should head back to Maxie with the key.

The Envoy Part II#019.src: Excellent! I'll hold onto that for now. Let's focus on getting the Corkian's Key.
The Envoy Part II#019.dst: Harika! Şimdilik onu ben saklayayım. Corkian'ların Anahtarı'nı almaya odaklanalım.
The Envoy Part II#019.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#020.src: They keep it in a vault inside the castle. I... I honestly don't know how to get in there.
The Envoy Part II#020.dst: Onu kalenin içindeki bir kasada tutuyorlar. Ben... açıkçası oraya nasıl girilir bilmiyorum.
The Envoy Part II#020.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#021.src: It's in the castle and to the right. There's {~} guards there at all times, you can't miss it.
The Envoy Part II#021.dst: Kalenin içinde, sağda. Orada her zaman {~} muhafız oluyor, gözden kaçıramazsın.

The Envoy Part II#022.src: Something has happened in the vault.

The Envoy Part II#023.src: Don't go in there, it's under control.

The Envoy Part II#024.src: The mechs were covered in farm produce for some reason and left a convenient trail. If you are serious about fighting the factory, follow the trail.
The Envoy Part II#024.dst: Makineler nedense tarım ürünlerine bulanmıştı ve işimize yarayacak bir iz bıraktılar. Fabrikayla savaşmakta ciddiysen izi takip et.
The Envoy Part II#024.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part II#025.src: Mo'in. See that guy up there? He hasn't moved an inch since I got here...
The Envoy Part II#025.dst: Mo'in. Yukarıdaki adamı görüyor musun? Ben geldiğimden beri bir milim kıpırdamadı...
The Envoy Part II#025.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#026.src: ...I don't think he's actually a farmer. Follow me.
The Envoy Part II#026.dst: ...Bence gerçekten çiftçi değil. Beni takip et.
The Envoy Part II#026.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#028.src: That model was a S-{~}... It's warned the others. Let's go.
The Envoy Part II#028.dst: O model bir S-{~} idi... Diğerlerini uyardı. Hadi gidelim.

The Envoy Part II#030.src: You did?! Great! Now we need to meet at the factory. The real hard part begins.
The Envoy Part II#030.dst: Aldın mı?! Harika! Şimdi fabrikada buluşmalıyız. Asıl zor kısım başlıyor.

The Envoy Part II#031.src: You hear a distant rumbling sound...

The Envoy Part II#032.src: An engraving on the pillar reads: Reunite three wise creatures to open the way.
The Envoy Part II#032.dst: Sütundaki bir oymada şöyle yazıyor: Yolu açmak için üç bilge yaratığı yeniden bir araya getir.

The Envoy Part II#033.src: You dare intrude on me while I am sculpting?! You shall pay with your life!
The Envoy Part II#033.dst: Ben heykel yaparken rahatsız etmeye nasıl cüret edersin?! Bunu canınla ödeyeceksin!

The Envoy Part II#034.src: Another miserable whelp has come to steal my knowledge? I won't let you!
The Envoy Part II#034.dst: Bilgimi çalmaya bir sefil velet daha mı geldi? İzin vermeyeceğim!

The Envoy Part II#035.src: So... You've managed to make it past my family. Pathetic aren't they?
The Envoy Part II#035.dst: Demek... Ailemi geçmeyi başardın. Acınası değiller mi?

The Envoy Part II#036.src: Let me show you a real challenge!

The Envoy Part II#037.src: Use Maxie's house key to enter Maxie's house
The Envoy Part II#037.dst: Maxie'nin ev anahtarıyla Maxie'nin evine gir

The Envoy Part II#040.src: Talk to Maxie on the first floor.

The Envoy Part II#042.src: To get in we need two keys. One from the Avos and one from Corkians.
The Envoy Part II#042.dst: İçeri girmek için iki anahtar lazım. Biri Avos'lardan, biri Corkian'lardan.
The Envoy Part II#042.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#046.src: Our best bet is to ask the chief. However, because of tensions the border is closed.
The Envoy Part II#046.dst: En iyisi şefe sormak. Ama gerginlik yüzünden sınır kapalı.
The Envoy Part II#046.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#050.src: Find the Avos chief. Ask for the factory key.
The Envoy Part II#050.dst: Avos şefini bul. Fabrika anahtarını iste.
The Envoy Part II#050.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#052.src: Press the button when you're ready.
The Envoy Part II#052.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#055.src: Locate the Avos Chief by asking the Avos citizens. Avos Chief is at -{~}, -{~}
The Envoy Part II#055.dst: Avos halkına sorarak Avos Şefi'ni bul. Avos Şefi: -{~}, -{~}

The Envoy Part II#057.src: The chief said your people are welcome here.
The Envoy Part II#057.dst: Şef, halkının burada hoş karşılandığını söyledi.
The Envoy Part II#057.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#058.src: You must be here to see him.
The Envoy Part II#058.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#060.src: Mo'in, soldier. I have been expecting you.
The Envoy Part II#060.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#061.src: You can't catapult yourself into a village full of bird people and not get noticed.
The Envoy Part II#061.dst: Kuş insanlarla dolu bir köye mancınıkla fırlayıp da fark edilmemek olmaz.
The Envoy Part II#061.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#062.src: We know what you are here for, however. The Avos factory key.
The Envoy Part II#062.dst: Neyse, ne için geldiğini biliyoruz. Avos fabrika anahtarı.
The Envoy Part II#062.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#064.src: The key you seek is hidden deep within our most protected temple.
The Envoy Part II#064.dst: Aradığın anahtar en iyi korunan tapınağımızın derinliklerinde saklı.
The Envoy Part II#064.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#065.src: Follow the road north of here to reach the temple. Speak to the grandmaster and she will allow you entry.
The Envoy Part II#065.dst: Tapınağa ulaşmak için buranın kuzeyindeki yolu takip et. Büyük üstatla konuş, seni içeri alacak.
The Envoy Part II#065.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#066.src: Talk to the chief's friend at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Envoy Part II#067.src: Eh, It's the warrior. I have my orders, but still say this is a bad idea.
The Envoy Part II#067.dst: Eh, savaşçı geldi. Emrimi aldım ama yine de bunun kötü bir fikir olduğunu söylüyorum.
The Envoy Part II#067.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#068.src: We hid this key for the purpose that it would never be used again.
The Envoy Part II#068.dst: Bu anahtarı bir daha asla kullanılmasın diye sakladık.
The Envoy Part II#068.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#069.src: The creatures we summoned down there are hostile to all. Even Avos.
The Envoy Part II#069.dst: Aşağıda çağırdığımız yaratıklar herkese düşman. Avos'lara bile.
The Envoy Part II#069.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#070.src: I can't say I have high hopes for you.
The Envoy Part II#070.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#071.src: Meet me round the back of my house and I shall show you the way.
The Envoy Part II#071.dst: Evimin arkasında buluşalım, sana yolu göstereceğim.
The Envoy Part II#071.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#072.src: Meet the grandmaster behind her house and get over the gap and enter the temple.
The Envoy Part II#072.dst: Büyük üstatla evinin arkasında buluş, boşluğu geç ve tapınağa gir.

The Envoy Part II#073.src: I'll make the bridge for you.
The Envoy Part II#073.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#075.src: You all act the same to me. Anyway, there you go.
The Envoy Part II#075.dst: Bana hepiniz aynı davranıyorsunuz. Neyse, buyur bakalım.
The Envoy Part II#075.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#076.src: Find the key inside the temple.

The Envoy Part II#077.src: You cannot have the key. Prepare for destruction.
The Envoy Part II#077.speaker: Key Temple Dragon

The Envoy Part II#078.src: Return to Maxie in his house with the first key.
The Envoy Part II#078.dst: İlk anahtarla evindeki Maxie'nin yanına dön.

The Envoy Part II#079.src: You're back, and you have the key!
The Envoy Part II#079.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#082.src: I think first we should just go and scout out the vault itself and work it out.
The Envoy Part II#082.dst: Bence önce gidip kasanın kendisini bir keşfedelim, sonra bir yolunu buluruz.
The Envoy Part II#082.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#085.src: Uh- No need to worry! We accidentally...
The Envoy Part II#085.speaker: Bertil

The Envoy Part II#086.src: Blew a hole in the wall! Yep!
The Envoy Part II#086.speaker: Reiva

The Envoy Part II#087.src: Stop. Maxie, was right. I'm sorry. Mech X pierced the vault like it was nothing and took the key.
The Envoy Part II#087.dst: Durun. Maxie haklıymış. Özür dilerim. Mech X kasayı hiç yokmuş gibi delip anahtarı aldı.
The Envoy Part II#087.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part II#089.src: Look for the hidden mech base.

The Envoy Part II#090.src: Psst! Over here, in the field!
The Envoy Part II#090.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#093.src: HELLO... I AM A... HUMAN... FARMER.
The Envoy Part II#093.speaker: Farmer

The Envoy Part II#094.src: DO YOU... HAVE... ANY BUSINESS... WITH ME?
The Envoy Part II#094.speaker: Farmer

The Envoy Part II#095.src: Nice try, mech! Not convincing enough for me!
The Envoy Part II#095.dst: İyi denemeydi, makine! Beni ikna etmeye yetmez!
The Envoy Part II#095.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#096.src: REPORT... COVER HAS BEEN COMPROMISED... TWO UNAUTHORIZED INTRUDERS... OUTSIDE OF BASE.
The Envoy Part II#096.dst: RAPOR... KİMLİK İFŞA OLDU... İKİ YETKİSİZ DAVETSİZ MİSAFİR... ÜSSÜN DIŞINDA.
The Envoy Part II#096.speaker: S-63 Mech

The Envoy Part II#099.src: That model was a S-{~}, meaning it has warned the others. Follow me.
The Envoy Part II#099.dst: O model bir S-{~} idi, yani diğerlerini uyardı. Beni takip et.
The Envoy Part II#099.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#101.src: Stand back, I'll open the door.
The Envoy Part II#101.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#102.src: I think we can safely assume this is the right place.
The Envoy Part II#102.dst: Sanırım doğru yerde olduğumuzu rahatça söyleyebiliriz.
The Envoy Part II#102.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#103.src: You storm in and find what we need. I'll cover you from out here.
The Envoy Part II#103.dst: Sen içeri dal ve ihtiyacımız olanı bul. Ben seni buradan korurum.
The Envoy Part II#103.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#104.src: You need to find and destroy that new factory mech.
The Envoy Part II#104.dst: O yeni fabrika makinesini bulup yok etmelisin.
The Envoy Part II#104.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#105.src: Retrieve the key from the base.

The Envoy Part II#106.dst: DAVETSİZ MİSAFİR TESPİT EDİLDİ. YOK ET.
The Envoy Part II#106.speaker: Mech X

The Envoy Part II#107.src: Corkus has to suffer... They shut down the Factory, locked us up in there. Once we have both keys we can open it and you are NOT getting this one.
The Envoy Part II#107.dst: Corkus acı çekmeli... Fabrikayı kapattılar, bizi içine kilitlediler. İki anahtarı da alınca orayı açabiliriz ve bu anahtarı ASLA alamayacaksın.
The Envoy Part II#107.speaker: Mech X

The Envoy Part II#109.src: Mo'in. Did you get the key?
The Envoy Part II#109.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#110.src: Follow the northwestern road and enter the factory from the west side. I will meet you there.
The Envoy Part II#110.dst: Kuzeybatı yolunu takip et ve fabrikaya batı tarafından gir. Orada buluşuruz.
The Envoy Part II#110.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#112.src: Mo'in. Are you sure you are ready?
The Envoy Part II#112.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#113.src: This won't be your average fight. The factory is cutting edge. Run by a being of pure electromagic.
The Envoy Part II#113.dst: Bu sıradan bir savaş olmayacak. Fabrika son teknoloji. Saf elektrobüyüden bir varlık tarafından yönetiliyor.
The Envoy Part II#113.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#114.src: The smartest man on Corkus, Cerid spent years making a being smarter even than he is...
The Envoy Part II#114.dst: Corkus'un en zeki adamı Cerid, kendisinden bile zeki bir varlık yaratmak için yıllarını harcadı...
The Envoy Part II#114.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#115.src: Now it runs the factory with a twisted sense of morality. It's easy to see why it was shut down.
The Envoy Part II#115.dst: Şimdi o varlık fabrikayı çarpık bir ahlak anlayışıyla yönetiyor. Neden kapatıldığını anlamak zor değil.
The Envoy Part II#115.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#116.src: Also.. I- I made you these boots using my magic. It turns out I am pretty good at making stuff.
The Envoy Part II#116.dst: Bir de.. B-ben sana büyümle bu botları yaptım. Meğer bir şeyler yapmakta epey iyiymişim.
The Envoy Part II#116.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#117.src: I just wanted to say thanks, too. I really feel like I made a difference fighting with you. When you are ready, just walk up to the factory doors.
The Envoy Part II#117.dst: Bir de teşekkür etmek istedim. Seninle savaşırken gerçekten bir fark yarattığımı hissettim. Hazır olduğunda fabrika kapılarına yürümen yeterli.
The Envoy Part II#117.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#119.src: Mo'in, {u}! I've been researching everything I can about the factory.
The Envoy Part II#119.dst: Mo'in, {u}! Fabrika hakkında bulabildiğim her şeyi araştırıyordum.
The Envoy Part II#119.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#120.src: ARE YOU INCAPABLE OF READING THE SIGN ON THE DOOR? THE FACTORY IS CLOSED. WE ARE NOT ACCEPTING VISITORS FOR TOURS RIGHT NOW.
The Envoy Part II#120.dst: KAPIDAKİ TABELAYI OKUYAMIYOR MUSUN? FABRİKA KAPALI. ŞU AN TUR İÇİN ZİYARETÇİ KABUL ETMİYORUZ.

The Envoy Part II#121.src: I have learned so much on our adventure. One day, if you ever need me, I will be there. You have an ally in this Corkian.
The Envoy Part II#121.dst: Bu macerada çok şey öğrendim. Bir gün bana ihtiyacın olursa yanında olacağım. Bu Corkian'da bir müttefikin var.

The Feathers Fly Part I#000.src: Visit the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires completion of The Envoy Part II)
The Feathers Fly Part I#000.dst: Atölyeyi ziyaret et: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Elçi Bölüm II görevini tamamlamış olmalısın)

The Feathers Fly Part I#001.src: Oh?! Hold on, is anyone there..!
The Feathers Fly Part I#001.dst: Hı?! Dur bir dakika, orada biri mi var..!

The Feathers Fly Part I#002.src: Why hello there! Whatcha doin' here? I'm Ava!
The Feathers Fly Part I#002.dst: Ooo, selam! N'apıyorsun burada? Ben Ava!
The Feathers Fly Part I#002.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#003.src: Want a quick job? How 'bout helpin' me out?! That was perfect timing!
The Feathers Fly Part I#003.dst: Hızlı bir iş ister misin? Bana yardım etmeye ne dersin?! Tam zamanında geldin!
The Feathers Fly Part I#003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#004.src: Y'see, while the other Avos hate it, I just find electromagic so fascinating!
The Feathers Fly Part I#004.dst: Bak, diğer Avos'lar nefret etse de ben elektrobüyüyü çok büyüleyici buluyorum!
The Feathers Fly Part I#004.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#005.src: Look, I think I got a breakthrough invention. If it works... Oh man...
The Feathers Fly Part I#005.dst: Bak, sanırım çığır açan bir icat yaptım. Eğer işe yararsa... Of be...
The Feathers Fly Part I#005.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#006.src: I just need to harness some nature magic, and there's an amazing source in the chief's hut. Ya comin'?
The Feathers Fly Part I#006.dst: Sadece biraz doğa büyüsü toplamam lazım, şefin kulübesinde de harika bir kaynak var. Geliyor musun?
The Feathers Fly Part I#006.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#007.src: Don't you worry about rewards! I got you! See ya' there!
The Feathers Fly Part I#007.dst: Ödülü hiç dert etme! Ben hallederim! Orada görüşürüz!
The Feathers Fly Part I#007.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#009.src: Hey! You showed up! Listen up, here's the plan...
The Feathers Fly Part I#009.dst: Hey! Geldin demek! Dinle, plan şu...
The Feathers Fly Part I#009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#010.src: There's a small museum inside the hut with all kinds of trophies.
The Feathers Fly Part I#010.dst: Kulübenin içinde her türlü ganimetin olduğu küçük bir müze var.
The Feathers Fly Part I#010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#011.src: Our chief is quite the talkative fella, and I can guarantee he'd love to tell you stories.
The Feathers Fly Part I#011.dst: Şefimiz epey geveze biridir, sana hikâye anlatmaya bayılacağına garanti veririm.
The Feathers Fly Part I#011.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#012.src: That should keep him and his guards busy. And that's where I come in!
The Feathers Fly Part I#012.dst: Bu da onu ve muhafızlarını oyalar. İşte o zaman ben devreye giriyorum!
The Feathers Fly Part I#012.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#013.src: I'll take that chance to sneak behind the throne, where our sacred totem is. I'm not stealing it, don't worry!
The Feathers Fly Part I#013.dst: Bu fırsatla gizlice tahtın arkasına, kutsal totemimizin olduğu yere geçeceğim. Çalmıyorum, merak etme!
The Feathers Fly Part I#013.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#014.src: I'm a little clumsy, but I'm sure I can count on ya'! No matter what, keep the chief busy!
The Feathers Fly Part I#014.dst: Biraz sakarım ama sana güvenebileceğimden eminim! Ne olursa olsun şefi oyala!
The Feathers Fly Part I#014.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#017.src: So, what brings you here, hm?
The Feathers Fly Part I#017.dst: Eee, seni buraya ne getirdi, hm?
The Feathers Fly Part I#017.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#018.src: Oh, you want to learn more about us... Of course, of course!
The Feathers Fly Part I#018.dst: Ah, bizi daha yakından tanımak istiyorsun... Elbette, elbette!
The Feathers Fly Part I#018.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#019.src: We have a room where I can show you some of our history.
The Feathers Fly Part I#019.dst: Sana tarihimizden bir şeyler gösterebileceğim bir odamız var.
The Feathers Fly Part I#019.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#020.src: You're in luck, I'm in a good mood. Follow me then.
The Feathers Fly Part I#020.dst: Şanslısın, keyfim yerinde. Beni takip et o zaman.
The Feathers Fly Part I#020.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#022.src: It's alright, these books aren't important... Be careful though.
The Feathers Fly Part I#022.dst: Sorun değil, bu kitaplar önemli değil... Ama dikkatli ol.
The Feathers Fly Part I#022.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#024.src: It's one of a kind! We planted it eons ago. It has never ever grown an inch. Or moved.
The Feathers Fly Part I#024.dst: Eşi benzeri yok! Çağlar önce diktik. O günden beri bir santim bile büyümedi. Kıpırdamadı da.
The Feathers Fly Part I#024.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#025.src: Never died or anything either. For all we know, it might predate your corruption too!
The Feathers Fly Part I#025.dst: Hiç ölmedi de. Bildiğimiz kadarıyla sizin yozlaşmanızdan bile eski olabilir!
The Feathers Fly Part I#025.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#026.src: Oh, this is quite the important tome.
The Feathers Fly Part I#026.dst: Ah, bu çok önemli bir kitaptır.
The Feathers Fly Part I#026.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#027.src: This book has a signature from all Avos chiefs ever since we discovered ink!
The Feathers Fly Part I#027.dst: Bu kitapta mürekkebi keşfettiğimizden beri bütün Avos şeflerinin imzası var!
The Feathers Fly Part I#027.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#029.src: It's a custom for every Avos chief to keep their feathers somewhere. I guess I left that here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#029.dst: Her Avos şefinin tüylerini bir yerde saklaması bir gelenektir. Galiba onu burada unutmuşum.
The Feathers Fly Part I#029.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#031.src: Though, we don't really have the time to sit down and read all of it, do we?
The Feathers Fly Part I#031.dst: Gerçi oturup hepsini okumaya pek vaktimiz yok, değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part I#031.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#033.src: Someone broke in? But why? Anyone can use our totem...
The Feathers Fly Part I#033.dst: Biri içeri mi girmiş? Ama neden? Totemimizi herkes kullanabilir...
The Feathers Fly Part I#033.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#034.src: I don't get it. They could've just asked...
The Feathers Fly Part I#034.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#035.src: Report back to Ava in the Workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#036.src: Oh, hey! Thanks for earlier. You were a big help.
The Feathers Fly Part I#036.dst: Aa, hey! Az önce için sağ ol. Çok yardımın dokundu.
The Feathers Fly Part I#036.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#037.src: Truth is, anyone can use that totem. They just don't like me very much.
The Feathers Fly Part I#037.dst: Aslında o totemi herkes kullanabilir. Sadece beni pek sevmiyorlar.
The Feathers Fly Part I#037.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#038.src: Anyway, we got what we needed, and it's promising! Now onto the next part...
The Feathers Fly Part I#038.dst: Neyse, ihtiyacımız olanı aldık, hem umut verici! Şimdi sıradaki kısma geçelim...
The Feathers Fly Part I#038.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#039.src: Y'see, I managed to bottle up some of our magic, but I still need corkian stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part I#039.dst: Bak, büyümüzün bir kısmını şişeye koymayı başardım ama hâlâ Corkian işi şeylere ihtiyacım var.
The Feathers Fly Part I#039.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#040.src: Fortunately for us, there's a shop outside the city. Though, things might get complicated...
The Feathers Fly Part I#040.dst: Şansımıza şehrin dışında bir dükkân var. Gerçi işler biraz karışabilir...
The Feathers Fly Part I#040.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#041.src: A bunch of Corkians aren't too fond of... Us. I just think you should come along with me, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part I#041.dst: Corkian'ların çoğu... Bizden pek hoşlanmaz. Bence benimle gelsen iyi olur, anlarsın ya?
The Feathers Fly Part I#041.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#042.src: Here, I wrote the coords into that book of yours. It's a bit far, so come on out and I'll give you a lift!
The Feathers Fly Part I#042.dst: Al, koordinatları o kitabına yazdım. Biraz uzak, o yüzden dışarı çık, seni götüreyim!
The Feathers Fly Part I#042.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#043.src: Meet Ava near the Corkian shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#043.dst: Corkian dükkânının yakınında Ava ile buluş: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#044.src: Alright, if you want a lift, tell me, or you could just walk!
The Feathers Fly Part I#044.dst: Pekâlâ, götürmemi istersen söyle, ya da yürüyebilirsin de!
The Feathers Fly Part I#044.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#045.src: Not sure why you'd do that when I'm right here though!
The Feathers Fly Part I#045.dst: Ben buradayken neden öyle yaparsın ki, onu bilmem tabii!
The Feathers Fly Part I#045.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#046.src: Alright, buckle up, we're taking off!
The Feathers Fly Part I#046.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#047.src: Still holding on? We're almost there!
The Feathers Fly Part I#047.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#048.src: Here we are! Enjoyed the lift? I'm a great form of fast travel, right?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#048.dst: İşte geldik! Yolculuk hoşuna gitti mi? Harika bir hızlı ulaşım aracıyım, değil mi?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#048.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#049.src: Well, this was my first time using this magic magnet on people, but...
The Feathers Fly Part I#049.dst: Gerçi bu büyülü mıknatısı insanlarda ilk kez kullandım ama...
The Feathers Fly Part I#049.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#050.src: This is the shop! I think we can buy an Enhanced Potential Microchip here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#050.dst: Dükkân burası! Sanırım buradan bir Enhanced Potential Microchip alabiliriz.
The Feathers Fly Part I#050.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#051.src: I need you to accompany me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#051.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#052.src: If I'm with a human, surely they'll sell one, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#052.dst: Yanımda bir insan varsa bana bir tane satarlar herhâlde, değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part I#052.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#053.src: You go first, I'll follow you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#053.dst: Önden sen git, ben arkandan gelirim.
The Feathers Fly Part I#053.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#054.src: Or I guess you could just leave, that's cool too...
The Feathers Fly Part I#054.dst: Ya da gidebilirsin de, o da olur...
The Feathers Fly Part I#054.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#055.src: Ah, finally! I could've taken you there y'know!
The Feathers Fly Part I#055.dst: Ah, nihayet! Seni oraya ben götürebilirdim, biliyorsun!
The Feathers Fly Part I#055.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#056.src: Honestly, I just wanted to test something on you... Oh well!
The Feathers Fly Part I#056.dst: Açıkçası sende bir şey denemek istemiştim... Neyse!
The Feathers Fly Part I#056.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#057.src: This is the shop! I think we can buy an Enhanced Potential Microchip here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#057.dst: Dükkân burası! Sanırım buradan bir Enhanced Potential Microchip alabiliriz.
The Feathers Fly Part I#057.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#058.src: I need you to accompany me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#058.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#059.src: If I'm with a human, surely they'll sell one, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#059.dst: Yanımda bir insan varsa bana bir tane satarlar herhâlde, değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part I#059.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#060.src: You go first, I'll follow you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#060.dst: Önden sen git, ben arkandan gelirim.
The Feathers Fly Part I#060.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#061.src: Hmpf. What are you doing in here, Avo?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#061.dst: Hıh. Burada ne işin var, Avo?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#061.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#063.src: So-uh, I was, y'know, wonderin' if you had any-
The Feathers Fly Part I#063.dst: Şey-ee, ben, işte, acaba sizde hiç-
The Feathers Fly Part I#063.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#066.src: There's NO WAY I'm selling anythin' to an Avo! Shoo! Get out!
The Feathers Fly Part I#066.dst: Bir Avo'ya bir şey satmamın İMKÂNI YOK! Hoşt! Defol!
The Feathers Fly Part I#066.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#069.src: I am NOT giving up! To hell with all this!
The Feathers Fly Part I#069.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#070.src: Here, go in yourself and ask. I'll cover the cost later.
The Feathers Fly Part I#070.dst: Al, sen kendin gir ve sor. Parasını sonra ben öderim.
The Feathers Fly Part I#070.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#071.src: I'll stand back. CLEARLY this guy is too STUCK up to- Ugh, I'm getting angry! Just go in again.
The Feathers Fly Part I#071.dst: Ben geride dururum. BELLİ Kİ bu adam fazla BURNU havada- Ah, sinirleniyorum! Sen yine gir işte.
The Feathers Fly Part I#071.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#072.src: Ask for an Enhanced Microchip at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#073.src: Huh?! I made myself clear! You were with her!
The Feathers Fly Part I#073.dst: Ha?! Gayet açık konuştum! Sen onunla beraberdin!
The Feathers Fly Part I#073.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#074.src: I'm closing for today, I cannot stand this! OUT!!
The Feathers Fly Part I#074.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#075.src: Oh, and don't even think about even approaching MY shop!
The Feathers Fly Part I#075.dst: Bir de BENİM dükkânıma yaklaşmayı aklından bile geçirme!
The Feathers Fly Part I#075.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#076.src: Find the control panel near the shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#077.src: So you did come back! Hang tight!
The Feathers Fly Part I#077.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#078.src: Look, we need a plan. Talk to me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#078.dst: Bak, bir plana ihtiyacımız var. Benimle konuş.
The Feathers Fly Part I#078.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#079.dst: Ay, bu adam kafayı yemiş. Hmm...
The Feathers Fly Part I#079.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#080.src: I'm... surprised he kicked you out, too. Maybe he's a patriot?
The Feathers Fly Part I#080.dst: Seni de kovmasına... şaşırdım. Belki vatanseverdir?
The Feathers Fly Part I#080.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#081.src: Well, anyway, we need a plan. I don't wanna wait this out.
The Feathers Fly Part I#081.dst: Neyse, bir plan lazım. Bunun geçmesini beklemek istemiyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part I#081.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#082.src: Look, this guy has to have a control panel somewhere. Maybe we can neutralize the robots.
The Feathers Fly Part I#082.dst: Bak, bu adamın bir yerde kontrol paneli olmalı. Belki robotları etkisiz hâle getirebiliriz.
The Feathers Fly Part I#082.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#083.src: That stuff hates water, y'know? So I'll go fetch some in the meantime.
The Feathers Fly Part I#083.dst: O tür şeyler sudan nefret eder, bilirsin. O arada ben biraz su getireyim.
The Feathers Fly Part I#083.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#084.src: I'd like to NOT get zapped by a forcefield, so I'll sneak inside once we're done with that.
The Feathers Fly Part I#084.dst: Bir güç kalkanında çarpılmamayı TERCİH EDERİM, o yüzden o işi hallettikten sonra gizlice içeri girerim.
The Feathers Fly Part I#084.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#085.src: Got it? Find the control panel. It should be somewhere around the house. Talk to me once you're ready.
The Feathers Fly Part I#085.dst: Anladın mı? Kontrol panelini bul. Evin etrafında bir yerde olmalı. Hazır olunca benimle konuş.
The Feathers Fly Part I#085.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#086.src: Good luck, then! I'll be back once you find the control panel!
The Feathers Fly Part I#086.dst: Bol şans o zaman! Kontrol panelini bulunca dönerim!
The Feathers Fly Part I#086.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#087.src: Here we are! Good job! Alright, let's see...
The Feathers Fly Part I#087.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#088.src: Wait... Why are there... Buttons... Everywhere??
The Feathers Fly Part I#088.dst: Dur... Neden her yerde... Düğme... Var??
The Feathers Fly Part I#088.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#089.src: I feel like soaking everything would be quite the mistake.
The Feathers Fly Part I#089.dst: Her şeyi ıslatmak bence büyük bir hata olur.
The Feathers Fly Part I#089.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#090.src: And none of them are labelled! What is that?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#090.dst: Hiçbirinde etiket de yok! Bu ne böyle?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#090.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#091.src: Look, your choice. What should we neutralize first?
The Feathers Fly Part I#091.dst: Bak, seçim senin. Önce hangisini etkisiz hâle getirelim?
The Feathers Fly Part I#091.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#092.src: Left, huh? Well, let's see how that goes.
The Feathers Fly Part I#092.dst: Sol, ha? Neyse, bakalım nasıl olacak.
The Feathers Fly Part I#092.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#095.src: Center... I guess the most important stuff could be here. In theory. I wouldn't count on it.
The Feathers Fly Part I#095.dst: Orta... Galiba en önemli şeyler burada olabilir. Teoride. Ben pek güvenmezdim.
The Feathers Fly Part I#095.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#096.src: Huh! This wasn't that bad. And... I see something poking out, hold on...
The Feathers Fly Part I#096.dst: Hı! O kadar da kötü değildi. Ve... dışarı çıkan bir şey görüyorum, bekle...
The Feathers Fly Part I#096.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#097.src: Haha!... Wait, that's not it. Urgh.
The Feathers Fly Part I#097.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#098.src: Hey, I'll just give that to you. Though, you probably don't know how to use it, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part I#098.dst: Hey, bunu sana vereyim. Gerçi muhtemelen nasıl kullanılacağını bilmiyorsundur, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part I#098.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#099.src: Looks like we got another shot. I still have some water left.
The Feathers Fly Part I#099.dst: Galiba bir şansımız daha var. Hâlâ biraz suyum kaldı.
The Feathers Fly Part I#099.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#100.src: Center... I guess the most important stuff could be here. In theory. I wouldn't count on it.
The Feathers Fly Part I#100.dst: Orta... Galiba en önemli şeyler burada olabilir. Teoride. Ben pek güvenmezdim.
The Feathers Fly Part I#100.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#101.src: Huh! This wasn't that bad. And... I see something poking out, hold on...
The Feathers Fly Part I#101.dst: Hı! O kadar da kötü değildi. Ve... dışarı çıkan bir şey görüyorum, bekle...
The Feathers Fly Part I#101.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#102.src: Haha! I think that's what we're looking for!
The Feathers Fly Part I#102.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#103.src: Look, I still want to make it up to the guy. I really don't want to be the villain of his story.
The Feathers Fly Part I#103.dst: Bak, adamın gönlünü yine de almak istiyorum. Onun hikâyesinin kötüsü olmak hiç istemiyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part I#103.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#104.src: I'll meet you back at the Workshop. You can go on ahead.
The Feathers Fly Part I#104.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#105.src: Right, right. Stand back, just in case.
The Feathers Fly Part I#105.dst: Tamam, tamam. Geri çekil, ne olur ne olmaz.
The Feathers Fly Part I#105.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#106.src: Oh wow. You got the right one, first try! How'd you know?
The Feathers Fly Part I#106.dst: Vay be. İlk denemede doğrusunu buldun! Nereden bildin?
The Feathers Fly Part I#106.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#107.src: Well, good job. I still want to make it up to the poor guy though.
The Feathers Fly Part I#107.dst: Neyse, aferin. Ama zavallı adamın gönlünü yine de almak istiyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part I#107.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#108.src: Just meet me back at the Workshop, I'll be there!
The Feathers Fly Part I#108.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#109.src: Fight your way out of the shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#110.src: Meet Ava in the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#112.src: Sorry about all the trouble I caused... I hope this makes it up to you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#112.dst: Çıkardığım bütün sorunlar için özür dilerim... Umarım bu gönlünü alır.
The Feathers Fly Part I#112.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#113.src: I hope 's alright... I managed to find the microchip right away, after all.
The Feathers Fly Part I#113.dst: Umarım sorun yoktur... Sonuçta mikroçipi hemen bulmayı başardım.
The Feathers Fly Part I#113.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#114.src: ...Alright. Time to go. I'll wait for {u}, I guess.
The Feathers Fly Part I#114.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#116.src: Sorry about all the trouble I caused... I hope this makes it up to you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#116.dst: Çıkardığım bütün sorunlar için özür dilerim... Umarım bu gönlünü alır.
The Feathers Fly Part I#116.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#118.src: Oh, there you are! I felt sad leaving you behind!
The Feathers Fly Part I#118.dst: Ah, işte buradasın! Seni geride bıraktığım için üzülmüştüm!
The Feathers Fly Part I#118.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#119.src: Say, if you need a lift, just tell me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#119.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#121.src: Alright, I'm dropping you off! Stick the landing!
The Feathers Fly Part I#121.dst: Pekâlâ, seni bırakıyorum! İnişi düzgün yap!
The Feathers Fly Part I#121.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#122.src: I can't believe it! It's working! Look! Look at it!
The Feathers Fly Part I#122.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#123.src: A Growth Accelerator... Can you imagine the possibilities?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#123.dst: Bir Büyüme Hızlandırıcı... Neler yapılabileceğini düşünebiliyor musun?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#123.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#124.src: We'll be able to... I don't know, help the poor, that's nice, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#124.dst: Şeyi yapabileceğiz... Bilmiyorum, yoksullara yardım ederiz, bu güzel bir şey, değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part I#124.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#125.src: But we're not done. Well, I'm not done. I'd still like your help.
The Feathers Fly Part I#125.dst: Ama işimiz bitmedi. Yani benim işim bitmedi. Hâlâ yardımını istiyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part I#125.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#126.src: Look, let's try it out together, alright? Maybe I'll let you go afterwards?
The Feathers Fly Part I#126.dst: Bak, beraber bir deneyelim, olur mu? Belki sonra seni bırakırım?
The Feathers Fly Part I#126.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#127.src: I'll join you outside. Once I'm sure this works, I'll be able to... Show it to them.
The Feathers Fly Part I#127.dst: Dışarıda yanına gelirim. Bunun çalıştığından emin olunca onlara... Gösterebileceğim.
The Feathers Fly Part I#127.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#128.src: In theory, it should be easy to operate... I'm trusting you. Again. Sorry 'bout that.
The Feathers Fly Part I#128.dst: Teoride kullanması kolay olmalı... Sana güveniyorum. Yine. Kusura bakma.
The Feathers Fly Part I#128.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#129.src: Meet Ava outside of the Workshop and help her operate her machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#129.dst: Atölyenin dışında Ava ile buluş ve makinesini çalıştırmasına yardım et: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#130.src: Alright, it's just on the hill next to us, but I can bring you there if ya want!
The Feathers Fly Part I#130.dst: Pekâlâ, hemen yanımızdaki tepede ama istersen seni oraya götürebilirim!
The Feathers Fly Part I#130.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#131.src: Just don't get too used to me, alright? Tell me when you're ready.
The Feathers Fly Part I#131.dst: Sadece bana fazla alışma, tamam mı? Hazır olunca söyle.
The Feathers Fly Part I#131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#133.src: Or I guess you could just leave, that's cool too...
The Feathers Fly Part I#133.dst: Ya da gidebilirsin de, o da olur...
The Feathers Fly Part I#133.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#134.src: Alright, this should be good. Talk to me and I'll explain!
The Feathers Fly Part I#134.dst: Pekâlâ, burası iyi olur. Benimle konuş, anlatayım!
The Feathers Fly Part I#134.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#135.src: I'll do a quick rundown of how to operate this. It's not automatic yet.
The Feathers Fly Part I#135.dst: Bunun nasıl çalıştırıldığını kısaca anlatayım. Henüz otomatik değil.
The Feathers Fly Part I#135.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#136.src: I'll give you a remote. You'll simply have to click in the right orders. You'll see!
The Feathers Fly Part I#136.dst: Sana bir kumanda vereceğim. Sadece doğru sırayla tıklaman gerekecek. Görürsün!
The Feathers Fly Part I#136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#137.src: You have to be quick, though! You can't just take all the time you want.
The Feathers Fly Part I#137.dst: Ama hızlı olmalısın! İstediğin kadar vakit harcayamazsın.
The Feathers Fly Part I#137.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#138.src: I have no clue how stable all of this is, so we'll start slowly!
The Feathers Fly Part I#138.dst: Bunların ne kadar sağlam olduğuna dair hiçbir fikrim yok, o yüzden yavaş başlayacağız!
The Feathers Fly Part I#138.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#139.src: I know this sounds a li'l scary, but you've shown yourself being capable.
The Feathers Fly Part I#139.dst: Biraz korkutucu geldiğini biliyorum ama ne kadar becerikli olduğunu gösterdin.
The Feathers Fly Part I#139.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#140.src: Tell me when you're ready, I'll give you the remote then start the machine!
The Feathers Fly Part I#140.dst: Hazır olunca söyle, sana kumandayı verip makineyi çalıştıracağım!
The Feathers Fly Part I#140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#142.src: Think of it like... Casting one of your spells. You're used to that, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#142.dst: Şöyle düşün... Büyülerinden birini yapmak gibi. Ona alışkınsın, değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part I#142.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#143.src: Let's start slowly! You have {~} seconds to fully charge it up!
The Feathers Fly Part I#143.dst: Yavaş başlayalım! Tamamen şarj etmek için {~} saniyen var!
The Feathers Fly Part I#143.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#146.src: Do you have ANY idea what it is we've just done?
The Feathers Fly Part I#146.dst: Az önce ne yaptığımızın FARKINDA mısın?
The Feathers Fly Part I#146.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#147.src: I have to show that to the Chief. They WILL accept me! I cannot fail now!
The Feathers Fly Part I#147.dst: Bunu Şef'e göstermeliyim. Beni KABUL EDECEKLER! Artık başarısız olamam!
The Feathers Fly Part I#147.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#148.src: Tell you what, let's meet up at the Chief's hut. If you want me to take you there right now, you can just go ahead and tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part I#148.dst: Bak ne diyeceğim, Şef'in kulübesinde buluşalım. Seni hemen oraya götürmemi istersen söylemen yeter!
The Feathers Fly Part I#148.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#149.src: Operate the machine with Ava for the Avos Chief at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#149.dst: Avos Şefi için Ava ile makineyi çalıştır: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#151.src: It really is convenient being with me, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part I#151.dst: Benimle olmak gerçekten çok işe yarıyor, ha?
The Feathers Fly Part I#151.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#152.src: On second thought... Isn't it too soon?
The Feathers Fly Part I#152.dst: Bir daha düşündüm de... Fazla erken değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part I#152.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#153.src: I-I think I want to turn back... I...
The Feathers Fly Part I#153.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#154.src: You should approach the Chief first. It... won't work if I do it. I'll come by afterwards.
The Feathers Fly Part I#154.dst: Şef'e önce sen yaklaşmalısın. Ben yaparsam... işe yaramaz. Ben sonra gelirim.
The Feathers Fly Part I#154.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#155.src: Ah, human! Welcome back. Good timing...
The Feathers Fly Part I#155.dst: Ah, insan! Tekrar hoş geldin. Tam zamanında...
The Feathers Fly Part I#155.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#156.src: Did you happen to see... An oddly dressed Avo around here recently?
The Feathers Fly Part I#156.dst: Son zamanlarda buralarda... Tuhaf giyimli bir Avo gördün mü acaba?
The Feathers Fly Part I#156.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#157.src: We kicked that girl from the tribe, and we do have our reasons.
The Feathers Fly Part I#157.dst: O kızı kabileden kovduk, bunun da sebepleri var.
The Feathers Fly Part I#157.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#158.src: I've heard reports of her snooping around recently. With a human, even.
The Feathers Fly Part I#158.dst: Son zamanlarda etrafta dolaşıp burnunu soktuğunu duydum. Hem de bir insanla.
The Feathers Fly Part I#158.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#159.src: And I believe... That this is no coincidence you're here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#159.dst: Ve senin burada olmanın... Tesadüf olmadığına inanıyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part I#159.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#160.src: I will be frank. You're with her, aren't you? I won't hurt you. I won't hurt her either.
The Feathers Fly Part I#160.dst: Açık konuşacağım. Onunla berabersin, değil mi? Sana zarar vermeyeceğim. Ona da.
The Feathers Fly Part I#160.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#161.src: She's not exactly welcome here. But she's never told you about that, did she?
The Feathers Fly Part I#161.dst: Burada pek hoş karşılanmıyor. Ama sana bundan hiç bahsetmedi, değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part I#161.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#162.src: And I have nothing to hide, Chief.
The Feathers Fly Part I#162.dst: Benim de saklayacak bir şeyim yok, Şef.
The Feathers Fly Part I#162.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#163.src: STOP IT, you two! Let her talk!
The Feathers Fly Part I#163.dst: KESİN ŞUNU, ikiniz de! Bırakın konuşsun!
The Feathers Fly Part I#163.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#164.src: You're all scared of change, and that's all there is to it. Now...
The Feathers Fly Part I#164.dst: Hepiniz değişimden korkuyorsunuz, mesele bundan ibaret. Şimdi...
The Feathers Fly Part I#164.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#166.src: Hmpf. Let's see that broken atrocity of yours.
The Feathers Fly Part I#166.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#168.src: This is it. I can't fail now... I really hope I can trust you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#168.dst: İşte bu. Artık başarısız olamam... Sana güvenebileceğimi gerçekten umuyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part I#168.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#169.src: You have no idea how important this is to me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#169.dst: Bunun benim için ne kadar önemli olduğunu bilemezsin.
The Feathers Fly Part I#169.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#170.src: It'll be slightly more difficult than last time, so get ready.
The Feathers Fly Part I#170.dst: Geçen seferden biraz daha zor olacak, o yüzden hazırlan.
The Feathers Fly Part I#170.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#171.src: I'll give you the remote once you're ready!
The Feathers Fly Part I#171.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#172.src: Wait, are you sure this isn't dang-
The Feathers Fly Part I#172.dst: Dur, bunun tehlikeli olmadığından emin mis-
The Feathers Fly Part I#172.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#175.src: Let's just give her a chance for now.
The Feathers Fly Part I#175.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#176.src: Why is she getting away with using such magic?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#176.dst: Böyle bir büyüyü kullanıp nasıl paçayı kurtarıyor?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#176.speaker: Avos Guard

The Feathers Fly Part I#177.src: Oh I'm gonna charge this sapling like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part I#177.dst: Ah, bu fidanı deli gibi şarj edeceğim!
The Feathers Fly Part I#177.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#179.src: One last time soldier, and I'm counting on you to be quick!
The Feathers Fly Part I#179.dst: Son bir kez asker, hızlı olacağına güveniyorum!
The Feathers Fly Part I#179.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#182.src: Wait... That's it?? No, this isn't right...
The Feathers Fly Part I#182.dst: Dur... Bu kadar mı?? Hayır, bu doğru değil...
The Feathers Fly Part I#182.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#185.src: Chief! Have you seen what she just did?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#185.dst: Şef! Az önce ne yaptığını gördünüz mü?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#185.speaker: Avos Guard

The Feathers Fly Part I#186.src: I-I didn't mean to! I told you to stand back!!
The Feathers Fly Part I#186.dst: B-ben istemeden oldu! Size geri çekilin dedim!!
The Feathers Fly Part I#186.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#187.src: Under normal circumstances, I'd have sent you down the pit after cutting off your feathers.
The Feathers Fly Part I#187.dst: Normal şartlarda tüylerini kesip seni çukura atardım.
The Feathers Fly Part I#187.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#188.src: But these are not normal circumstances. Soldier, may you come over here as well?
The Feathers Fly Part I#188.dst: Ama şartlar normal değil. Asker, sen de buraya gelir misin?
The Feathers Fly Part I#188.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#189.src: Talk to the Avos Chief with Ava at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#189.dst: Ava ile birlikte Avos Şefi ile konuş: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#190.src: So you fused OUR magic... With electromagic?
The Feathers Fly Part I#190.dst: Demek BİZİM büyümüzü... Elektrobüyüyle birleştirdin, öyle mi?
The Feathers Fly Part I#190.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#191.src: I recognized extracts from the totem too. You're the one who stole from us, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#191.dst: Totemden alınmış özleri de tanıdım. Bizden çalan sendin, değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part I#191.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#192.dst: Ben... öyle bir şey yapmış olabilirim.
The Feathers Fly Part I#192.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#193.src: And on top of that, you used the Wynn warrior to fool us?
The Feathers Fly Part I#193.dst: Üstüne bir de bizi kandırmak için Wynn savaşçısını mı kullandın?
The Feathers Fly Part I#193.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#194.src: And I'm sure you know why I did!
The Feathers Fly Part I#194.dst: Neden yaptığımı da gayet iyi biliyorsunuz!
The Feathers Fly Part I#194.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#195.src: Do you have any idea how unstable this wretched electromagic is?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#195.dst: Bu lanet elektrobüyünün ne kadar kararsız olduğu hakkında en ufak fikrin var mı?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#195.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#197.src: And you should NOT! Don't you understand? This is too dangerous!
The Feathers Fly Part I#197.dst: Ve ETMEMELİSİN! Anlamıyor musun? Bu çok tehlikeli!
The Feathers Fly Part I#197.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#198.src: Should we kill her on the spot?! We almost died!
The Feathers Fly Part I#198.dst: Onu hemen burada öldürelim mi?! Neredeyse ölüyorduk!
The Feathers Fly Part I#198.speaker: Avos Guard

The Feathers Fly Part I#199.src: No, don't kill her. I want her and the soldier in my hut, now.
The Feathers Fly Part I#199.dst: Hayır, öldürmeyin. Onu ve askeri hemen kulübemde istiyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part I#199.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#200.src: Ava. You can't keep going with this. Just stop. This is your final warning.
The Feathers Fly Part I#200.dst: Ava. Bununla devam edemezsin. Sadece dur. Bu son uyarın.
The Feathers Fly Part I#200.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#201.src: What do you even hope to accomplish? You used to be such a brilliant kid.
The Feathers Fly Part I#201.dst: Neyi başarmayı umuyorsun ki? Eskiden ne parlak bir çocuktun.
The Feathers Fly Part I#201.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#202.src: I just... wanna help people. You know that, I'm sure you understand!
The Feathers Fly Part I#202.dst: Ben sadece... insanlara yardım etmek istiyorum. Bunu biliyorsun, anladığına eminim!
The Feathers Fly Part I#202.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#203.src: Have you seen the Factory? They tried to help people, and instead they killed hundreds!
The Feathers Fly Part I#203.dst: Fabrikayı gördün mü? Onlar da insanlara yardım etmeye çalıştı, sonunda yüzlercesini öldürdüler!
The Feathers Fly Part I#203.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#204.src: Do you think you're able change the world?! Well, you can't, Ava! This is beyond you!
The Feathers Fly Part I#204.dst: Dünyayı değiştirebileceğini mi sanıyorsun?! Değiştiremezsin, Ava! Bu senin harcın değil!
The Feathers Fly Part I#204.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#205.src: So, for the last time. Stop all of this. I might reconsider your banishment then.
The Feathers Fly Part I#205.dst: O yüzden son kez söylüyorum. Bütün bunları bırak. O zaman sürgününü yeniden düşünebilirim.
The Feathers Fly Part I#205.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#206.src: You... You're really serious about that, huh? You'll NEVER change, will you?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#206.dst: Sen... Gerçekten ciddisin, ha? ASLA değişmeyeceksin, değil mi?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#206.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#207.src: Do you guys have ANY idea how archaic you all are?! A final warning??
The Feathers Fly Part I#207.dst: Ne kadar çağ dışı olduğunuzun HİÇ farkında mısınız?! Son uyarı mı??
The Feathers Fly Part I#207.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#208.src: I can't believe you worked with her, soldier. Well, now you know to avoid her.
The Feathers Fly Part I#208.dst: Onunla çalıştığına inanamıyorum, asker. Neyse, artık ondan uzak durman gerektiğini biliyorsun.
The Feathers Fly Part I#208.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#209.src: ...It appears she left some device on the floor. You might as well take them. And here, take these. We haven't had the chance to thank you regarding the Factory.
The Feathers Fly Part I#209.dst: ...Görünüşe göre yere bir alet bırakmış. Onları sen alsan iyi olur. Al, bunları da al. Fabrika konusunda sana teşekkür etme fırsatımız olmamıştı.
The Feathers Fly Part I#209.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#211.src: Looks like Ava left. She probably went back to the Workshop.
The Feathers Fly Part I#211.dst: Görünüşe göre Ava gitmiş. Muhtemelen Atölye'ye geri döndü.

The Feathers Fly Part I#215.src: Looks like Ava is waiting for you in the square south from here. Maybe she'll give you a lift?
The Feathers Fly Part I#215.dst: Görünüşe göre Ava seni buranın güneyindeki meydanda bekliyor. Belki seni götürür?

The Feathers Fly Part I#216.src: (!) Don't aim directly at a block when Left-Clicking!
The Feathers Fly Part I#216.dst: (!) Sol Tık yaparken doğrudan bir bloğa nişan alma!

The Feathers Fly Part I#217.src: Oh no, time's up! It was supposed to be easy... Hold on, I'm booting it up again.
The Feathers Fly Part I#217.dst: Ah hayır, süre doldu! Kolay olması gerekiyordu... Bekle, yeniden başlatıyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part I#217.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#218.src: Oh, you're back! Talk to me so we can get started!
The Feathers Fly Part I#218.dst: Ah, döndün! Başlayabilmemiz için benimle konuş!
The Feathers Fly Part I#218.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#219.src: Hey, it happens to the best of us!
The Feathers Fly Part I#219.dst: Hey, en iyilerin bile başına gelir!
The Feathers Fly Part I#219.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#220.src: It's fine, the machine isn't at full power, it won't explode or anything.
The Feathers Fly Part I#220.dst: Sorun yok, makine tam güçte değil, patlamaz falan.
The Feathers Fly Part I#220.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#221.src: Just tell me when you're ready!
The Feathers Fly Part I#221.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#222.src: Gah! If I can't get myself to do it now, I'll never do it!
The Feathers Fly Part I#222.dst: Ah! Kendimi şimdi yapmaya ikna edemezsem asla yapamam!
The Feathers Fly Part I#222.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#225.src: To hell with this! I'll show everyone! I'll show how great we could be! You'll see, chief!
The Feathers Fly Part I#225.dst: Canı cehenneme! Herkese göstereceğim! Ne kadar harika olabileceğimizi göstereceğim! Göreceksin, şef!
The Feathers Fly Part I#225.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#001.src: Oh... So you showed up! I'm glad, I really am!
The Feathers Fly Part II#001.dst: Oh... Demek geldin! Sevindim, gerçekten çok sevindim!
The Feathers Fly Part II#001.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#002.src: It's time for me to show the Growth Accelerator to the Corkians.
The Feathers Fly Part II#002.dst: Büyüme Hızlandırıcısı'nı Corkian'lara gösterme vakti geldi.
The Feathers Fly Part II#002.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#003.src: Look, this time I'll really try and reward you well, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#003.dst: Bak, bu sefer seni gerçekten iyi ödüllendirmeye çalışacağım, tamam mı?
The Feathers Fly Part II#003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#004.src: Anyway! I have a plan. You see, I definitely can't easily get in the city.
The Feathers Fly Part II#004.dst: Neyse! Bir planım var. Şehre öyle kolay kolay giremeyeceğim kesin.
The Feathers Fly Part II#004.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#005.src: The Corkians have a council where they deal with their issues. We can try getting an audience.
The Feathers Fly Part II#005.dst: Corkian'ların sorunlarını görüştükleri bir konseyi var. Bir huzura kabul ayarlamayı deneyebiliriz.
The Feathers Fly Part II#005.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#006.src: I know a way for me to get in the city. That's where you come in! There are some sentries to take care of.
The Feathers Fly Part II#006.dst: Şehre girmenin bir yolunu biliyorum. İşte burada sen devreye giriyorsun! Halletmen gereken birkaç nöbetçi var.
The Feathers Fly Part II#006.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#007.src: They're really old models though, somehow. I'll give you a jammer I made for this. Right-Click a robot to use it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#007.dst: Nedense epey eski modeller ama. Bunun için yaptığım bir karıştırıcıyı vereceğim. Kullanmak için bir robota Sağ Tık yap!
The Feathers Fly Part II#007.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#008.src: Once you jam one robot, you'll have to jam all others within {~} seconds! So try to plan ahead and locate them all before jamming one!
The Feathers Fly Part II#008.dst: Bir robotu karıştırdığın an, diğerlerini de {~} saniye içinde karıştırman gerekecek! O yüzden önceden plan yap, birine dokunmadan hepsini bul!
The Feathers Fly Part II#008.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#009.src: Tell me once you're ready. I'll throw you in there. I'll join you afterwards. You'll see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#009.dst: Hazır olunca söyle. Seni oraya fırlatacağım. Ben de sonra yanına gelirim. Görürsün!
The Feathers Fly Part II#009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#010.src: Well then, first off, take this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#011.src: Now, just stand still... I gotta try something on you...
The Feathers Fly Part II#011.dst: Şimdi kıpırdama... Senin üzerinde bir şey denemem lazım...
The Feathers Fly Part II#011.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#012.src: Locate and jam all the robot sentries near the Corkus Clocktower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] within {~} seconds
The Feathers Fly Part II#012.dst: Corkus Saat Kulesi yakınındaki bütün robot nöbetçileri bul ve {~4} saniye içinde karıştır: [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#014.src: Thanks! These robots were harmless but hey, better safe than sorry right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#014.dst: Sağ ol! Bu robotlar zararsızdı ama olsun, tedbirli olmakta fayda var, değil mi?
The Feathers Fly Part II#014.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#015.src: Anyway, we need to get ready to meet the Corkian Council.
The Feathers Fly Part II#015.dst: Neyse, Corkian Konseyi ile görüşmeye hazırlanmamız lazım.
The Feathers Fly Part II#015.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#016.src: And I think... I need a disguise. I don't like hiding myself, but I don't have a choice.
The Feathers Fly Part II#016.dst: Ve galiba... Kılık değiştirmem gerekiyor. Saklanmayı sevmem ama başka çarem yok.
The Feathers Fly Part II#016.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#017.src: Thanks to some plans I got, I know where to find some. Follow me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#017.dst: Elime geçen birkaç plan sayesinde nerede kıyafet bulacağımı biliyorum. Beni takip et!
The Feathers Fly Part II#017.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#018.src: Here we are! I'm pretty sure we can find some outfits in there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#018.dst: İşte geldik! Eminim burada birkaç kıyafet bulabiliriz.
The Feathers Fly Part II#018.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#019.src: I'll stand here to quickly hide in case anyone comes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#019.dst: Biri gelirse hemen saklanabilmek için burada duracağım.
The Feathers Fly Part II#019.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#020.src: Just look around, and come back with what you think looks better!
The Feathers Fly Part II#020.dst: Etrafa bir bak, sana göre en güzel duranı getir!
The Feathers Fly Part II#020.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#021.src: Yeah, I am letting you choose my outfit. Aren't you lucky? Go and get me the fanciest clothes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#021.dst: Evet, kıyafetimi sana seçtiriyorum. Şanslısın, değil mi? Git de bana en şık kıyafetleri getir!
The Feathers Fly Part II#021.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#022.src: Pick an outfit to fit in with the Corkians and bring it to Ava at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#022.dst: Corkian'lara uyum sağlayacak bir kıyafet seç ve Ava'ya götür: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#023.src: I'm trusting you. We Avos aren't exactly into... Fashion. Then again, they're not into Electromagic either, so what do I know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#023.dst: Sana güveniyorum. Biz Avos'lar pek... modayla ilgilenmeyiz. Gerçi onlar da Electromagic ile ilgilenmiyor, ben ne bileyim.
The Feathers Fly Part II#023.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#026.src: I feel like... I'm about to go to work.
The Feathers Fly Part II#026.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#027.src: At the very least, I'll probably blend in very well!
The Feathers Fly Part II#027.dst: En azından muhtemelen çok iyi uyum sağlarım!
The Feathers Fly Part II#027.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#028.src: Now, I'm gonna be completely honest about this, so don't panic, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#028.dst: Şimdi, sana tamamen dürüst olacağım, o yüzden paniğe kapılma ama...
The Feathers Fly Part II#028.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#029.src: I have... absolutely NO idea how we could even get an audience.
The Feathers Fly Part II#029.dst: Huzura nasıl kabul edileceğimiz hakkında... HİÇBİR fikrim yok.
The Feathers Fly Part II#029.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#030.src: I think we need to split up and try to find out how to get one from the Council.
The Feathers Fly Part II#030.dst: Bence ayrılıp Konsey'den nasıl kabul alacağımızı araştırmalıyız.
The Feathers Fly Part II#030.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#031.src: I'll be around the town center if ya need me for anything! I'll ask around. You should too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#031.dst: Bir şeye ihtiyacın olursa kasaba meydanının oralarda olacağım! Ben etrafa soracağım. Sen de sor!
The Feathers Fly Part II#031.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#032.src: One last thing, though... Sorry if that's a little weird but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#032.dst: Son bir şey ama... Biraz tuhaf kaçacak, kusura bakma ama...
The Feathers Fly Part II#032.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#034.src: {u}, huh? That's... A nice name. Well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#034.dst: {u}, öyle mi? Bu... Güzel bir isim. Neyse, bol şans!
The Feathers Fly Part II#034.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#037.src: I've already seen plenty of green in my lifetime, y'know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#037.dst: Hayatım boyunca yeterince yeşil gördüm zaten, biliyor musun.
The Feathers Fly Part II#037.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#038.src: Well, I know you folks sure do love money. Maybe we can get noticed with this...
The Feathers Fly Part II#038.dst: Siz insanların paraya bayıldığınızı biliyorum. Belki bununla dikkat çekebiliriz...
The Feathers Fly Part II#038.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#039.src: Hmm... You know, this could actually work!
The Feathers Fly Part II#039.dst: Hmm... Biliyor musun, bu gerçekten işe yarayabilir!
The Feathers Fly Part II#039.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#040.src: I have no idea how this audience things works but i could try to get people to notice me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#040.dst: Bu huzura kabul işi nasıl işliyor hiç bilmiyorum ama insanların beni fark etmesini sağlamaya çalışabilirim!
The Feathers Fly Part II#040.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#041.src: Well, we should split up and meet up later to see what information we have. Just ask around town!
The Feathers Fly Part II#041.dst: Neyse, ayrılalım, sonra buluşup ne bilgi topladığımıza bakalım. Kasabada etrafa sor yeter!
The Feathers Fly Part II#041.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#042.src: I'll be around the town center if you got any information!
The Feathers Fly Part II#042.dst: Bir bilgi bulursan kasaba meydanının oralarda olacağım!
The Feathers Fly Part II#042.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#043.src: One last thing, though... Sorry if thats a little weird but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#043.dst: Son bir şey ama... Biraz tuhaf kaçacak, kusura bakma ama...
The Feathers Fly Part II#043.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#048.src: Ya got good taste! I always wanted to explore the ocean, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part II#048.dst: Zevkin iyiymiş! Okyanusu keşfetmeyi hep istemişimdir, biliyor musun?
The Feathers Fly Part II#048.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#049.src: Hey, thanks for helping me out so much. You've been such a huge help!
The Feathers Fly Part II#049.dst: Hey, bana bu kadar yardım ettiğin için sağ ol. Çok büyük yardımın dokundu!
The Feathers Fly Part II#049.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#050.src: Well, this isn't over, of course. And to tell you the truth...
The Feathers Fly Part II#050.dst: Ama tabii daha bitmedi. Doğruyu söylemek gerekirse...
The Feathers Fly Part II#050.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#051.src: I, uh, have no idea how to get an audience... Sorry?
The Feathers Fly Part II#051.dst: Şey, huzura nasıl kabul edileceğimiz hakkında hiçbir fikrim yok... Pardon?
The Feathers Fly Part II#051.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#052.src: I think we need to split up and try to find out how to get one.
The Feathers Fly Part II#052.dst: Bence ayrılıp nasıl kabul alacağımızı araştırmalıyız.
The Feathers Fly Part II#052.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#053.src: I'll be around the town center if ya need me for anything!
The Feathers Fly Part II#053.dst: Bir şeye ihtiyacın olursa kasaba meydanının oralarda olacağım!
The Feathers Fly Part II#053.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#057.src: Oh, and check this mask out! Time to be Ava the human!
The Feathers Fly Part II#057.dst: Ha, bir de şu maskeye bak! İnsan Ava olma vakti!
The Feathers Fly Part II#057.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#059.src: I feel like... I'm not even supposed to be wearing this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#059.dst: Sanki... bunu giymemem gerekiyormuş gibi hissediyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part II#059.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#060.src: This looks... Really, really cool though! ...Wait, where did you even find this?
The Feathers Fly Part II#060.dst: Ama bu... Gerçekten çok havalı duruyor! ...Dur, sen bunu nereden buldun ki?
The Feathers Fly Part II#060.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#061.src: I saw this dog, and... Well, that's besides the point. You'll tell me later!
The Feathers Fly Part II#061.dst: Bir köpek gördüm, sonra... Neyse, konumuz bu değil. Sonra anlatırsın!
The Feathers Fly Part II#061.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#062.src: Look, this audience thing is foreign to me but I feel like it won't really be an issue with this... thing.
The Feathers Fly Part II#062.dst: Bak, bu huzura kabul işi bana yabancı ama bu... şeyle pek sorun olacağını sanmıyorum.
The Feathers Fly Part II#062.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#063.src: Well, we still need information on who to even talk to for that stuff... I'll ask around.
The Feathers Fly Part II#063.dst: Yine de bu iş için kiminle konuşacağımızı öğrenmemiz lazım... Ben etrafa sorarım.
The Feathers Fly Part II#063.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#064.src: You should too! I'll be around the town center! Come by once you got enough information!
The Feathers Fly Part II#064.dst: Sen de sor! Ben kasaba meydanının oralarda olacağım! Yeterince bilgi toplayınca uğra!
The Feathers Fly Part II#064.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#068.src: Ask around {p} for a way to get an audience with the Council. Ava is at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#068.dst: {p} çevresinde Konsey'e kabul almanın bir yolunu araştır. Ava'nın yeri: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#070.src: Alright, so it's not really on the legal side of things, BUT apparently...
The Feathers Fly Part II#070.dst: Tamam, pek yasal sayılmaz AMA anlaşılan...
The Feathers Fly Part II#070.speaker: Ava
