The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, maybe I'll stop by sometimes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.dst: Hoşça kal, Ava. Kim bilir, belki arada bir uğrarım.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.src: ...? If you stop by the Workshop later, maybe I'll have some things for you as well.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.dst: ...? Sonra Atölye'ye uğrarsan, belki benim de sana verecek bir şeylerim olur.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1164.dst: Hoşça kal. Teşekkürler. Her şey için.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1164.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, maybe I'll stop by sometimes. After all, you're very stylish!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.dst: Hoşça kal, Ava. Kim bilir, belki arada bir uğrarım. Ne de olsa çok şıksın!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, I might stop by sometimes. Maybe you'll have figured out that armour of yours.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.dst: Hoşça kal, Ava. Kim bilir, belki arada bir uğrarım. Belki o zamana kadar o zırhını çözmüş olursun.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.src: Please contact Cerid for more information about this model.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.dst: Bu modelle ilgili daha fazla bilgi için lütfen Cerid ile iletişime geçin.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.src: If you have any questions, know that I am definitely not the right machine to ask.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.dst: Herhangi bir sorunuz varsa, bilin ki sorulacak doğru makine kesinlikle ben değilim.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.src: Hey, it's alright. We'll be fine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.dst: Hey, sorun yok. Biz iyi olacağız.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.src: You know, that Workshop of yours is way nicer than I expected.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.dst: Biliyor musun, Atölye'n beklediğimden çok daha güzelmiş.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.src: {u}, thanks for the help. You've introduced me to quite the talent!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.dst: {u}, yardımın için sağ ol. Beni tam bir yetenekle tanıştırdın!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.src: Believe me, I know how rejection feels like. I guess everyone does, in their own ways.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.dst: İnan bana, reddedilmenin nasıl bir his olduğunu bilirim. Herkes bilir galiba, kendince.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.src: Efena... She's nicer than Chief, that's for sure...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.dst: Efena... Şef'ten daha iyi biri, orası kesin...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.src: This is all... Very hard to believe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1284.dst: Yani... Maxie, değil mi? Doğru mu?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1284.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.src: {u}, once you come back here, you'll be able to get some of my gadgets.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.dst: {u}, buraya geri geldiğinde benim aletlerimden bazılarını alabileceksin.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.speaker: Ava

The Hero of Gavel#000.src: Find out what's happening in the center of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#001.src: Hmm.. I might have just enough for one tier {~}... Why are you standing there?
The Hero of Gavel#001.dst: Hmm.. {~}. kademe için ancak yetecek kadar param olabilir... Sen niye dikiliyorsun orada?
The Hero of Gavel#001.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#002.src: What all these people are here for? Don't tell me you don't know about the Siegfried contest.
The Hero of Gavel#002.dst: Bu kalabalık ne için mi burada? Bana Siegfried yarışmasını bilmediğini söyleme.
The Hero of Gavel#002.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#003.src: Are you SERIOUS?! It's the biggest thing happening since the last contest last month!
The Hero of Gavel#003.dst: CİDDİ MİSİN?! Geçen ayki yarışmadan beri olan en büyük olay bu!
The Hero of Gavel#003.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#004.src: Whoever wins the big scavenger hunt gets to go on an adventure with Siegfried himself.
The Hero of Gavel#004.dst: Büyük hazine avını kazanan, bizzat Siegfried'le maceraya çıkıyor.
The Hero of Gavel#004.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#005.src: This year, I think I even have a good chance to win!
The Hero of Gavel#005.dst: Bu yıl kazanma şansım bile var bence!
The Hero of Gavel#005.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#006.src: Huh? Oh, you want this ticket? No way, this one's mine. Go get your own at that little shop.
The Hero of Gavel#006.dst: Ha? Bu bileti mi istiyorsun? Olmaz, bu benim. Git kendininkini şu küçük dükkândan al.
The Hero of Gavel#006.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#007.src: Hey, that's the mug I dropped!
The Hero of Gavel#007.speaker: Siegfried Fan 1

The Hero of Gavel#011.src: How can I win an adventure now?
The Hero of Gavel#011.speaker: Siegfried Fan 2

The Hero of Gavel#012.src: Get a Siegfried Scavenger Hunt ticket in the center of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#012.dst: {p} merkezinden bir Siegfried Hazine Avı bileti al: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#013.src: Tickets for sale! You! Would you like to join the great Siegfried Scavenger Hunt?
The Hero of Gavel#013.dst: Biletler satışta! Sen! Büyük Siegfried Hazine Avı'na katılmak ister misin?
The Hero of Gavel#013.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#014.src: Entry is completely free, and if you win, you'll get to adventure with Siegfried himself!
The Hero of Gavel#014.dst: Katılım tamamen ücretsiz, kazanırsan bizzat Siegfried'le maceraya çıkacaksın!
The Hero of Gavel#014.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#015.src: You're interested? Great! Here, it's all quite simple.
The Hero of Gavel#015.dst: İlgileniyor musun? Harika! Al, gayet basit.
The Hero of Gavel#015.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#016.src: The ticket shows what items you need to find. It's split into three tiers.
The Hero of Gavel#016.dst: Bilette bulman gereken eşyalar yazıyor. Üç kademeye ayrılıyor.
The Hero of Gavel#016.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#017.src: The first two, they're for the common folk. But if you REALLY want to win, you need a tier {~} item.
The Hero of Gavel#017.dst: İlk ikisi sıradan halk için. Ama GERÇEKTEN kazanmak istiyorsan {~}. kademeden bir eşya lazım.
The Hero of Gavel#017.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#018.src: Heh, you can even bring all three and you're practically guaranteed to win!
The Hero of Gavel#018.dst: Heh, üçünü birden getirirsen kazanman neredeyse garanti!
The Hero of Gavel#018.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#019.src: Here, take the ticket. Come back with your items and you'll be entered into the draw.
The Hero of Gavel#019.dst: Al, bilet senin. Eşyalarınla geri gel, seni çekilişe yazayım.
The Hero of Gavel#019.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#020.src: Bring all three limited Siegfried Collection items to the merchant in {p} Center at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#020.dst: Üç sınırlı Siegfried Koleksiyonu eşyasının hepsini {p} merkezindeki tüccara götür: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#021.src: You’re back! Let me see your items.
The Hero of Gavel#021.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#022.src: This… Wow, all of them? Let me take a look at these…
The Hero of Gavel#022.dst: Bu… Vay, hepsi mi? Bir bakayım şunlara…
The Hero of Gavel#022.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#023.src: They’re all authentic! You must be ri-I mean, you must be a huge fan of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#023.dst: Hepsi orijinal! Sen zengin ol- yani, Siegfried'in büyük bir hayranı olmalısın!
The Hero of Gavel#023.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#025.src: Okay, I’ve entered you into the draw. The event’s taking place at the Golden Eagle Theatre.
The Hero of Gavel#025.dst: Tamam, seni çekilişe yazdım. Etkinlik Golden Eagle Theatre'da yapılacak.
The Hero of Gavel#025.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#026.src: Just turn toward the bank and follow the signs, the winner will be selected when everyone gets there.
The Hero of Gavel#026.dst: Bankaya doğru dön ve tabelaları takip et, herkes gelince kazanan seçilecek.
The Hero of Gavel#026.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#027.src: Go to the Golden Eagle Theatre behind the Bank in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the winners to be announced.
The Hero of Gavel#027.dst: Kazananların açıklanması için {p} bankasının arkasındaki Golden Eagle Theatre'a git: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#028.src: Welcome, welcome everyone! We’re only waiting on a few more people before we begin.
The Hero of Gavel#028.dst: Hoş geldiniz, hoş geldiniz! Başlamadan önce birkaç kişiyi daha bekliyoruz.
The Hero of Gavel#028.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#029.src: Ah, there we go! I believe we’re all set now.
The Hero of Gavel#029.dst: Ah, işte geldiler! Sanırım artık hazırız.
The Hero of Gavel#029.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#030.src: Welcome everyone, to the monthly SIEGFRIED FESTIVAL SCAVENGER HUNT!
The Hero of Gavel#030.dst: Herkes hoş geldi, aylık SIEGFRIED FESTİVALİ HAZİNE AVI'NA!
The Hero of Gavel#030.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#031.src: Today, we are once again celebrating the heroic deeds of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#031.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#032.src: All of you, my fellow gavellians, have adventured far and wide to gather rare items across the province.
The Hero of Gavel#032.dst: Siz, sevgili Gavelli dostlarım, eyaletin dört bir yanında nadir eşyalar toplamak için uzun yollar katettiniz.
The Hero of Gavel#032.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#033.src: And yet, I cannot announce the winner…
The Hero of Gavel#033.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#043.src: Thank you all for participating in this fantastic scavenger hunt around Gavel! Siegfried: The winner of this hunt will have the privilege of going on a once-in-a-lifetime, fully authentic, adventure with me!
The Hero of Gavel#043.dst: Gavel'daki bu harika hazine avına katılan herkese teşekkürler! Siegfried: Bu avın galibi, benimle hayatında bir kez yaşanacak, tamamen gerçek bir maceraya çıkma ayrıcalığına sahip olacak!
The Hero of Gavel#043.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#044.src: Now, without further ado: I shall announce the winner!
The Hero of Gavel#044.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#047.src: I better win, I bought his mug!
The Hero of Gavel#047.speaker: Siegfried Fan

The Hero of Gavel#051.src: {u}, please head to the backstage area to my right for your adventure. Thank you everyone!!
The Hero of Gavel#051.dst: {u}, maceran için lütfen sağımdaki kulise geç. Herkese teşekkürler!!
The Hero of Gavel#051.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#052.src: Meet Siegfried backstage in the Golden Eagle Theatre to go on your adventure!
The Hero of Gavel#052.dst: Maceraya çıkmak için Golden Eagle Theatre'ın kulisinde Siegfried'le buluş!

The Hero of Gavel#053.src: Welcome ! Congratulations on winning the scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#053.dst: Hoş geldin ! Hazine avını kazandığın için tebrikler!
The Hero of Gavel#053.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#054.src: Today, you’ll be going with me on one of my glorious adventures.
The Hero of Gavel#054.dst: Bugün benimle şanlı maceralarımdan birine çıkacaksın.
The Hero of Gavel#054.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#055.src: And to get there, we’ll ride in the great Siegfried Airship!
The Hero of Gavel#055.dst: Oraya gitmek için de büyük Siegfried Zeplini'ne bineceğiz!
The Hero of Gavel#055.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#056.src: It’s up at the airship docks – I’ll teleport us there!
The Hero of Gavel#056.dst: Zeplin limanında duruyor, bizi oraya ışınlayacağım!
The Hero of Gavel#056.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#057.src: (translated: Gavellian) MAGICAL MAGICKY MAGIC MAGICSPELL. Teleport!
The Hero of Gavel#057.dst: (çeviri: Gavelce) BÜYÜLÜ BÜYÜCÜK BÜYÜ BÜYÜSÖZ. Işınlan!
The Hero of Gavel#057.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#059.src: Travel with Siegfried on his airship at the {p} airship docks at [{~}, {~},-{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#059.dst: {p} zeplin limanında Siegfried'in zepliniyle yolculuk et: [{~}, {~},-{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#060.src: Here, follow me onto the airship!
The Hero of Gavel#060.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#062.src: Impressed by my piloting skills? Dodging these islands isn’t a challenge at all for the mighty Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#062.dst: Pilotluk becerilerime hayran mı kaldın? Bu adalardan kaçmak yüce Siegfried için hiç zor değil!
The Hero of Gavel#062.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#063.src: I rode an airship much like this one when I saved {p} from the dragon.
The Hero of Gavel#063.dst: {p} bölgesini ejderhadan kurtardığımda da buna çok benzeyen bir zeplin kullanmıştım.
The Hero of Gavel#063.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#064.src: Right now we’re heading to a cave on the far east of the region.
The Hero of Gavel#064.dst: Şu an bölgenin en doğusundaki bir mağaraya gidiyoruz.
The Hero of Gavel#064.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#065.src: We’ll have to navigate its treacherous corridors and defeat terrible beasts to get to the treasure at the end.
The Hero of Gavel#065.dst: Sondaki hazineye ulaşmak için hain koridorlarından geçip korkunç canavarları yenmemiz gerekecek.
The Hero of Gavel#065.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#066.src: Why don’t you go get my map from the upper level of the airship, and we’ll get ready for our adventure.
The Hero of Gavel#066.dst: Zeplinin üst katından haritamı getirsene, biz de maceraya hazırlanalım.
The Hero of Gavel#066.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#067.src: How much lon- Oh, you brought the map!
The Hero of Gavel#067.dst: Daha ne kadar- Aa, haritayı getirmişsin!
The Hero of Gavel#067.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#068.src: We’ll need to use this map to navigate the dangerous cave we’re going to.
The Hero of Gavel#068.dst: Gideceğimiz tehlikeli mağarada yolumuzu bu haritayla bulacağız.
The Hero of Gavel#068.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#069.src: How did I get this? Well-er- I always prepare before my adventures!
The Hero of Gavel#069.dst: Bunu nereden mi buldum? Şey-ee- Maceralarımdan önce hep hazırlık yaparım!
The Hero of Gavel#069.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#070.src: Anyway, we’re about to land now – be careful not to fall off!
The Hero of Gavel#070.dst: Neyse, inmek üzereyiz, dikkat et de düşme!
The Hero of Gavel#070.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#071.src: Enter the perilous cave on the eastern edge of the {p} with Siegfried at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#071.dst: Siegfried'le birlikte {p} bölgesinin doğu ucundaki tehlikeli mağaraya gir: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#072.src: Here we are, the great Cave of Treasure-Hoarding Evil Creatures!
The Hero of Gavel#072.dst: İşte geldik, Hazine İstifleyen Kötü Yaratıklar'ın büyük Mağarası!
The Hero of Gavel#072.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#073.src: Speak to me when you’re fully prepared for this dangerous adventure.
The Hero of Gavel#073.dst: Bu tehlikeli maceraya tamamen hazır olduğunda benimle konuş.
The Hero of Gavel#073.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#074.src: This cave is exceedingly dangerous, so make sure to follow my instructions.
The Hero of Gavel#074.dst: Bu mağara son derece tehlikeli, o yüzden talimatlarıma uymaya dikkat et.
The Hero of Gavel#074.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#075.src: I’ve got decades of experience bravely adventuring in these caves, so I know what I’m doing.
The Hero of Gavel#075.dst: Bu mağaralarda yılların cesur maceracılık tecrübesi var bende, ne yaptığımı biliyorum.
The Hero of Gavel#075.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#077.src: Follow Siegfried through the cave on the eastern edge of the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#077.dst: {p} bölgesinin doğu ucundaki mağarada Siegfried'i takip et: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#078.src: You sure took your time getting here! No matter.
The Hero of Gavel#078.dst: Buraya gelmen epey sürdü! Neyse, önemli değil.
The Hero of Gavel#078.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#079.src: I adventure in caves such as these often to get rid of the evil beasts dwelling within.
The Hero of Gavel#079.dst: İçinde yaşayan kötü canavarlardan kurtulmak için böyle mağaralarda sık sık maceraya atılırım.
The Hero of Gavel#079.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#080.src: If it wasn’t for me defeating them before they could even--
The Hero of Gavel#080.dst: Onlar daha harekete geçemeden ben yenmeseydim--
The Hero of Gavel#080.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#081.src: Woah, stop! This might look like a harmless decoration, but it’s a trap!
The Hero of Gavel#081.dst: Dur, dur! Bu zararsız bir süs gibi görünebilir ama bir tuzak!
The Hero of Gavel#081.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#082.src: Stay behind me, I’ll open it with my magic spell. (translated: Gavellian) OPEN!
The Hero of Gavel#082.dst: Arkamda dur, büyümle açacağım. (çeviri: Gavelce) AÇIL!
The Hero of Gavel#082.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#083.src: Aha! I’ll protect you from the guardian, you deal with the rat!
The Hero of Gavel#083.dst: Aha! Seni bekçiden ben korurum, sen fareyi hallet!
The Hero of Gavel#083.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#085.src: Ow- I mean, hah! That was easier than swatting a fly for the mighty Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#085.dst: Ay- yani, hah! Yüce Siegfried için sinek kovalamaktan bile kolaydı!
The Hero of Gavel#085.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#086.src: Seems like we’re done here! That must have been a very difficult fight for you.
The Hero of Gavel#086.dst: Görünüşe göre burada işimiz bitti! Senin için çok zorlu bir dövüş olmuştur.
The Hero of Gavel#086.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#087.src: The caves I adventure in are filled with terrifying beasts similar to those.
The Hero of Gavel#087.dst: Maceraya atıldığım mağaralar bunlara benzer korkunç canavarlarla dolu.
The Hero of Gavel#087.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#088.src: WAIT! Don’t move, that boulder is about to fall!
The Hero of Gavel#088.dst: DUR! Kıpırdama, o kaya düşmek üzere!
The Hero of Gavel#088.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#089.src: Wow, that was close! Of course, I saw that coming and had no risk at all.
The Hero of Gavel#089.dst: Vay, kıl payı! Tabii ben bunu önceden gördüm, hiç risk yoktu.
The Hero of Gavel#089.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#090.src: You might say that we can’t go further, as it’s blocking our way. But I can fix that!
The Hero of Gavel#090.dst: Yolumuzu kapattığı için daha ileri gidemeyiz diyebilirsin. Ama ben bunu hallederim!
The Hero of Gavel#090.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#091.src: And no more boulder! Only one as powerful as I can do that.
The Hero of Gavel#091.dst: Ve kaya yok! Bunu ancak benim kadar güçlü biri yapabilir.
The Hero of Gavel#091.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#092.src: All we must do now is cross a perilous bridge over the Endless Chasm.
The Hero of Gavel#092.dst: Şimdi tek yapmamız gereken Sonsuz Uçurum'un üzerindeki tehlikeli köprüden geçmek.
The Hero of Gavel#092.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#093.src: Aa, why did- Woah, careful! It looks like the bridge fell.
The Hero of Gavel#093.dst: Aa, niye- Dikkat! Köprü çökmüş galiba.
The Hero of Gavel#093.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#094.src: But this is not such an obstacle as you might think, for I can, uh, jump over this chasm!
The Hero of Gavel#094.dst: Ama bu sandığın kadar büyük bir engel değil, çünkü ben, ıı, bu uçurumun üstünden atlayabilirim!
The Hero of Gavel#094.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#099.src: Jump after Siegfried into the pit at the end of the cave.
The Hero of Gavel#099.dst: Mağaranın sonundaki çukura Siegfried'in peşinden atla.

The Hero of Gavel#100.src: Find a way to wake Siegfried.

The Hero of Gavel#102.src: Aaaaggggh my LEGS MY LEGS AAAGGH SO COLD!
The Hero of Gavel#102.dst: Aaaaggggh BACAKLARIM BACAKLARIM AAAGGH ÇOK SOĞUK!
The Hero of Gavel#102.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#104.src: Why couldn’t I THINK when I signed that STUPID CONTRACT that I’d end up here!?
The Hero of Gavel#104.dst: O APTAL SÖZLEŞMEYİ imzalarken neden buraya düşeceğimi DÜŞÜNEMEDİM ki!?
The Hero of Gavel#104.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#106.src: They aren’t gonna come rescue us, you know. We’re on our own.
The Hero of Gavel#106.dst: Bizi kurtarmaya gelmeyecekler, biliyorsun. Başımızın çaresine kendimiz bakacağız.
The Hero of Gavel#106.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#107.src: Why are you so calm? DON’T YOU SEE?!
The Hero of Gavel#107.dst: Nasıl bu kadar sakinsin? GÖRMÜYOR MUSUN?!
The Hero of Gavel#107.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#108.src: WE’RE ON OUR OWN! This is REAL now! No coming back after ‘dying’, no more obvious traps, no more Siegfried. If I die here, I DIE! No coming back!
The Hero of Gavel#108.dst: YAPAYALNIZIZ! Bu artık GERÇEK! 'Öldükten' sonra geri dönmek yok, göstermelik tuzaklar yok, Siegfried yok. Burada ölürsem ÖLÜRÜM! Dönüşü yok!
The Hero of Gavel#108.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#109.src: I.. I can’t do this. We’ll just starve here, in this cave… where nobody will ever find our bodies.
The Hero of Gavel#109.dst: Ben.. ben bunu yapamam. Burada, bu mağarada açlıktan öleceğiz… cesetlerimizi kimse bulamayacak.
The Hero of Gavel#109.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#110.src: Stop looking at me! You figure out how to get us out of here, I’m just a worthless actor! Tell me if you find anything, I- I need a moment alone.
The Hero of Gavel#110.dst: Bakma bana öyle! Buradan nasıl çıkacağımızı sen bul, ben değersiz bir aktörüm sadece! Bir şey bulursan söyle, ben- biraz yalnız kalmam lazım.
The Hero of Gavel#110.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#111.src: You found something? Ok. I’ll… follow you then.
The Hero of Gavel#111.dst: Bir şey mi buldun? Tamam. O zaman… seni takip ederim.
The Hero of Gavel#111.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#112.src: WHAT WAS THAT SOUND?! A- are you sure we should go into there?
The Hero of Gavel#112.dst: O SES DE NEYDİ?! G- gerçekten oraya girmeli miyiz?
The Hero of Gavel#112.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#113.src: MY ARM! IT HIT MY ARM!
The Hero of Gavel#113.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#114.src: … I think I can manage.. OW!
The Hero of Gavel#114.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#115.src: Venture deeper into the cave with Siegfried.

The Hero of Gavel#116.src: You.. You got us out of there!
The Hero of Gavel#116.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#117.src: I didn’t think we’d ever find a way out of there…
The Hero of Gavel#117.dst: Oradan bir çıkış bulabileceğimizi hiç sanmıyordum…
The Hero of Gavel#117.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#118.src: … Well, I guess we should keep going. M- Maybe there’s a way out?
The Hero of Gavel#118.dst: … Eh, sanırım devam etmeliyiz. B- Belki bir çıkış vardır?
The Hero of Gavel#118.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#119.src: L- Look! There’s plants and light up ahead! A WAY OUT!
The Hero of Gavel#119.dst: B- Bak! İleride bitkiler ve ışık var! BİR ÇIKIŞ!
The Hero of Gavel#119.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#122.src: Rescue Siegfried from the trap OR leave him there.
The Hero of Gavel#122.dst: Siegfried'i tuzaktan kurtar YA DA onu orada bırak.

The Hero of Gavel#123.src: W- What just happened?! I’m trapped in here!
The Hero of Gavel#123.dst: N- Ne oldu?! Burada mahsur kaldım!
The Hero of Gavel#123.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#124.src: … It’s… some sort of trap. I can feel the ground heating up!!
The Hero of Gavel#124.dst: … Bu… bir çeşit tuzak. Zeminin ısındığını hissediyorum!!
The Hero of Gavel#124.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#125.src: T-That was terrifying… Y-you saved my life. Thank you … I wasn’t prepared for real danger like this.
The Hero of Gavel#125.dst: Ç-Çok korkunçtu… H-hayatımı kurtardın. Teşekkür ederim … Böyle gerçek bir tehlikeye hazırlıklı değildim.
The Hero of Gavel#125.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#126.src: Rest before continuing through the cave.

The Hero of Gavel#127.src: …What? Houses, and a well? All the way down here?
The Hero of Gavel#127.dst: …Ne? Evler ve bir kuyu mu? Bu kadar aşağıda?
The Hero of Gavel#127.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#128.src: It’s… empty. And the houses sure don’t look like anyone’s lived here for.. centuries.
The Hero of Gavel#128.dst: Burası… boş. Evlere bakılırsa burada yüzyıllardır.. kimse yaşamamış.
The Hero of Gavel#128.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#129.src: OW! MY LEGS! And my arms, too! E- Everything hurts so much.. I need to sit down. I think I turned my arm the wrong way.
The Hero of Gavel#129.dst: AY! BACAKLARIM! Kollarım da! H- Her yerim çok acıyor.. Oturmam lazım. Sanırım kolumu ters çevirdim.
The Hero of Gavel#129.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#130.src: I’ll just.. rest here a bit. W- would you mind taking a look around for something we can eat? I can.. hardly move.
The Hero of Gavel#130.dst: Ben biraz.. burada dinleneyim. Y- yiyecek bir şeyler için etrafa bakar mısın? Ben.. kıpırdayamıyorum bile.
The Hero of Gavel#130.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#131.src: … Was this a sandwich at some point?
The Hero of Gavel#131.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#132.src: It barely has any resemblance to one.
The Hero of Gavel#132.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#133.src: Well… I doubt there’s anything better around here. I- I’ll take it.
The Hero of Gavel#133.dst: Eh… Buralarda daha iyisi yoktur herhalde. B- Bunu alayım.
The Hero of Gavel#133.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#134.src: OW!! I think I broke my teeth! This is like eating stone!
The Hero of Gavel#134.dst: AY!! Sanırım dişlerimi kırdım! Taş yemek gibi!
The Hero of Gavel#134.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#135.src: … I th-ow-ink I’m ready to- ow- move on. Let’s get go-oow-ing.
The Hero of Gavel#135.dst: … Sanı-ay-rım devam etmeye- ay- hazırım. Hadi gide-ayy-lim.
The Hero of Gavel#135.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#136.src: ... Is this the food you found?
The Hero of Gavel#136.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#137.src: I guess it's... the best that could be found here. You say you cooked it yourself?
The Hero of Gavel#137.dst: Herhalde... burada bulunabilecek en iyisi bu. Kendin mi pişirdin dedin?
The Hero of Gavel#137.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#138.src: I'll give it a try, then. Doubt there's anything better around here.
The Hero of Gavel#138.dst: O zaman bir deneyeyim. Buralarda daha iyisi yoktur zaten.
The Hero of Gavel#138.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#140.src: Thank you, {u}! I feel much better. I can head deeper as soon as you're ready.
The Hero of Gavel#140.dst: Teşekkürler, {u}! Çok daha iyi hissediyorum. Sen hazır olduğunda derinlere inebilirim.
The Hero of Gavel#140.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#142.src: I guess... I'll eat it, if it's the only food around.
The Hero of Gavel#142.dst: Herhalde... buralardaki tek yiyecek buysa yerim.
The Hero of Gavel#142.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#143.src: Let's see... How do i even eat these?
The Hero of Gavel#143.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#146.src: You know… my name is actually Gurix.
The Hero of Gavel#146.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#147.src: Sound extremely Corkian, I know. They made me use Siegfried because it sounds less foreign, I suppose.
The Hero of Gavel#147.dst: Çok Corkuslu duruyor, biliyorum. Daha az yabancı geldiği için Siegfried adını kullandırdılar herhalde.
The Hero of Gavel#147.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#149.src: OW! {u}, I think this web is poisoned! Quick, get me out with one of your spells!
The Hero of Gavel#149.dst: AY! {u}, bu ağ zehirli galiba! Çabuk, bir büyünle çıkar beni!
The Hero of Gavel#149.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#150.src: Thank you . I’ll.. I’ll follow you from now on. Clearly you’re more prepared than I am.
The Hero of Gavel#150.dst: Teşekkürler . Ben.. Bundan sonra seni takip edeceğim. Belli ki benden daha hazırlıklısın.
The Hero of Gavel#150.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#151.src: Find your way through the spider burrows.

The Hero of Gavel#152.src: {u}? I think that giant web there is being held up by the platforms on the walls.
The Hero of Gavel#152.dst: {u}? Sanırım şuradaki dev ağı duvarlardaki platformlar tutuyor.
The Hero of Gavel#152.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#153.src: I think… Maybe you can cut them down? I’ll stay here, I think it’s the safest place. I’ll call for you if a spider webs me again.
The Hero of Gavel#153.dst: Bence… Belki onları kesebilirsin? Ben burada kalayım, en güvenli yer burası galiba. Bir örümcek beni yine ağa sararsa seslenirim.
The Hero of Gavel#153.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#154.src: You did it! The web fell!
The Hero of Gavel#154.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#155.src: Let’s head onwards, I don’t want to deal with any more spiders.
The Hero of Gavel#155.dst: Hadi ilerleyelim, daha fazla örümcekle uğraşmak istemiyorum.
The Hero of Gavel#155.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#157.src: Hey, wait up! Thanks for saving me there.
The Hero of Gavel#157.dst: Hey, bekle! Orada beni kurtardığın için sağ ol.
The Hero of Gavel#157.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#158.src: Woah... This is enormous! Who knows what this used to be?
The Hero of Gavel#158.dst: Vay... Burası devasa! Eskiden ne olduğunu kim bilir?
The Hero of Gavel#158.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#159.src: The path seems to be across those yellow shards, maybe we can reach them?
The Hero of Gavel#159.dst: Yol şu sarı kristallerin karşısında gibi, onlara ulaşabilir miyiz?
The Hero of Gavel#159.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#160.src: Find a way to escape through the skylight at the end of the cave.
The Hero of Gavel#160.dst: Mağaranın sonundaki tavan penceresinden kaçmanın bir yolunu bul.

The Hero of Gavel#161.src: Another town? Or another part of the same one? I’m not sure..
The Hero of Gavel#161.dst: Başka bir kasaba mı? Yoksa aynısının başka bir kısmı mı? Emin değilim..
The Hero of Gavel#161.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#162.src: This one even seems to have a forge and a tailor.. It was a full, proper village!
The Hero of Gavel#162.dst: Burada demirhane ve terzi bile var gibi.. Tam teşekküllü bir köymüş!
The Hero of Gavel#162.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#164.src: {u}, look! I can see the sky from here! M- maybe there’s a way to get up!
The Hero of Gavel#164.dst: {u}, bak! Buradan gökyüzünü görebiliyorum! B- belki yukarı çıkmanın bir yolu vardır!
The Hero of Gavel#164.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#165.src: I think.. what if we can this geyser somehow? It looks dormant, but I feel like we can activate it again.
The Hero of Gavel#165.dst: Bence.. ya şu gayzeri bir şekilde kullanabilirsek? Uykuda gibi duruyor ama yeniden çalıştırabiliriz gibi geliyor.
The Hero of Gavel#165.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#166.src: You take a look around, I’ll be resting a little. I don’t think I’ve ever walked this much in my life…
The Hero of Gavel#166.dst: Sen etrafa bir bak, ben biraz dinleneceğim. Hayatımda hiç bu kadar yürüdüğümü sanmıyorum…
The Hero of Gavel#166.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#168.src: W-Wait.. that’ll be quite a long fall after we get launched up. Can you try making some safety equipment, like a parachute or some really soft boots?
The Hero of Gavel#168.dst: B-Bekle.. yukarı fırlatıldıktan sonra epey uzun bir düşüş olacak. Paraşüt ya da çok yumuşak botlar gibi bir güvenlik donanımı yapmayı deneyebilir misin?
The Hero of Gavel#168.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#169.src: You’ve already made something? Let me see.
The Hero of Gavel#169.dst: Bir şey yaptın bile mi? Göster bakayım.
The Hero of Gavel#169.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#170.src: This looks… usable? It’s something, at least.
The Hero of Gavel#170.dst: Bu… kullanılabilir gibi mi? En azından bir şey.
The Hero of Gavel#170.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#171.src: Probably the best we’ll get down here. Are you sure you don’t need anything for yourself? No? Okay.
The Hero of Gavel#171.dst: Herhalde burada elde edebileceğimizin en iyisi bu. Kendin için bir şeye ihtiyacın olmadığından emin misin? Yok mu? Peki.
The Hero of Gavel#171.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#172.src: I can’t wait to see the look on their faces when we get back. We’ve just saved the legacy of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#172.dst: Döndüğümüzde suratlarındaki ifadeyi görmek için sabırsızlanıyorum. Siegfried'in mirasını kurtardık!
The Hero of Gavel#172.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#176.src: W-we made it? …, WE DID IT! WE’RE BACK! HAHAAA! I’M ALIVE!
The Hero of Gavel#176.dst: B-başardık mı? …, BAŞARDIK! GERİ DÖNDÜK! HAHAAA! YAŞIYORUM!
The Hero of Gavel#176.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#177.src: Hello there! It is I, Siegfried, and I just stopped the threat that was this cave!
The Hero of Gavel#177.dst: Merhaba! Benim, Siegfried, ve bu mağaranın tehdidini az önce durdurdum!
The Hero of Gavel#177.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#178.src: Hah, that’s a great costume you have there! Looks just like me!
The Hero of Gavel#178.dst: Hah, harika bir kostümün var! Tıpkı bana benziyor!
The Hero of Gavel#178.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#179.dst: Ne? B- Benim yerime başkasını mı KOYDULAR?
The Hero of Gavel#179.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#180.src: Hah, don’t mind the jokester over there. He does have an impressive costume though!
The Hero of Gavel#180.dst: Hah, şuradaki şakacıya aldırma. Gerçi kostümü etkileyici!
The Hero of Gavel#180.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#181.src: W-what's going on here? You can't replace me!
The Hero of Gavel#181.dst: N-neler oluyor burada? Benim yerime başkasını koyamazsınız!
The Hero of Gavel#181.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#183.src: Look over there! Those must be fireworks to celebrate my victory!
The Hero of Gavel#183.dst: Şuraya bakın! Bunlar zaferimi kutlamak için atılan havai fişekler olmalı!
The Hero of Gavel#183.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#185.src: Well, anyways! You had a really bad fall in that cave there. I carried you out myself, you must’ve had some wild hallucinations.
The Hero of Gavel#185.dst: Neyse işte! O mağarada çok kötü düştün. Seni oradan bizzat ben taşıdım, epey tuhaf halüsinasyonlar görmüş olmalısın.
The Hero of Gavel#185.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#186.src: Even though it was your own mistake, I’ll return you the emeralds you spent on the scavenger hunt.. and some more as compensation. That'll be.. [{~} Liquified Emeralds]!
The Hero of Gavel#186.dst: Kendi hatan olsa da hazine avına harcadığın zümrütleri.. bir de tazminat olarak biraz daha fazlasını sana geri vereceğim. Ediyor.. [{~} Sıvı Zümrüt]!
The Hero of Gavel#186.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#187.src: I must return to {p} for the celebration now. Perhaps we will meet again at the next scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#187.dst: Şimdi kutlama için {p} şehrine dönmeliyim. Belki bir sonraki hazine avında yine karşılaşırız!
The Hero of Gavel#187.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#188.src: Hello there, human! It is I, Siegfried! You must have just missed how I expertly ended the threat of this monster-ridden cave!
The Hero of Gavel#188.dst: Merhaba, insan! Benim, Siegfried! Canavar dolu bu mağaranın tehdidine nasıl ustalıkla son verdiğimi az farkla kaçırdın!
The Hero of Gavel#188.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#191.src: {u}, I'm glad to see you managed to get out alive. That must have been quite a fall into the chasm.
The Hero of Gavel#191.dst: {u}, sağ salim çıkabildiğine sevindim. Uçuruma düşmek epey sert olmuş olmalı.
The Hero of Gavel#191.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#192.src: Of course, I got out easily using my spells and great knowledge of caves! Well, I must be off now. Maybe we may meet again if you win the next scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#192.dst: Ben tabii büyülerim ve mağaralar hakkındaki engin bilgim sayesinde kolayca çıktım! Eh, artık gitmeliyim. Belki bir sonraki hazine avını kazanırsan yine karşılaşırız!
The Hero of Gavel#192.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#193.src: As compensation for your unfortunate accident, Siegfried will return you the emeralds spent on purchasing scavenger hunt items.
The Hero of Gavel#193.dst: Talihsiz kazanın için tazminat olarak Siegfried, hazine avı eşyalarına harcadığın zümrütleri sana geri verecek.

The Hero of Gavel#194.src: That should amount to... {~} Liquid Emeralds. We apologize for the difficulties you encountered during your adventure with Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#194.dst: Bu da... {~} Sıvı Zümrüt ediyor. Siegfried'le maceran sırasında yaşadığın zorluklar için özür dileriz!

The Hidden City#001.src: A Human! Agh! Don't worry about getting me medical attention, I've got this under control...
The Hidden City#001.dst: Bir İnsan! Ah! Bana tıbbi yardım bulmak için endişelenme, durum kontrolüm altında...
The Hidden City#001.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#002.src: It's a broken leg. I'm already getting it treated, but I have a job to do elsewise- and a time sensitive one, too.
The Hidden City#002.dst: Bacağım kırık. Tedavi ettiriyorum zaten, ama başka bir yerde yapmam gereken bir iş var, üstelik zamanı da kısıtlı.
The Hidden City#002.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#003.src: I won't be able to do it like this, but it doesn't matter if I'm the one who carries it out. It just needs to be done.
The Hidden City#003.dst: Bu hâlde yapamam, ama işi benim yapmam şart değil. Yeter ki yapılsın.
The Hidden City#003.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#004.src: I don't work for villagers, I was hired to come here by other humans... there's something you must keep secret.
The Hidden City#004.dst: Köylüler için çalışmıyorum, beni buraya başka insanlar tuttu... gizli tutman gereken bir şey var.
The Hidden City#004.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#005.src: Swear it! If you're going to take the job, and my payment for it, you must be silent about it!
The Hidden City#005.dst: Yemin et! İşi ve karşılığında vereceğim ücreti alacaksan, ağzını sıkı tutmalısın!
The Hidden City#005.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#008.src: There is a hidden town in the canyon here. Up in the mountains- it was built and run by humans.
The Hidden City#008.dst: Buradaki kanyonda gizli bir kasaba var. Dağlarda- insanlar kurmuş ve insanlar yönetiyor.
The Hidden City#008.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#009.src: Now, the villagers have very strict rules about humans living in their lands, and it's VERY illegal.
The Hidden City#009.dst: Köylülerin, topraklarında yaşayan insanlarla ilgili çok katı kuralları var ve bu ÇOK yasa dışı.
The Hidden City#009.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#010.src: I was contacted by the Mayor because he is aware that the town may have become... compromised.
The Hidden City#010.dst: Benimle Belediye Başkanı iletişime geçti, çünkü kasabanın... ifşa olmuş olabileceğini biliyor.
The Hidden City#010.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#011.src: The job is to figure out who and why, of course. To let this slip could collapse the treatise between our races.
The Hidden City#011.dst: İş de tabii ki bunu kimin ve neden yaptığını bulmak. Bu meselenin sızması ırklarımız arasındaki antlaşmayı çökertebilir.
The Hidden City#011.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#012.src: I've never been to the city in the mountains, but I was given instructions. Here, I'll write down the location in your book.
The Hidden City#012.dst: Dağlardaki şehre hiç gitmedim ama bana talimat verildi. Dur, konumu kitabına yazayım.
The Hidden City#012.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#013.src: Be aware though, they won't let you in unless the area is safe. They can't risk villagers wandering in.
The Hidden City#013.dst: Ama dikkat et, bölge güvenli olmadıkça seni içeri almazlar. Köylülerin içeri girmesi riskini göze alamazlar.
The Hidden City#013.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#015.src: Head to [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find the human town.
The Hidden City#015.dst: İnsan kasabasını bulmak için [{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumuna git.

The Hidden City#016.src: Hm? Oh, a fellow adventurer, I see! I'm sorry, but this discovery is mine to make. There's something strange about that door...
The Hidden City#016.dst: Hm? Ah, bir maceracı dostu, anlıyorum! Kusura bakma ama bu keşif benim olacak. O kapıda tuhaf bir şey var...
The Hidden City#016.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#017.src: Deadly gasses? Nonsense! As you can see the two of us are breathing just fine.
The Hidden City#017.dst: Ölümcül gazlar mı? Saçmalık! Gördüğün gibi ikimiz de gayet rahat nefes alıyoruz.
The Hidden City#017.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#018.src: You want me to leave? Why, so that you can have all of the glory for yourself? Ha, not a chance!
The Hidden City#018.dst: Gitmemi mi istiyorsun? Neden, bütün şan şöhret sana kalsın diye mi? Ha, hayatta olmaz!
The Hidden City#018.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#019.src: The only way I'm leaving is if I can get that door open or if the whole cave starts crashing down on us.
The Hidden City#019.dst: Buradan ancak o kapıyı açabilirsem ya da bütün mağara tepemize çökmeye başlarsa giderim.
The Hidden City#019.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#021.src: Gweh! I just had to go running my mouth about the cave collapsing! I'm out- if you have any sense you'll leave too!
The Hidden City#021.dst: Gıh! Mağaranın çökmesi hakkında çenemi tutamadım tabii! Ben gidiyorum, aklın varsa sen de gidersin!
The Hidden City#021.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#022.src: Go up to the door and inspect the noise.

The Hidden City#024.src: Thank you for getting rid of that curious villager! We thought he'd never leave.
The Hidden City#024.dst: O meraklı köylüden kurtulduğun için teşekkürler! Hiç gitmeyecek sandık.
The Hidden City#024.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#025.src: I've never seen you before. Who gave you access to the town?
The Hidden City#025.dst: Seni daha önce hiç görmedim. Kasabaya girme iznini sana kim verdi?
The Hidden City#025.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#026.src: You're here in place of the detective the mayor hired?
The Hidden City#026.dst: Belediye başkanının tuttuğu dedektifin yerine mi geldin?
The Hidden City#026.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#027.src: Normally, I wouldn't believe that, but come in. We're desperate.
The Hidden City#027.dst: Normalde buna inanmazdım, ama gel içeri. Çaresiz durumdayız.
The Hidden City#027.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#028.src: If you ever need to leave and get back, I can simply open the way.
The Hidden City#028.dst: Çıkıp geri gelmen gerekirse yolu açarım.
The Hidden City#028.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#029.src: You probably should be going now. Our mayor can get impatient.
The Hidden City#029.dst: Artık gitsen iyi olur. Başkanımız sabırsızlanabilir.
The Hidden City#029.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#030.src: Talk to Mayor Eoric in the town hall.
The Hidden City#030.dst: Belediye binasında Belediye Başkanı Eoric ile konuş.

The Hidden City#031.src: What are you doing here? I'm writing an important letter, this better be worth my time.
The Hidden City#031.dst: Ne işin var burada? Önemli bir mektup yazıyorum, değse iyi olur.
The Hidden City#031.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#032.src: What? Narder sent you? Why'd he send a {p} soldier?
The Hidden City#032.dst: Ne? Seni Narder mı gönderdi? Neden bir {p} askeri göndermiş?
The Hidden City#032.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#033.src: I didn't think the army were authorized to know about {p}, especially Fruma recruits.
The Hidden City#033.dst: Ordunun {p} hakkında bilgi sahibi olmaya yetkisi olduğunu sanmıyordum, hele Fruma'lı acemilerin.
The Hidden City#033.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#034.src: Anyway, {p}'s secrecy is in great danger. We have found evidence of the traitor.
The Hidden City#034.dst: Neyse, {p} kasabasının gizliliği büyük tehlikede. Hainin izlerini bulduk.
The Hidden City#034.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#035.src: We have locked down all of the exits. No one leaves or enters without my permission.
The Hidden City#035.dst: Bütün çıkışları kapattık. Benim iznim olmadan kimse giremez, çıkamaz.
The Hidden City#035.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#036.src: We need a detective to sniff out the traitor and expose him.
The Hidden City#036.dst: Haini kokusundan bulup ortaya çıkaracak bir dedektife ihtiyacımız var.
The Hidden City#036.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#037.src: Start by asking the citizens around here about anything suspicious they've seen.
The Hidden City#037.dst: İşe buradaki halka gördükleri şüpheli şeyleri sorarak başla.
The Hidden City#037.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#038.src: When you find the culprit, remember to leave him alive! The guards will take care of him.
The Hidden City#038.dst: Suçluyu bulduğunda sakın öldürme! Muhafızlar onun icabına bakar.
The Hidden City#038.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#040.src: Sorry, detective, but I haven't seen anything suspicious. In fact, I haven't even left my house for the last week.
The Hidden City#040.dst: Kusura bakma dedektif, şüpheli bir şey görmedim. Hatta geçen haftadan beri evden bile çıkmadım.
The Hidden City#040.speaker: Reder

The Hidden City#041.src: The only suspicious thing I've seen is a hooded man walking around. There's not many people in {p} so it's weird.
The Hidden City#041.dst: Gördüğüm tek şüpheli şey ortalıkta dolaşan kapüşonlu bir adam. {p} kasabasında pek insan yok, o yüzden tuhaf.
The Hidden City#041.speaker: Nichye

The Hidden City#042.src: If you want to find out anything, the best person to ask is Lumilda. She's in her bakery, next to the Scroll Shop.
The Hidden City#042.dst: Bir şey öğrenmek istiyorsan en iyisi Lumilda'ya sormak. Parşömen Dükkânı'nın yanındaki fırınında.
The Hidden City#042.speaker: Sybeth

The Hidden City#043.src: Ah, detective! What brings you to the sweet Lumilda's Bakery?
The Hidden City#043.dst: Ah, dedektif! Seni tatlı mı tatlı Lumilda'nın Fırını'na hangi rüzgâr attı?
The Hidden City#043.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#044.src: Hm, yes, there is a weird person coming through.
The Hidden City#044.dst: Hm, evet, buradan tuhaf biri geçip duruyor.
The Hidden City#044.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#045.src: It's a hooded man. Never seen the face. A trouble maker, if you ask me!
The Hidden City#045.dst: Kapüşonlu bir adam. Yüzünü hiç görmedim. Bana sorarsan, bela arıyor!
The Hidden City#045.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#046.src: He's been here a few times, usually writing things on a piece of paper. That man's a real mystery. No one even knows where he lives.
The Hidden City#046.dst: Birkaç kez geldi, genelde bir kâğıda bir şeyler yazıyordu. O adam tam bir muamma. Nerede yaşadığını bile kimse bilmiyor.
The Hidden City#046.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#047.src: One time my grandson couldn't resist and followed the man. Last thing he saw was the man leaving through the Eastern Exit.
The Hidden City#047.dst: Bir keresinde torunum dayanamayıp adamı takip etti. En son adamın Doğu Çıkışı'ndan çıktığını görmüş.
The Hidden City#047.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#048.src: Ain't that a place to start, sweetheart?
The Hidden City#048.dst: Başlamak için iyi bir yer değil mi, tatlım?
The Hidden City#048.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#049.src: Inspect anything beyond the Eastern Exit.
The Hidden City#049.dst: Doğu Çıkışı'nın ötesindeki her şeyi incele.

The Hidden City#051.src: Ah. You must be the detective then. None of those half witted Eltomites would figure it out.
The Hidden City#051.dst: Ah. Demek dedektif sensin. O kalın kafalı Eltomlulardan hiçbiri bunu çözemezdi.

The Hidden City#052.src: I guess the Grook is out of the pen then.

The Hidden City#053.src: This town shouldn’t even be here. Humans aren't allowed to settle in Gavel.
The Hidden City#053.dst: Bu kasaba burada olmamalı bile. İnsanların Gavel'a yerleşmesi yasak.

The Hidden City#054.src: These Humans couldn’t be bothered to fight their own war, so they hid an entire city here.
The Hidden City#054.dst: Bu İnsanlar kendi savaşlarını vermeye üşenip koca bir şehri buraya sakladılar.

The Hidden City#055.src: Traitor? I’m no traitor. I'm just looking to carry out the law where it needs to be carried out. Nothing personal, yes?
The Hidden City#055.dst: Hain mi? Ben hain değilim. Yalnızca yasanın uygulanması gereken yerde uygulanmasını istiyorum. Kişisel bir şey yok, değil mi?

The Hidden City#056.src: Maybe they'll actually use "Ardulf" instead of saying "freak" once they've seen the good I can do for them!
The Hidden City#056.dst: Onlar için yapabileceğim iyiliği görünce belki bana "ucube" yerine sonunda "Ardulf" derler!
The Hidden City#056.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#057.src: Read the note on the table.

The Hidden City#063.src: Requested to use a ship... I refused...
The Hidden City#063.speaker: Hilan

The Hidden City#064.src: He beat me up... And left...
The Hidden City#064.speaker: Hilan

The Hidden City#066.src: Head up to the Airbase's Tower to confront the hooded man.
The Hidden City#066.dst: Kapüşonlu adamla yüzleşmek için Hava Üssü'nün Kulesi'ne çık.

The Hidden City#068.src: What are you doing here? Why are you protecting this illegal town?
The Hidden City#068.dst: Ne işin var burada? Bu yasa dışı kasabayı neden koruyorsun?
The Hidden City#068.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#069.src: The Villagers will not be happy about {p}. This could seriously harm the Gavel-Wynn relationship.
The Hidden City#069.dst: Köylüler {p} meselesinden hiç hoşlanmayacak. Bu, Gavel-Wynn ilişkilerine ciddi zarar verebilir.
The Hidden City#069.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#070.src: You can't stop me. You wouldn't murder one of your own, would you?
The Hidden City#070.dst: Beni durduramazsın. Kendi soyundan birini öldürmezsin, değil mi?
The Hidden City#070.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#071.src: I will tell the mayor of {p} all about this place, and claim my reward for doing so. I will be rich and if you want to stop me you will have to do it yourself!
The Hidden City#071.dst: {p} belediye başkanına bu yeri baştan sona anlatacağım ve ödülümü alacağım. Zengin olacağım, beni durdurmak istiyorsan bunu kendin yapman gerekecek!
The Hidden City#071.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#072.src: Escape your cell and find a way to sabotage the ship.
The Hidden City#072.dst: Hücrenden kaç ve gemiyi sabote etmenin bir yolunu bul.

The Hidden City#074.src: Talk to {p}'s Mayor at the top of {p}.
The Hidden City#074.dst: {p} kasabasının tepesindeki {p} Belediye Başkanı ile konuş.

The House of Twain (Quest)#000.src: Talk to Twendle at The {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The House of Twain (Quest)#001.src: Oh, hey you there! Are you heading down this road? You know it's a dead end, right?
The House of Twain (Quest)#001.dst: Oo, hey sen! Bu yoldan mı gidiyorsun? Çıkmaz sokak olduğunu biliyorsun, değil mi?
The House of Twain (Quest)#001.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#002.src: It leads to an old mansion, that has fallen into decay.
The House of Twain (Quest)#002.dst: Çürümeye yüz tutmuş eski bir malikâneye çıkıyor.
The House of Twain (Quest)#002.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#003.src: That mansion is the house of my ancestor; Dwendle Twain. It was a house of incredible heritage and magical powers, Dwendle himself was adopted into it.
The House of Twain (Quest)#003.dst: O malikâne atam Dwendle Twain'in evi. İnanılmaz bir mirası ve büyülü güçleri olan bir haneydi, Dwendle da oraya evlat edinilmişti.
The House of Twain (Quest)#003.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#004.src: Marius Twain was the leader of the mansion; they fought against evil spirits, I think. The history of the house is not well-known, outside of a novel.
The House of Twain (Quest)#004.dst: Malikânenin reisi Marius Twain'di; sanırım kötü ruhlara karşı savaşıyorlardı. Bir roman dışında hanenin tarihi pek bilinmez.
The House of Twain (Quest)#004.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#005.src: I want to know the history of the mansion and uncover its secrets, but every time I get close, dark beings prevent me from entering.
The House of Twain (Quest)#005.dst: Malikânenin tarihini öğrenip sırlarını çözmek istiyorum, ama ne zaman yaklaşsam karanlık varlıklar içeri girmemi engelliyor.
The House of Twain (Quest)#005.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#006.src: I am no soldier, and I don't think I will ever uncover the truth without your help. I can greatly reward you for your help.
The House of Twain (Quest)#006.dst: Ben asker değilim ve senin yardımın olmadan gerçeği asla ortaya çıkaramam sanırım. Yardımın için seni cömertçe ödüllendirebilirim.
The House of Twain (Quest)#006.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#007.src: My ancestor left our family a large amount of emeralds. Beware though, traveller, the mansion's secrets are incredibly difficult to uncover and the monsters are powerful.
The House of Twain (Quest)#007.dst: Atam ailemize bolca zümrüt bıraktı. Ama dikkat et yolcu, malikânenin sırlarını çözmek inanılmaz zor ve canavarları da güçlü.
The House of Twain (Quest)#007.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#008.src: Unravel the secrets of the mansion and help me uncover the secrets of my heritage. Bring me [{~} Twain Journal].
The House of Twain (Quest)#008.dst: Malikânenin sırlarını çöz ve soyumun sırlarını ortaya çıkarmama yardım et. Bana [{~} Twain Journal] getir.
The House of Twain (Quest)#008.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#009.src: This book has been hidden within the depths of the mansion and is protected by far more than puzzles or walls.
The House of Twain (Quest)#009.dst: Bu kitap malikânenin derinliklerine saklanmış ve onu bulmacalardan ya da duvarlardan çok daha fazlası koruyor.
The House of Twain (Quest)#009.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#010.src: I believe the spirits that now haunt the mansion will do anything to protect the book. I'm sure they think it's their own, and the secrets it hides.
The House of Twain (Quest)#010.dst: Bence şimdi malikâneye musallat olan ruhlar kitabı korumak için her şeyi yapar. Eminim kitabı da, sakladığı sırları da kendilerinin sanıyorlar.
The House of Twain (Quest)#010.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#012.src: If you already have a Ghostly Cap, you can wear that one and do not have to do any previous steps in order for the quest to work.
The House of Twain (Quest)#012.dst: Zaten bir Ghostly Cap'in varsa onu takabilirsin, görevin işlemesi için önceki adımların hiçbirini yapman gerekmez.
The House of Twain (Quest)#012.speaker: Note

The House of Twain (Quest)#013.src: I guess I put my faith in the right person. My history lies within these pages, and I don't intend to keep them secret. I shall make them public.
The House of Twain (Quest)#013.dst: Demek güvenimi doğru kişiye vermişim. Tarihim bu sayfalarda saklı ve bunları gizli tutmaya niyetim yok. Herkese açıklayacağım.
The House of Twain (Quest)#013.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#014.src: Thank you traveller. As promised, here is your reward.
The House of Twain (Quest)#014.dst: Teşekkürler yolcu. Söz verdiğim gibi, işte ödülün.
The House of Twain (Quest)#014.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#015.src: I know uncovering the truth is never easy, but keep trying, please bring me [{~} Twain Journal].
The House of Twain (Quest)#015.dst: Gerçeği ortaya çıkarmanın hiç kolay olmadığını biliyorum ama denemeye devam et, lütfen bana [{~} Twain Journal] getir.

The Lost#001.src: Ho, traveler! I need the help of a true explorer, I can see it in your eyes, you are an adventurer like me!
The Lost#001.dst: Hey, yolcu! Gerçek bir kâşifin yardımına ihtiyacım var, gözlerinden okunuyor, sen de benim gibi bir maceracısın!
The Lost#001.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#002.src: While you are here, adventurer, I could use your help with something. I have gotten myself into a small predicament in my travels.
The Lost#002.dst: Madem buradasın maceracı, bir konuda yardımına ihtiyacım var. Yolculuğumda ufak bir çıkmaza girdim.
The Lost#002.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#003.src: You see, me and three others were on a grand expedition to explore the entire canyon! Unfortunately, we ran into a slight problem...
The Lost#003.dst: Bak, ben ve üç kişi daha bütün kanyonu keşfetmek için büyük bir keşif gezisindeydik! Ne yazık ki ufak bir sorunla karşılaştık...
The Lost#003.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#004.src: The {p} is clearly called that for a reason, within hours, we had lost each other!
The Lost#004.dst: {p} adını boşuna almamış, birkaç saat içinde birbirimizi kaybettik!
The Lost#004.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#005.src: Luckily, we were prepared for it. We each carried a flag so if we ever got lost, we can raise it to be found.
The Lost#005.dst: Neyse ki buna hazırlıklıydık. Her birimiz bir bayrak taşıyorduk, kaybolursak bulunmak için onu dikecektik.
The Lost#005.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#006.src: They were all meant to come to my blue flag, but they must all be trapped in some predicament! The canyon can be a dangerous place.
The Lost#006.dst: Hepsinin benim mavi bayrağıma gelmesi gerekiyordu, ama hepsi bir çıkmaza sıkışmış olmalı! Kanyon tehlikeli bir yer olabiliyor.
The Lost#006.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#007.src: I can see all three red flags from here, but it would be terrible if I went looking and they came back to this flag to find me gone!
The Lost#007.dst: Üç kırmızı bayrağı da buradan görebiliyorum, ama ben aramaya çıksam da onlar bu bayrağa döndüğünde beni bulamasalar çok kötü olur!
The Lost#007.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#008.src: Do you think you could go and check if they're all alright? I'm sure I can find some reward for you if you help!
The Lost#008.dst: Gidip hepsinin iyi olup olmadığına bakabilir misin? Yardım edersen sana bir ödül bulurum, eminim!
The Lost#008.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#009.src: Find the three lost crew members at the red flags around [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Lost#009.dst: Kayıp üç ekip üyesini [{~}, {~}, -{~}] civarındaki kırmızı bayraklarda bul

The Lost#011.src: HUMAN! YOU, DOWN THERE! HELP ME! I was just trying to find my way back to my friends...
The Lost#011.dst: İNSAN! SEN, AŞAĞIDAKİ! YARDIM ET! Ben sadece arkadaşlarıma dönmenin yolunu arıyordum...
The Lost#011.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#012.src: When this GIANT BIRD KIDNAPPED ME and threw me in her nest! I think she thinks I'm one of her chicks!
The Lost#012.dst: Derken bu DEV KUŞ BENİ KAÇIRIP yuvasına attı! Sanırım beni yavrularından biri sanıyor!
The Lost#012.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#013.src: The Canyon's movements must've dislodged her eggs from her nest-
The Lost#013.dst: Kanyonun hareketleri yumurtalarını yuvasından düşürmüş olmalı-
The Lost#013.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#014.src: O-OH GROOK, SHE'S PECKING ME! FIND HER EGGS NEARBY AND THROW THEM UP HERE... QUICKLY!!
The Lost#014.dst: A-AMAN GROOK, BENİ GAGALIYOR! YAKINLARDA YUMURTALARINI BUL VE BURAYA AT... ÇABUK!!
The Lost#014.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#015.src: YOU HAVE THE EGGS?? GOOD! THROW THEM UP HERE, PLEASE!!!
The Lost#015.dst: YUMURTALAR SENDE Mİ?? GÜZEL! BURAYA AT ŞUNLARI, LÜTFEN!!!
The Lost#015.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#016.src: W-WOAH, STAY BACK, BIRD! I have a... uhh... I DON'T HAVE A WEAPON, HUMAN! PLEASE HURRY UP!
The Lost#016.dst: D-DUR, YAKLAŞMA KUŞ! Bende bir... ıı... SİLAHIM YOK, İNSAN! LÜTFEN ACELE ET!
The Lost#016.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#017.src: YES YES YES!!! THANK YOU, HUMAN! Oh, thank grook, this bird's leaving me alone now... It worked!
The Lost#017.dst: EVET EVET EVET!!! TEŞEKKÜRLER, İNSAN! Ah, grook'a şükür, kuş artık beni rahat bırakıyor... İşe yaradı!
The Lost#017.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#018.src: I'll head back to Dejol, now... And I'm never going to go near another bird again!
The Lost#018.dst: Ben artık Dejol'ün yanına dönüyorum... Ve bir daha hiçbir kuşun yanına yaklaşmayacağım!
The Lost#018.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#019.src: A-ah, hello. I'm g-guessing Dejol sent you?
The Lost#019.dst: A-ah, merhaba. S-seni Dejol mü gönderdi?
The Lost#019.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#020.src: W-Well, I was just walking through the c-canyon, when... the ground suddenly rose up underneath me and launched me all the way up here!
The Lost#020.dst: Ş-Şey, k-kanyonda yürüyordum ki... zemin aniden altımda yükselip beni ta buraya fırlattı!
The Lost#020.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#021.src: N-Now, I'm... embarrassed to admit it, but I'm REALLY afraid of heights, s-so I don't know what to do... Do you have any ideas?
The Lost#021.dst: Ş-Şimdi... söylemesi utanç verici ama yükseklikten ÇOK korkuyorum, o y-yüzden ne yapacağımı bilmiyorum... Bir fikrin var mı?
The Lost#021.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#023.src: Y-YOU JERK!! I COULD HAVE DIED!! WHAT THE HELL IS WRONG WITH YOU???
The Lost#023.dst: S-SENİ PİSLİK!! ÖLEBİLİRDİM!! SENİN DERDİN NE BE???
The Lost#023.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#024.src: P-Please NEVER do that again! That was the worst thing I have ever done in my entire life!!
The Lost#024.dst: L-Lütfen bunu bir daha ASLA yapma! Hayatım boyunca başıma gelen en kötü şeydi!!
The Lost#024.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#025.src: ...Ugh! I-I'm going to head back to Dejol now. I hope I NEVER have to see you again!
The Lost#025.dst: ...Ah! B-Ben artık Dejol'ün yanına dönüyorum. Umarım seni bir daha ASLA görmem!
The Lost#025.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#026.src: Hey there! I'm in a bit of a pickle right now, you see. This house I took refuge in, well... The original owner must have left for a reason!
The Lost#026.dst: Selam! Şu an biraz zor durumdayım, anlarsın ya. Sığındığım bu ev, şey... İlk sahibi boşuna gitmemiş galiba!
The Lost#026.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#027.src: It's so sad... So many people are constantly displaced by the canyon's movements destroying their homes every year. I remember hearing a story once, it was about-
The Lost#027.dst: Çok üzücü... Kanyonun hareketleri her yıl evlerini yıktığı için bir sürü insan sürekli yerinden ediliyor. Bir keresinde bir hikâye duymuştum, şey hakkındaydı-
The Lost#027.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#028.src: Wait... Hey, do you hear that?
The Lost#028.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#029.src: Hey! You alright down there?! Oh, lord, how are we going to get out of this? I'm up here, come find me.
The Lost#029.dst: Hey! Aşağıda iyi misin?! Aman tanrım, buradan nasıl çıkacağız? Ben yukarıdayım, gel bul beni.
The Lost#029.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#030.src: Oh... Well, this isn't good! The house just went and collapsed on us!
The Lost#030.dst: Ah... Eh, hiç iyi değil bu! Ev resmen üstümüze çöktü!
The Lost#030.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#031.src: See what I was talking about, human? The canyon isn't really a good place to be. Now we're stuck in this pit!
The Lost#031.dst: Neden bahsettiğimi gördün mü, insan? Kanyon hiç de iyi bir yer değil. Şimdi de bu çukurda mahsur kaldık!
The Lost#031.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#032.src: Although... there is a crafting table over there... Hey, maybe you could collect some supplies and make something to get us out of here?
The Lost#032.dst: Gerçi... şurada bir çalışma masası var... Hey, belki biraz malzeme toplayıp bizi buradan çıkaracak bir şey yapabilirsin?
The Lost#032.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#033.src: Heh, that's certainly one way to get out here! You made an entire catapult, huh?
The Lost#033.dst: Heh, buradan çıkmanın bir yolu bu da tabii! Koca bir mancınık yaptın demek, ha?
The Lost#033.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#035.src: Alrighty, I'll be right behind you!
The Lost#035.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#036.src: Me first? Okay, I'll do just that!
The Lost#036.dst: Önce ben mi? Tamam, öyle yapayım!
The Lost#036.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#038.src: Hey, I made it!! You should come up as well, now.
The Lost#038.dst: Hey, başardım!! Şimdi sen de yukarı gel.
The Lost#038.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#039.src: Woah... That's certainly a lot of fun! Anyways, come talk to me.
The Lost#039.dst: Vay... Gerçekten çok eğlenceliymiş! Neyse, gel konuşalım.
The Lost#039.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#040.src: Thanks for the help, friend! I couldn't have done it without you!
The Lost#040.dst: Yardımın için sağ ol dostum! Sensiz başaramazdım!
The Lost#040.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#041.src: I'm gonna go find my friend Dejol now- wait, you know who he is??
The Lost#041.dst: Ben şimdi arkadaşım Dejol'ü bulmaya gidiyorum- dur, onu tanıyor musun??
The Lost#041.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#042.src: Oh... Wow, guess it's a small world, huh? That's funny! I'll see you down there later, then!
The Lost#042.dst: Ah... Vay, dünya küçükmüş, ha? Ne komik! O zaman aşağıda görüşürüz!
The Lost#042.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#043.src: Return to Dejol at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to tell him of your success
The Lost#043.dst: Başarını anlatmak için Dejol'ün yanına dön: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Lost#044.src: Ho, adventurer! Looks like you had some adventures helping out my crew!
The Lost#044.dst: Hey, maceracı! Ekibime yardım ederken epey macera yaşamışsın gibi görünüyor!
The Lost#044.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#045.src: Thank goodness they all found their way back unharmed. Mostly. Yuge's pride seems to have taken a hit.
The Lost#045.dst: Çok şükür hepsi yollarını bulup sağ salim döndü. Çoğunlukla. Yuge'un gururu biraz incinmiş gibi.
The Lost#045.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#046.src: Anyway, we ought to get back to our exploration - and we'll stick together closer this time!
The Lost#046.dst: Neyse, keşfimize geri dönsek iyi olur, bu sefer birbirimizden ayrılmayacağız!
The Lost#046.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#047.src: You were a huge help, though, so please take this as a reward!
The Lost#047.dst: Ama çok yardımın dokundu, lütfen bunu ödül olarak al!
The Lost#047.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#048.src: You should probably get down to check if she's okay.
The Lost#048.dst: Aşağı inip onun iyi olup olmadığına bakmalısın.

The Lost#049.src: Looks like you need [{~} Plank of Wood], [{~} Piece of Rope] and [{~} Chunk of Rock] to craft something useful.
The Lost#049.dst: İşe yarar bir şey yapmak için [{~} Plank of Wood], [{~} Piece of Rope] ve [{~} Chunk of Rock] gerekiyor gibi.

The Lost#050.src: Well, that's certainly one way out of here. You should talk to Gordon.
The Lost#050.dst: Eh, buradan çıkmanın bir yolu bu da tabii. Gordon ile konuşmalısın.

The Lost#051.src: So we're just gonna launch ourselves out of this pit? You got it!
The Lost#051.dst: Yani kendimizi bu çukurdan fırlatacak mıyız? Tamamdır!
The Lost#051.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#052.src: Who should be launched out of the pit first?

The Lost#054.src: Looks like you've found all three of Dejol's crew members! You should head back to Dejol.
The Lost#054.dst: Görünüşe göre Dejol'ün üç ekip üyesini de buldun! Dejol'ün yanına dönmelisin.

The Lost#055.src: Oh, hey there! It's good to see you again. Thanks again for helping me get away from that house— though, I feel kind of bad for the owner...
The Lost#055.dst: Ah, selam! Seni yeniden görmek güzel. O evden kurtulmama yardım ettiğin için tekrar sağ ol, gerçi ev sahibi için biraz üzülüyorum...

The Lost#056.src: Hey, human! Thanks for helping me with the birds. I managed to sneak down once you gave me the eggs, so... All said and done, now!
The Lost#056.dst: Hey, insan! Kuşlar konusunda yardım ettiğin için sağ ol. Yumurtaları verdikten sonra gizlice aşağı inebildim, yani... Her şey yoluna girdi!

The Lost#057.src: EEK! A-Are you back to throw me off another cliff, human?? Keep your distance, p-please!
The Lost#057.dst: İİK! B-Beni başka bir uçurumdan atmaya mı geldin, insan?? Uzak dur, l-lütfen!

The Lost#058.src: Ho, adventurer! Thanks for your help again!
The Lost#058.dst: Hey, maceracı! Yardımın için tekrar sağ ol!

The Maiden Tower#000.src: Get me that urn, Win person. If I go up there covered in guts, I have reason to believe she won't take it well?
The Maiden Tower#000.dst: Bana o vazoyu getir, Win'li. Yukarıya bağırsak içinde çıkarsam bunu pek iyi karşılamayacağını düşünmek için sebebim var, değil mi?
The Maiden Tower#000.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

The Maiden Tower#002.src: I found this strange creature along the road outside the tower- it dug up from the ground.
The Maiden Tower#002.dst: Kulenin dışındaki yolda tuhaf bir yaratık buldum, topraktan çıkıvermiş.
The Maiden Tower#002.speaker:
Diary
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

The Maiden Tower#003.src: It looked so spindly and thin- I decided to take it in as a pet. I've called her Fiona.
The Maiden Tower#003.dst: Öyle cılız ve sıska görünüyordu ki onu evcil hayvan olarak sahiplenmeye karar verdim. Adını Fiona koydum.
The Maiden Tower#003.speaker:
Diary
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

The Maiden Tower#004.src: My father is confused as to what it is, and I am too, but it needs some loving care for certain...
The Maiden Tower#004.dst: Babam ne olduğunu anlayamadı, ben de anlayamadım, ama kesinlikle biraz şefkatli bakıma ihtiyacı var...
The Maiden Tower#004.speaker:
Diary
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

The Maiden Tower#005.src: Fiona quite likes my father, it seems! I keep finding her scratching at his door.
The Maiden Tower#005.dst: Fiona babamı epey seviyor galiba! Onu hep babamın kapısını tırmalarken buluyorum.
The Maiden Tower#005.speaker:
Diary
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

The Maiden Tower#006.src: She seems to like to bite, too...it is a habit I'll need to train out of her, given it leaves my skin pale.
The Maiden Tower#006.dst: Isırmayı da seviyor gibi... tenimi solgunlaştırdığına göre bu huyunu eğitimle bıraktırmam gerekecek.
The Maiden Tower#006.speaker:
Diary
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

The Maiden Tower#007.src: My father has died today... I found Fiona atop him. She must have been trying to comfort him...
The Maiden Tower#007.dst: Babam bugün öldü... Fiona'yı onun üstünde buldum. Onu teselli etmeye çalışıyor olmalıydı...
The Maiden Tower#007.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

The Maiden Tower#008.src: His funeral rites are being sorted. I cannot write more...at least I will have my dear pet.
The Maiden Tower#008.dst: Cenaze töreni ayarlanıyor. Daha fazla yazamıyorum... en azından sevgili evcil hayvanım yanımda.
The Maiden Tower#008.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

The Maiden Tower#009.src: ...Fiona was the problem to begin with. I feel sickly and pale, and it all started when she arrived!!
The Maiden Tower#009.dst: ...Baştan beri sorun Fiona'ymış. Kendimi hasta ve solgun hissediyorum ve hepsi o gelince başladı!!
The Maiden Tower#009.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

The Maiden Tower#010.src: I didn't want to admit it- She is the reason my father died, and the reason that I look like death when I look in the mirror!!
The Maiden Tower#010.dst: Kabul etmek istemedim- Babamın ölümünün sebebi o, aynaya baktığımda ölü gibi görünmemin sebebi de o!!
The Maiden Tower#010.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

The Maiden Tower#011.src: The only consolation is that she seems to have disappeared on her own. Good riddance to her!
The Maiden Tower#011.dst: Tek tesellim, kendiliğinden ortadan kaybolmuş olması. Hele şükür, gitti!
The Maiden Tower#011.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

The Maiden Tower#012.src: I dearly need a man to comfort me during these times... Not even a man, anyone will do!!
The Maiden Tower#012.dst: Bu zor günlerde beni teselli edecek bir erkeğe çok ihtiyacım var... Erkek olmasa da olur, kim olursa!!

The Maiden Tower#013.src: Fine then. Consider yourself lucky that I'm in a...mood. I'll talk with you instead of crackin' yer bones for my bread.
The Maiden Tower#013.dst: Peki öyleyse. Şanslısın ki biraz... keyfim yerinde. Kemiklerini ekmeğim için öğütmek yerine seninle konuşacağım.
The Maiden Tower#013.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#014.src: Ogres are tough. We're independent and solitary folks. You don't bother us or interfere with our life, we leave well enough alone.
The Maiden Tower#014.dst: Ogrelar serttir. Bağımsız ve yalnız yaşayan bir halkız. Sen bize bulaşmazsan, hayatımıza karışmazsan, biz de seni rahat bırakırız.
The Maiden Tower#014.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#015.src: And...well, when it's two ogres getting together, it's simple. But... I passed by a tall tower, and heard a maiden's voice from inside...
The Maiden Tower#015.dst: Ve... iki ogre bir araya geldi mi iş basittir. Ama... uzun bir kulenin önünden geçtim ve içeriden bir genç kızın sesini duydum...

The Maiden Tower#016.src: If you can help me out, I'd be real grateful. I'm sure I've got somethin' that you'd like in exchange.
The Maiden Tower#016.dst: Bana yardım edebilirsen çok minnettar olurum. Karşılığında hoşuna gidecek bir şeyim vardır, eminim.
The Maiden Tower#016.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#017.src: Ohoho! An admirer? Such a lovely, rugged accent! However...if you wish to meet me, I'd like to see your devotion, yes?
The Maiden Tower#017.dst: Ohoho! Bir hayran mı? Ne hoş, ne yabani bir şive! Ama... benimle tanışmak istiyorsan bağlılığını görmek isterim, olur mu?

The Maiden Tower#018.src: There is a lovely urn my father had before. He took it with him to the grave, and I do miss my dear father so.
The Maiden Tower#018.dst: Babamın eskiden çok güzel bir vazosu vardı. Onu yanında mezara götürdü, sevgili babamı da öyle özlüyorum ki.
The Maiden Tower#018.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#019.src: I go into {p}, I'll get attacked. I get attacked, I attack back. They'll come after us...wouldn't want to present her with that. You get that urn for me, alright?
The Maiden Tower#019.dst: {p} içine girersem saldırırlar. Saldırırlarsa karşılık veririm. Sonra peşimize düşerler... ona bunu sunmak istemem. O vazoyu bana sen getir, tamam mı?

The Maiden Tower#021.src: I've got you some compensation already, so don't worry about gettin' snubbed for credit. Thank you kindly for the help.
The Maiden Tower#021.dst: Sana şimdiden bir karşılık ayarladım, emeğin karşılıksız kalacak diye endişelenme. Yardımın için çok sağ ol.
The Maiden Tower#021.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#022.src: Ohoho...you're one of those Humans I've read about, aren't you? Did you truly intend to be my suitor, dear?~
The Maiden Tower#022.dst: Ohoho... sen okuduğum şu İnsanlardan birisin, değil mi? Gerçekten talibim olmaya mı niyetlendin, canım?~

The Maiden Tower#023.src: Oh...my...goodness! A big, strong, strapping ogre!! Not a fairytale, my foot! And so polite, too... Oh, you'll make a perfect husband, heehee~
The Maiden Tower#023.dst: Aman... tanrım... ne güzel! İri, güçlü, yapılı bir ogre!! Masal değilmiş, hadi oradan! Üstelik ne kibar... Ah, mükemmel bir koca olacaksın, hihi~

The Maiden Tower#024.src: Now I'm sure you'll find a nice lad somewhere who'll take you for who you are, but until you find someone that has no standards, shove your creepy lips where I can't see 'em!!
The Maiden Tower#024.dst: Eminim bir yerlerde seni olduğun gibi kabul edecek hoş bir delikanlı bulursun, ama hiç standardı olmayan birini bulana kadar o ürkütücü dudaklarını gözümün önünden çek!!
The Maiden Tower#024.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#025.src: ...I...I g-guess he was rotten to the core, despite his...l-luscious exterior...but, you'll make me feel better, right, you s-studly human? Right?! RIGHT?!!
The Maiden Tower#025.dst: ...Ben... s-sanırım o... n-nefis dış görünüşüne rağmen özüne kadar çürükmüş... ama sen beni teselli edersin, değil mi, y-yakışıklı insan? Değil mi?! DEĞİL Mİ?!!

The Maiden Tower#027.src: Ah! What are you doing in my swamp?! Don't you know that Ogres live alone for a reason?
The Maiden Tower#027.dst: Ah! Benim bataklığımda ne işin var?! Ogreların boşuna yalnız yaşamadığını bilmiyor musun?
The Maiden Tower#027.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#028.src: Eh? You're from across the sea, a land called Win? You certainly don't look like a winner to me, ya small fry.
The Maiden Tower#028.dst: Ha? Denizin ötesinden, Win denen bir diyardan mı geldin? Bana hiç de kazanan gibi görünmüyorsun, seni çelimsiz.
The Maiden Tower#028.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#029.src: That is, until it's time to find ourselves a partner. Then we'll turn over hell and highwater ta be together.
The Maiden Tower#029.dst: Yani, kendimize bir eş bulma vakti gelene kadar. O zaman bir araya gelmek için dağları deviririz.
The Maiden Tower#029.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#030.src: Ogres don't live in fairytale towers, or have a voice that could make flowers grow with its lovely lilt!
The Maiden Tower#030.dst: Ogrelar masal kulelerinde yaşamaz, sesleri de o tatlı ezgisiyle çiçek açtıracak gibi değildir!
The Maiden Tower#030.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#031.src: I've been tryin' ta figure out how to approach this... I'm gettin' on in years, I need to find someone, and she's the girl.
The Maiden Tower#031.dst: Bu işe nasıl yaklaşacağımı düşünüp duruyorum... Yaşım ilerliyor, birini bulmam lazım ve aradığım kız o.
The Maiden Tower#031.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#032.src: Follow the rocky-looking path to find the tower. I'll meet with you there- prepare to be a wingman for an ogre.
The Maiden Tower#032.dst: Kuleyi bulmak için taşlı görünen patikayı takip et. Orada buluşuruz, bir ogreya çöpçatanlık yapmaya hazır ol.
The Maiden Tower#032.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#033.src: Follow the stones in the path to the tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Maiden Tower#033.dst: Kuleye giden patikadaki taşları takip et: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Maiden Tower#034.src: This is the place. She's up at the top... Remember, I won't stop 'til I meet her. Coming here means you're in for the long haul.
The Maiden Tower#034.dst: İşte burası. Kız en tepede... Unutma, onunla tanışana kadar durmayacağım. Buraya geldiysen sonuna kadar varsın demektir.
The Maiden Tower#034.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#035.src: I hear a voice outside! Oh, who might it be, I wonder~
The Maiden Tower#035.dst: Dışarıdan bir ses duyuyorum! Ah, acaba kim olabilir~
The Maiden Tower#035.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#036.src: Here goes... Hello, fair lady of the tower! I am Sherk! I heard your voice on the road- and I must meet you myself! ...that's formal enough, right?
The Maiden Tower#036.dst: İşte başlıyoruz... Merhaba, kulenin güzel hanımı! Ben Sherk! Yolda sesinizi duydum ve sizinle bizzat tanışmalıyım! ...bu kadar resmiyet yeter, değil mi?
The Maiden Tower#036.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#037.src: Woman, you have no idea what you're sayin' when you ask for devotion.
The Maiden Tower#037.dst: Kadın, bağlılık isterken ne dediğinin hiç farkında değilsin.
The Maiden Tower#037.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#038.src: Retrieve the urn for me, so I can have a memento of him. Brave the crypts of {p}, behind the bank... And prove your devotion, dear suitor~
The Maiden Tower#038.dst: Vazoyu bana getir de ondan bir hatıram olsun. {p} bankasının arkasındaki mezarlara cesurca gir... Ve bağlılığını kanıtla, sevgili talibim~
The Maiden Tower#038.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#039.src: ...I'll return! You'll get your urn, no doubt! ... ...and a lovely fine boot up my backside. I don't fancy a massacre for a piece of pottery, Win person.
The Maiden Tower#039.dst: ...Döneceğim! Vazonu alacaksın, hiç şüphen olmasın! ... ...bir de kıçıma güzel bir tekme. Bir çömlek parçası için katliam yapmaya hiç hevesim yok, Win'li.
The Maiden Tower#039.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#040.src: Find the urn in the {p} Catacombs, behind the {p} bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Maiden Tower#040.dst: Vazoyu {p} bankasının arkasındaki {p} Yeraltı Mezarları'nda bul: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Maiden Tower#041.src: And this is why I asked your help. As nice as blood spreads on toast, I have to reserve my sensibilities for the miss.
The Maiden Tower#041.dst: İşte bu yüzden senden yardım istedim. Kan kızarmış ekmeğe ne kadar güzel sürülse de inceliğimi hanımefendiye saklamam lazım.
The Maiden Tower#041.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#042.src: Just one last thing. I doubt she'll be expecting an ogre of all people to climb up her tower. I don't want her to get frightened away.
