The Order of the Grook#150.dst: Şimdi pratik sınava! Kemikleri biraz sallama vakti! Kurduğum bir engel parkurunu koşacaksınız, ama bir farkla.
The Order of the Grook#150.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#151.src: Everyone up to the table! You'll need this feather with ya to get through.It'll help you jump higher!
The Order of the Grook#151.dst: Herkes masaya! Geçebilmek için bu tüyü yanınızda taşımanız lazım. Daha yükseğe zıplamanıza yardım edecek!
The Order of the Grook#151.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#152.src: The goal is to grab three crystal balls I put in the obstacle course. once you found 'em, bring 'em back to me.
The Order of the Grook#152.dst: Amaç, engel parkuruna koyduğum üç kristal küreyi almak. Bulunca bana geri getirin.
The Order of the Grook#152.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#153.src: The course is behind me. Shake a leg now!
The Order of the Grook#153.dst: Parkur arkamda. Hadi, elini çabuk tut!
The Order of the Grook#153.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#154.src: Lessee here, one, two, three, yes indeedy! You got through that pretty quick!
The Order of the Grook#154.dst: Bakalım, bir, iki, üç, evet efendim! Epey çabuk geçtin!
The Order of the Grook#154.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#155.src: Now, if you'll just hand me back that feather ya got there...
The Order of the Grook#155.dst: Şimdi, o elindeki tüyü bana geri verirsen...
The Order of the Grook#155.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#156.src: ...then you'll be all done! Congrats, little fledge, you've finished this class! Now get on along to your next one!
The Order of the Grook#156.dst: ...işin bitiyor! Tebrikler küçük yavru, bu dersi bitirdin! Hadi bakalım, sıradakine!
The Order of the Grook#156.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#157.src: Moving swiftly on, the next class is just across the way. Follow me!
The Order of the Grook#157.dst: Hızla devam edelim, sonraki ders hemen karşıda. Beni takip edin!
The Order of the Grook#157.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#158.src: Alright everyone. Take a seat but don't get comfy. You'll be getting up soon. Hope you brought your reading glasses
The Order of the Grook#158.dst: Pekâlâ millet. Oturun ama fazla rahatlamayın. Birazdan kalkacaksınız. Umarım okuma gözlüklerinizi getirmişsinizdir.
The Order of the Grook#158.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#159.src: See, I'll just be giving you short primer, then sending you out for the practical exercise, Since I have all this written down already.
The Order of the Grook#159.dst: Bakın, size kısa bir giriş yapıp sonra pratik alıştırmaya göndereceğim, çünkü hepsini zaten yazdım.
The Order of the Grook#159.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#160.src: The basis of this class is that many materials, whether you know it or not, are inherently magical in some way or another. If you want to be artificer, you need to know how each one works.
The Order of the Grook#160.dst: Bu dersin temeli şu: Pek çok malzeme, farkında olsanız da olmasanız da, şu ya da bu şekilde doğası gereği büyülüdür. Zanaatkâr olmak istiyorsanız her birinin nasıl çalıştığını bilmelisiniz.
The Order of the Grook#160.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#161.src: Thankfully, the field of artifice is very popular one, so there's a wealth of knowledge out there on magical materials and how to use them efficiently.
The Order of the Grook#161.dst: Neyse ki zanaatkârlık çok popüler bir alan, o yüzden büyülü malzemeler ve onları verimli kullanma hakkında bir sürü bilgi var.
The Order of the Grook#161.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#162.src: Heck, Wynn soldiers are cobbling together rings out of copper and old spider silk, so you know this sort of thing is easy to get to. Tough to master, though!
The Order of the Grook#162.dst: Yahu, Wynn askerleri bakırla eski örümcek ağından yüzük yapıp duruyor, demek ki bu işe girmek kolay. Ustalaşmak ise zor!
The Order of the Grook#162.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#163.src: For those intimidated, you don't need much crafting knowledge for this class; you'll be reading up on everything you need to know in the back.
The Order of the Grook#163.dst: Gözü korkanlar için söyleyeyim, bu ders için çok zanaat bilgisi gerekmiyor; bilmeniz gereken her şeyi arkada okuyacaksınız.
The Order of the Grook#163.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#164.src: You all be crafting a magical amulet using different items. I've stockpiled in the back; everyone will be crafting a different kind of necklace.
The Order of the Grook#164.dst: Hepiniz farklı eşyalar kullanarak büyülü bir muska yapacaksınız. Arkaya stok yaptım; herkes farklı türde bir kolye yapacak.
The Order of the Grook#164.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#165.src: Here's a note on what you should craft. Once you have the materials you think you need, come to the crafting table. It's enchanted, and will craft the item for you if you have what you need.
The Order of the Grook#165.dst: Ne yapman gerektiğini anlatan bir not burada. Gerekli olduğunu düşündüğün malzemeleri toplayınca zanaat masasına gel. Masa büyülü, gereken her şey sende varsa eşyayı senin için yapar.
The Order of the Grook#165.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#166.src: Mhm, that's the ticket, {u}. If you're interested in learning more, you can probably find my books in most of the libraries.
The Order of the Grook#166.dst: Hı hı, işte bu, {u}. Daha fazlasını öğrenmek istersen kitaplarımı çoğu kütüphanede bulabilirsin herhalde.
The Order of the Grook#166.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#167.src: Your feathers are coming out just nicely, fledgeling. You can scoot off to your next class now
The Order of the Grook#167.dst: Tüylerin gayet güzel çıkıyor, yavru. Artık bir sonraki dersine gidebilirsin.
The Order of the Grook#167.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#168.src: Okay class, everyone take your seats, and listen up. This class is going to be interesting.
The Order of the Grook#168.dst: Tamam sınıf, herkes yerine otursun ve dinlesin. Bu ders ilginç olacak.
The Order of the Grook#168.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#169.src: As you know, this class is all about magical effects, specifically those tied to various materials, and how they'll affect you!
The Order of the Grook#169.dst: Bildiğiniz gibi bu ders tamamen büyülü etkilerle, özellikle çeşitli malzemelere bağlı olanlarla ve size nasıl etki edecekleriyle ilgili!
The Order of the Grook#169.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#170.src: This is going to be a hands-on learning experience, so those of you with weak constitutions may request to skip the demonstration if you're concerned for your health.
The Order of the Grook#170.dst: Bu uygulamalı bir öğrenme deneyimi olacak, bünyesi zayıf olanlar sağlıklarından endişeliyse gösteriyi atlamak isteyebilir.
The Order of the Grook#170.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#171.src: It may be explosive, but it will be in a controlled manner. The worst that'll happen to you is your face will get a bit dusty, or your glasses will fall off.
The Order of the Grook#171.dst: Patlayıcı olabilir ama kontrollü olacak. Başınıza gelecek en kötü şey yüzünüzün biraz tozlanması ya da gözlüğünüzün düşmesi.
The Order of the Grook#171.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#172.src: Magical crystals, as we have to my left here, can be charged with all kinds of different effects. This is an incredibly valuable aspect for artificers.
The Order of the Grook#172.dst: Solumda gördüğünüz gibi büyülü kristaller her türlü farklı etkiyle yüklenebilir. Bu, zanaatkârlar için inanılmaz değerli bir özellik.
The Order of the Grook#172.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#173.src: Our last sample is of cosmic material, and if you're sickened easily, then don't examine it. Its effects are mostly unknown, but one thing's certain...
The Order of the Grook#173.dst: Son örneğimiz kozmik bir malzeme, kolay midesi bulananlar incelemesin. Etkileri çoğunlukla bilinmiyor ama bir şey kesin...
The Order of the Grook#173.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#174.src: ...it's dangerous to be exposed for long periods. Now, each of you will go back behind me, and examine and interact with each of the three samples provided.
The Order of the Grook#174.dst: ...uzun süre maruz kalmak tehlikeli. Şimdi her biriniz arkama geçip verilen üç örneği tek tek inceleyecek ve onlarla etkileşime gireceksiniz.
The Order of the Grook#174.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#175.src: Once you've done so, then you can leave. Hands-on training is the best way to learn, after all.
The Order of the Grook#175.dst: Bunu yaptıktan sonra gidebilirsiniz. Ne de olsa en iyi öğrenme yolu uygulamalı eğitimdir.
The Order of the Grook#175.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#176.src: Well done. How did that feel?
The Order of the Grook#176.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#177.src: Personally, the void sample is the most interesting to me. You may now leave the classroom.
The Order of the Grook#177.dst: Şahsen bana en ilginç gelen boşluk örneği. Artık sınıftan çıkabilirsin.
The Order of the Grook#177.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#178.src: There's a bit of a walk to your next class. Follow me.
The Order of the Grook#178.dst: Sonraki dersinize biraz yürümemiz gerek. Beni takip edin.
The Order of the Grook#178.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#179.src: These staircases were supposed to move, but... That was too much work to put together, apparently. They're a pain to navigate, aren't they?
The Order of the Grook#179.dst: Bu merdivenlerin hareket etmesi gerekiyordu ama... Görünüşe göre yapması çok zahmetliymiş. Bunlarda yol bulmak tam bir dert, değil mi?
The Order of the Grook#179.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#180.src: Alright, fledgeling grooks. Time to hit you all with the info you're really here for!
The Order of the Grook#180.dst: Pekâlâ, yavru Grook'lar. Asıl buraya geliş sebebiniz olan bilgileri patlatma vakti!
The Order of the Grook#180.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#181.src: But no one actually KNOWS for sure. That means they. Could. Be. ANYTHING! What could lie beneath that veneer of fluff and playful demeanor?!
The Order of the Grook#181.dst: Ama kimse kesin olarak BİLMİYOR. Yani. Her. Şey. OLABİLİRLER! O tüylü ve oyuncu görünüşün altında ne yatıyor olabilir?!
The Order of the Grook#181.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#182.src: These materials have innate magical energy to them. Stable like lodestone and reliable like quartz, but not as powerful as either. Interesting, that a fluffball has that potential!!
The Order of the Grook#182.dst: Bu malzemelerin içinde doğuştan büyülü enerji var. Mıknatıs taşı gibi kararlı, kuvars gibi güvenilir ama ikisi kadar güçlü değil. Bir tüy yumağında bu potansiyelin olması ilginç!!
The Order of the Grook#182.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#183.src: And the worst part is, if too much fluff gathers up in one spot, ANOTHER WYBEL APPEARS! They reproduce by budding!! Growing out of lint and dust! It's a no-win game they're makin' us play!
The Order of the Grook#183.dst: İşin en kötüsü, bir yerde fazla tüy birikirse BİR WYBEL DAHA ORTAYA ÇIKIYOR! Tomurcuklanarak çoğalıyorlar!! Tüy ve tozdan büyüyorlar! Bize kazanamayacağımız bir oyun oynatıyorlar!
The Order of the Grook#183.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#184.src: Wybels do have some good use though...they can sniff out sources of cosmic magic, like a pig sniffs out truffles. Sometimes they even try to take it home.
The Order of the Grook#184.dst: Yine de Wybel'lerin bazı işe yarar yanları var...domuzun yer mantarını koklayıp bulması gibi kozmik büyü kaynaklarını koklayıp bulabiliyorlar. Bazen eve götürmeye bile çalışıyorlar.
The Order of the Grook#184.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#185.src: They're here to kill us all, I swear it! How else would you explain a wybel VAPORIZING a group of poachers? Ten colors of wybel, every one of them rotten evil!
The Order of the Grook#185.dst: Hepimizi öldürmek için buradalar, yemin ederim! Yoksa bir wybel'in bir grup kaçak avcıyı BUHARLAŞTIRMASINI başka nasıl açıklarsınız? On renk wybel, her biri baştan aşağı kötü!
The Order of the Grook#185.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#186.src: Alrighty, fledgeling, good job. You're armed with the REAL truth now! Go on to your next class.
The Order of the Grook#186.dst: Pekâlâ yavru, aferin. Artık GERÇEK hakikatle donandın! Sonraki dersine geç.
The Order of the Grook#186.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#187.src: Hello, students. This is your magical creatures class, and I will be your instructor.
The Order of the Grook#187.dst: Merhaba öğrenciler. Burası büyülü yaratıklar dersiniz, eğitmeniniz de ben olacağım.
The Order of the Grook#187.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#188.src: Different species have different levels of innate magicality. This is often an invisible aspect of the species. You must never assume.
The Order of the Grook#188.dst: Farklı türlerin farklı düzeylerde doğuştan büyüselliği vardır. Bu, türün çoğu zaman görünmeyen bir yönüdür. Asla varsayımda bulunmamalısınız.
The Order of the Grook#188.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#189.src: To begin with, Doguns. They are ancient creatures, artificial-seeming at first. Despite this, they are highly adept at earth and fire-based magic.
The Order of the Grook#189.dst: Başlangıç olarak Dogun'lar. Kadim yaratıklardır, ilk bakışta yapay gibi görünürler. Buna rağmen toprak ve ateşe dayalı büyüde son derece ustadırlar.
The Order of the Grook#189.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#190.src: Able to quite literally move mountains, it is theorized that they were the ones to carve out the inside of the {p} into the caves we know today.
The Order of the Grook#190.dst: Kelimenin tam anlamıyla dağları yerinden oynatabildikleri için {p} içini oyarak bugün bildiğimiz mağaraları açanların onlar olduğu düşünülüyor.
The Order of the Grook#190.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#191.src: Moving on. We'll touch on the societies of Trolls, Goblins, Orcs, Ogres, and Hobgoblins. Some include Gerts into this grouping, though by technicality they are separate.
The Order of the Grook#191.dst: Devam edelim. Trollerin, Goblinlerin, Orkların, Ogrelerin ve Hobgoblinlerin toplumlarına değineceğiz. Bazıları Gert'leri de bu gruba katar, ama teknik olarak ayrıdırlar.
The Order of the Grook#191.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

The Order of the Grook#192.src: Though many of these types of societies have mystical practices, the only known way for Orcs and such to utilize magic is through artifacts. They've little magical potential.
The Order of the Grook#192.dst: Bu tür toplumların çoğunun mistik gelenekleri olsa da Orkların ve benzerlerinin büyü kullanmasının bilinen tek yolu eserlerdir. Büyü potansiyelleri azdır.
The Order of the Grook#192.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

similar.text: Though many Greenskins societies with mystical particles, the only known way for them to utilize magic is through magical artifacts. They've little magic potential.

The Order of the Grook#193.src: Tales also tell of their utilizing demonic energy for various purposes. However, we are only able to assume their magical energy from Dwarven tales, as they are nigh-extinct
The Order of the Grook#193.dst: Hikâyeler onların iblis enerjisini çeşitli amaçlarla kullandığını da anlatır. Ancak neredeyse yok oldukları için büyü enerjilerini yalnızca Cüce hikâyelerinden tahmin edebiliyoruz.
The Order of the Grook#193.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#194.src: Moving on. The term "Greenskins" is a catch-all for Trolls, Goblins, Orcs, Ogres and Hobgoblins. Some include Gerts into this definition, though by technicality they are separate.
The Order of the Grook#194.dst: Devam edelim. "Yeşilderililer" terimi Troller, Goblinler, Orklar, Ogreler ve Hobgoblinler için genel bir addır. Bazıları Gert'leri de bu tanıma katar, ama teknik olarak ayrıdırlar.
The Order of the Grook#194.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#195.src: Though many Greenskins societies with mystical particles, the only known way for them to utilize magic is through magical artifacts. They've little magic potential.
The Order of the Grook#195.dst: Yeşilderili toplumların çoğunda mistik izler olsa da büyü kullanmalarının bilinen tek yolu büyülü eserlerdir. Büyü potansiyelleri azdır.
The Order of the Grook#195.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#196.src: Meanwhile, Villagers are of the opposite persuasion. High magical potential, often unrealized out of laziness.
The Order of the Grook#196.dst: Köylüler ise tam tersi. Büyü potansiyelleri yüksektir ama tembellikten çoğu zaman açığa çıkmaz.
The Order of the Grook#196.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#197.src: Humans are often thought of as more magical than Villagers, due to Fruman soldiers seeming to know some magic innately, but this is untrue.
The Order of the Grook#197.dst: Fruma askerleri doğuştan biraz büyü biliyor gibi göründüğü için İnsanların Köylülerden daha büyülü olduğu sanılır, ama bu doğru değil.
The Order of the Grook#197.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#198.src: Dwarves have a similar level of magicality to Humans, but like Villagers, it often goes unrealized. Their culture values physical strength more.
The Order of the Grook#198.dst: Cücelerin büyüselliği İnsanlarınkine yakındır ama Köylüler gibi çoğu zaman açığa çıkmaz. Kültürleri fiziksel güce daha çok değer verir.
The Order of the Grook#198.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#199.src: It is theorized that the reason for this is due to their distaste for the demonic energies of the Doguns. They reject their magic potential often, such that it is lessening over time.
The Order of the Grook#199.dst: Bunun sebebinin Dogun'ların iblis enerjilerinden hoşlanmamaları olduğu düşünülüyor. Büyü potansiyellerini o kadar sık reddediyorlar ki zamanla azalıyor.
The Order of the Grook#199.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#200.src: Inversely, Elves have a deep connection to their magicality. Despite their reclusiveness, they are known for their open share of magical energy within their own society.
The Order of the Grook#200.dst: Tersine, Elflerin büyüsellikleriyle derin bir bağı vardır. İçlerine kapanık olsalar da kendi toplumları içinde büyü enerjisini açıkça paylaşmalarıyla bilinirler.
The Order of the Grook#200.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#201.src: The outcast Elves of {p} have shared their connection to what they refer to as 'The Light.' This connection is supposedly unfathomable, but guides them and protects them.
The Order of the Grook#201.dst: {p} bölgesinin dışlanmış Elfleri, 'Işık' dedikleri şeyle bağlarını paylaştı. Bu bağın akıl almaz olduğu söylenir ama onlara yol gösterir ve onları korur.
The Order of the Grook#201.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#202.src: Now, we see if you were paying attention. You will come here and order the societies I have referred to in this class from least magical, to most.
The Order of the Grook#202.dst: Şimdi dikkatinizi verip vermediğinize bakalım. Buraya gelip bu derste bahsettiğim toplumları en az büyülüden en büyülüye doğru sıralayacaksınız.
The Order of the Grook#202.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#203.src: Well done, you got it right!
The Order of the Grook#203.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#204.src: Correct. {u}, thank you for paying attention. No one ever seems to in this class. You may go.
The Order of the Grook#204.dst: Doğru. {u}, dikkatini verdiğin için teşekkürler. Bu derste kimse dikkat etmez gibi. Gidebilirsin.
The Order of the Grook#204.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#205.src: Next class is actually rather close!
The Order of the Grook#205.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#207.src: ...I was hoping for a smaller class size.
The Order of the Grook#207.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#208.src: Corruption is incredibly dangerous...it'll be tough to keep so many students safe. If anyone wishes to leave, you may.
The Order of the Grook#208.dst: Yozlaşma inanılmaz tehlikelidir...bu kadar öğrenciyi güvende tutmak zor olacak. Ayrılmak isteyen varsa gidebilir.
The Order of the Grook#208.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#209.src: Now... Corruption is a force of nature of...some description. Yes, you heard me right. We don't actually know much about it.
The Order of the Grook#209.dst: Şimdi... Yozlaşma bir tür...doğa gücüdür. Evet, doğru duydunuz. Aslında onun hakkında pek bir şey bilmiyoruz.
The Order of the Grook#209.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#210.src: Even though it's plagued the Wynn province for a thousand years, the way it behaves is so incredibly alien in nature that it's nigh-impossible to study.
The Order of the Grook#210.dst: Wynn eyaletine bin yıldır musallat olsa da davranışı o kadar yabancı ki incelemek neredeyse imkânsız.
The Order of the Grook#210.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#211.src: We know it raises undead bodies... The working theory is that the more heavily injured a target is, the more susceptible they are to being corrupted.
The Order of the Grook#211.dst: Ölü bedenleri dirilttiğini biliyoruz... Geçerli teoriye göre hedef ne kadar ağır yaralıysa yozlaşmaya o kadar açık oluyor.
The Order of the Grook#211.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#212.src: And...well, you can't exactly get more injured than "dead". Hence, the growth of zombies and skeletons and all, over in Wynn.
The Order of the Grook#212.dst: Ve...eh, "ölü"den daha yaralı olunmaz herhalde. Wynn'deki zombi, iskelet ve benzerlerinin çoğalması bundan.
The Order of the Grook#212.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#213.src: It appears to spread by a complex "root" system. A scientist from {p}, Orikal, has studied this. The corruption spikes appear to spread it in greater concentration.
The Order of the Grook#213.dst: Karmaşık bir "kök" sistemiyle yayılıyor gibi görünüyor. {p} kökenli bir bilim insanı olan Orikal bunu inceledi. Yozlaşma dikenleri onu daha yoğun şekilde yayıyor gibi.
The Order of the Grook#213.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#214.src: As for the effects on your person, most often paranoia and anger are seen. And that's about the only consistent thing with it; it affect everyone slightly differently.
The Order of the Grook#214.dst: Kişi üzerindeki etkilerine gelince, en sık paranoya ve öfke görülüyor. Tutarlı olan tek şey de bu; herkesi biraz farklı etkiliyor.
The Order of the Grook#214.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#215.src: The worst part is that practically everything single thing we've touched on here is conjecture and theorycrafting! The force of corruption is terrifying.
The Order of the Grook#215.dst: İşin en kötüsü, burada değindiğimiz neredeyse her şey tahmin ve teoriden ibaret! Yozlaşma gücü dehşet verici.
The Order of the Grook#215.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#216.src: The only thing we know for certain is that powerful ice-based magic can halt corruption, as seen in the {p} region.
The Order of the Grook#216.dst: Kesin bildiğimiz tek şey, güçlü buz büyüsünün yozlaşmayı durdurabildiği; {p} bölgesinde görüldüğü gibi.
The Order of the Grook#216.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#217.src: Now, the dangerous part. Everyone, come up past my desk here. We'll examine a corrupted creature in a controlled environment.
The Order of the Grook#217.dst: Şimdi tehlikeli kısım. Herkes masamın ötesine gelsin. Yozlaşmış bir yaratığı kontrollü bir ortamda inceleyeceğiz.
The Order of the Grook#217.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#218.src: We have one in captivity, and its cage is reinforced with the strongest metals we have...so dear god let it be enough.
The Order of the Grook#218.dst: Elimizde esir bir tane var, kafesi de sahip olduğumuz en sağlam metallerle güçlendirildi...tanrım, ne olur yetsin.
The Order of the Grook#218.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#219.src: Bringing it out now...be sure to back up. We don't want anyone caught in the crossfire here.
The Order of the Grook#219.dst: Şimdi dışarı çıkarıyorum...geri çekilmeyi unutmayın. Kimsenin arada kalmasını istemeyiz.
The Order of the Grook#219.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#220.src: One thing to note about undead corrupteds...they can't be cured. You can weaken them, but that's about it. ...wait...
The Order of the Grook#220.dst: Ölümsüz yozlaşmışlarla ilgili bilinmesi gereken bir şey...tedavi edilemezler. Zayıflatabilirsiniz ama o kadar. ...bir dakika...
The Order of the Grook#220.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#221.src: Wait, why's it spreading here? It's never done this before! E-everyone, back up, now!
The Order of the Grook#221.dst: Dur, neden burada yayılıyor? Daha önce hiç böyle yapmamıştı! H-herkes, geri çekilin, hemen!
The Order of the Grook#221.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#222.src: A-as you can see, corruption is very powerful, eheheh, c-can someone go get another teacher or something?!
The Order of the Grook#222.dst: G-gördüğünüz gibi yozlaşma çok güçlüdür, ehehe, b-biri gidip başka bir öğretmen falan çağırabilir mi?!
The Order of the Grook#222.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#223.src: Wait, no! It's corroding the bars! Everyone, RUN! NOW! GET OUT OF HERE, CLASS DISMISSED!!!
The Order of the Grook#223.dst: Hayır, olamaz! Parmaklıkları aşındırıyor! Herkes KAÇSIN! HEMEN! ÇIKIN BURADAN, DERS BİTTİ!!!
The Order of the Grook#223.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#224.src: GAACK! No, {u}, I said RUN! Don't fight that thing, get OUT!
The Order of the Grook#224.dst: AAAH! Hayır {u}, KAÇ dedim! O şeyle dövüşme, ÇIK DIŞARI!
The Order of the Grook#224.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#225.src: Dear lord...that was awful. {u}, I can't believe you were able to kill that thing!
The Order of the Grook#225.dst: Aman tanrım...korkunçtu. {u}, o şeyi öldürebildiğine inanamıyorum!
The Order of the Grook#225.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#226.src: Class absolutely dismissed. We've got to cancel this class...it's far too dangerous for the students...
The Order of the Grook#226.dst: Ders kesinlikle bitti. Bu dersi iptal etmemiz lazım...öğrenciler için fazlasıyla tehlikeli...
The Order of the Grook#226.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#227.src: There's two main ways of usin' nature magic... Shamanism and druidism. Two sides of the same coin, man.
The Order of the Grook#227.dst: Doğa büyüsünü kullanmanın iki ana yolu var... Şamanizm ve druidlik. Aynı madalyonun iki yüzü, dostum.
The Order of the Grook#227.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#228.src: Either way, it's all about equivalent exchange, y'see? You can't get somethin' from nothin', man. Either make life or take life.
The Order of the Grook#228.dst: Her türlü iş eşdeğer takasla ilgili, anladın mı? Hiçten bir şey alamazsın, dostum. Ya hayat yaratırsın ya hayat alırsın.
The Order of the Grook#228.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#229.src: You'll need to sacrifice some old grooks, but it has to be just the right amount, man! The practice is through the door behind me.
The Order of the Grook#229.dst: Birkaç yaşlı grook'u feda etmen gerekecek ama tam doğru miktarda olmalı, dostum! Uygulama arkamdaki kapının ardında.
The Order of the Grook#229.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#230.src: Groovy work, man! You're at one with nature!
The Order of the Grook#230.dst: Süper iş, dostum! Doğayla bir oldun!
The Order of the Grook#230.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#231.src: Your feathers are all grown out, man! Time to head out!
The Order of the Grook#231.dst: Tüylerin tamamen çıktı, dostum! Yola koyulma vakti!
The Order of the Grook#231.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#233.src: That's all four classes! I hope you found them magically enriching! Now, off to the graduation hall!
The Order of the Grook#233.dst: Dört dersin hepsi bu kadar! Umarım büyülü bir şekilde zenginleştirici bulmuşsunuzdur! Şimdi mezuniyet salonuna!
The Order of the Grook#233.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#234.src: It's the room all the way at the bottom of the stairs. Hurry, don't hold up the ceremony! It won't start until everyone's there.
The Order of the Grook#234.dst: Merdivenlerin en dibindeki oda. Acele edin, töreni bekletmeyin! Herkes gelmeden başlamayacak.
The Order of the Grook#234.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#235.src: Go to the ceremony room for the Headmaster's closing speech.
The Order of the Grook#235.dst: Müdürün kapanış konuşması için tören salonuna git.

The Order of the Grook#236.src: Take a seat. The ceremony is starting.
The Order of the Grook#236.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#237.src: And so, your teachings, or at least their basics, have ended. Your magical feathers have started to grow!
The Order of the Grook#237.dst: Ve böylece eğitiminiz, ya da en azından temelleri, sona erdi. Büyülü tüyleriniz çıkmaya başladı!
The Order of the Grook#237.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#238.src: You have all been performing very well during your classes today. I've heard quite a bit of praise from the teachers being passed around.
The Order of the Grook#238.dst: Bugün derslerinizde hepiniz çok iyi iş çıkardınız. Öğretmenlerden epey övgü duydum.
The Order of the Grook#238.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#239.src: But now, for your efforts, you shall not go unrewarded. You will leave here with more than simply knowledge.
The Order of the Grook#239.dst: Ama emekleriniz karşılıksız kalmayacak. Buradan sadece bilgiyle ayrılmayacaksınız.
The Order of the Grook#239.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#240.src: Your tools have shaped your minds, subtly but inexorably. And so with that, what you leave with today, both in mind and in treasure, shall be different for each of you.
The Order of the Grook#240.dst: Araçlarınız zihninizi belli belirsiz ama kaçınılmaz şekilde biçimlendirdi. Bu yüzden bugün hem zihninizde hem de hazine olarak götürdükleriniz her biriniz için farklı olacak.
The Order of the Grook#240.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#241.src: There is a reason I've called you up first, you know. Recall what I said about old hats earlier? Don't think we didn't notice the armor, or the weapon, or the grim countenance.
The Order of the Grook#241.dst: Seni ilk çağırmamın bir sebebi var, biliyorsun. Az önce eski kurtlar hakkında söylediklerimi hatırlıyor musun? Zırhı, silahı ya da o asık yüzü fark etmediğimizi sanma.
The Order of the Grook#241.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#242.src: But no need to worry. Those who truly have the drive to become learned in the ways of magic, no matter who they are, will always find their way here, and be accepted.
The Order of the Grook#242.dst: Ama endişelenmene gerek yok. Büyünün yollarını öğrenmeye gerçekten hevesli olan herkes, kim olursa olsun, buraya giden yolu her zaman bulur ve kabul görür.
The Order of the Grook#242.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#243.src: A shame about Seasum, but not to worry. Now, hand over your materials, and you'll receive your rewards.
The Order of the Grook#243.dst: Seasum'a yazık oldu ama dert etme. Şimdi malzemelerini teslim et, ödüllerini alacaksın.
The Order of the Grook#243.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#244.src: And there you have it. Your feathers are grown, and you can spread your magical wings! Good luck on your adventures, Wynn soldier.
The Order of the Grook#244.dst: İşte oldu. Tüylerin çıktı, artık büyülü kanatlarını açabilirsin! Maceralarında bol şans, Wynn askeri.
The Order of the Grook#244.speaker: Headmaster

The Passage (Quest)#001.src: My dad said I can't let any strangers through this passage!
The Passage (Quest)#001.dst: Babam bu geçitten hiçbir yabancıyı geçirmememi söyledi!
The Passage (Quest)#001.speaker: Wirt

The Passage (Quest)#002.src: If you want access, talk to him, he's the recruiter of the town! His name is Ildan. He's just southwest of here.
The Passage (Quest)#002.dst: Geçmek istiyorsan onunla konuş, kasabanın üye sorumlusu o! Adı Ildan. Buranın hemen güneybatısında.
The Passage (Quest)#002.speaker: Wirt

The Passage (Quest)#003.src: Find Ildan in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and ask to be a member of the town
The Passage (Quest)#003.dst: {p} bölgesinde [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki Ildan'ı bul ve kasabaya üye olmak istediğini söyle

The Passage (Quest)#004.src: Oh! So you want to become a member of this town?
The Passage (Quest)#004.dst: Oo! Demek bu kasabanın bir üyesi olmak istiyorsun?
The Passage (Quest)#004.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#005.src: You will have to help us first, of course!
The Passage (Quest)#005.dst: Önce bize yardım etmen gerekecek, elbette!
The Passage (Quest)#005.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#006.src: They used to have a powerful chief, but he eventually died in battle.
The Passage (Quest)#006.dst: Eskiden güçlü bir şefleri vardı ama sonunda savaşta öldü.
The Passage (Quest)#006.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#007.src: The tribe couldn't bear the fact that he was dead. They performed some unethical necromancy spell on him.
The Passage (Quest)#007.dst: Kabile onun öldüğünü kabullenemedi. Ona ahlaka aykırı bir ölü büyüsü yaptılar.
The Passage (Quest)#007.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#008.src: He keeps reviving his minions and it's causing quite some problems to our army.
The Passage (Quest)#008.dst: Adamlarını durmadan diriltiyor ve bu da ordumuza epey sorun çıkarıyor.
The Passage (Quest)#008.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#009.src: You can access the tomb from a sacrificial shrine, I've heard, but I'm not sure how. There are probably hints nearby the shrine.
The Passage (Quest)#009.dst: Duyduğuma göre mezara bir kurban sunağından girilebiliyormuş ama nasıl olduğunu bilmiyorum. Sunağın yakınlarında muhtemelen ipuçları vardır.
The Passage (Quest)#009.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#010.src: Bring me back [{~} Antic Bead] as a proof of its death, and I will let you become a citizen.
The Passage (Quest)#010.dst: Ölümünün kanıtı olarak bana [{~} Antic Bead] getir, ben de vatandaş olmana izin vereyim.
The Passage (Quest)#010.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#011.src: I've marked the direction to the shrine in your book. Remember, there should be hints right nearby the shrine. Good luck.
The Passage (Quest)#011.dst: Sunağın yönünü kitabına işaretledim. Unutma, sunağın hemen yakınında ipuçları olmalı. Bol şans.
The Passage (Quest)#011.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#012.src: Search for clues near [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring back [{~} Antic Bead] to Ildan.
The Passage (Quest)#012.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] yakınlarında ipucu ara ve Ildan'a [{~} Antic Bead] getir.

The Passage (Quest)#014.src: Well, welcome to this town, adventurer! You are now officially a citizen.
The Passage (Quest)#014.dst: Eh, kasabamıza hoş geldin, maceracı! Artık resmen vatandaşsın.
The Passage (Quest)#014.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#015.src: Oh, but before you go! I do have a few things to say. First, about the beads here.
The Passage (Quest)#015.dst: Ah, ama gitmeden önce! Söyleyeceğim birkaç şey var. İlki, buradaki boncuklar hakkında.
The Passage (Quest)#015.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#016.src: The tribesmen accept these as currency, so if you collect enough, I've heard they can offer you powerful masks.
The Passage (Quest)#016.dst: Kabile üyeleri bunları para olarak kabul ediyor, yeterince toplarsan sana güçlü maskeler verebildiklerini duydum.
The Passage (Quest)#016.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#017.src: Second, about the shrine. Now, this is just a rumor, but apparently that tomb is not unique.
The Passage (Quest)#017.dst: İkincisi, sunak hakkında. Bu sadece bir söylenti ama görünüşe göre o mezar tek değilmiş.
The Passage (Quest)#017.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#018.src: There are supposed to be a bunch of these altars scattered around the province, even in Gavel too!
The Passage (Quest)#018.dst: Güya eyaletin dört bir yanına dağılmış bu sunaklardan bir sürü varmış, Gavel'da bile!
The Passage (Quest)#018.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#019.src: If true, you should look for them. While the fights will be tough, I would imagine great rewards could be gotten from them!
The Passage (Quest)#019.dst: Doğruysa onları aramalısın. Dövüşler zorlu olacak ama bence onlardan büyük ödüller kazanılabilir!
The Passage (Quest)#019.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#020.src: Anyway, I've talked enough. I'm proud to have such a powerful fighter join our town! I wish you luck, friend!
The Passage (Quest)#020.dst: Neyse, yeterince konuştum. Böyle güçlü bir savaşçının kasabamıza katılmasından gurur duyuyorum! Bol şans, dostum!
The Passage (Quest)#020.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#023.src: I'm sure you've noticed, but there is a tribe camp not far from here.
The Passage (Quest)#023.dst: Fark etmişsindir ama buradan pek uzak olmayan bir kabile kampı var.
The Passage (Quest)#023.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#024.src: They quickly realised that it was a bad idea, so they locked him in a tomb.
The Passage (Quest)#024.dst: Bunun kötü bir fikir olduğunu çabucak anladılar ve onu bir mezara kilitlediler.
The Passage (Quest)#024.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#025.src: Have you found the shrine yet? I've heard that throwing something as tribute to it could do the trick... There should be clues about what it might be near the shrine.
The Passage (Quest)#025.dst: Sunağı buldun mu? Ona haraç olarak bir şey atmanın işe yarayabileceğini duydum... Ne olabileceğine dair ipuçları sunağın yakınında olmalı.

The Passage (Quest)#026.src: Sorry man, if you haven't got any business with me then I can't talk.
The Passage (Quest)#026.dst: Kusura bakma dostum, benimle bir işin yoksa konuşamam.
The Passage (Quest)#026.speaker: Troms Citizen 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿢 󐀂

The Passage (Quest)#027.src: Well... I'm glad it worked out for you.
The Passage (Quest)#027.dst: Eh... Senin için iyi sonuçlandığına sevindim.

similar.text: Glad to see you again!

The Passage (Quest)#029.src: Have you heard tales about the great General Skien? Many years ago, he led the Tromsian Army into battle.
The Passage (Quest)#029.dst: Büyük General Skien'in hikâyelerini duydun mu? Yıllar önce Troms Ordusu'nu savaşa götürmüştü.
The Passage (Quest)#029.speaker:
Troms Citizen
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

The Passage (Quest)#030.src: But what is most famous about him is not stories of victory, but rather something much more mysterious.
The Passage (Quest)#030.dst: Ama onu en ünlü yapan şey zafer hikâyeleri değil, çok daha gizemli bir şey.
The Passage (Quest)#030.speaker:
Troms Citizen
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

The Passage (Quest)#031.src: One day, Skien started acting very strange, and he vanished along with the entire Tromsian Army.
The Passage (Quest)#031.dst: Bir gün Skien çok tuhaf davranmaya başladı ve bütün Troms Ordusu ile birlikte ortadan kayboldu.

The Price of Ingenuity#002.src: Previously implemented locomotive models employ an engine with relatively low efficiency.
The Price of Ingenuity#002.dst: Daha önce kullanılan lokomotif modellerinin motorları görece düşük verimlidir.

The Price of Ingenuity#003.src: Rest for the night in you room in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#004.src: ...what. Where is it? W-where is it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#004.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#005.dst: Hop, hop, sakin ol! Ne oluyor-
The Price of Ingenuity#005.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#006.src: My bow, Yuman! Where is it? WHERE did you put it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#006.dst: Yayım, Yuman! Nerede? NEREYE koydun onu?!
The Price of Ingenuity#006.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#007.src: Hey, hey, relax, jeez! It's over here, on the meeting table! It fell off your bed in the early morning, so I figured I'd put it somewhere safe!
The Price of Ingenuity#007.dst: Hey, hey, rahat ol, ya! Burada işte, toplantı masasında! Sabaha karşı yatağından düştü, ben de güvenli bir yere koyayım dedim!
The Price of Ingenuity#007.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#008.src: I didn't, like, snatch it off ya or anything! Sorry, man! My bad. I forgot you got like this.
The Price of Ingenuity#008.dst: Yani elinden falan kapmadım ki! Kusura bakma, dostum! Benim hatam. Bu konuda böyle olduğunu unuttum.
The Price of Ingenuity#008.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#010.src: Sorry. For shouting at you. I... don't know what came over me.
The Price of Ingenuity#010.dst: Özür dilerim. Sana bağırdığım için. Ben... bana ne oldu bilmiyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#010.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#011.src: Hey, it's all good! I get grouchy too when one of my bros moves my stuff without tellin' me! 'Kay, well, maybe not that grouchy, but- I sorta get it, is what I mean.
The Price of Ingenuity#011.dst: Hey, sorun yok! Kankalarımdan biri haber vermeden eşyalarımı kurcalayınca ben de huysuzlanırım! Tamam, belki o kadar değil, ama- yani biraz anlıyorum, onu diyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#011.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#012.src: Mmh. Did I ever tell you about it back when I was staying here?
The Price of Ingenuity#012.dst: Hmm. Burada kaldığım zamanlar sana bundan hiç bahsetmiş miydim?
The Price of Ingenuity#012.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#013.src: Nah, don't think you ever did. You were still keepin' everyone an arm's length away back then, so I didn't want to push my luck.
The Price of Ingenuity#013.dst: Yok, bahsettiğini sanmıyorum. O zamanlar herkesle aranda hâlâ mesafe vardı, ben de üstüne gitmek istemedim.
The Price of Ingenuity#013.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#014.src: Right... right. It's not even that big of a deal. My bow's just... important to me.
The Price of Ingenuity#014.dst: Doğru... doğru. Aslında o kadar büyük bir mesele değil. Yayım benim için... önemli, o kadar.
The Price of Ingenuity#014.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#015.src: Yes, I know I look silly walking around with the bulky thing all day! But I can't afford to lose it. I need it. I can't explain why, but I do.
The Price of Ingenuity#015.dst: Evet, bütün gün o koca şeyle dolaşırken komik göründüğümü biliyorum! Ama onu kaybetmeyi göze alamam. Ona ihtiyacım var. Nedenini açıklayamam ama var.
The Price of Ingenuity#015.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#016.src: Nah that's cool, man! If we're talkin' silly, just take a look at me! I fight using my GUITAR! How d'you get sillier than that?
The Price of Ingenuity#016.dst: Yok, gayet normal, dostum! Komiklikten bahsediyorsak bir de bana bak! Ben GİTARIMLA dövüşüyorum! Bundan daha komiği olur mu?
The Price of Ingenuity#016.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#017.src: Pff, ha! What, do you just play bad music until your enemies give up? "Please, stop, I can't bear it! The melody's too discordant!"
The Price of Ingenuity#017.dst: Pff, ha! Ne yani, düşmanların pes edene kadar kötü müzik mi çalıyorsun? "Lütfen, dur, dayanamıyorum! Melodi çok ahenksiz!"
The Price of Ingenuity#017.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#018.src: Hahahah! That'd be fun, I should try that! But nah, I just club 'em with it. Yus stuck some metal plates in, so it hurts more and doesn't break!
The Price of Ingenuity#018.dst: Hahahah! Komik olurdu, bir denemeliyim! Ama yok, onunla kafalarına geçiriyorum sadece. Yus içine metal plakalar taktı, hem daha çok acıtıyor hem de kırılmıyor!
The Price of Ingenuity#018.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#019.src: Wow. You're right, that's way sillier than what I do. I've got to tell Zeph about this.
The Price of Ingenuity#019.dst: Vay. Haklısın, bu benimkinden çok daha komik. Bunu Zeph'e anlatmam lazım.
The Price of Ingenuity#019.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#020.src: Woah, hey! You don't gotta do that, let him think I'm cool! But, uh, jokes aside. Feeling better?
The Price of Ingenuity#020.dst: Hop, hey! Anlatmana gerek yok, bırak beni havalı sansın! Ama, şey, şaka bir yana. Daha iyi misin?
The Price of Ingenuity#020.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#022.src: Good! Cool, then you should wake up the rest of your gang. Quill said he'd be over soon, wanted to talk to you about something.
The Price of Ingenuity#022.dst: Güzel! Tamamdır, o zaman ekibinin geri kalanını uyandır. Quill birazdan uğrayacağını söyledi, seninle bir şey konuşmak istiyormuş.
The Price of Ingenuity#022.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#023.src: Wake up the other three members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#026.src: Morning, Sui! She's not exactly a... morning person. Guess I forgot to warn you!
The Price of Ingenuity#026.dst: Günaydın, Sui! Kendisi pek... sabah insanı sayılmaz. Seni uyarmayı unuttum galiba!
The Price of Ingenuity#026.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#030.src: Why'd you wake me up? Um, this early.
The Price of Ingenuity#030.dst: Beni neden uyandırdınız? Şey, bu kadar erken.
The Price of Ingenuity#030.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#033.src: Um... is he... expecting me to, ha, prepare, breakfast? Oh, no...
The Price of Ingenuity#033.dst: Şey... yoksa o... benden, ha, kahvaltı, hazırlamamı mı bekliyor? Eyvah...
The Price of Ingenuity#033.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#035.src: And there she goes. Well, no stopping her anxieties now! Might as well just let her get it out of her system.
The Price of Ingenuity#035.dst: İşte başladı. Eh, artık kaygılarını kimse durduramaz! En iyisi bırakalım, içini döksün.
The Price of Ingenuity#035.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#038.src: Ah, yes, I had overheard! I assume he has some work for us then.
The Price of Ingenuity#038.dst: Ah, evet, kulağıma çalınmıştı! Demek bize bir işi var.
The Price of Ingenuity#038.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#039.src: Allow me to go freshen up, and then I will join you.
The Price of Ingenuity#039.dst: İzninizle biraz toparlanayım, sonra size katılırım.
The Price of Ingenuity#039.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#040.src: Surprisingly so, yes! These beds were much more comfortable than I had anticipated...
The Price of Ingenuity#040.dst: Şaşırtıcı ama evet! Bu yataklar beklediğimden çok daha rahatmış...
The Price of Ingenuity#040.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#041.src: However... hm. I appear to have been afflicted with repeating night terrors.
The Price of Ingenuity#041.dst: Yalnız... hmm. Görünüşe bakılırsa tekrar tekrar kâbuslarla boğuşuyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#041.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#042.src: Reality is setting in, in a sense. Returning to the {p} now is out of the question. We cannot come home until the deed is done.
The Price of Ingenuity#042.dst: Gerçek bir bakıma yavaş yavaş oturuyor. {p} bölgesine şimdi dönmek söz konusu bile değil. İş bitmeden eve dönemeyiz.
The Price of Ingenuity#042.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#043.src: It does weigh on me a little. We have made new friends and allies here, but this is the furthest away I have ever been from home.
The Price of Ingenuity#043.dst: Bu biraz içime dokunuyor. Burada yeni dostlar ve müttefikler edindik, ama evden hiç bu kadar uzak kalmamıştım.
The Price of Ingenuity#043.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#044.src: Hm. I know the feeling, Mora. If it helps, it never really goes away, but it becomes... lighter. Easier to deal with.
The Price of Ingenuity#044.dst: Hmm. O duyguyu bilirim, Mora. Bir faydası olursa söyleyeyim, hiçbir zaman tam geçmiyor ama... hafifliyor. Katlanması kolaylaşıyor.
The Price of Ingenuity#044.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#045.src: Hoho! It does not especially, no. But I appreciate the sentiment. I am glad to have my family here with me.
The Price of Ingenuity#045.dst: Hoho! Pek bir faydası olmadı, hayır. Ama düşüncen için teşekkür ederim. Ailemin burada yanımda olmasına seviniyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#045.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#046.src: But enough of that! I heard Quill was coming over? I had best freshen up before he arrives. I will join the rest of you later.
The Price of Ingenuity#046.dst: Ama bu kadarı yeter! Quill'in geleceğini duydum? O gelmeden toparlansam iyi olur. Size sonra katılırım.
The Price of Ingenuity#046.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#048.src: Hrrk..... f-f-five more minutes, m- s- Synd- Zzzzzzzzz.....
The Price of Ingenuity#048.dst: Hrrk..... b-b-beş dakika daha, M- S- Synd- Zzzzzzzzz.....
The Price of Ingenuity#048.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#050.src: Okay, he's slept enough. What do you think, should I shoot him?
The Price of Ingenuity#050.dst: Tamam, bu kadar uyku yeter. Ne dersin, vurayım mı onu?
The Price of Ingenuity#050.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#051.src: Pfft! Ha, kidding. It wouldn't work anyway, he's stubborn enough to just roll over and keep sleeping.
The Price of Ingenuity#051.dst: Pfft! Ha, şaka şaka. Zaten işe yaramazdı, öyle inatçı ki dönüp uyumaya devam eder.
The Price of Ingenuity#051.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#052.src: Hm, what can we try... oh, I know.
The Price of Ingenuity#052.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#053.src: Oh, wow, these sure are some nice shiny and rare trinkets! Gosh, if only Zeph were awake, he'd love these. What a shame!
The Price of Ingenuity#053.dst: Vay canına, ne güzel, parlak, nadir biblolar bunlar! Ah, keşke Zeph uyanık olsaydı, bunlara bayılırdı. Ne yazık!
The Price of Ingenuity#053.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#054.src: This is a fun one! It's a passion project, inspired by one of my favorite books, an intriguing story of a girl and her friends saving the world.
The Price of Ingenuity#054.dst: Bu çok eğlenceli! Severek yaptığım bir proje; en sevdiğim kitaplardan birinden, dünyayı kurtaran bir kız ve arkadaşlarının merak uyandıran hikâyesinden ilham aldım.

The Price of Ingenuity#055.src: Oh, wow, these sure are some nice and shiny and rare trinkets! Gosh, if only Zeph were awake, he'd love these. What a shame!
The Price of Ingenuity#055.dst: Vay canına, ne güzel de parlak, nadir biblolar bunlar! Ah, keşke Zeph uyanık olsaydı, bunlara bayılırdı. Ne yazık!
The Price of Ingenuity#055.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#056.src: HUH! N-no, wait, I- I- I'm awake, where are- sh-sh-show me the t-trinkets, I want to see-
The Price of Ingenuity#056.dst: HA! H-hayır, dur, b- b- ben uyanığım, nerede- g-g-göster b-biblolar, görmek istiyorum-
The Price of Ingenuity#056.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#059.src: There aren't an-any tr-trinkets, are there.
The Price of Ingenuity#059.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#060.src: Nope! But I like the enthusiasm.
The Price of Ingenuity#060.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#061.src: Ugh... wh-why are you w-waking everyone up, anyway? I d-didn't think we had an-anything planned today..
The Price of Ingenuity#061.dst: Of... h-hem neden herkesi u-uyandırıyorsun ki? B-bugün p-planlı bir şeyimiz yok sanıyordum..
The Price of Ingenuity#061.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#062.src: O-oh! Uh... I- I- I- I slept... fine. G-g-good, even! Yeah!
The Price of Ingenuity#062.dst: A-ah! Şey... b- b- b- ben... iyi uyudum. G-g-güzel, hatta! Evet!
The Price of Ingenuity#062.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#064.src: H-hey! What's that s-s-supposed to mean!?
The Price of Ingenuity#064.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#065.src: You got in bed super late! And you know how I know that? Because your snoring only started waking me up after that!
The Price of Ingenuity#065.dst: Yatağa çok geç girdin! Nereden mi biliyorum? Çünkü horlaman beni ancak ondan sonra uyandırmaya başladı!
The Price of Ingenuity#065.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#066.src: I kept waking up thinking it was thundering outside, that's how loud it was!
The Price of Ingenuity#066.dst: Dışarıda gök gürlüyor sanıp durmadan uyandım, o kadar yüksekti!
The Price of Ingenuity#066.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#067.src: Wh-what?! N-n-no, that's not- {u}, b-back me up here! I- I wasn't sn-snoring loudly, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#067.dst: N-ne?! H-h-hayır, öyle değil- {u}, b-bana arka çık! B- ben yüksek sesle h-horlamıyordum, değil mi?
The Price of Ingenuity#067.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#068.src: S-see! It couldn't have been th-that bad.
The Price of Ingenuity#068.dst: G-gördün mü! O k-kadar kötü olamaz.
The Price of Ingenuity#068.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#069.src: Or maybe {u} needs to sleep lighter! Next thing you know, an enemy's gonna sneak up on you at night, and you're not gonna hear it because you're too used to Zeph's loud snoring!
The Price of Ingenuity#069.dst: Ya da belki {u} daha hafif uyumalı! Bir bakmışsın gece bir düşman sinsice yaklaşmış, sen de duymamışsın çünkü Zeph'in gürültülü horlamasına alışmışsın!
The Price of Ingenuity#069.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#070.src: Oh my g-gods... the whole station m-must have heard me!
The Price of Ingenuity#070.dst: Aman t-tanrılar... bütün istasyon b-beni duymuştur!
The Price of Ingenuity#070.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#071.src: It better have been just the station! Next thing you know, the crown's going to raid this hideout, and they would've only found it because your snoring echoes around {p} every night!
The Price of Ingenuity#071.dst: Umarım sadece istasyon duymuştur! Bir bakmışsın taç bu sığınağa baskın yapmış, hem de sırf senin horlaman her gece {p} boyunca yankılandığı için bulmuşlar!
The Price of Ingenuity#071.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#073.src: Oh! W-wonder what it's about. Do you-
The Price of Ingenuity#073.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#074.src: Do you think h-he's mad about my mistake?
The Price of Ingenuity#074.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#075.src: You heard him yourself, stupid. He wasn't mad! He thinks you did the right thing!
The Price of Ingenuity#075.dst: Kendin duydun, aptal. Kızgın değildi! Doğru olanı yaptığını düşünüyor!
The Price of Ingenuity#075.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#076.src: B-but... Still! Ugh. I'll have to go freshen up b-before he's here then!
The Price of Ingenuity#076.dst: A-ama... Yine de! Of. O zaman o gelmeden b-biraz toparlanmam lazım!
The Price of Ingenuity#076.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#077.src: And that leaves one more. Hm...
The Price of Ingenuity#077.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#078.src: {u}, you should let me wake her.
The Price of Ingenuity#078.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#079.src: She's... kind of like Sui, but more intense? In the way she's, y'know. Military trained.
The Price of Ingenuity#079.dst: Biraz Sui gibi, ama daha sert? Yani, bilirsin. Askeri eğitim almış.
The Price of Ingenuity#079.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#080.src: So it's probably better if I do it since I know what I'm dealing with!
The Price of Ingenuity#080.dst: O yüzden neyle uğraştığımı bildiğim için benim yapmam daha iyi!
The Price of Ingenuity#080.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#082.src: You know, you'd think she'd wake up at the crack of dawn with her military background... but nope.
The Price of Ingenuity#082.dst: Askeri geçmişi yüzünden gün ağarırken kalkar sanırsın... ama yok.
The Price of Ingenuity#082.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#086.src: I thought I'd be prepared for it, but nope...
The Price of Ingenuity#086.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#087.src: We thought you were asleep, Syndra! I was coming up to wake you!
The Price of Ingenuity#087.dst: Uyuyorsun sandık, Syndra! Seni uyandırmaya geliyordum!
The Price of Ingenuity#087.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#088.src: Well... I'm awake. Quill is stopping by, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#088.dst: Eh... uyanığım. Quill uğrayacak, değil mi?
The Price of Ingenuity#088.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#090.src: I've been awake for a while, Rex. I heard you talking about it downstairs!
The Price of Ingenuity#090.dst: Bir süredir uyanığım, Rex. Aşağıda konuştuğunuzu duydum!
The Price of Ingenuity#090.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#091.src: And here I thought I was a morning person...
The Price of Ingenuity#091.dst: Ben de kendimi sabah insanı sanırdım...
The Price of Ingenuity#091.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#093.src: Ah, hello! Good morning to you all.
The Price of Ingenuity#093.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#095.src: Oh, dear. What is with all the formality this morning?
The Price of Ingenuity#095.dst: Aman. Bu sabah bu resmiyet de ne böyle?
The Price of Ingenuity#095.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#096.src: Well, Yuman told us to be up and ready since you were coming-
The Price of Ingenuity#096.dst: Şey, Yuman sen geleceğin için hazır olmamızı söyledi-
The Price of Ingenuity#096.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#097.src: -so, naturally, the assumption was made that you had a mission for us-
The Price of Ingenuity#097.dst: -doğal olarak bize bir göreviniz olduğu varsayıldı-
The Price of Ingenuity#097.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#098.src: -o-o-or that w-we had done something wrong...
The Price of Ingenuity#098.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#101.src: Pahaha! Goodness, that was a lot all at once. Syndra, are they typically like this?
The Price of Ingenuity#101.dst: Pahaha! Aman, bir anda ne çok şey söylendi. Syndra, bunlar hep böyle midir?
The Price of Ingenuity#101.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#102.src: They're not usually this snappy, no. But between meeting the brothers and experiencing the Roughworks, they're probably getting swept up in their emotions.
The Price of Ingenuity#102.dst: Genelde bu kadar telaşlı değiller, hayır. Ama kardeşlerle tanışmak ve Roughworks'ü görmek derken duygularına kapılıyorlar herhalde.
The Price of Ingenuity#102.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#103.src: Ah... I understand, don't worry. But no, I'm not here to assign you all a mission, nor to scold you, or anything else of the sort.
The Price of Ingenuity#103.dst: Ah... anlıyorum, merak etmeyin. Ama hayır, size görev vermeye de, sizi azarlamaya da, öyle bir şeye de gelmedim.
The Price of Ingenuity#103.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#104.src: I simply wanted to offer you all a starting sum of tickets for the shops. I'd meant to give them yesterday, but in the chaos I forgot to.
The Price of Ingenuity#104.dst: Sadece dükkânlar için hepinize başlangıç olarak biraz fiş vermek istedim. Dün verecektim ama o karmaşada unuttum.
The Price of Ingenuity#104.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#105.src: The ticket system is used to ration out food and other items to people that need it. You'll receive a weekly allowance of tickets to spend on whatever you'd like, in addition to this starting sum.
The Price of Ingenuity#105.dst: Fiş sistemiyle ihtiyacı olanlara yiyecek ve başka eşyalar paylaştırılıyor. Bu başlangıç miktarının yanında, istediğiniz şeye harcamanız için her hafta fiş alacaksınız.
The Price of Ingenuity#105.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#106.src: Of course, basic amenities are free of charge if you're part of our community. Wouldn't want any of our members to sleep on the tracks, after all!
The Price of Ingenuity#106.dst: Elbette topluluğumuzun bir parçasıysanız temel ihtiyaçlar ücretsiz. Sonuçta üyelerimizden kimsenin rayların üstünde yatmasını istemeyiz!
The Price of Ingenuity#106.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#107.src: So... I baked bread for, um, no reason?
The Price of Ingenuity#107.dst: Yani... ekmeği, şey, boşuna mı pişirdim?
The Price of Ingenuity#107.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#108.src: I fear so, haha! Do not worry, you will not be forced to do work here.
The Price of Ingenuity#108.dst: Korkarım öyle, haha! Merak etme, burada kimse seni çalışmaya zorlamayacak.
The Price of Ingenuity#108.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#109.src: And, besides, if I wanted you to cook for us, I would have let you know well in advance.
The Price of Ingenuity#109.dst: Hem, bize yemek yapmanı isteseydim bunu çok önceden haber verirdim.
The Price of Ingenuity#109.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#110.src: I mean... I w-wouldn't mind some fr-fresh bread...
The Price of Ingenuity#110.dst: Yani... b-ben biraz t-taze ekmeğe hayır demem...
The Price of Ingenuity#110.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#112.src: Ah, one more thing. I wanted to point you all towards the training yard- Zeph, I believe you have been there already?
The Price of Ingenuity#112.dst: Ah, bir şey daha. Sizi eğitim alanına yönlendirmek istiyordum- Zeph, sen oraya gitmiştin sanırım?
The Price of Ingenuity#112.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#114.src: I believe the brothers should be there right now. If you're to be working with us, it would be best to get used to each other's fighting styles.
The Price of Ingenuity#114.dst: Kardeşler şu an orada olmalı. Bizimle çalışacaksanız birbirinizin dövüş tarzına alışmanız en iyisi olur.
The Price of Ingenuity#114.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#115.src: Why don't you go join them there, while Syndra and I discuss further matters?
The Price of Ingenuity#115.dst: Syndra ile ben başka meseleleri konuşurken siz neden onların yanına gitmiyorsunuz?
The Price of Ingenuity#115.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#116.src: Find the brothers at the training yard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#117.src: ...do you really gotta head out there again?
The Price of Ingenuity#117.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#118.src: You know contracts are rare, man. I have to take what I can get.
The Price of Ingenuity#118.dst: Sözleşmelerin az bulunduğunu biliyorsun, dostum. Ne bulursam almak zorundayım.
The Price of Ingenuity#118.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#119.src: Why's it always gotta be you and Yus heading out?! For once- for once, man, take care of yourself!
The Price of Ingenuity#119.dst: Neden hep sen ve Yus gitmek zorundasınız?! Bir kere- bir kere olsun, dostum, kendine dikkat et!
The Price of Ingenuity#119.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#123.src: No, this can wait. Did Quill send you over?
The Price of Ingenuity#123.dst: Hayır, bu bekleyebilir. Sizi Quill mi gönderdi?
The Price of Ingenuity#123.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#124.src: Indeed he did. He suggested we get to know each other's fighting styles!
The Price of Ingenuity#124.dst: Evet, o gönderdi. Birbirimizin dövüş tarzlarını tanımamızı önerdi!
The Price of Ingenuity#124.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#125.src: Not a bad idea. Yuman and I would be happy to show off what we can do, right?
The Price of Ingenuity#125.dst: Fena fikir değil. Yuman'la ben neler yapabildiğimizi göstermekten memnuniyet duyarız, değil mi?
The Price of Ingenuity#125.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#127.src: Well, Zeph, {u}, and I've already been through it! Some cool moves from you both! Man, getting to see a cursed one in action was awesome...
The Price of Ingenuity#127.dst: Eh, Zeph, {u} ve ben bunu zaten yaptık! İkinizin de havalı hareketleri vardı! Dostum, bir lanetliyi iş başında görmek müthişti...
The Price of Ingenuity#127.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#129.src: Yeah! Like, I'd hear all the stories, and think... man, having those kinds of powers sounds so cool. Sometimes I wished I could have em! Without, uh, being evil, of course.
The Price of Ingenuity#129.dst: Evet! Yani, bütün o hikâyeleri dinler, düşünürdüm... dostum, öyle güçlere sahip olmak çok havalı olmalı. Bazen bende de olsun isterdim! Kötü olmadan tabii, şey.
The Price of Ingenuity#129.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#130.src: You'd be even harder to deal with if you did, bro. But on that subject- Quill said something about you all practicing... what was the word he used... "magic?"
The Price of Ingenuity#130.dst: Öyle olsaydı seninle başa çıkmak daha da zor olurdu, kanka. Ama madem konu açıldı- Quill sizin bir şey çalıştığınızdan bahsetti... neydi o kelime... "büyü?"
The Price of Ingenuity#130.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#131.src: What?! Ey, princess, why didn't you show anything off the other day?
The Price of Ingenuity#131.dst: Ne?! Hey, prenses, geçen gün neden hiçbir şey göstermedin?
The Price of Ingenuity#131.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#133.src: Don't be insensitive, Yuman. It isn't something people just... pick up.
The Price of Ingenuity#133.dst: Düşüncesizlik etme, Yuman. Öyle hemen... kapılacak bir şey değil.
The Price of Ingenuity#133.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#134.src: From what little I've heard from Quill, it can take years of study to master a blessing... so I wouldn't be surprised if they couldn't even make a spark! Uh, no offense.
The Price of Ingenuity#134.dst: Quill'den duyduğum kadarıyla bir kutsamada ustalaşmak yıllarca çalışmayı gerektirebilirmiş... o yüzden tek bir kıvılcım bile çıkaramasanız şaşırmam! Şey, alınma.
The Price of Ingenuity#134.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#135.src: W- well... maybe we'll s- sur- surprise you!
The Price of Ingenuity#135.dst: Ş- şey... belki sizi ş- şaş- şaşırtırız!
The Price of Ingenuity#135.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#136.src: Ha, think you're the only ones with hidden talents? I've got a trick or two up my sleeve too!
The Price of Ingenuity#136.dst: Ha, gizli yetenekleri olan bir tek siz mi sandınız? Benim de cebimde bir iki numara var!
The Price of Ingenuity#136.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#138.src: It's an expression, dumbass. Like you're one to talk. Why are you half-naked?
The Price of Ingenuity#138.dst: Deyim o, salak. Sen de konuşacak adam mısın? Neden yarı çıplaksın?
The Price of Ingenuity#138.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#139.src: To show off my abs? Obviously. Anyway, {u}, why don't you decide who goes first?
The Price of Ingenuity#139.dst: Karın kaslarımı göstermek için tabii ki? Neyse, {u}, ilk kimin başlayacağına sen karar versene?
The Price of Ingenuity#139.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#141.src: Who, me? Sorry, but I'll sit this one out until you're all done.
The Price of Ingenuity#141.dst: Kim, ben mi? Kusura bakma ama hepiniz bitirene kadar bu turu pas geçiyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#141.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#142.src: Got to save the best for last, right? Heh.
The Price of Ingenuity#142.dst: En iyisini sona saklamak lazım, değil mi? Heh.
The Price of Ingenuity#142.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#143.src: I'll have to add arrows until my bowstring runs out of space next time...
The Price of Ingenuity#143.dst: Bir dahaki sefere kirişte yer kalmayana kadar ok eklemem lazım...
The Price of Ingenuity#143.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#144.src: I'll h-have to come back here a-again tonight!
The Price of Ingenuity#144.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#145.src: It's like there's ripples gently spreading within me...
The Price of Ingenuity#145.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#146.src: To see my powers growing this clearly...
The Price of Ingenuity#146.dst: Güçlerimin bu kadar belirgin şekilde büyüdüğünü görmek...
The Price of Ingenuity#146.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#148.src: Dang, I think I overloaded it. I'll have to put it through a charge cycle...
The Price of Ingenuity#148.dst: Hay aksi, galiba aşırı yükledim. Bir şarj döngüsünden geçirmem lazım...
The Price of Ingenuity#148.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#150.src: So. Magic, curses, blessings... whatever you want to call it, it hasn't worked for me. It just doesn't... click.
The Price of Ingenuity#150.dst: Evet. Büyü, lanet, kutsama... ne dersen de, bende işe yaramadı. Bir türlü... oturmuyor.
The Price of Ingenuity#150.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#151.src: Ah, not to worry, Rex! Even without it, none in the province could match your accuracy with a bow.
The Price of Ingenuity#151.dst: Ah, hiç dert etme, Rex! O olmadan da eyalette kimse yaydaki isabetinle boy ölçüşemez.
The Price of Ingenuity#151.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#152.src: Y- yeah! And if you d- did get magic, it'd j- jus- just be unfair for the rest of us!
The Price of Ingenuity#152.dst: E- evet! Hem sende de büyü olsaydı, b- bi- bizim için hiç adil olmazdı!
The Price of Ingenuity#152.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#153.src: Yeah, yeah, sure. Either way, I've been practicing a new technique... let's see if I can pull it off.
The Price of Ingenuity#153.dst: Evet, evet, tabii. Neyse, yeni bir teknik üzerinde çalışıyorum... bakalım becerebilecek miyim.
The Price of Ingenuity#153.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#155.src: Yep! I just place every arrow on the string at once, which lets me shoot at a much larger area!
The Price of Ingenuity#155.dst: Evet! Bütün okları aynı anda kirişe yerleştiriyorum, böylece çok daha geniş bir alana atış yapabiliyorum!
The Price of Ingenuity#155.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#156.src: But... how'd you manage to hit each arrow right on target?! That's... insane!
The Price of Ingenuity#156.dst: Ama... her oku nasıl tam hedefe isabet ettirdin?! Bu... delilik!
The Price of Ingenuity#156.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#157.src: Ha. Go on, keep praising my skill. That was actually the first time I tried that many arrows at once... glad it worked out!
The Price of Ingenuity#157.dst: Ha. Devam et, övmeye devam et becerimi. Aslında o kadar oku ilk kez aynı anda deniyordum... işe yaramasına sevindim!
The Price of Ingenuity#157.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#158.src: The... first... You said you'd practiced it, man! What do you mean that was the first time?!
The Price of Ingenuity#158.dst: İlk... kez mi... Çalıştığını söylemiştin, dostum! Ne demek ilk kezdi?!
The Price of Ingenuity#158.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#159.src: Yeah? I practiced theoretically. In my head. Keep up, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#159.dst: Evet? Teoride çalıştım. Kafamda. Ayak uydur, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#159.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#161.src: Couldn't even make a spark, eh?
The Price of Ingenuity#161.dst: Tek bir kıvılcım bile çıkaramazlar, ha?
The Price of Ingenuity#161.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#162.src: Alright, alright! I've been proven wrong.
The Price of Ingenuity#162.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#164.src: So... I w-want to first say that I've been c-coming here every night.
The Price of Ingenuity#164.dst: Şey... önce h-her gece buraya g-geldiğimi söylemek istiyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#164.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#165.src: I was e-embarrassed that I just didn't g-get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#165.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#166.src: I mean, j-just look at how fast your m-magic developed, Mora!
The Price of Ingenuity#166.dst: Yani, b-bir baksana senin b-büyün ne kadar hızlı gelişti, Mora!
The Price of Ingenuity#166.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#167.src: And you, S-sui! You are a natural, a-after all.
The Price of Ingenuity#167.dst: Ya sen, S-sui! Sen zaten d-doğuştan yeteneklisin.
The Price of Ingenuity#167.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#168.src: I still don't know any form of magic. Why feel so embarassed?
The Price of Ingenuity#168.dst: Ben hâlâ hiçbir büyü bilmiyorum. Neden bu kadar utanıyorsun?
The Price of Ingenuity#168.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#169.src: Rex, you don't even n-need magic to be a valuable asset! You're the best archer in the w-world!
The Price of Ingenuity#169.dst: Rex, senin değerli olmak için b-büyüye ihtiyacın bile yok! Sen d-dünyanın en iyi okçususun!
The Price of Ingenuity#169.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#170.src: I don't h-have that skill! My blade skills a-aren't good enough! You've h-had to save me time and time a-again.
The Price of Ingenuity#170.dst: Bende o beceri y-yok! Kılıç becerilerim y-yeterince iyi değil! Beni defalarca k-kurtarmak zorunda kaldın.
The Price of Ingenuity#170.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#171.src: And {u}, I felt like I had l-let you down after all the k-knowledge you had given me.
The Price of Ingenuity#171.dst: Sen de {u}, bana verdiğin onca b-bilgiden sonra seni h-hayal kırıklığına uğrattığımı hissettim.
The Price of Ingenuity#171.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#172.src: I may not have talked to you a lot, Zeph. But from what I know of the science behind magic, you don't have to blame yourself for not getting it.
The Price of Ingenuity#172.dst: Seninle pek konuşmamış olabilirim, Zeph. Ama büyünün arkasındaki bilim hakkında bildiklerime göre, anlayamadın diye kendini suçlamana gerek yok.
The Price of Ingenuity#172.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#173.src: A lot of people study magic their whole lives. I'm sure you'll get there eventually.
The Price of Ingenuity#173.dst: Birçok insan bütün hayatı boyunca büyü çalışır. Eninde sonunda başaracağından eminim.
The Price of Ingenuity#173.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#174.src: Thank y-you, Yusanu. However, I think I f-finally figured it out...
The Price of Ingenuity#174.dst: T-teşekkürler, Yusanu. Ama sanırım s-sonunda çözdüm...
The Price of Ingenuity#174.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#176.src: I think I'm finally g-getting this magic thing somewhat down!
The Price of Ingenuity#176.dst: Sanırım bu büyü işini sonunda b-biraz kavrıyorum!
The Price of Ingenuity#176.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#177.src: I will n-not stop practicing! N-not until I can m-m-match you all!
The Price of Ingenuity#177.dst: Çalışmayı b-bırakmayacağım! S-sizinle b-b-boy ölçüşebilene kadar asla!
The Price of Ingenuity#177.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#178.dst: Benim de, şey, yapmam şart mı?
The Price of Ingenuity#178.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#179.src: Come on, man! Show us what you've got!
The Price of Ingenuity#179.dst: Hadi ama, dostum! Neler yapabildiğini göster!
The Price of Ingenuity#179.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#180.src: ...okay. I've tried to, um, practice a bit, now that I'm... yeah.
The Price of Ingenuity#180.dst: ...peki. Biraz, şey, çalışmaya çalıştım, artık ben... şey.
The Price of Ingenuity#180.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#181.src: I haven't fully developed it, but, I have this new skill...
The Price of Ingenuity#181.dst: Tam geliştiremedim ama, yeni bir becerim var...
The Price of Ingenuity#181.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#182.src: Okay! I'm going to try it!
The Price of Ingenuity#182.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#183.src: W- woah! It's like you ma- made that out of n- n- nothing!
The Price of Ingenuity#183.dst: V- vay! Sanki y- y- yoktan v- var ettin!
The Price of Ingenuity#183.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#184.src: ...ugh! It takes so much concentration... even a word makes me fail...
The Price of Ingenuity#184.dst: ...of! Çok fazla odaklanmak gerekiyor... tek bir kelime bile bozuyor...
The Price of Ingenuity#184.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#185.src: Also. It's not, um, out of nothing.
The Price of Ingenuity#185.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#186.src: It's like... there's an ocean of swirling energy, all around me. If I can get a bit, in, like... a bucket, I can use it. But... I don't know how to get it without, um, falling into it and getting overwhelmed.
The Price of Ingenuity#186.dst: Sanki... etrafımda dönüp duran bir enerji okyanusu var. Bir kısmını, şey... bir kovaya alabilirsem kullanabiliyorum. Ama... içine, şey, düşüp boğulmadan nasıl alacağımı bilmiyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#186.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#188.src: Uh... n- not- not really, but-
The Price of Ingenuity#188.dst: Şey... p- pek- pek değil, ama-
The Price of Ingenuity#188.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#193.src: I... I'm fine. No, even... more than that...
The Price of Ingenuity#193.dst: Ben... iyiyim. Hayır, hatta... daha da iyi...
The Price of Ingenuity#193.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#194.src: It's like... I finally felt this power's ebb and flow, not just... it pouring out, I...
The Price of Ingenuity#194.dst: Sanki... bu gücün gelgitini sonunda hissettim, sadece... taşıp akmasını değil, ben...
The Price of Ingenuity#194.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#195.src: ...ah! Is everyone fine? You... you all seem fine. Okay...
The Price of Ingenuity#195.dst: ...ah! Herkes iyi mi? Siz... iyi görünüyorsunuz. Tamam...
The Price of Ingenuity#195.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#196.src: I think... I think that's all from me.
The Price of Ingenuity#196.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#197.src: Very well! This is as good an opportunity as any to show off my progress!
The Price of Ingenuity#197.dst: Pekâlâ! İlerlememi göstermek için bundan iyi fırsat olmaz!
The Price of Ingenuity#197.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#198.src: Although I am proficient in combat with my hammer, that is... standard. So, allow me to show my magic instead, as that is what I have been training!
The Price of Ingenuity#198.dst: Çekicimle dövüşte ustayım ama bu... sıradan. O yüzden izin verin, bunun yerine üzerinde çalıştığım büyümü göstereyim!
The Price of Ingenuity#198.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#199.src: ...oh, dear. I did not expect it to have become so powerful! It seems I must still master control over it...
The Price of Ingenuity#199.dst: ...aman. Bu kadar güçlendiğini hiç beklemiyordum! Görünüşe bakılırsa onu kontrol etmeyi daha öğrenmem gerekiyor...
The Price of Ingenuity#199.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#200.src: I apologize for the damage I have caused. If you would ask for compensation, I would gladly provide it.
The Price of Ingenuity#200.dst: Verdiğim zarar için özür dilerim. Tazminat isterseniz memnuniyetle öderim.
The Price of Ingenuity#200.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#201.src: Eh, don't worry about it. It's just a training room. Besides, all this junk in here doesn't even work anymore.
The Price of Ingenuity#201.dst: Eh, dert etme. Alt tarafı bir eğitim odası. Hem buradaki hurdaların hiçbiri zaten çalışmıyor.
The Price of Ingenuity#201.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#203.src: Yo, that was badass, man! Your curse is awesome.
The Price of Ingenuity#203.dst: Hey, bu efsaneydi, dostum! Lanetin müthiş.
The Price of Ingenuity#203.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#204.src: Is it! I suppose it is, haha! I am glad to have had the oppurtunity to learn to use it.
The Price of Ingenuity#204.dst: Öyle mi! Sanırım öyle, haha! Onu kullanmayı öğrenme fırsatı bulduğuma seviniyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#204.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#205.src: That is all, then. Who will go next?
The Price of Ingenuity#205.dst: Benden bu kadar o hâlde. Sırada kim var?
The Price of Ingenuity#205.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#206.src: Lemme show you just what I can really do, man.
The Price of Ingenuity#206.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#207.src: Watch and learn, princess. Not every day you get to see me shred.
The Price of Ingenuity#207.dst: İzle ve öğren, prenses. Beni her gün döktürürken göremezsin.
The Price of Ingenuity#207.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#209.src: Yuman But wait! That's not all!
The Price of Ingenuity#209.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#210.src: My Sonic Boomer can help out with defense too! I'm no one trick pony - I can cover every genre of combat!
The Price of Ingenuity#210.dst: Sonic Boomer'ım savunmada da işe yarar! Tek numaralı değilim ben, dövüşün her türünden çalarım!
The Price of Ingenuity#210.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#211.src: And bam! That's it from me and Sonic Boomer for today.
The Price of Ingenuity#211.dst: Ve bam! Benden ve Sonic Boomer'dan bugünlük bu kadar.
The Price of Ingenuity#211.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#214.src: I'll say, I'm not as... direct... as Yuman. But I can hold my own in a fight.
The Price of Ingenuity#214.dst: Söyleyeyim, ben Yuman kadar... dolaysız... değilim. Ama dövüşte kendimi idare ederim.
The Price of Ingenuity#214.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#216.src: I mean... yeah? Yusanu made this thing for me, and he calls it the Electric Blaster.
The Price of Ingenuity#216.dst: Yani... evet? Bunu bana Yusanu yaptı, adını Electric Blaster koydu.
The Price of Ingenuity#216.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#217.src: It's also able to fire a much larger blast with way more power, but that does make it less... precise.
The Price of Ingenuity#217.dst: Çok daha güçlü, çok daha büyük bir atış da yapabiliyor, ama bu da onu daha az... isabetli yapıyor.
