The Price of Ingenuity#217.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#218.src: That's all from me. Next one!
The Price of Ingenuity#218.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#219.src: Alrighty! Let's see... where to start...
The Price of Ingenuity#219.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#220.src: Oh, you have gotta be... again?! Really?! Ugh!
The Price of Ingenuity#220.dst: Yok artık... yine mi?! Ciddi misin?! Of!
The Price of Ingenuity#220.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#221.src: Yulie, Yuman, can you check the tunnels for any intruders?
The Price of Ingenuity#221.dst: Yulie, Yuman, tünellerde davetsiz misafir var mı bir bakar mısınız?
The Price of Ingenuity#221.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#222.src: If you need us to. Keep us updated, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#222.dst: Gerekiyorsa bakarız. Bizi haberdar et, olur mu?
The Price of Ingenuity#222.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#223.src: Sure. Get the others to help you, I gotta run and check on things!
The Price of Ingenuity#223.dst: Tabii. Diğerlerinden de yardım alın, ben koşup işlere bakmalıyım!
The Price of Ingenuity#223.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#224.src: Of course we can help, just tell us what to do!
The Price of Ingenuity#224.dst: Elbette yardım edebiliriz, ne yapmamız gerektiğini söyleyin yeter!
The Price of Ingenuity#224.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#225.src: {u} and I actually have some important tasks Syndra needed done!! Will you be okay without us?
The Price of Ingenuity#225.dst: Aslında {u} ile benim Syndra'nın halletmemizi istediği önemli işlerimiz var!! Bizsiz idare edebilir misiniz?
The Price of Ingenuity#225.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#226.src: We will. It shouldn't be too hard for us, anyway- just routine check ups.
The Price of Ingenuity#226.dst: Ederiz. Zaten pek zor olmaz- rutin kontroller işte.
The Price of Ingenuity#226.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#227.src: Yep, yep! Alright guys, follow papa!
The Price of Ingenuity#227.dst: Evet, evet! Pekâlâ millet, babanızın peşinden gelin!
The Price of Ingenuity#227.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#228.src: Wh- what? Ugh... put some c- cl- clothes on, a- at- at least.
The Price of Ingenuity#228.dst: N- ne? Of... b- bari ü- üs- üstüne bir şeyler giy.
The Price of Ingenuity#228.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#232.src: I needed a way to get everyone else out of here so we could talk!
The Price of Ingenuity#232.dst: Konuşabilmemiz için herkesi buradan uzaklaştırmanın bir yolunu bulmam lazımdı!
The Price of Ingenuity#232.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#233.src: Yeah, obviously! It was the best excuse I could come up with in the moment.
The Price of Ingenuity#233.dst: Evet, tabii ki! O an aklıma gelen en iyi bahane buydu.
The Price of Ingenuity#233.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#234.src: So, look. Yusanu's been really hard to get a read of! He's barely ever around- I'm honestly surprised he even showed up today!
The Price of Ingenuity#234.dst: Bak şimdi. Yusanu'yu çözmek gerçekten çok zor! Neredeyse hiç ortalıkta yok- açıkçası bugün gelmesine bile şaşırdım!
The Price of Ingenuity#234.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#235.src: But anyway, when you and Zeph headed out with Yuman during the last alarm, I wanted to check in with Yusanu and see what he was up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#235.dst: Neyse, son alarmda sen ve Zeph Yuman'la çıktığınızda, Yusanu'ya uğrayıp ne yaptığına bakmak istedim.
The Price of Ingenuity#235.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#236.src: But guess what? He was gone! Walked into his workshop and never walked out. Isn't that weird?
The Price of Ingenuity#236.dst: Ama bil bakalım ne oldu? Yoktu! Atölyesine girmiş ve hiç çıkmamıştı. Tuhaf değil mi?
The Price of Ingenuity#236.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#237.src: I don't know what it means, and I don't know if he's a risk to us or not. But what I do know is that he's suspicious!
The Price of Ingenuity#237.dst: Bunun ne anlama geldiğini bilmiyorum, bizim için tehlike olup olmadığını da bilmiyorum. Ama şüpheli olduğunu biliyorum!
The Price of Ingenuity#237.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#238.src: Because they'd all probably tell me not to do anything impulsive right now. Which isn't even true, I've thought this plan out extensively!
The Price of Ingenuity#238.dst: Çünkü büyük ihtimalle hepsi şu an düşüncesizce bir şey yapmamamı söylerdi. Ki bu doğru bile değil, bu planı uzun uzun düşündüm!
The Price of Ingenuity#238.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#239.src: Come on, meet me outside his workshop! I just want to look. If it's nothing, then it's nothing! But I don't think it's nothing.
The Price of Ingenuity#239.dst: Hadi, atölyesinin dışında buluşalım! Sadece bir bakmak istiyorum. Bir şey yoksa yoktur! Ama bence bir şey var.
The Price of Ingenuity#239.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#241.src: I'll meet up with you at the workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#241.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#244.src: See? I told you! He's just... gone.
The Price of Ingenuity#244.dst: Gördün mü? Sana söylemiştim! Ortadan... kaybolmuş.
The Price of Ingenuity#244.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#245.src: Not even a trace... Seems like I wasn't distrustful for nothing. But how?
The Price of Ingenuity#245.dst: Tek bir iz bile yok... Demek boşuna şüphelenmemişim. Ama nasıl?
The Price of Ingenuity#245.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#246.src: He has to have gone somewhere! He couldn't have just... vanished.
The Price of Ingenuity#246.dst: Bir yere gitmiş olmalı! Öylece... buharlaşıp gidemez.
The Price of Ingenuity#246.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#247.src: There has to be something else going on here! Do you see why I suspect him now?
The Price of Ingenuity#247.dst: Burada başka bir şeyler dönüyor olmalı! Ondan neden şüphelendiğimi şimdi anlıyor musun?
The Price of Ingenuity#247.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#248.src: Let's snoop around a bit and make sure he's not posing a threat to us.
The Price of Ingenuity#248.dst: Biraz etrafı kolaçan edelim, bizim için tehlike oluşturmadığından emin olalım.
The Price of Ingenuity#248.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#249.src: I'm glad you feel that way. Makes me feel less... horrible... about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#249.dst: Böyle hissetmene sevindim. Bu konuda kendimi daha az... berbat... hissediyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#249.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#250.src: I guess we can be horrible people together, then.
The Price of Ingenuity#250.dst: O zaman berbat insanlar olmayı birlikte yaparız herhalde.
The Price of Ingenuity#250.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#251.src: I get it, trust me. They've taken us in and given us a place to stay, and now...
The Price of Ingenuity#251.dst: Anlıyorum, inan bana. Bizi aralarına aldılar, kalacak yer verdiler, şimdi de...
The Price of Ingenuity#251.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#252.src: If we're wrong, if I'm wrong, then we both might get thrown out.
The Price of Ingenuity#252.dst: Yanılıyorsak, ben yanılıyorsam, ikimiz de kapı dışarı edilebiliriz.
The Price of Ingenuity#252.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#253.src: The blame will land squarely on us both. I really hope that even if we are kicked out, the rest can still stay here...
The Price of Ingenuity#253.dst: Bütün suç ikimizin üstüne kalır. Bizi kovsalar bile umarım diğerleri burada kalabilir...
The Price of Ingenuity#253.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#254.src: ...no time to dwell on that. He must have left the workshop through an exit somewhere. Let's look around and see what we can find.
The Price of Ingenuity#254.dst: ...bunu düşünecek vakit yok. Atölyeden bir yerdeki bir çıkıştan gitmiş olmalı. Etrafa bakıp neler bulabileceğimize bakalım.
The Price of Ingenuity#254.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#255.src: Try and find Yusanu in his workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#256.src: Aha! And you thought I was just being paranoid.
The Price of Ingenuity#256.dst: Aha! Bir de beni sadece paranoyak sanıyordun.
The Price of Ingenuity#256.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#257.src: But you were thinking it, I could tell!
The Price of Ingenuity#257.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#258.src: Okay, fine, maybe a little. But I was right to be!
The Price of Ingenuity#258.dst: Tamam, peki, belki birazcık. Ama haklıymışım!
The Price of Ingenuity#258.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#259.src: That's confirmation. Though, not like we needed it...
The Price of Ingenuity#259.dst: Bu da kanıtı. Gerçi ihtiyacımız yoktu ya...
The Price of Ingenuity#259.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#262.src: Yusanu's really puulling out all the stops to make sure nobody follows him!
The Price of Ingenuity#262.dst: Yusanu kimse onu takip etmesin diye gerçekten her yolu deniyor!
The Price of Ingenuity#262.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#263.src: Too bad we're persistent, though. There's got to be some way to open it, we just need to find it!
The Price of Ingenuity#263.dst: Ama ne yazık ki biz ısrarcıyız. Açmanın bir yolu olmalı, sadece bulmamız lazım!
The Price of Ingenuity#263.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#264.src: Whatever you did seems to have worked, the door's open!
The Price of Ingenuity#264.dst: Ne yaptıysan işe yaradı galiba, kapı açıldı!
The Price of Ingenuity#264.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#266.src: Dead end? No, I see something on the other side...
The Price of Ingenuity#266.dst: Çıkmaz mı? Hayır, karşı tarafta bir şey görüyorum...
The Price of Ingenuity#266.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#267.src: How do we get across? I guess you could try to use your magic... but I don't want you to put yourself at risk just cause I dragged you along for this.
The Price of Ingenuity#267.dst: Karşıya nasıl geçeceğiz? Büyünü kullanmayı deneyebilirsin herhalde... ama sırf seni bu işe sürükledim diye kendini tehlikeye atmanı istemem.
The Price of Ingenuity#267.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#270.src: Oh! Yusanu has to have taken this way, there aren't any other options. So, there's a trick to it...
The Price of Ingenuity#270.dst: Ah! Yusanu bu yoldan gitmiş olmalı, başka seçenek yok. Demek ki bir numarası var...
The Price of Ingenuity#270.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#271.src: Look, over there! Do you see the button on the other side? I bet he uses it to close off this path whenever he takes it.
The Price of Ingenuity#271.dst: Bak, şurada! Karşı taraftaki düğmeyi görüyor musun? Bahse girerim bu yoldan her geçtiğinde onunla yolu kapatıyor.
The Price of Ingenuity#271.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#272.src: It's a good thing you have the best sharpshooter in all of Fruma on your side! A shot like that is nothing to me.
The Price of Ingenuity#272.dst: İyi ki yanında bütün Fruma'nın en iyi nişancısı var! Öyle bir atış benim için çocuk oyuncağı.
The Price of Ingenuity#272.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#273.src: Just a moment... need to line it up... just right...
The Price of Ingenuity#273.dst: Bir saniye... nişan almam lazım... tam... böyle...
The Price of Ingenuity#273.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#274.src: Got it! Oh, that's more precarious than I expected. Be careful!
The Price of Ingenuity#274.dst: Tamamdır! Ah, beklediğimden daha tehlikeli duruyor. Dikkatli ol!
The Price of Ingenuity#274.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#276.src: ...okay, why are we right outside the Sovereign's mansion?!
The Price of Ingenuity#276.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#277.src: This place is so heavily guarded, and he just has a secret tunnel directly to the front door?!
The Price of Ingenuity#277.dst: Burası o kadar sıkı korunuyor ki, adamın ön kapıya doğrudan giden gizli bir tüneli mi var?!
The Price of Ingenuity#277.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#279.src: We can't just leave it here, obviously, but we're definitely not getting through the front door...
The Price of Ingenuity#279.dst: Tabii ki öylece bırakamayız ama ön kapıdan kesinlikle giremeyiz...
The Price of Ingenuity#279.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#280.src: Look, up there. The arch connects to the main structure, and probably has a way inside.
The Price of Ingenuity#280.dst: Bak, şurada. Kemer ana yapıya bağlanıyor, muhtemelen içeri girecek bir yolu vardır.
The Price of Ingenuity#280.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#281.src: Maybe we can get up by climbing this building over here!
The Price of Ingenuity#281.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#282.src: Travel up the nearby building at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and enter Soosu's mansion.
The Price of Ingenuity#282.dst: Yakındaki binaya tırman [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] ve Soosu'nun malikânesine gir.

The Price of Ingenuity#283.src: Sneak through Soosu's mansion looking for Yusanu at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#283.dst: Soosu'nun malikânesinde gizlice dolaşıp Yusanu'yu ara: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#284.src: ... Hey, stay on your guard. We don't want to get caught in here.
The Price of Ingenuity#284.dst: ... Hey, tetikte ol. Burada yakalanmak istemeyiz.
The Price of Ingenuity#284.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#285.src: Though... it's kind of quiet in here. Weird.
The Price of Ingenuity#285.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#286.src: Okay. Okay okay. That's a lot of buttons.
The Price of Ingenuity#286.dst: Tamam. Tamam tamam. Bir sürü düğme var.
The Price of Ingenuity#286.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#287.src: So these two say up and down... over here it looks like a list...? Office, Workshop, Quarters, Workshop {~}, Roof Workshop... And why is there a lever? It's not even labeled.
The Price of Ingenuity#287.dst: Bu ikisinde yukarı ve aşağı yazıyor... şurası bir listeye benziyor...? Ofis, Atölye, Odalar, Atölye {~}, Çatı Atölyesi... Bir de neden şalter var? Üstünde yazı bile yok.
The Price of Ingenuity#287.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#288.src: Ugh, I can never figure out Roughworks machines. Always overly complicated...
The Price of Ingenuity#288.dst: Of, Roughworks makinelerini hiç çözemem. Hep gereğinden fazla karmaşık...
The Price of Ingenuity#288.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#289.src: Well, what about you? Any thoughts?
The Price of Ingenuity#289.dst: Peki ya sen? Bir fikrin var mı?
The Price of Ingenuity#289.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#290.src: Okay. Sure! As good a suggestion as any.
The Price of Ingenuity#290.dst: Tamam. Olur! Herhangi bir öneri kadar iyi.
The Price of Ingenuity#290.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#291.src: ...so, which one of these is up?
The Price of Ingenuity#291.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#292.src: Okay. Thanks for the input. I'm... not going to do that! That sounds like an awful idea- has Zeph been rubbing off on you?
The Price of Ingenuity#292.dst: Tamam. Fikrin için sağ ol. Ben... onu yapmayacağım! Berbat bir fikre benziyor- Zeph sana mı bulaştı?
The Price of Ingenuity#292.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#293.src: And I thought one of him was bad enough...
The Price of Ingenuity#293.dst: Bir tane Zeph yeterince kötü sanıyordum...
The Price of Ingenuity#293.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#294.src: Oh, whatever! Let's just try something.
The Price of Ingenuity#294.dst: Ah, boş ver! Bir şey deneyelim işte.
The Price of Ingenuity#294.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#298.src: That was... I don't want to talk about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#298.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#299.src: Wait! {u}, quietly, come look at this.
The Price of Ingenuity#299.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#300.src: Shoot, they're coming this way! Follow me!
The Price of Ingenuity#300.dst: Kahretsin, bu tarafa geliyorlar! Beni takip et!
The Price of Ingenuity#300.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#302.src: Approximately {~} of the input fuel energy is lost as heat. This results in a poor overall performance.
The Price of Ingenuity#302.dst: Yakıt enerjisinin yaklaşık {~} kadarı ısı olarak kaybolur. Bu da genel performansın düşük olmasına yol açar.

The Price of Ingenuity#307.src: N-O-O-O!!! Mother w-o-o-o-ould know what to do!
The Price of Ingenuity#307.speaker: Glitter

The Price of Ingenuity#309.src: Those "guards" don't seem very normal, do they? Isn't this supposed to be the Sovereign's mansion?
The Price of Ingenuity#309.dst: Şu "muhafızlar" pek normal görünmüyor, değil mi? Burası Hükümdar'ın malikânesi değil miydi?
The Price of Ingenuity#309.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#310.src: They didn't even see us... oh, whatever. Let's keep moving.
The Price of Ingenuity#310.dst: Bizi görmediler bile... ah, boş ver. Devam edelim.
The Price of Ingenuity#310.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#312.src: Why did you call me here again so soon? I was just here yesterday.
The Price of Ingenuity#312.dst: Beni neden bu kadar çabuk yine çağırdın? Daha dün buradaydım.
The Price of Ingenuity#312.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#313.src: Oh, don't play dumb! Dead soldiers! Killed on the job! Sound familiar??
The Price of Ingenuity#313.dst: Aa, aptalı oynama! Ölü askerler! Görev başında öldürülmüş! Tanıdık geliyor mu??
The Price of Ingenuity#313.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#315.src: Well, it better! Again - dead soldiers!! We had an agreement, Yus, and you've clearly gone and broken it!
The Price of Ingenuity#315.dst: Eh, gelse iyi olur! Tekrar ediyorum - ölü askerler!! Bir anlaşmamız vardı, Yus, ve sen apaçık onu bozdun!
The Price of Ingenuity#315.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#316.src: I- I know. And I'm sorry that it happened. But- it happened while I was here, working! What do you expect me to have done about it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#316.dst: B- biliyorum. Olanlar için de üzgünüm. Ama- ben buradayken, çalışırken oldu! Ne yapmamı bekliyordun ki?!
The Price of Ingenuity#316.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#317.src: Hmph! You're smart, aren't you? Smart enough to be able to grasp the fundamentals of conductivity and electrical currents! You could have found a way.
The Price of Ingenuity#317.dst: Hıh! Akıllısın, değil mi? İletkenliğin ve elektrik akımlarının temellerini kavrayacak kadar akıllısın! Bir yolunu bulabilirdin.
The Price of Ingenuity#317.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#318.src: It's such a shame... you were one of my favorites, Yus. And now you've really let me down.
The Price of Ingenuity#318.dst: Ne yazık... sen en sevdiklerimden biriydin, Yus. Şimdi ise beni gerçekten hayal kırıklığına uğrattın.
The Price of Ingenuity#318.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#319.src: ...I know. I- I'll find a way to fix it. Tell me what to do, and- and I can. Whatever I need to- so I can keep them safe- I'll, I'll do it.
The Price of Ingenuity#319.dst: ...biliyorum. B- bir çözüm bulurum. Ne yapmam gerektiğini söyle, ve- ve yaparım. Ne gerekiyorsa- onları güvende tutabilmek için- y- yaparım.
The Price of Ingenuity#319.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#320.src: Oh, Yus, you're so silly. There's nothing you can do to fix this now. The damage is done, and nobody around here will shut! Up! About it!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#320.dst: Ah, Yus, ne kadar da tatlısın. Bunu artık düzeltmek için yapabileceğin hiçbir şey yok. Olan oldu, ve buradaki hiç kimse bu konuda çenesini! Kapatmıyor!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#320.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#321.src: I let you live in that abandoned trainyard because I thought you'd be quiet. But this isn't quiet! I can't focus now that everyone is-
The Price of Ingenuity#321.dst: O terk edilmiş tren deposunda yaşamana sessiz durursun diye izin verdim. Ama bu sessizlik değil! Herkes bu kadar- yüzünden odaklanamıyorum-
The Price of Ingenuity#321.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#323.src: A GHO–O–O–OST! SPARKLES HEARD A GHO–O–O–O–OST! WHAT DO WE–E–E–E DO???
The Price of Ingenuity#323.dst: BİR HA–A–A–AYALET! SPARKLES BİR HA–A–A–A–AYALET DUYDU! NE YAPA–A–A–A–ALIM???
The Price of Ingenuity#323.speaker: Glitter

The Price of Ingenuity#324.src: Ugh! Not now!! Can't you see mommy's busy?!
The Price of Ingenuity#324.dst: Of! Şimdi değil!! Annenizin meşgul olduğunu görmüyor musunuz?!
The Price of Ingenuity#324.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#326.src: ...They'll be fine. I'll just bring them back later!
The Price of Ingenuity#326.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#327.src: You know, they've been getting better and better at replicating human behavior! My latest constructs were at an estimated {~} accuracy-
The Price of Ingenuity#327.dst: Biliyor musun, insan davranışını taklit etmede gittikçe daha iyi oluyorlar! Son yapılarımın isabeti tahminen {~} civarındaydı-
The Price of Ingenuity#327.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#329.src: Right! Here's what you can do for me, Yus. This isn't going to go away. I need someone to pin this on, so they'll all shut up and move on from it!
The Price of Ingenuity#329.dst: Doğru! Benim için yapabileceğin şu, Yus. Bu iş kendiliğinden geçmeyecek. Bunu birinin üstüne yıkmam lazım ki hepsi sussun ve unutsun!
The Price of Ingenuity#329.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#330.src: Especially that loudmouth from the north! Would it kill him to leave me alone and stop meddling in my business??
The Price of Ingenuity#330.dst: Özellikle de şu kuzeydeki geveze! Beni rahat bırakıp işlerime burnunu sokmayı bıraksa ölür mü??
The Price of Ingenuity#330.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#332.src: Don't answer that. Look, this is the only way. You need to hand over whoever is responsible for this whole thing. That's the only way we can keep our peace and keep being friends.
The Price of Ingenuity#332.dst: Cevap verme. Bak, tek yol bu. Bütün bu işten kim sorumluysa onu teslim etmen lazım. Barışımızı korumanın ve arkadaş kalmanın tek yolu bu.
The Price of Ingenuity#332.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#333.src: Wh- you can't be serious! I can't do that, Soosu! You- you really expect me to give up one of my friends or family?!
The Price of Ingenuity#333.dst: N- ciddi olamazsın! Bunu yapamam, Soosu! Sen- sen gerçekten dostlarımdan ya da ailemden birini sana teslim etmemi mi bekliyorsun?!
The Price of Ingenuity#333.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#334.src: No, Yus, what I expected from you was to keep your "friends and family" quiet! But we're past that point now. Something needs to happen.
The Price of Ingenuity#334.dst: Hayır, Yus, senden beklediğim "dostlarını ve aileni" sessiz tutmandı! Ama o noktayı çoktan geçtik. Bir şey olması lazım.
The Price of Ingenuity#334.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#335.src: I-... I understand. I need to think. I'll... I'll let you know soon.
The Price of Ingenuity#335.dst: B-... Anlıyorum. Düşünmem lazım. Ben... yakında sana haber veririm.
The Price of Ingenuity#335.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#336.src: What is he doing?! Sneaking around, meeting with the Sovereign?!
The Price of Ingenuity#336.dst: Ne yapıyor bu?! Gizli gizli dolaşıp Hükümdar'la mı görüşüyor?!
The Price of Ingenuity#336.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#337.src: We need to cut him off. I'm not letting him get away with this. Follow me, quickly!
The Price of Ingenuity#337.dst: Önünü kesmemiz lazım. Bunu yanına bırakmayacağım. Peşimden gel, çabuk!
The Price of Ingenuity#337.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#338.src: Come on! Let's see if we can cut him off before he enters the tunnel!
The Price of Ingenuity#338.dst: Hadi! Bakalım tünele girmeden önünü kesebilecek miyiz!
The Price of Ingenuity#338.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#340.src: Okay. This is as good a place as any to hide out and wait...
The Price of Ingenuity#340.dst: Tamam. Saklanıp beklemek için burası da iyi bir yer...
The Price of Ingenuity#340.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#341.src: I can't believe this! I can't believe him! How long has he been doing this?
The Price of Ingenuity#341.dst: İnanamıyorum! Ona inanamıyorum! Ne zamandır bunu yapıyor?
The Price of Ingenuity#341.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#342.src: I... uh, I'll see you guys later, I... guess.
The Price of Ingenuity#342.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#346.src: Not a word, Yusanu. You are in no position to be asking questions!
The Price of Ingenuity#346.dst: Tek kelime etme, Yusanu. Soru soracak durumda değilsin!
The Price of Ingenuity#346.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#347.src: Secretly meeting with the Sovereign? Really? Are you insane?!
The Price of Ingenuity#347.dst: Hükümdar'la gizli gizli görüşmek mi? Cidden mi? Aklını mı kaçırdın?!
The Price of Ingenuity#347.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#348.src: You- you... followed me... oh, no... no no no, no... you weren't seen, were you? You're going to ruin ev-
The Price of Ingenuity#348.dst: Siz- siz... beni takip ettiniz... olamaz... hayır hayır hayır, hayır... kimse sizi görmedi, değil mi? Her şeyi mahvedeceksiniz-
The Price of Ingenuity#348.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#349.src: We're going to ruin everything?! And not you, the guy always sneaking off to meet the Sovereign?!
The Price of Ingenuity#349.dst: Her şeyi biz mi mahvedeceğiz?! Sürekli gizlice Hükümdar'la görüşmeye giden sen değil de?!
The Price of Ingenuity#349.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#350.src: You don't understand! The only reason we're safe down there is BECAUSE I struck a deal with her!!
The Price of Ingenuity#350.dst: Anlamıyorsunuz! Aşağıda güvende olmamızın tek sebebi onunla anlaşma yapmış OLMAM!!
The Price of Ingenuity#350.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#352.src: I work as her assistant in her workshop, help her with whatever projects she's working on, and in exchange she allows us to live in the station!
The Price of Ingenuity#352.dst: Atölyesinde asistanı olarak çalışıyorum, üzerinde çalıştığı projelere yardım ediyorum, karşılığında da istasyonda yaşamamıza izin veriyor!
The Price of Ingenuity#352.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#353.src: As long as we don't cause any trouble with soldiers, at least- which, might I remind you, you people caused? So don't- don't act like...
The Price of Ingenuity#353.dst: Tabii askerlerle başımız derde girmediği sürece- ki, hatırlatayım, onu siz yaptınız? O yüzden- o yüzden sanki...
The Price of Ingenuity#353.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#354.src: Oh my god, you idiot. How long were you planning to keep this a secret? Were you ever going to tell anyone?
The Price of Ingenuity#354.dst: Aman tanrım, seni salak. Bunu ne kadar daha saklamayı düşünüyordun? Hiç kimseye söyleyecek miydin?
The Price of Ingenuity#354.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#356.src: You were just gonna let it sit until, inevitably , someone was going to piss off the soldiers? Because, trust me, that would have happened eventually. With or without us.
The Price of Ingenuity#356.dst: Kaçınılmaz olarak biri askerleri kızdırana kadar öylece bekleyecek miydin? Çünkü inan bana, eninde sonunda olacaktı. Biz olsak da olmasak da.
The Price of Ingenuity#356.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#357.src: Status: On Hold. She needs my attention elsewhere.
The Price of Ingenuity#357.dst: Durum: Beklemede. Başka bir yerde benim ilgime ihtiyacı var.

The Price of Ingenuity#359.src: Ack! You- you heard that part too?
The Price of Ingenuity#359.dst: Ah! Siz- siz o kısmı da mı duydunuz?
The Price of Ingenuity#359.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#361.src: Ughhh.... I don't know! I don't know. I don't want to, obviously! You're all good people, and it'd break every single one of our guidelines to throw someone out like that!
The Price of Ingenuity#361.dst: Offf.... Bilmiyorum! Bilmiyorum. Tabii ki istemiyorum! Hepiniz iyi insanlarsınız, birini böyle kapı dışarı etmek kurallarımızın her birine aykırı olur!
The Price of Ingenuity#361.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#362.src: But... I don't think I have a choice. The Steel Feather's safety is on the line, and I could fix it by just- just- handing someone over, but- I- I can't. I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#362.dst: Ama... başka seçeneğim olduğunu sanmıyorum. Steel Feather'ın güvenliği tehlikede, ve sadece- sadece- birini teslim ederek düzeltebilirim, ama- ben- yapamam. Bunu yapamam.
The Price of Ingenuity#362.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#364.src: Okay. You were doing what you thought was right. I can understand that. But this - keeping secrets, following their rules - it was never going to end well!
The Price of Ingenuity#364.dst: Tamam. Doğru olduğunu düşündüğün şeyi yapıyordun. Bunu anlayabilirim. Ama bu - sır saklamak, onların kurallarına uymak - asla iyi bitmeyecekti!
The Price of Ingenuity#364.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#365.src: We can get past this choice by doing what we were already doing - trying to take down the crown! If we succeed, there won't be any more risk for you all.
The Price of Ingenuity#365.dst: Zaten yaptığımız şeyi yaparak bu seçimden kurtulabiliriz - tacı devirmeye çalışarak! Başarırsak sizin için hiçbir tehlike kalmaz.
The Price of Ingenuity#365.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#367.src: This is your chance to make it right, Yusanu! You have information. Tell us what you and the Sovereign were working on. Is it important?
The Price of Ingenuity#367.dst: Bu, işleri düzeltme fırsatın, Yusanu! Elinde bilgi var. Hükümdar'la ne üzerinde çalıştığınızı anlat. Önemli bir şey mi?
The Price of Ingenuity#367.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#368.src: ...I don't know much about... what it is. I know it's not a weapon, at least- Soosu was clear on that. It's... an important assignment from the Queen.
The Price of Ingenuity#368.dst: ...ne olduğu hakkında... pek bir şey bilmiyorum. En azından silah olmadığını biliyorum- Soosu bu konuda netti. Kraliçe'den gelen... önemli bir görev.
The Price of Ingenuity#368.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#369.src: It's- it's strange. Very, very strange. It uses science that sounds... impossible. I think we're building over an existing device, something the Queen already had.
The Price of Ingenuity#369.dst: Bu- bu tuhaf. Çok, çok tuhaf. Kulağa... imkânsız gelen bir bilim kullanıyor. Sanırım var olan bir cihazın üzerine inşa ediyoruz, Kraliçe'nin zaten elinde olan bir şeyin.
The Price of Ingenuity#369.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#370.src: Soosu... she's stressed about the project. She needs to get it done, but it- it seems like an impossible task. There's something on the line for her.
The Price of Ingenuity#370.dst: Soosu... proje yüzünden gergin. Bitirmesi lazım ama- imkânsız bir iş gibi görünüyor. Onun için tehlikede olan bir şey var.
The Price of Ingenuity#370.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#371.src: ...mysterious device, important to the crown... got it. {u}, Yusanu- we need to steal it. If it's important to the crown... whatever it does, it's better if they don't have it.
The Price of Ingenuity#371.dst: ...gizemli bir cihaz, taç için önemli... anladım. {u}, Yusanu- onu çalmamız lazım. Taç için önemliyse... ne işe yararsa yarasın, onlarda olmaması daha iyi.
The Price of Ingenuity#371.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#372.src: Wh- what?! You can't be serious! We can't just-
The Price of Ingenuity#372.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#373.src: We can, and we should! The Sovereigns aren't your friends, Yusanu, they're complicit in and responsible for everything wrong with Fruma!!
The Price of Ingenuity#373.dst: Yapabiliriz, yapmalıyız da! Hükümdarlar senin dostun değil, Yusanu, Fruma'daki bütün kötülüklerin hem ortağı hem sorumlusu onlar!!
The Price of Ingenuity#373.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#374.src: If we can hurt them, then we can hurt the crown. And if we can hurt the crown... we might actually stand a chance.
The Price of Ingenuity#374.dst: Onlara zarar verebilirsek taca da zarar verebiliriz. Taca zarar verebilirsek de... belki gerçekten bir şansımız olur.
The Price of Ingenuity#374.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#375.src: ...okay. Okay, fine! You're right. You're... right.
The Price of Ingenuity#375.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#376.src: I can get you to it. Uh... how did you get in, anyway?
The Price of Ingenuity#376.dst: Sizi oraya götürebilirim. Şey... hem siz nasıl girdiniz ki?
The Price of Ingenuity#376.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#377.src: We'll show you. Come on, back in we go.
The Price of Ingenuity#377.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#380.dst: Soosu'nun atölyesine kadar Yusanu'yu takip et.

The Price of Ingenuity#381.src: Right, we'll need to be fast. Soosu tends to spend most of her time in the workshops...
The Price of Ingenuity#381.dst: Pekâlâ, hızlı olmamız lazım. Soosu zamanının çoğunu atölyelerde geçirir...
The Price of Ingenuity#381.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#383.src: I... would probably be fine. But if she sees you two, then...
The Price of Ingenuity#383.dst: Ben... muhtemelen bir şey olmaz. Ama sizi görürse, o zaman...
The Price of Ingenuity#383.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#384.src: So don't get caught, got it. I'm guessing we wouldn't stand a chance fighting her?
The Price of Ingenuity#384.dst: Yani yakalanmayacağız, anladım. Tahminim onunla dövüşsek hiç şansımız olmaz?
The Price of Ingenuity#384.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#385.src: No!! No, no, absolutely not. Her blessing... I haven't seen her use it in combat, but knowing what it can do...
The Price of Ingenuity#385.dst: Hayır!! Hayır, hayır, kesinlikle olmaz. Kutsamasını... dövüşte kullandığını hiç görmedim, ama neler yapabildiğini bilince...
The Price of Ingenuity#385.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#386.src: Being able to mold matter... it means more than just putting together machines. So...
The Price of Ingenuity#386.dst: Maddeyi şekillendirebilmek... sadece makine yapmak demek değil. Yani...
The Price of Ingenuity#386.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#387.src: It won't come to that. Come on, let's get going.
The Price of Ingenuity#387.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#388.src: The door to the workshop has already been unlocked...

The Price of Ingenuity#391.dst: Kuantum Yer Değiştirme Modülü - Araştırma Notları

The Price of Ingenuity#392.src: Alright, before we descend - Soosu has a bunch of golems walking around her workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#392.dst: Pekâlâ, aşağı inmeden önce - Soosu'nun atölyesinde dolaşan bir sürü golem var.
The Price of Ingenuity#392.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#393.src: They're more... uh, advanced than Sparkles and Glitter. If they see us, they'll sound the alarms. So don't get caught!
The Price of Ingenuity#393.dst: Sparkles ve Glitter'dan daha... şey, gelişmişler. Bizi görürlerse alarmı çalarlar. O yüzden yakalanmayın!
The Price of Ingenuity#393.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#394.src: How did you two even manage to find me?
The Price of Ingenuity#394.dst: Siz ikiniz beni nasıl buldunuz ki?
The Price of Ingenuity#394.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#395.src: Really? I'm... surprised the system held together long enough for that.
The Price of Ingenuity#395.dst: Gerçekten mi? Sistemin o kadar dayanmasına... şaşırdım.
The Price of Ingenuity#395.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#396.src: Look, it's not our fault this... thing doesn't come with an instruction manual!
The Price of Ingenuity#396.dst: Bak, bu... şeyin kullanım kılavuzuyla gelmemesi bizim suçumuz değil!
The Price of Ingenuity#396.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#397.src: Ha! Okay, it's a little hard to figure out. You have to pick the destination, then hit up or down, and then pull the lever to turn it on! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#397.dst: Ha! Tamam, çözmesi biraz zor. Önce hedefi seçiyorsun, sonra yukarı ya da aşağıya basıyorsun, sonra da çalıştırmak için şalteri çekiyorsun! Basit.
The Price of Ingenuity#397.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#398.src: That... sounds right, but the way you say that is concerning. What actually happened?
The Price of Ingenuity#398.dst: Bu... doğru gibi geliyor ama söyleyiş şeklin endişe verici. Gerçekte ne oldu?
The Price of Ingenuity#398.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#399.src: Ugh, it doesn't matter what happened. What matters is this stupid box is overly complicated and annoying!
The Price of Ingenuity#399.dst: Of, ne olduğu önemli değil. Önemli olan bu aptal kutunun gereksiz yere karmaşık ve sinir bozucu olması!
The Price of Ingenuity#399.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#400.src: Okay, okay! It is... a little hard to figure out. You have to pick the destination, then hit up or down, and then pull the lever to turn it on! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#400.dst: Tamam, tamam! Çözmesi... biraz zor. Önce hedefi seçiyorsun, sonra yukarı ya da aşağıya basıyorsun, sonra da çalıştırmak için şalteri çekiyorsun! Basit.
The Price of Ingenuity#400.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#401.src: ...I chose the music, by the way.
The Price of Ingenuity#401.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#403.src: Oh... I forgot how much of a mess it was down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#403.dst: Ah... aşağısının ne kadar dağınık olduğunu unutmuşum.
The Price of Ingenuity#403.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#404.src: Sneak through the mansion avoiding the guards.

The Price of Ingenuity#405.src: Alright! That's our goal, over there.
The Price of Ingenuity#405.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#406.src: It's the most important sector of Soosu's workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#406.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#407.src: Look around Soosu's workshop for the device.
The Price of Ingenuity#407.dst: Cihazı bulmak için Soosu'nun atölyesini ara.

The Price of Ingenuity#408.src: And you're sure she won't be coming down here?
The Price of Ingenuity#408.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#409.src: Uh... mostly. {~} sure. We should be fine today, if we move quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#409.dst: Şey... çoğunlukla. {~} eminim. Hızlı hareket edersek bugün sorun olmaz.
The Price of Ingenuity#409.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#411.src: The festival's coming up, so she has a lot to handle. She'll be busy cleaning up the other workshops, building whatever contraptions she needs for this year's festival... that sort of stuff.
The Price of Ingenuity#411.dst: Festival yaklaşıyor, o yüzden halletmesi gereken çok iş var. Diğer atölyeleri toparlamakla, bu yılki festival için gereken düzenekleri yapmakla meşgul olur... öyle şeyler.
The Price of Ingenuity#411.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#412.src: She only comes down here for the big projects. Well, or when she needs to let out some steam. But she doesn't have anything going on today, so... we're safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#412.dst: Buraya sadece büyük projeler için iner. Bir de stres atması gerektiğinde. Ama bugün bir işi yok, yani... güvendeyiz.
The Price of Ingenuity#412.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#413.src: ...if you say so, Yusanu. Still, I'd rather be out of here quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#413.dst: ...sen öyle diyorsan, Yusanu. Yine de buradan çabucak çıkmayı tercih ederim.
The Price of Ingenuity#413.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#414.src: Yeah... same. Let's take the device and go.
The Price of Ingenuity#414.dst: Evet... ben de. Cihazı alıp gidelim.
The Price of Ingenuity#414.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#415.src: This is Soosu's favorite room in the workshop. Her golem creation room.
The Price of Ingenuity#415.dst: Burası Soosu'nun atölyedeki en sevdiği oda. Golem yapım odası.
The Price of Ingenuity#415.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#416.src: She... told me once that she likes working with plants. It's why a lot of her golems are built off of flower pots and soil.
The Price of Ingenuity#416.dst: Bir keresinde... bitkilerle çalışmayı sevdiğini söylemişti. Golemlerinin çoğunun saksı ve topraktan yapılmasının sebebi bu.
The Price of Ingenuity#416.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#417.src: Hm. Well, good thing she's using her blessing on this, and not... I don't know. Reshaping the whole world?
The Price of Ingenuity#417.dst: Hmm. Eh, iyi ki kutsamasını bunun için kullanıyor da... ne bileyim. Bütün dünyayı yeniden şekillendirmek için değil?
The Price of Ingenuity#417.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#418.src: A-another golem? Should we turn back?
The Price of Ingenuity#418.dst: B-bir golem daha mı? Geri mi dönsek?
The Price of Ingenuity#418.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#419.src: Oh, hey, it's Flowers! That's Soosu's favourite golem! Wonder why he's sleeping here and not on his Flowersbed, though. ... I wasn't the one that named that.
The Price of Ingenuity#419.dst: Aa, bak, bu Flowers! Soosu'nun en sevdiği golem! Gerçi neden Flowersbed'inde değil de burada uyuyor, merak ettim. ... Adını ben koymadım bu arada.
The Price of Ingenuity#419.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#420.src: Finally!!! He said yes!!! Uncle T finally let me visit his workshop, I'm so excited!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#420.dst: Sonunda!!! Evet dedi!!! Tonton T sonunda atölyesine gelmeme izin verdi, çok heyecanlıyım!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#420.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#421.src: He's real!! Flowers is REAL NOW!!!! I showed Ma my drawing, and she helped me sew him together!! Now I can match with Fiona! She has Daruma, and I have... Flowers!
The Price of Ingenuity#421.dst: Gerçek oldu!! Flowers artık GERÇEK!!!! Anneme çizimimi gösterdim, onu dikmeme yardım etti!! Artık Fiona'yla aynıyız! Onun Daruma'sı var, benim de... Flowers'ım!
The Price of Ingenuity#421.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#422.src: Hmph. Hmph!!!!!!!! Fiona's old enough now, she's gotta work too... she's always so tired now, she won't play with me anymore!!!! This sucks. This sucks!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#422.dst: Hıh. Hıh!!!!!!!! Fiona artık büyüdü, onun da çalışması lazımmış... hep çok yorgun, artık benimle oynamıyor!!!! Bu berbat. Berbat!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#422.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#423.src: Uncle T agreed to help me make the super ultra cow milker o-matic!!
The Price of Ingenuity#423.dst: Tonton T süper ultra otomatik inek sağma makinesini yapmama yardım etmeyi kabul etti!!
The Price of Ingenuity#423.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#425.src: Grrrrrr............ I haven't written in AGES......... and it's because I gotta WORK!!!! In the FIELDS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#425.dst: Grrrrrr............ ÇOK UZUN zamandır yazmadım......... çünkü ÇALIŞMAM lazım!!!! TARLADA!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#425.speaker: 127 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#426.src: I've been READING!! Reading so so many books... about FARMING!
The Price of Ingenuity#426.dst: OKUYORUM!! Bir sürü bir sürü kitap okuyorum... ÇİFTÇİLİK hakkında!
The Price of Ingenuity#426.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#427.src: It's that time of year again!! The FESTIVAL OF THE CROWN!!! Just a week away!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#427.dst: Yılın o zamanı geldi yine!! TAÇ FESTİVALİ!!! Sadece bir hafta kaldı!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#427.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#428.src: Weird thing happened today. Uncle T came home with a strange man from the military, big ol fancy uniform and all!
The Price of Ingenuity#428.dst: Bugün tuhaf bir şey oldu. Tonton T ordudan garip bir adamla eve geldi, kocaman süslü üniformasıyla falan!
The Price of Ingenuity#428.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#429.src: It turns out, the Crown really liked my super duper farmer!! Cause it makes it easier to harvest crops and stuff, they want us to make more of them, so everyone can do their work faster!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#429.dst: Meğer Taç benim süper muhteşem çiftçimi çok beğenmiş!! Çünkü mahsul toplamayı falan kolaylaştırıyormuş, daha çok yapmamızı istiyorlar, herkes işini daha hızlı yapsın diye!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#429.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#430.src: Ugh...... ughhhhhhhh......... UGHHHHHHH...... I'm so TIRED!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#430.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#431.src: Uncle T got really hurt today. Really, really, really hurt.
The Price of Ingenuity#431.dst: Tonton T bugün çok kötü yaralandı. Çok, çok, çok kötü.
The Price of Ingenuity#431.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#432.src: Ma says Uncle T's gonna be okay. He will.
The Price of Ingenuity#432.dst: Annem Tonton T'nin iyileşeceğini söylüyor. İyileşecek.
The Price of Ingenuity#432.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#435.src: The Citadel was AWESOME!!! I've always dreamed of going up there, someday... and now I HAVE!!
The Price of Ingenuity#435.dst: Citadel MUHTEŞEMDİ!!! Hep bir gün oraya çıkmayı hayal ederdim... ve şimdi ÇIKTIM!!
The Price of Ingenuity#435.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#436.src: Work on project E-lec-tricity is ongoing (yes, the name changed... the Sovereign didn't like what I called it before...... bleh.), and it's going really well!!
The Price of Ingenuity#436.dst: E-lek-trik projesi üzerinde çalışmalar sürüyor (evet, adı değişti... Hükümdar önceki adını beğenmedi...... ıyy.), ve çok iyi gidiyor!!
The Price of Ingenuity#436.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#437.src: OKAY!!! DO NOT PANIC!!!! BUT THINGS! ARE! HAPPENING!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#437.dst: TAMAM!!! PANİK YAPMA!!!! AMA BİR ŞEYLER! OLUYOR!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#437.speaker: 130 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#439.src: Looking back at these entries, I... I feel hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#439.dst: Bu yazılara dönüp bakınca... içimde bir boşluk hissediyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#439.speaker: 3 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#440.src: Mother passed away from her illness, a few days ago. They knew it was coming for a while, apparently, but... it was still a shock.
The Price of Ingenuity#440.dst: Annem birkaç gün önce hastalığından öldü. Görünüşe göre bir süredir geleceğini biliyorlarmış, ama... yine de bir şok oldu.
The Price of Ingenuity#440.speaker: 4 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#441.src: What's the point in writing these, anymore? I don't know what to say. I could talk about my projects, about all the progress I've been making, but it all feels so hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#441.dst: Artık bunları yazmanın ne anlamı var? Ne diyeceğimi bilmiyorum. Projelerimden, kaydettiğim onca ilerlemeden bahsedebilirim, ama hepsi çok boş geliyor.
The Price of Ingenuity#441.speaker: 10 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#442.src: How many years has it been? I can check the dates, but... I don't want to.
The Price of Ingenuity#442.dst: Kaç yıl oldu? Tarihlere bakabilirim, ama... istemiyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#442.speaker: 40 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#443.src: Never forget, never stop creating, never give in!
The Price of Ingenuity#443.dst: Asla unutma, üretmeyi asla bırakma, asla pes etme!
The Price of Ingenuity#443.speaker: 45 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#444.src: And there it is... looking at it like this, it really is impressive.
The Price of Ingenuity#444.dst: İşte orada... böyle bakınca gerçekten etkileyici.
The Price of Ingenuity#444.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#445.src: Again, you really don't know what this is for? And more importantly, which of us will carry it out?
The Price of Ingenuity#445.dst: Yine soruyorum, bunun ne işe yaradığını gerçekten bilmiyor musun? Daha önemlisi, onu hangimiz dışarı taşıyacak?
The Price of Ingenuity#445.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#446.src: I'd say until we're in the clear, {u} should carry it. And no... I really, absolutely do not. Every time I've asked Soosu to elaborate, she's just blown me off.
The Price of Ingenuity#446.dst: Bence tehlikeden çıkana kadar {u} taşısın. Ve hayır... gerçekten, kesinlikle bilmiyorum. Soosu'ya her ayrıntı sorduğumda beni başından savdı.
The Price of Ingenuity#446.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#447.src: Well. Whatever this is, it can't be any good if the Crown wants it. {u}, are you ready?
The Price of Ingenuity#447.dst: Eh. Bu her neyse, Taç istiyorsa iyi bir şey olamaz. {u}, hazır mısın?
The Price of Ingenuity#447.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#448.src: Wait. Do you also hear that sound? Are those footsteps?
The Price of Ingenuity#448.dst: Dur. Sen de o sesi duyuyor musun? Ayak sesleri mi bunlar?
The Price of Ingenuity#448.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#449.src: Can't be anything else - and there's two pairs of them. So Soosu is here, but with whom...?
The Price of Ingenuity#449.dst: Başka bir şey olamaz - hem de iki kişi. Demek Soosu burada, ama kiminle...?
The Price of Ingenuity#449.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#450.src: ...are you sure this is the best idea? Dividing your attention between the discussion, and your...projects... It hasn't worked out in the past.
The Price of Ingenuity#450.dst: ...bunun en iyi fikir olduğundan emin misin? Dikkatini görüşmeyle... projelerin arasında bölmek... Geçmişte işe yaramadı.
The Price of Ingenuity#450.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#451.src: Well, you know, Zhiraok, not eeeveryone seems to have the time to drop everything and leave their region. Sometimes, we have a job to do.
The Price of Ingenuity#451.dst: Eh, bilirsin Zhiraok, heeerkesin her şeyi bırakıp bölgesinden ayrılacak vakti yok gibi. Bazen yapmamız gereken bir iş olur.
The Price of Ingenuity#451.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#452.src: Ah, there you are, Flowers! Wakey wakey, sleepyhead - you've got some guarding to get back to!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.dst: Ah, işte buradasın, Flowers! Uyan uyan, uykucu - nöbetine dönmen lazım!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#454.src: Awareness, Soosu! A bit of warning before you stop like that?
The Price of Ingenuity#454.dst: Dikkat, Soosu! Öyle aniden durmadan önce biraz haber versene?
The Price of Ingenuity#454.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#455.src: Hm? Ah, sorry, sorry, but an unexpected run-in with a close friend is just sooo nice! Surely there's space somewhere in your mind to know that, hmm?
The Price of Ingenuity#455.dst: Hm? Ah, pardon, pardon, ama yakın bir dostla beklenmedik karşılaşma çok güüüzel! Aklının bir köşesinde bunu bilecek yer vardır herhalde, hmm?
The Price of Ingenuity#455.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#456.src: Soosu... This is a solved problem! How many times have I told you that? ...Alright, look, that's a tangent. What I really need to tell you-
The Price of Ingenuity#456.dst: Soosu... Bu çözülmüş bir sorun! Sana kaç kere söyledim? ...Peki, bak, konu dağıldı. Sana asıl söylemem gereken-
The Price of Ingenuity#456.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#457.src: Escape the workshop without being spotted.

The Price of Ingenuity#458.src: Soosu's here? And with Zhiraok, of all people?! We have to get out, now!
The Price of Ingenuity#458.dst: Soosu burada mı? Hem de Zhiraok'la, onca insan arasından?! Hemen çıkmamız lazım!
The Price of Ingenuity#458.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#459.src: Yeah, but I bet Soosu's got Flowers on high alert! Don't use your magic, and whatever you do, don't get spotted!
The Price of Ingenuity#459.dst: Evet, ama bahse girerim Soosu Flowers'ı tam alarma geçirmiştir! Büyünü kullanma, ne yaparsan yap, sakın görünme!
The Price of Ingenuity#459.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#460.src: Wait- What's that, Flowers? Intruders?! Right by the device room?!
The Price of Ingenuity#460.dst: Dur- O ne, Flowers? Davetsiz misafirler mi?! Hem de cihaz odasının hemen yanında mı?!
The Price of Ingenuity#460.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#461.src: ...!! The Cursed!! You're not laying one digit on her, you hear me?!
The Price of Ingenuity#461.dst: ...!! Lanetli!! Ona tek bir parmağını bile süremezsin, duydun mu?!
The Price of Ingenuity#461.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#462.src: Wh-what the helix Infiltrators! You aren't getting away this time!
The Price of Ingenuity#462.dst: N-ne integrali bu Sızanlar! Bu sefer kaçamayacaksınız!
The Price of Ingenuity#462.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#463.src: Yusanu?! Who is that with you? Wait, are you trying to steal the device?!
The Price of Ingenuity#463.dst: Yusanu?! Yanındaki kim? Dur, yoksa cihazı çalmaya mı çalışıyorsun?!
The Price of Ingenuity#463.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#464.src: Hello, we're meant to run! Are you even taking this seriously?!
The Price of Ingenuity#464.dst: Alo, kaçmamız lazım! Bunu ciddiye alıyor musun sen?!
The Price of Ingenuity#464.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#465.src: ...you're smart enough that I shouldn't need to reiterate this! I know you are! Please, take the problem seriously!
The Price of Ingenuity#465.dst: ...bunu tekrarlamama gerek kalmayacak kadar akıllısın! Biliyorum ki öylesin! Lütfen, sorunu ciddiye al!
The Price of Ingenuity#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#466.src: A set of criminals is in your quadrant, the Cursed behind the Torann massacre is with them, they're infil-
The Price of Ingenuity#466.dst: Senin çeyreğinde bir grup suçlu var, Torann katliamının arkasındaki Lanetli de onlarla, sızıyorlar-
The Price of Ingenuity#466.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#467.src: Oh my god, Z, I get it!!! All you do is yap yap yap yap YAP!!! Give me some room to think!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#467.dst: Aman tanrım, Z, anladım!!! Tek yaptığın vır vır vır vır VIR!!! Biraz düşünmeme izin ver!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#467.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#468.src: Bla bla criminals, bla bla cursed one!!!! Yes, I know how important it is! Flowers, hold this steady for me, won't you?
The Price of Ingenuity#468.dst: Bla bla suçlular, bla bla lanetli!!!! Evet, ne kadar önemli olduğunu biliyorum! Flowers, şunu benim için sabit tutar mısın?
The Price of Ingenuity#468.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#469.src: As long as your focus is on the solutions, not your... But, Soosu, I haven't heard anything from you. There was key information I had to learn offhand!
The Price of Ingenuity#469.dst: Odak noktan senin şeylerin değil de çözümler olduğu sürece... Ama Soosu, senden hiçbir şey duymadım. Önemli bilgileri tesadüfen öğrenmek zorunda kaldım!
The Price of Ingenuity#469.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#470.src: One of your commanders summarized the topic for me. I should've heard it from you! So...what's your angle? It feels like you're ignoring the issue.
The Price of Ingenuity#470.dst: Komutanlarından biri konuyu bana özetledi. Bunu senden duymalıydım! Peki... açın ne? Sorunu görmezden geliyormuşsun gibi geliyor.
The Price of Ingenuity#470.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#471.src: ...Soosu? Soosu, are you listening? I asked you a question!
The Price of Ingenuity#471.dst: ...Soosu? Soosu, dinliyor musun? Sana bir soru sordum!
The Price of Ingenuity#471.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#472.src: Hm? Yeah, yeah, sure. Hey, could you fetch me some bolts?
The Price of Ingenuity#472.dst: Hm? Evet, evet, tabii. Hey, bana birkaç cıvata getirir misin?
The Price of Ingenuity#472.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#473.src: ...fine, sure- But please, we have to round this out, Soosu. You have to get involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#473.dst: ...peki, tamam- Ama lütfen, bunu bir sonuca bağlamamız lazım, Soosu. İşin içine girmen lazım.
The Price of Ingenuity#473.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#475.src: Oh, right, about Flowers. Could you go check if his body picked up any parts while walking that I could use?
The Price of Ingenuity#475.dst: Ah, doğru, Flowers hakkında. Yürürken gövdesine kullanabileceğim bir parça takılmış mı, bakar mısın?
The Price of Ingenuity#475.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#477.src: I knew letting you work in here was irrational. There's such a greater sum of problems than your toys! You're acting like a child, but you aren't one!
The Price of Ingenuity#477.dst: Burada çalışmana izin vermenin irrasyonel olduğunu biliyordum. Oyuncaklarından çok daha büyük bir sorunlar toplamı var! Çocuk gibi davranıyorsun, ama çocuk değilsin!
The Price of Ingenuity#477.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#478.src: I know you can do such good work if you just apply yourself! Why are you just ignoring a high-ranking defector and a Cursed exponentiating each others' threat?!
The Price of Ingenuity#478.dst: Kendini verirsen çok iyi işler çıkarabileceğini biliyorum! Neden üst düzey bir hain ve bir Lanetli birbirlerinin tehdidini katlarken görmezden geliyorsun?!
The Price of Ingenuity#478.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#480.src: Do you think you're better than me, Zhiraok?
The Price of Ingenuity#480.dst: Benden üstün olduğunu mu sanıyorsun, Zhiraok?
The Price of Ingenuity#480.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#481.src: Oh, look at Soosu, always so inattentive and clueless, always ignoring the needs of her district, always cooped up in her laboratory.
The Price of Ingenuity#481.dst: Aa, şu Soosu'ya bakın, hep dalgın ve bihaber, bölgesinin ihtiyaçlarını hep görmezden gelir, hep laboratuvarına kapanır.
The Price of Ingenuity#481.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#482.src: Who even cares about the work she does? The projects she's assigned?! Who even cares that she knows, she knows, she KNOWS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#482.dst: Yaptığı iş kimin umurunda ki? Verilen projeler?! Bildiği, bildiği, BİLDİĞİ kimin umurunda!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#482.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#483.src: ...Hm! Maybe you are better, Z. If you weren't, maybe we wouldn't be here right now!!
The Price of Ingenuity#483.dst: ...Hm! Belki de gerçekten üstünsün, Z. Olmasaydın belki şu an burada olmazdık!!
The Price of Ingenuity#483.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#484.src: I... ... ...I'm sorry Soosu. That...that wasn't my angle, I didn't mean t-
The Price of Ingenuity#484.dst: Ben... ... ...Özür dilerim, Soosu. Benim... açım bu değildi, öyle demek iste-
The Price of Ingenuity#484.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#485.src: But you did! Hand me cog C-{~}, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#485.dst: Ama öyle dedin! C-{~} dişlisini uzatır mısın?
The Price of Ingenuity#485.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#486.src: ...alright. I just want to reach the end of this sequence as fast as possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#486.dst: ...peki. Sadece bu dizinin sonuna olabildiğince çabuk ulaşmak istiyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#486.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#487.src: That makes two of us. I'm working on it. You can stop bugging me about it!!
The Price of Ingenuity#487.dst: İkimiz de öyle. Üzerinde çalışıyorum. Bu konuda başımın etini yemeyi bırakabilirsin!!
The Price of Ingenuity#487.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#488.src: ...maybe I should've been paying more attention. I didn't realize her project was putting so much weight on your shoulders. And I promised to help, too...
The Price of Ingenuity#488.dst: ...belki daha dikkatli olmalıydım. Onun projesinin omuzlarına bu kadar yük bindirdiğini fark etmemiştim. Hem de yardım edeceğime söz vermiştim...
The Price of Ingenuity#488.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#489.src: Preliminary results suggest significantly improved utilization of energy, and reduced pollution. (Cleaner air? May help.)
The Price of Ingenuity#489.dst: İlk sonuçlar enerjinin çok daha verimli kullanıldığını ve kirliliğin azaldığını gösteriyor. (Daha temiz hava? İşe yarayabilir.)

The Price of Ingenuity#491.src: Return to the Steel Feather through Yusanu's tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#492.src: ...what was that?! What were they DOING there?!
The Price of Ingenuity#492.dst: ...o neydi öyle?! Onların orada ne İŞİ vardı?!
The Price of Ingenuity#492.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#493.src: I- I- I don't know! A surprise visit? I didn't... I didn't think...
The Price of Ingenuity#493.dst: B- b- bilmiyorum! Sürpriz bir ziyaret mi? Ben... aklıma gelmedi...
The Price of Ingenuity#493.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#494.src: So, "letting off some steam", huh?! Oh, sure, bring Sovereign Zhiraok along with you!! Why not!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#494.dst: Demek "stres atmak", ha?! Ah, tabii, yanında Hükümdar Zhiraok'u da getir!! Neden olmasın!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#494.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#495.src: We almost got caught! We- oh god, we... we almost got caught...
The Price of Ingenuity#495.dst: Az kalsın yakalanıyorduk! Biz- tanrım, biz... az kalsın yakalanıyorduk...
The Price of Ingenuity#495.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#496.src: ...what are we doing? Why did- why did we do that? That was so...
The Price of Ingenuity#496.dst: ...ne yapıyoruz biz? Neden- neden bunu yaptık? Çok...
The Price of Ingenuity#496.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#497.src: You're asking ME?! Yeah, Rex, why did we do that?!
The Price of Ingenuity#497.dst: BANA mı soruyorsun?! Evet, Rex, neden bunu yaptık?!
The Price of Ingenuity#497.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#498.src: Stop. Just... stop, for a second. I need to... think.
The Price of Ingenuity#498.dst: Dur. Sadece... bir saniye dur. Düşünmem... lazım.
The Price of Ingenuity#498.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#499.src: ...damn it. Damn it, damn it, damn it! Stupid, impulsive... ugh!!
The Price of Ingenuity#499.dst: ...kahretsin. Kahretsin, kahretsin, kahretsin! Aptal, düşüncesiz... of!!
The Price of Ingenuity#499.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#501.src: No, I... I'm not. I'm sorry, I- I should know better by now...
The Price of Ingenuity#501.dst: Hayır, ben... iyi değilim. Özür dilerim, b- bunu artık öğrenmiş olmam lazım...
The Price of Ingenuity#501.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#502.src: It... doesn't matter. It's too late to take it back. We can... we can use it as a trump card. Yusanu, please tell me you can figure out what it is.
The Price of Ingenuity#502.dst: Bu... önemli değil. Geri almak için çok geç. Onu... onu koz olarak kullanabiliriz. Yusanu, lütfen ne olduğunu çözebileceğini söyle.
The Price of Ingenuity#502.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#503.src: I... I don't know. I never got to work too closely with it, so... I have no idea what it is. If I work with it, maybe I can get somewhere. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#503.dst: Ben... bilmiyorum. Onunla hiç çok yakından çalışmadım, yani... ne olduğu hakkında hiçbir fikrim yok. Üzerinde çalışırsam belki bir yere varırım. Ama...
The Price of Ingenuity#503.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#504.src: Good enough, I guess. Come on, let's get back. I need to... find Mora. And you need to tell everyone what you've been up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#504.dst: Yeterli, herhalde. Hadi, geri dönelim. Benim... Mora'yı bulmam lazım. Senin de herkese neler çevirdiğini anlatman lazım.
The Price of Ingenuity#504.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#505.src: You collectively decide that leaving Flowers be is probably best for everyone involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#505.dst: Flowers'ı rahat bırakmanın herkes için en iyisi olduğuna hep birlikte karar veriyorsunuz.

The Price of Ingenuity#506.src: These vents are broken, and were blocked off for a reason. Proceeding further will be dangerous!
The Price of Ingenuity#506.dst: Bu havalandırmalar bozuk ve bir sebepten kapatılmış. Daha ileri gitmek tehlikeli olacak!

The Price of Ingenuity#507.src: ...so just hiding what we did today isn't an option?
The Price of Ingenuity#507.dst: ...yani bugün yaptığımızı saklamak seçenek değil mi?
The Price of Ingenuity#507.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#508.src: And let it come back to bite us later down the line? No thanks. Let's go.
The Price of Ingenuity#508.dst: Sonra dönüp başımıza bela olsun diye mi? Yok, sağ ol. Hadi gidelim.
The Price of Ingenuity#508.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#509.src: Really, Rex, are you... alright? I don't think I've ever seen-
The Price of Ingenuity#509.dst: Cidden, Rex, sen... iyi misin? Seni hiç böyle gördüğümü-
The Price of Ingenuity#509.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#510.src: Don't. Don't push it. Not right now.
The Price of Ingenuity#510.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#511.src: Hey! You three, where the heck have you been all day?!
The Price of Ingenuity#511.dst: Hey! Siz üçünüz, bütün gün neredeydiniz be?!
The Price of Ingenuity#511.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#513.src: Yes, it's rather curious! I happened to speak to Syndra, and apparently there were no such "important tasks" assigned to you! She seemed rather clueless about the whole matter!
The Price of Ingenuity#513.dst: Evet, epey merak uyandırıcı! Syndra ile konuşma fırsatım oldu, görünüşe bakılırsa size öyle "önemli işler" falan verilmemiş! Bütün meseleden pek bihaber görünüyordu!
The Price of Ingenuity#513.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#515.src: You know what happened, Mora. I- I messed up. Again.
The Price of Ingenuity#515.dst: Ne olduğunu biliyorsun, Mora. B- ben batırdım. Yine.
The Price of Ingenuity#515.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#516.src: Huh? What do you mean, agai-
The Price of Ingenuity#516.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#517.src: Ah, Yuman, would you mind taking Yusanu along with you to go tell the others we'll be a little late to the meeting? I believe there will be some additional news today.
The Price of Ingenuity#517.dst: Ah, Yuman, Yusanu'yu da yanına alıp diğerlerine toplantıya biraz geç kalacağımızı söyler misin? Sanırım bugün bazı ek haberler olacak.
The Price of Ingenuity#517.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#518.src: Uh... sure, I guess. Yus, can you tell me what's up while we walk?
The Price of Ingenuity#518.dst: Şey... tabii, herhalde. Yus, yürürken neler olduğunu anlatır mısın?
The Price of Ingenuity#518.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#521.src: It's... bad. We stole something important from the Sovereign's workshop. It's... a long story. Yusanu should tell his part of it. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#521.dst: Kötü... Hükümdar'ın atölyesinden önemli bir şey çaldık. Uzun... hikâye. Yusanu kendi kısmını anlatsın. Ama...
The Price of Ingenuity#521.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#522.src: I see. I apologize, Rex, I should have been more attentive.
The Price of Ingenuity#522.dst: Anlıyorum. Özür dilerim, Rex, daha dikkatli olmalıydım.
The Price of Ingenuity#522.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#523.src: No! No, it's not your fault, I should have- I should have known I was being impulsive, I... I wasn't thinking straight.
The Price of Ingenuity#523.dst: Hayır! Hayır, senin suçun değil, ben- düşüncesizce davrandığımı fark etmeliydim, ben... aklım başımda değildi.
The Price of Ingenuity#523.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#524.src: Ah. Of course, you don't know. I should have informed you the last time this happened...
The Price of Ingenuity#524.dst: Ah. Tabii ya, sen bilmiyorsun. Geçen sefer bu olduğunda sana haber vermeliydim...
The Price of Ingenuity#524.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#525.src: Rex has these... ah, "moods," sometimes, wherein she gets... overly excitable and impulsive. Many a time have they led her into trouble.
The Price of Ingenuity#525.dst: Rex'in bazen... ah, "hâlleri" olur, o zamanlar... aşırı heyecanlı ve düşüncesiz olur. Bu hâller onu pek çok kez başını belaya soktu.
The Price of Ingenuity#525.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#526.src: Ugh, I should know better by now! Especially here, especially now, when...
The Price of Ingenuity#526.dst: Of, bunu artık öğrenmiş olmam lazım! Hele burada, hele şimdi, tam da...
The Price of Ingenuity#526.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#527.src: Well, what is done is done, and nevertheless, we must press on. Let's join the others for the meeting. Syndra has something important to tell us.
The Price of Ingenuity#527.dst: Eh, olan oldu, ne olursa olsun devam etmeliyiz. Toplantı için diğerlerine katılalım. Syndra'nın bize söyleyeceği önemli bir şey var.
The Price of Ingenuity#527.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#528.src: Attend the meeting in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#529.src: There you are! Mora, Rex, what's going-
The Price of Ingenuity#529.dst: İşte buradasınız! Mora, Rex, neler oluyor-
The Price of Ingenuity#529.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#530.src: Syndra, I believe that can wait. We've, ah, held up dinner long enough, I believe. If everyone is here, we should begin. First- Yusanu, what was it you had to tell us?
The Price of Ingenuity#530.dst: Syndra, sanırım o bekleyebilir. Akşam yemeğini, ah, yeterince geciktirdik bence. Herkes buradaysa başlayalım. Önce- Yusanu, bize ne söyleyecektin?
The Price of Ingenuity#530.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#531.src: ...sigh. Before I begin, I need to make it clear- I was doing what I thought was best for the Steel Feather.
The Price of Ingenuity#531.dst: ...of. Başlamadan önce şunu açıkça söylemeliyim- Steel Feather için en iyisi olduğunu düşündüğüm şeyi yapıyordum.
The Price of Ingenuity#531.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#532.src: Yeah, man, good start... really instills confidence.
The Price of Ingenuity#532.dst: Evet, dostum, güzel başlangıç... insana gerçekten güven veriyor.
The Price of Ingenuity#532.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#533.src: Yuman, please... let me get through this. Don't interrupt.
The Price of Ingenuity#533.dst: Yuman, lütfen... bitirmeme izin ver. Sözümü kesme.
The Price of Ingenuity#533.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#534.src: So. So, so,so... The... the reason the crown has left us alone down here is because I have been working with Sovereign Soosu.
The Price of Ingenuity#534.dst: Şey. Şey, şey, şey... Tacın... tacın bizi burada rahat bırakmasının sebebi Hükümdar Soosu ile çalışıyor olmam.
The Price of Ingenuity#534.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#537.src: The reason we've been able to stay under the radar for so long is because of this, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#537.dst: Bu kadar uzun süre gözden uzak kalabilmemizin sebebi bu, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#537.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#538.src: The reason we can live here, leave our home, make use of the city's electricity... it's because of my collaboration.
The Price of Ingenuity#538.dst: Burada yaşayabilmemizin, evimizden ayrılabilmemizin, şehrin elektriğini kullanabilmemizin... sebebi benim bu işbirliğim.
The Price of Ingenuity#538.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#539.src: She said she saw potential in me. Told me that if I helped her in her workshops, then... then you all would be safe down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#539.dst: Bende potansiyel gördüğünü söyledi. Atölyelerinde ona yardım edersem... hepinizin aşağıda güvende olacağını söyledi.
The Price of Ingenuity#539.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#540.src: I didn't tell anybody because I knew you wouldn't get it. You'd think it was stupid, and risky, and a bad idea. Working with... with someone responsible for our problems.
The Price of Ingenuity#540.dst: Kimseye söylemedim çünkü anlamayacağınızı biliyordum. Aptalca, riskli, kötü bir fikir derdiniz. Sorunlarımızdan sorumlu biriyle... çalışmak.
The Price of Ingenuity#540.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#541.src: And I knew it was risky. I did. But I thought that if I were to mess up, only I would be punished. You all would be safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#541.dst: Riskli olduğunu da biliyordum. Gerçekten. Ama bir hata yaparsam sadece benim cezalandırılacağımı düşündüm. Siz güvende olurdunuz.
The Price of Ingenuity#541.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#542.src: ...now. I understand emotions are running high right now. I would ask everyone to take a step back, think through it logically, and remain c-
The Price of Ingenuity#542.dst: ...şimdi. Duyguların şu an yüksek olduğunu anlıyorum. Herkesten bir adım geri çekilmesini, mantıkla düşünmesini ve sakin kal-
The Price of Ingenuity#542.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#543.src: Are you insane, Yusanu?! Of all the secrets you could have been keeping-
The Price of Ingenuity#543.dst: Aklını mı kaçırdın, Yusanu?! Saklayabileceğin onca sır varken-
The Price of Ingenuity#543.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#545.src: No, I don't think I will! Is that what the alarms were about? How long has this been going on? What was running through your head when you decided-
The Price of Ingenuity#545.dst: Hayır, bırakmayacağım! Alarmlar bu yüzden miydi? Ne zamandır sürüyor bu? Karar verirken kafanda ne geçiyordu-
The Price of Ingenuity#545.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#546.src: As if you haven't been doing the same thing this whole time! Trying to put all the weight on your own shoulders, not getting help from anyone else!!
The Price of Ingenuity#546.dst: Sanki sen bunca zamandır aynı şeyi yapmıyormuşsun gibi! Bütün yükü kendi omuzlarına almaya çalışıyorsun, kimseden yardım almıyorsun!!
The Price of Ingenuity#546.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#547.src: So- so, y'know, I'm a little mad. He should have talked to us about it! But... he's telling us now. He's asking for help now.
The Price of Ingenuity#547.dst: Yani- yani, bilirsin, biraz kızgınım. Bunu bizimle konuşmalıydı! Ama... şimdi anlatıyor. Şimdi yardım istiyor.
The Price of Ingenuity#547.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#549.dst: Ne yazık ki daha da kötüsü var.
The Price of Ingenuity#549.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#551.src: After yesterday's run-in with the soldiers... Soosu is demanding I hand over whoever's responsible. I... I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#551.dst: Dün askerlerle yaşanan olaydan sonra... Soosu kim sorumluysa onu teslim etmemi istiyor. Ben... bunu yapamam.
The Price of Ingenuity#551.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#552.src: Rex and {u} caught me talking to her today. That's why... that's why I'm telling you.
The Price of Ingenuity#552.dst: Rex ve {u} bugün beni onunla konuşurken yakaladı. Bu yüzden... bu yüzden size anlatıyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#552.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#553.src: ...yeah. I convinced him to stop working with her, and to tell you all about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#553.dst: ...evet. Onunla çalışmayı bırakmaya ve hepinize anlatmaya ikna ettim.
The Price of Ingenuity#553.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#554.src: We also... stole an important gadget she and Yusanu were working on. Something the Queen was very invested in.
The Price of Ingenuity#554.dst: Bir de... onunla Yusanu'nun üzerinde çalıştığı önemli bir aleti çaldık. Kraliçe'nin çok önem verdiği bir şeyi.
The Price of Ingenuity#554.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#555.src: I don't know what it is or what it does. I don't know what it's for. All I know is that the Queen needs it finished. It's all she's had Soosu working on for... months.
The Price of Ingenuity#555.dst: Ne olduğunu da, ne yaptığını da bilmiyorum. Ne işe yaradığını bilmiyorum. Tek bildiğim, Kraliçe'nin onun bitmesine ihtiyacı olduğu. Soosu'yu... aylardır sadece bununla uğraştırıyor.
The Price of Ingenuity#555.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#556.src: I'll try to figure out what it is in my spare time. Maybe it'll help us! I... hope it will.
The Price of Ingenuity#556.dst: Boş vakitlerimde ne olduğunu çözmeye çalışacağım. Belki bize yardımı dokunur! Ben... öyle umuyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#556.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#557.src: Yulie, Yuman... I owe you a better apology. I can talk to you in private later, but... right now, we should continue with the meeting.
The Price of Ingenuity#557.dst: Yulie, Yuman... size daha düzgün bir özür borçluyum. Sonra sizinle baş başa konuşabilirim, ama... şimdi toplantıya devam etmeliyiz.
The Price of Ingenuity#557.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#559.src: ...that was certainly a lot. Fortunately, angering the Sovereign may not ultimately matter. If all goes according to plan... the crown will fall at the end of the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#559.dst: ...epey bir şeydi bu. Neyse ki Hükümdar'ı kızdırmak sonunda önemli olmayabilir. Her şey plana göre giderse... taç festivalin sonunda düşecek.
The Price of Ingenuity#559.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#560.src: My goal, as always, has been to find a way to destroy the crown's influence and to free our province. I believe this upcoming festival is an opportunity to do just that.
The Price of Ingenuity#560.dst: Amacım her zamanki gibi tacın etkisini yok etmenin ve eyaletimizi özgürleştirmenin bir yolunu bulmaktı. Yaklaşan festivalin tam da bunun için bir fırsat olduğuna inanıyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#560.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#561.src: During the Crown Festival, Her Majesty will die.
The Price of Ingenuity#561.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#562.src: Settle down, everyone, settle down! Please, allow Syndra to continue.
The Price of Ingenuity#562.dst: Sakin olun, herkes, sakin olun! Lütfen, Syndra devam etsin.
The Price of Ingenuity#562.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#563.src: It will not be easy. But if we strike when her guard is down, and catch her by surprise, I believe it is possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#563.dst: Kolay olmayacak. Ama gardı düşükken saldırır ve onu gafil avlarsak bunun mümkün olduğuna inanıyorum.
The Price of Ingenuity#563.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#564.src: I'll be splitting you all into several groups, and will assign tasks that must be completed before the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#564.dst: Sizi birkaç gruba ayıracağım ve festivalden önce tamamlanması gereken görevler vereceğim.
The Price of Ingenuity#564.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#565.src: The decision Quill and I have come to is that I alone will be going for the kill. That way, if anything goes wrong... no one else faces the consequences.
The Price of Ingenuity#565.dst: Quill ile vardığımız karar şu: öldürme işini yalnızca ben yapacağım. Böylece bir şeyler ters giderse... sonuçlarına başka kimse katlanmaz.
The Price of Ingenuity#565.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#566.src: I'll go over the details tomorrow. I think... we've had enough excitement today. Please, hold your complaints until then, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#566.dst: Ayrıntıları yarın anlatacağım. Bence... bugünlük bu kadar heyecan yeter. Lütfen şikâyetlerinizi de o zamana kadar saklayın.
The Price of Ingenuity#566.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#567.src: Ahem. Yes, indeed. I suppose we should be getting to dinner, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#567.dst: Öhöm. Evet, kesinlikle. Sanırım biz de akşam yemeğine geçsek iyi olur.
The Price of Ingenuity#567.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#568.src: Yuman... this may be unfair of me to ask, but would you be willing to play us a song tonight? We will not have many days left together.
The Price of Ingenuity#568.dst: Yuman... bunu istemem haksızlık olabilir ama bu gece bize bir şarkı çalar mısın? Birlikte çok günümüz kalmadı.
The Price of Ingenuity#568.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#569.src: Yeah... yeah, man, of course. I can do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#569.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#570.src: Then let us enjoy the remainder of our company!
The Price of Ingenuity#570.dst: O hâlde birlikteliğimizin geri kalanının tadını çıkaralım!
The Price of Ingenuity#570.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#572.src: Hey, everyone! Man, uh... small crowd today, huh?
The Price of Ingenuity#572.dst: Selam, millet! Dostum, şey... bugün kalabalık az, ha?
The Price of Ingenuity#572.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#573.src: Oh, man, is that Jiro I see? Hey, man! I didn't, uh... expect to see ya.
The Price of Ingenuity#573.dst: Ah, dostum, o gördüğüm Jiro mu? Selam, dostum! Şey... seni görmeyi beklemiyordum.
The Price of Ingenuity#573.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#575.src: Uh, just, you didn't seem super happy with me after... after yesterday. With the- soldier thing.
The Price of Ingenuity#575.dst: Şey, sadece, dünkü... dünkü şeyden sonra bana pek memnun görünmüyordun. Şu- asker meselesi.
The Price of Ingenuity#575.speaker: Yuman
